article.articleHeadline: 中秋教師節連假將至　關務署嚴防豬瘟入境 | 中華日報|中華新聞雲
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mid-Autumn Festival and Teachers' Day holiday approaching; Customs Administration tightens measures to prevent African Swine Fever from entering the country
article.articleSummary: Taiwan's Customs Administration, ahead of the Mid-Autumn Festival and Teachers' Day holidays, tightened border controls to prevent African Swine Fever (ASF) from entering the country. With expected travel surges, travelers are warned not to bring or mail pork products such as mooncakes, ham, sausages, or pork-based baked goods, and not to order overseas meat products online. As ASF outbreaks persist internationally, including a July ASF occurrence in Finland, authorities continue X-ray screening of luggage, express shipments, and mail from high-risk regions. By Sept 10, customs had seized 697 pork-containing items totaling 494 kg, mostly from Mainland China (including Hong Kong and Macau), with items like pork ham, sausages, pork tendons, mooncakes, and zongzi. Penalties for violations start at NT$200,000, rising to NT$1,000,000 for successive offenses. For guidance, consult the APHIA website’s traveler section or call 0800-039131.

triage.headline_ja: 中秋節・教師節連休を前に、関税局がアフリカ豚熱の侵入防止を強化
triage.triage_reason: 動物疾病（アフリカ豚熱）に関する台湾税関の定例的な検疫強化の記事であり、ヒトへの公衆衛生上の脅威はなく、新規性・異常性も低い。
triage.notes: ASFは動物（豚）の疾病でヒトに感染しない。記事は台湾税関の連休前の検疫強化措置についての内容で、フィンランドでの7月の発生や中国本土からの密輸押収品への言及はあるが、これらは背景情報であり記事の主題として明確な発生国とは言えない。台湾・フィンランドは対象国リストに含まれず、中国本土での発生自体を報じているわけではないため verified_locations は空とした。

article.articleHeadline: Mengurai Pemicu Lonjakan Influenza A pada Anak Saat Kemarau
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Unraveling the Triggers Behind the Surge of Influenza A in Children During the Dry Season
article.articleSummary: Influenza A infections in children are rising at major Indonesian hospitals during the dry season, prompting concern over pediatric admissions. Indonesian Pediatric Society reports rising flu admissions, though national data show no sharp rise. Western Pacific WHO data through Sept 10, 2026 indicate uptick dominated by Influenza A, with Singapore showing a sharp increase. Nearby countries also trend up; Laos remains stable. At Indonesian referral centers, about 5% of influenza cases require hospitalization, with 80% of these patients under 2 years and half under 6 months. Complications are mainly bronchopneumonia or pneumonia; neurologic complications are rare (~0.2% or 4 per 100,000). Vaccination offers 40–60% protection against A and B and should start at 6 months, with antibodies developing after ~2 weeks. The dry season is not a cause; crowded spaces and pollution may heighten risk. Parents should monitor activity, hydration, urine output, and seek care for breathing difficulty or seizures.

triage.headline_ja: 乾季における小児インフルエンザA急増の要因を解説
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザAの通常の増加を解説する啓発記事であり、異常性や国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限等の懸念は認められない。
triage.notes: 記事は季節性インフルエンザAの通常の増加を解説する内容で、全国データでは急増は見られないとされている。乳児での入院率や合併症について言及があるが、通常の季節性パターンの範囲内であり緊急性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: Lingering Dengue NS1 Antigen Complicates Diagnosis of Visceral
article.articleSummary: 23-year-old migrant worker from Dang district, Nepal, who had worked in Malaysia, presented with prolonged fever after an initial positive dengue NS1 test in Malaysia. Dengue fever persisted, but dengue NS1 antigenemia continued as he returned to Nepal. In India, clinicians evaluated for hematologic malignancy given fever, splenomegaly/hepatomegaly and pancytopenia, delaying VL diagnosis. Visceral leishmaniasis (Leishmania donovani) was eventually diagnosed; dengue NS1 remained detectable, an unusual persistence. Treatment with six doses of liposomal amphotericin B failed, followed by relapse. Serial testing showed dengue NS1, IgM, IgG becoming negative, revealing that dengue infection had resolved; active visceral leishmaniasis persisted and was then successfully treated with miltefosine. This case, reported in BMC Infectious Diseases, highlights how coinfection and altered immune response can obscure diagnosis: dengue and visceral leishmaniasis may influence each other’s test kinetics and clinical presentation, with imported VL cases into South Asia at risk for misdiagnosis.

triage.headline_ja: 残存するデング熱NS1抗原が内臓リーシュマニア症の診断を複雑にする
triage.triage_reason: 単一症例に関する診断上の課題を報告した医学論文であり、アウトブレイクや公衆衛生上の異常事態を示すものではない。
triage.notes: 移民労働者1名の症例報告であり、デング熱と内臓リーシュマニア症の重複感染による診断遅延について学術的知見を示す内容。集団発生や公衆衛生上の脅威を示す情報はない。ネパール・マレーシア・インドが関与するが、いずれも対象国での流行発生を示すものではなく、医療機関での個別症例対応に留まる。

article.articleHeadline: 市疾控中心提醒：秋季警惕孩子感染水痘 _新闻频道_厦门网
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: City CDC reminds: Be vigilant for chickenpox in children this autumn.
article.articleSummary: Xiamen City CDC warns to be vigilant for chickenpox (varicella) in autumn, a peak period for respiratory infections in schools. Varicella is caused by varicella-zoster virus, with an average 14-day incubation. The rash progresses through macule, papule, vesicle, and crust stages, often starting on the trunk and face; simultaneous red patches, blisters, and crusts on one area strongly suggests chickenpox. Vaccination with the live attenuated varicella vaccine is a key preventive measure; China CDC 2026 guidance recommends two doses for susceptible individuals aged 12 months and older. After exposure, vaccination can prevent disease in those without prior infection; timing and suitability should be assessed by vaccination clinics considering age, vaccination history, and health. Those with a history of chickenpox or herpes zoster generally do not need re-vaccination. If rash appears, seek medical care and report exposure history.

triage.headline_ja: 市疾病予防管理センターが注意喚起：秋は子どもの水痘感染に警戒を
triage.triage_reason: 水痘は既知の一般的な感染症で、季節性の注意喚起に過ぎず、異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 季節性の予防啓発記事であり、疾病発生の異常な増加や公衆衛生上の緊急性を示す情報はない。

article.articleHeadline: Dengue cases rise to 36 in Madurai,100 medical camps to be held from today
article.articleSummary: Madurai district reports 36 dengue cases in the past month as preventive measures are stepped up ahead of the northeast monsoon. From Monday, 100 medical camps with blood-testing facilities will operate daily across the district through December 30. Fourteen mobile medical teams will cover 42 locations, while 29 doctor teams will screen students at 58 schools and anganwadi centres under the School Children Wellness Programme. Fogging is underway in fever-affected areas, with larvicides stocked for village panchayats and urban areas. Desilting drains, removing garbage, cleaning overhead water tanks, chlorination of drinking water, and repair of leaking pipelines have been intensified. Officials will monitor mosquito breeding sites; Nilavembu kudineer will be provided to students. Notices and fines may be issued under the Tamil Nadu Public Health Act for stagnant water or breeding sites. Fever cases average 30-35 daily; 2-3 dengue positives; no deaths so far; 24-hour treatment at all government PHCs.

triage.headline_ja: マドゥライでデング熱症例が36人に増加、本日から100か所の医療キャンプを実施
triage.triage_reason: インド・タミルナードゥ州マドゥライ地区における季節性のデング熱発生（36例、死亡なし）であり、地元当局が通常の予防対策（防疫キャンプ、フォギング等）で対応している。異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 季節性デング熱の通常発生であり、死亡例なし、地元自治体による予防的対応が進行中。北東モンスーン前の毎年恒例の公衆衛生対応の一環と考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: 用死因不明猪制肉干 潮州腊味厂验出猪病毒阳性　 | 中國報 China Press
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dried pork made from pigs with unknown cause of death; Chaozhou cured meat factory tests positive for porcine virus.
article.articleSummary: As of 21 September 2026, Guangdong Province (Chaozhou, Chao’an District, Dongfeng Town) reports a cured meat factory used pork from pigs with unknown causes of death to produce pork jerky. A May raid seized raw meat and finished jerky; lab testing showed a porcine virus in the batch. The implicated goods are valued at about 210,000 yuan (about 127,700 Malaysian ringgit). The investigation indicates unsafe production and sale of non-compliant foods. The case has been transferred to public security authorities for formal filing, with a suspect identified as Chen Mouzhong. No human infections are mentioned in the report; the health concern centers on animal-derived meat contamination and unsafe sourcing practices in Guangdong. This underscores food-safety risks from using livestock of unknown health status in meat processing in China.

triage.headline_ja: 死因不明の豚肉で肉干製造、潮州の腊味工場で豚ウイルス陽性反応
triage.triage_reason: 人への感染は報告されておらず、食品安全・動物由来ウイルス汚染事案に留まるため、公衆衛生上の緊急性は低い。
triage.notes: 人への感染事例は報告されておらず、食品安全違反（死因不明の豚を使用した肉加工品からの豚ウイルス検出）に関する行政・刑事事件として扱われている。

article.articleHeadline: 4분기 중점검역관리지역 32개국...브라질·미국 등 추가
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 32 countries added to the fourth-quarter priority quarantine-control regions... Brazil, the United States, etc.
article.articleSummary: On 2026-09-21, Korea's KDCA announced 32 countries will be designated as fourth-quarter priority quarantine-control regions, effective Oct 1, targeting five diseases: plague, avian influenza with human infection, MERS, Ebola virus disease, and Nipah virus infection. Avian influenza region loses India and Henan (China) but gains Brazil, Michigan (USA), and Anhui/Jiangsu (China). Regional counts: AI human infection 5 countries; Ebola 11; MERS 13; plague 4; Nipah 2. India is removed from AI region but remains Nipah-priority. Across 177 countries, 15 diseases are designated; Q4 adds 7 countries and removes 3 vs Q3. Bangladesh added due to rising measles risk; China designates chikungunya nationwide as a quarantine region, with Japan and Hong Kong also affected. From Sept 7, Congo DR and its border nations are prioritized; travelers from these regions must report health status on entry, and symptomatic individuals must notify quarantine officers. Ebola: since WHO’s May 17 PHEIC, 7,043 cases and 3,400 deaths, with Congo DR involvement and ongoing spread; domestic risk monitored with risk-based response.

triage.headline_ja: 第4四半期重点検疫管理地域32カ国…ブラジル・米国など追加
triage.triage_reason: 韓国KDCAによる四半期ごとの検疫対象国リスト更新に関する行政発表であり、新規の感染症発生イベントではないが、DRCのエボラ拡大継続や中国でのチクングニア指定など既存アウトブレイクの動向情報を含むため注視が必要。
triage.notes: 本記事は韓国の検疫行政における四半期の対象国リスト更新に関する内容で、単独の新規感染症発生報告ではない。ただしDRCにおけるエボラ(WHO PHEIC継続中、7,043例・3,400死亡)、中国での鳥インフルエンザ地域変更およびチクングニア全国指定、インドのニパウイルス優先国継続など、既存の複数疾病モニタリング状況を反映しており、続報の確認が望ましい。

article.articleHeadline: 질병관리청, 추석 연휴 감염병 주의보 - 시사저널
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: KDCA Issues Infectious Disease Alert for the Chuseok Holiday - Sisa Journal
article.articleSummary: KDCA issues an infectious disease alert for the Chuseok holiday (Sept 24–27) as travel and outdoor activity rise. Japan reports a measles outbreak with 549 cases through August, prompting vaccination reminders for those lacking two MMR doses; an earlier influenza season heightens respiratory risks for attendees of events like the 2026 Aichi–Nagoya Asian Games. Southeast Asia (Vietnam, Thailand, Philippines) requires insect repellent and long clothing; returnees with fever should seek dengue testing and monitor for malaria-like symptoms. China advises avoiding live poultry markets and maintaining hygiene, with Q-CODE or health declarations for certain entrants. Domestic guidance emphasizes food safety: store foods at ≤5°C and cook to ≥85°C, plus 30-second handwashing. Tick-borne risks—scrub typhus (123 cases by Aug) and SFTS (94; 18% mortality)—rise in autumn; wear protective clothing and shower after outdoor work. Mosquito-borne diseases such as dengue, malaria, chikungunya, and Zika remain global travel concerns.

triage.headline_ja: 疾病管理庁、秋夕連休の感染症注意報を発令 - シサジャーナル
triage.triage_reason: 韓国当局による秋夕連休向けの季節性感染症に関する一般的な渡航・生活注意喚起であり、特定国での新規アウトブレイク報告ではない。既知の季節性疾患への通常対応の範囲内。
triage.notes: 記事は韓国KDCAによる秋夕連休向けの一般的な感染症予防ガイダンスで、日本の麻疹549例（対象国外）、東南アジア（ベトナム・タイ・フィリピン）でのデング熱/マラリア注意、中国での鳥インフルエンザ一般注意、韓国国内のツツガムシ病・SFTSなど複数疾患に言及するが、いずれも既知の季節性リスクに対する定例的な渡航者向け注意喚起であり、特定国における新規の異常な発生報告ではないため、verified_locationsは空とした。

article.articleHeadline: ارتفاع حصيلة وفيات "إيبولا" بالكونغو الديمقراطية إلى 3676 حالة
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola death toll in the Democratic Republic of Congo rises to 3,676.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) has reached 3,676 deaths, with 7,614 confirmed cases and a case fatality rate of 48.3% as of mid-September 2026, per the DRC Ministry of Communications and Media. The outbreak remains ongoing in a region afflicted by armed conflict for 30 years, with the UN on August 21 calling for additional resources to control transmission amid massive humanitarian needs. A Nature Medicine study previously indicated the outbreak is caused by a previously unknown Bundibugyo virus strain, likely spillover from animals to humans. The World Health Organization had declared on May 17 that the DRC and Uganda outbreaks constitute a Public Health Emergency of International Concern, with high regional risk.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国におけるエボラ出血熱による死者数が3,676人に増加
triage.triage_reason: WHOがPHEIC（国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態）を宣言済みであり、死者数・感染者数が多く、新規株の出現や紛争地域での対応困難など複数のIHR基準・WPRO基準に該当するため。
triage.notes: ウガンダも発生地域として記載されPHEIC宣言の対象国だが、記事サマリーの主題はDRCでの死者数増加であり、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。バンディブギョ株という既知だが稀な株による発生で、30年続く武装紛争地域での対応が困難とされている点も懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: mRNA研究下一步？亞太專家齊聚台灣　聚焦傳染病、腫瘤與罕病應用
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Next step in mRNA research? Asia-Pacific experts gather in Taiwan to focus on applications in infectious diseases, cancer, and rare diseases.
article.articleSummary: As of 21 September 2026, Taiwan hosted the first 2026 mRNA Asia Science Forum, uniting 12 researchers from Taiwan, Japan, Korea, Hong Kong, and Australia, to discuss mRNA applications in infectious diseases, cancer, rare diseases, and other areas. The event builds on the Moderna Taiwan mRNA Forward-Looking Innovation Award and collaborations with Taiwan’s mRNA research community to foster regional scientific exchange and cross-border partnerships. Moderna’s Chief Medical Officer Francesca Ceddia called for international and cross-disciplinary cooperation to unlock the full potential of mRNA against emerging global health threats and diverse disease areas. Moderna Taiwan committed to ongoing collaborations with industry, government, academia, research institutions, and clinicians to strengthen Taiwan’s mRNA ecosystem and scientific exchange. The forum underscores Asia-Pacific collaboration to accelerate research and clinical translation of mRNA for infectious diseases, cancer, and rare diseases.

triage.headline_ja: mRNA研究の次のステップは？アジア太平洋の専門家が台湾に集結、感染症・腫瘍・希少疾患への応用に焦点
triage.triage_reason: 特定の感染症アウトブレイクに関する報告ではなく、mRNA研究に関する学術フォーラムの開催報告であり、公衆衛生上の緊急性や異常事態を示すものではない。
triage.notes: 記事は特定の疾患アウトブレイクではなく、mRNA技術に関する国際学術会議の報告。台湾・日本・韓国・香港・豪州が参加国だが、対象国リストには中国（香港を含む）のみ該当。実際の感染症発生事例ではないため全対象国基準は該当なし。

article.articleHeadline: 女子洗澡"洗出"肺部感染 旧花洒成细菌温床
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A woman takes a bath, "washing out" a pulmonary infection; an old showerhead becomes a breeding ground for bacteria.
article.articleSummary: A case of Mycobacterium avium complex (MAC) pulmonary disease linked to an old showerhead. A woman experienced recurrent cough, yellow-white sputum, and in severe episodes hemoptysis over three years, with multiple hospital visits and relief followed by relapse. Diagnosis traced to inhalation of aerosols containing MAC from a showerhead not replaced for over a decade; warm, moist shower environments promote growth. MAC infections can resemble tuberculosis and be difficult to diagnose radiographically. Transmission may occur via inhalation; skin or mucous injuries may also allow entry, and even ingestion is possible. Preventive measures include regular descaling and replacement of showerheads; soak heads in 1:1 white vinegar and water for about 3 hours, scrub with toothbrush; limit shower time (5–10 minutes) and avoid long baths; gentle skin care. If persistent unexplained dry cough occurs, seek medical evaluation.

triage.headline_ja: 女性が入浴で肺感染を「洗い出す」、古いシャワーヘッドが細菌の温床に
triage.triage_reason: 単一個人の非結核性抗酸菌症例に関する健康啓発記事であり、公衆衛生上の緊急性や集団感染、国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: MAC（Mycobacterium avium complex）は環境由来の非結核性抗酸菌であり、ヒト-ヒト感染はしない。本記事は個人の健康啓発・生活衛生記事であり、感染症アウトブレイクの兆候ではない。

article.articleHeadline: வேகமாக பரவும் உண்ணி காய்ச்சல்... அறிகுறிகள் என்னென்ன? யாரெல்லாம் உஷாராக இருக்க வேண்டும்?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Fast-spreading Unni fever... What are the symptoms? Who should be on the lookout?
article.articleSummary: Fast-spreading scrub typhus (Unni fever) is rising in Tamil Nadu alongside dengue and blue fever. A Chennai Anna University student died from scrub typhus, heightening public concern after a health department explainer video. The illness is caused by chigger mites that latch onto exposed skin, typically on limbs and other exposed areas. It has been spreading among forest and paddy-field workers, with a seasonal surge linked to monsoon changes. Typical symptoms mirror dengue-like fever: high fever, body aches, fatigue, intense headache, and dry cough; some patients develop redness or crusting at the bite site. From August through January, doctors anticipate higher transmission. Early testing and treatment can cure cases. Preventive measures include wearing protective clothing to avoid insect bites, especially for agricultural workers.

triage.headline_ja: 急速に拡大するダニ熱（ツツガムシ病）...症状は？誰が注意すべきか？
triage.triage_reason: タミル・ナードゥ州でツツガムシ病とデング熱が季節的に増加し学生の死亡例も報告されているが、症例数や規模など詳細情報が不足しており、季節性の既知疾患である点からRRAへの即時移行より継続監視が妥当。
triage.notes: ツツガムシ病はダニ媒介性で人-人感染はしないため国際的拡大リスクは低い。学生1名の死亡例と季節的増加が報告されているが、全体の症例数や重症度の詳細は記事に記載なし。健康啓発目的の記事の側面が強く、続報の有無を注視すべき。

article.articleHeadline: Anak Anjing yang Gigit Ibu dan 2 Anak di Jembrana Positif Rabies
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A puppy that bit a mother and two children in Jembrana tests positive for rabies
article.articleSummary: Rabies confirmed in Bali's Jembrana: a four‑month‑old male puppy in Anyar Sari, Baler Bale Agung, Negara District, Jembrana Regency tested positive after samples were analyzed at Balai Besar Veteriner Denpasar. The dog, which had bitten a mother and two children (Ni Komang Ayu Suarini, 42; Conradus Febatan Tri Sandy, 15; Dominika Sayyo Bayu, 23) on Sept 8, 12, and 13, 2026, died by self‑inflicted euthanasia on Sept 14. The household had three dogs; the other two had been vaccinated the previous day. Rabies vaccination coverage in Kelurahan Baler Bale Agung reached about 99% by Sept 18, 2026, prompting additional surveillance and vaccination campaigns to curb spread. The affected victims’ rabies symptoms were not described as present at report time, and the dog reportedly showed no classic rabies signs before death and had never been vaccinated.

triage.headline_ja: ジェンブラナで母親と子供2人を噛んだ子犬が狂犬病陽性と判明
triage.triage_reason: インドネシア・バリ島で狂犬病の動物症例が確認され、人への曝露事例があるが、被害者の発症は報告されておらず、地元当局によるワクチン接種・監視体制強化が進行中であるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 地元保健当局は99%のワクチン接種率を達成し、追加監視・接種キャンペーンを実施中。狂犬病は地域流行病であり突発的異常事象ではないが、人への曝露と地域内感染継続の可能性から経過観察対象とする。

article.articleHeadline: மகாபிரபு நீங்க இங்கேயும் வந்துட்டீங்களா! எல்-நினோவால் டெங்கு அதிகரிப்பு? சென்னைக்கு பெரிய வார்னிங்!
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Maha Prabhu, have you come here too? Dengue increase due to El Niño? A major warning for Chennai!
article.articleSummary: Dengue in Tamil Nadu has surged to about 17,000 cases this year, with Chennai reporting over 650 confirmed infections (654 cited). El Niño is raising concerns that Chennai could see higher dengue incidence due to extreme heat. September tallies show sharp spikes: Sep 15 = 133, Sep 16 = 283, Sep 17 = 244, Sep 18 = 253; data for Sep 19–20 not released. Three consecutive days with >200 cases have fueled public anxiety. Chennai’s 2021 outbreak involved about 5,750 cases, while 2025 saw around 4,780; the current September surge is concentrated in Chennai but remains elevated. Public health officials urge vigilance against mosquito breeding around stagnant rainwater and indoor spaces; fever warrants immediate medical care, and home remedies are discouraged. As of Sep 21, 2026, residents are advised to monitor for fever and seek prompt treatment.

triage.headline_ja: マハープラブ、あなたもここに来たのですか！エルニーニョでデング熱が増加？チェンナイに重大な警告！

article.articleHeadlineTranslated: China designates nationwide quarantine management areas for chikungunya fever, with Japan and Hong Kong also included.
article.articleSummary: As of 21 September 2026, Korea’s Disease Control Agency designates nationwide quarantine management areas for infectious diseases, adding China (nationwide), Japan, and Hong Kong. Avian influenza (AI) human infections trigger key-area status for Brazil and Michigan, with mandatory health-status reporting on entry; India remains in Nipah risk with entry reporting. Anhui and Jiangsu in China are added for AI; Henan is removed. The five diseases—plague, AI, MERS, Ebola, Nipah—cover 32 countries as key areas, while 15 other diseases cover 177 countries as general areas. Measles outbreaks surged in the Americas (~2x) and Southeast Asia (~7x); Bangladesh was added to quarantine regions after a March surge and WHO risk assessment. Chikungunya fever is designated nationwide in China, with local transmission in Guangdong, Guangxi, Sichuan, Chongqing, Fujian, and Hunan, plus new cases in Japan and Hong Kong. Ebola remains active: as of the 10th, 7,043 cases and 3,400 deaths, spreading to seven DR Congo provinces including South Ubangi. Border-entry measures apply to neighboring countries; Congo border surveillance is enhanced. Details on KDCA or Q-CODE websites.

triage.headline_ja: 中国全域をチクングニア熱の検疫管理地域に指定…日本・香港も対象に含む

triage.notes: 記事は韓国疾病管理庁の検疫管理地域指定に関する包括的な発表で、複数疾患（チクングニア熱、鳥インフルエンザ、ニパウイルス、麻疹、エボラ）を同時に扱っている。特にコンゴ民主共和国のエボラ（7,043例・3,400死亡、7州へ拡大）と中国全土でのチクングニア熱地域内伝播（広東・広西・四川・重慶・福建・湖南）が重大情報として注目される。Bangladesh・Michigan・日本は対象国リスト外のため verified_locations から除外。

article.articleHeadline: Dengue cases spike in Chennai, GCC intensifies preventive measures
article.articleSummary: Dengue cases surge in Chennai with 614 cases in the first 18 days of September and 605 in August, pushing Tamil Nadu’s 2026 total to 17,049 and Chennai to 2,600 so far this year. Nationwide, 2023–2025 saw declines from 56,863 to 25,585, with 2026 currently at 17,049 dengue cases and 9 deaths in the state. About 95% of infections are self-limiting; 5% require hospitalization. To curb transmission, the Greater Chennai Corporation deployed 3,690 domestic breeding checkers across 15 zones, covering 80–100 houses daily; intermittent rains may have boosted Aedes breeding. Over the past 20 days, Rs 5.56 lakh in penalties were issued to commercial institutions for non-compliance. Drones spraying is limited to Culex control, with intensified manual spraying. Scrub typhus is also reported during the monsoon, transmitted by chigger mites and potentially causing ARDS or myocarditis if untreated.

triage.headline_ja: チェンナイでデング熱症例が急増、GCC（グレーター・チェンナイ市当局）が予防対策を強化

triage.notes: デング熱はインドのタミル・ナードゥ州・チェンナイでモンスーン期に毎年見られる季節性感染症であり、地方自治体（GCC）による対策（ブリーディングチェッカー配備、罰金措置、殺虫剤散布）が既に実施されている。スクラブチフスも併記されているが詳細情報は限定的。国際的な拡大や渡航制限のリスクは記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: 假冒天王「劉德華」收貨！業者走私中國禽流感疫苗　遭海巡攔截
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Fake "King of Pop" Andy Lau takes delivery! Operators smuggle Chinese avian influenza vaccines, intercepted by the Coast Guard.
article.articleSummary: Taiwan’s Coast Guard Investigative Bureau, Yunlin Interdiction Team, seized 93.6 liters of unapproved Chinese avian influenza vaccine illegally imported through the Chinese mainland. The principal suspect, surnamed Chen, attempted to dodge customs by listing the recipient under the fake name of mainland pop star Andy Lau and disguising the vaccine as yogurt, routing the shipment via a domestic logistics platform to a delivery point. Investigations linked two illicit orders from the Chinese mainland during Taiwan’s recent avian influenza outbreaks in central and southern regions. The unregulated vaccine, untested with unknown composition, could have supplied about 100,000 poultry if used in domestic farming. The case was prosecuted under the Animal Drugs Management Act and referred to Yunlin District Prosecutors Office. Authorities urge avoidance of illicit animal medicines and to report tips via the 118 abuse-reporting line to help safeguard animal health and public safety.

triage.headline_ja: 偽の「劉德華」名義で受け取り！業者が中国製鳥インフルエンザワクチンを密輸、海巡に摘発される
triage.triage_reason: 記事の主題は台湾での未承認鳥インフルエンザワクチンの密輸事件であり、疾病発生そのものの報告ではないため、シグナルとしての優先度は低い。
triage.notes: 記事は台湾での密輸・法執行事件が主題であり、中国大陸での鳥インフルエンザ発生自体は背景情報に過ぎない。台湾は対象国リストに含まれておらず、中国も本記事の発生地ではないため verified_locations は空とした。

article.articleHeadline: 影／虛報酸奶大陸走私禽流感疫苗 假「劉德華」今起訴
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Video: False report of yogurt; Mainland smuggling of avian influenza vaccines; the fake “Andy Lau” files a lawsuit today.
article.articleSummary: 93.6 liters of illegal avian influenza vaccines imported from Mainland China were intercepted in Yunlin, Taiwan, in a joint operation involving coast guard and other agencies. The shipments were disguised as yogurt to evade inspection and listed recipient as Hong Kong star Andy Lau (Liu Dehua) to conceal the true addressee, later revealed as a Chen-surname suspect. The unapproved animal-use vaccines were delivered via domestic logistics and seized at entry, with a declared value of about NT$500,000 (approximately NT$1,200 per 200cc), enough to treat around 100,000 poultry. The vaccines’ ingredients were unknown and untested, raising clear food safety and animal-health concerns amid ongoing avian influenza outbreaks in central and southern Taiwan. The case was brought to indictment under the Animal Drugs Administration Act, highlighting risks of cross-strait smuggling of veterinary vaccines.

triage.headline_ja: 動画:ヨーグルトに偽装した大陸からの鳥インフルエンザワクチン密輸、偽の「劉德華(アンディ・ラウ)」名義で本日起訴
triage.triage_reason: 台湾での鳥インフルエンザワクチンの密輸・摘発事件であり、人の健康被害や新規感染症の発生を示すものではないため、感染症シグナルとしての該当性は低い。
triage.notes: 記事は動物用鳥インフルエンザワクチンの密輸摘発に関する内容で、家畜衛生・食品安全の観点が中心。台湾は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations は空とした。中国本土産の密輸品という言及はあるが、発生国としての主体は台湾。

article.articleHeadline: Tren Kasus Influenza Meningkat, Masyarakat Diimbau tak Panik
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rising Influenza Case Trends, Public Urged Not to Panic.
article.articleSummary: Influenza A is rising in Indonesia as of data through 12 September 2026, with lab-confirmed positivity at 38% in week 35 (up from 22% the prior week); of 175 specimens tested, 66 were positive, the majority influenza A(H1N1)pdm09. Public health expert Tri Wibawa of UGM says there is no need for panic; the circulating A(H1N1) is a lineage of the 2009 pandemic H1N1 virus with genetic changes. Symptoms typically include fever with chills, cough, sore throat, runny or congested nose, muscle or body aches, headache, and fatigue. High-risk groups are adults over 65, children under 5, people with chronic diseases, and those with weakened immunity. Preventive measures, described as six steps, include: maintaining a healthy lifestyle, cough and sneeze etiquette, frequent handwashing, avoiding close contact with flu cases, using masks when ill, and vaccinating against influenza, especially for vulnerable populations.

triage.headline_ja: インフルエンザ症例数の増加傾向、市民にパニックを起こさないよう呼びかけ

article.articleHeadline: 10월부터 일본·홍콩서 모기 물렸다면 '신고'...4분기 검역관리지역 지정 | 아주경제
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Starting in October, if bitten by a mosquito in Japan or Hong Kong, report it... Fourth-quarter designation of quarantine-management zones | Aju Economy
article.articleSummary: From Oct 1, 2026, Korea's KDCA updates its fourth-quarter designations: 32 countries designated as priority quarantine-management areas and 177 as quarantine-management areas. Japan and Hong Kong are newly added as priority quarantine-management areas due to chikungunya fever outbreaks; Bangladesh is designated as a quarantine-management area amid a measles surge. For avian influenza human infection, the United States (Michigan) and Brazil, along with China’s Anhui and Jiangsu, are newly designated; India is removed from the avian influenza priority area but remains under Nipah virus priority management. Consequently, India and Henan Province are no longer in the avian-influenza focus area, while China-wide designation now covers chikungunya. Travelers with stay or transit in these areas must report health status to quarantine officials at entry via a health declaration or Q-CODE, regardless of symptoms.

article.articleHeadline: หมอมนูญ" เตือนซิฟิลิสพุ่งในเยาวชน ชี้ระยะ 2 อาจมีผื่นทั่วตัว แม้ไม่มีไข้-ต่อมน้ำเหลืองโต - สยามรัฐ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dr. Manoon warns of a surge in syphilis among youths; Stage 2 may have rashes all over the body even without fever or enlarged lymph nodes - Siam Rath
article.articleSummary: On 21 September 2026, Thai physician Dr. Manoon Leechawong warned of a surge in syphilis among youths in Thailand. A case from Vichaiyuth Hospital involves a 48-year-old Thai man with HIV on ART for 11 years and good viral control who developed a one-week diffuse erythematous rash on the trunk, arms, and thighs with itching, but no fever or oral ulcers, after unprotected sex two months earlier. Exam showed no fever, palms/soles spared, and no lymphadenopathy. Laboratory tests showed RPR reactive at 1:32 (previously negative 10 years ago and 7 years ago) and a positive Treponemal antibody, confirming syphilis. Diagnosed as secondary syphilis (syphilis stage 2) with HIV infection. The report highlights that secondary syphilis can present with widespread rashes without fever or enlarged lymph nodes, underscoring the need for testing and awareness amid rising outbreaks.

triage.headline_ja: 「マヌーン医師」が若者の間で梅毒が急増していると警告；第2期では発熱やリンパ節腫脹がなくても全身に発疹が出ることがあると指摘 - サイアムラット

article.articleHeadline: Chennai corporation steps up fever control measures across institutions
article.articleSummary: Greater Chennai Corporation intensifies dengue prevention and fever control during the pre-monsoon season across 16 educational institutions and hostels in Chennai. On Sunday, 289 workers and 53 fogging machines were deployed and 581 kg of unwanted materials removed to curb mosquito breeding. GCC Commissioner GS Sameeran inspected Victoria Hostel, Chepauk, directing debris clearance, stagnant-water removal, and campus hygiene maintenance. Institutions including Anna University, IIT Madras, Victoria Hostel, Presidency College, and Madras University show higher case concentration due to large student populations. Chennai logged 4,400 fever cases in August and 4,600 in September (as of 21 September 2026), with dengue-positive around 654. About 95% of dengue is self-limiting; the remaining 5% require hospitalization. Domestic Breeding Checkers increased to 3,290 from 2,500; each inspects 80–100 homes daily. Pamphlets distributed; fines totaling Rs 5,56,000 imposed over 20 days on non-compliant establishments and repeat hotspots.

article.articleSummary: Influenza A on the rise in Indonesia. As of 12 September 2026, the Ministry of Health reports influenza positivity at 38% in week 35 from 175 specimens; 66 tested positive, with the majority being influenza A(H1N1)pdm09. The circulating A(H1N1) strain is a genetic variant descended from the 2009 pandemic virus. While August 2026 showed an uptick, experts urge mitigation rather than panic. High-risk groups include adults over 65, children under 5, individuals with chronic diseases, and the immunocompromised. Preventive measures: healthy lifestyle, cough etiquette, frequent handwashing, avoiding close contact with flu patients, masking when ill, and vaccination for vulnerable populations. This assessment is based on data from Kementerian Kesehatan RI; no details on imported or exported cases are provided. Published 2026-09-21.

article.articleHeadline: 雲林男用「劉德華」假名進貨中國禽流感疫苗93.6公升被起訴
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Yunlin man indicted for procuring 93.6 liters of China's avian influenza vaccine under the alias "Liu Dehua".
article.articleSummary: A Yunlin County man surnamed Chen was indicted for procuring about 93.6 liters (468 bottles) of avian influenza vaccine from China in February, using the alias 'Liu Dehua' to receive shipments and misdeclaring them as yogurt to evade customs. The vaccines, intended for poultry (thousands of ducks) in Yunlin, could have immunized about 100,000 birds, with a purchase cost around 600 TWD per bottle and a potential resale price of 1,200 TWD per bottle. Authorities intercepted the shipments late February; none entered the market. Chen was prosecuted under the Animal Drugs Management Act. A joint operation by Yunlin District Prosecutors Office, Yunlin Coast Guard Investigative Team, and other agencies tracked and confiscated the illegal vaccine. Officials warn illegal veterinary drugs threaten Taiwan's animal health and public health, urging compliance by businesses and the public.

article.articleHeadline: El brote de ébola en África aún tardará varios meses en poder ser controlado
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola outbreak in Africa will still take several months to be brought under control.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), declared last May, has killed nearly 4,000 people. Jean-Jacques Muyembe, co-discoverer of Ebola and director-general of the INRB, says it will take at least three to four months before the outbreak can be considered over. This is the DRC’s seventeenth Ebola outbreak and the second deadliest globally after the 2014–2016 West Africa epidemic (about 11,000 deaths and 28,000 cases). The current episode is caused by the Bundibugyo strain, for which there is neither vaccine nor treatment, unlike the Zaire variant with vaccines. Muyembe attributes late detection and a weakened health system to delayed response. He recalls the 1976 Yambuku investigation—began September 23, 1976—where Ebola presented with fever, headaches, and severe hemorrhaging, underscoring how the disease emerged and spread.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカのエボラ出血熱流行、収束にはまだ数か月かかる見込み
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で進行中のエボラ出血熱流行が約4000人の死者を出し、ワクチン・治療法のないBundibugyo株が原因であるため、公衆衛生上深刻かつ国際的関心の高い事案と判断。
triage.notes: 記事にはアンゴラも地域として付与されているが、サマリー中で言及がないため除外。DRCの第17回目のエボラ流行で、ワクチン・治療法のないBundibugyo株が原因である点が特に懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola in Kongo: Impfstoffe allein reichen nicht aus, sagt Experte
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Kongo: Vaccines Alone Are Not Enough, Says an Expert.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreaks intensify in the Kongo-Kinshasa region of the Democratic Republic of Congo, with experts warning it could become the largest to date. Virologist and zoonoses specialist Fabian Leendertz (Head, Helmholtz Institute for One Health) notes the epidemic remains out of control, though WHO reports around 85% of contacts are being traced this week—a positive step but not decisive. Vaccines are a key tool, but success depends on public trust; skepticism and misinformation hinder uptake. Local engagement—using community figures such as religious leaders, athletes, and long-standing aid workers—is essential to reach people and improve access. The complex security situation and governance challenges limit aid work, preventing rapid mass vaccination. The 2014–2016 West Africa Ebola outbreak, which killed over 11,000, showed that extensive contact tracing, isolation, and changes in burial practices were critical to ending transmission, alongside community cooperation.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ出血熱：ワクチンだけでは不十分と専門家が指摘
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱の流行が制御不能な状態にあり、専門家は史上最大規模になる可能性を警告しており、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響と国際的拡大リスクが認められる。
triage.notes: 発生地域にAngolaが含まれているが、記事サマリーではDRC（コンゴ・キンシャサ地域）のみが言及されており、Angolaでの発生は確認できないため除外した。WHOによる接触者追跡85%達成との報告があるが、専門家は依然として流行が制御不能と評価しており、史上最大規模になる可能性が指摘されている。

article.articleHeadline: RSV低龄威胁全年存在 全年风险叠加秋冬高发
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: RSV Threat to Very Young Children Persists Year-Round; Risks Build Across the Year with Autumn–Winter Peaks
article.articleSummary: Week 36, 2026 nationwide sentinel surveillance by the China CDC shows that among hospitalized 0–4-year-olds with severe acute respiratory infection, respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) positivity now leads as the top pathogen. RSV, a highly transmissible cause of infant lower respiratory illness, is a major driver of pneumonia and bronchiolitis, with infants under one year at greatest risk for severe disease due to immature immunity and narrow airways. In Guangzhou and other southern provinces near the Tropic of Cancer (Guangdong, Fujian, Guangxi), RSV is detectable year‑round with no clear off-season; in northern China, RSV seasonality concentrates from October to April. There is no specific antiviral treatment; proactive prevention is key. Nirsevimab, a long‑acting monoclonal antibody for infant RSV prevention, was approved in December 2023; a November 2025 multicenter real‑world study showed reduced infection and related health care use, and the December 2025 Guangzhou expert consensus endorses its use.

triage.headline_ja: RSVの脅威は乳幼児に一年中存在、秋冬にピークが重なりリスク増大
triage.triage_reason: 季節性・定例のサーベイランス報告であり、既知の病原体（RSV）に関する通常の疫学情報。異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められず、社会的関心の急激な高まりも見られない。
triage.notes: 中国CDCによる定例サーベイランスデータに基づく季節性RSV流行状況の報告であり、既知の予防策（ニルセビマブ）にも言及。新規性や異常性は低く、通常のサーベイランス情報として扱う。

article.articleHeadline: Air Bersih Makin Sulit, Puskesmas Toboali Bangka Selatan Catat 19 Kasus Diare
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Clean water increasingly scarce, Toboali Community Health Center in South Bangka records 19 diarrhea cases.
article.articleSummary: Diarrhea cases at Puskesmas Toboali in South Bangka Regency, Bangka Belitung Islands, Indonesia, reached 19 through August 2026, predominantly affecting infants and toddlers. The dry season is linked to reduced access to clean water, with water quality and consumption of outside foods cited as contributing factors. Hygienic washing of baby bottles and feeding cups, as well as ensuring water used for cleaning is clean, are emphasized. Health authorities recommend household water treatment during the dry season and boiling drinking water to 100°C before consumption to prevent further cases. The article notes no laboratory confirmation and provides the current count of 19 cases without detailing a broader outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: 清潔な水の確保がさらに困難に、南バンカ・トボアリ保健所で下痢症例19件を記録
triage.triage_reason: 乾季による水不足が原因とされる下痢症例が19件と限定的で、検査による病原体確認もなく、広範な流行や国際的懸念を示す情報がない。
triage.notes: 乾季による水質悪化が原因とされる散発的な下痢症例であり、検査確認もなく、対象国リストにおける公衆衛生上の重大リスクとは判断されない。

article.articleHeadline: Insécurité alimentaire croissante face à l'épidémie de Maladie à virus Ebola (MVE) dans la province de l'Ituri en RD Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rising food insecurity amid Ebola virus disease (EVD) outbreak in Ituri Province, DR Congo.
article.articleSummary: Food insecurity is rising amid an Ebola virus disease (EVD) outbreak in Ituri Province, Democratic Republic of Congo. Response measures, including mobility restrictions, are disrupting market supplies and driving up food prices, eroding household purchasing power. While local response capacities and community mutual aid networks help sustain some access to food, emergency assistance remains necessary for the most isolated and vulnerable populations. The article notes that restrictions intended to control transmission have unintended economic impacts on livelihoods, intensifying hunger even as health interventions seek to contain the outbreak. Ongoing coordination between humanitarian actors and communities is required to bridge gaps in access, particularly for those cut off by movement controls or living in remote areas of Ituri. No specific case or death counts are provided in the report.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国イトゥリ州でのエボラウイルス病（EVD）流行の中で高まる食料不安
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱は既知の高致死性・国際的関心の高い疾患であり、移動制限による食料不安の悪化は公衆衛生・人道両面でのリスクを示唆するため、フルRRAでの詳細評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事は感染者数・死亡者数などの具体的な疫学データを含まず、主に移動制限による食料不安の人道的影響に焦点を当てている。エボラ流行自体の詳細（症例数、感染拡大状況）については追加情報が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Epidemics on the rise in Kerala's Ernakulam district; 43 dengue cases in 2 days
article.articleSummary: As of 21 September 2026, Ernakulam district, Kerala, is witnessing a dengue surge alongside fever cases, with 43 dengue infections confirmed in the past two days. Sporadic rain has caused water stagnation in multiple areas, creating favorable conditions for vector-borne transmission, while rising temperatures and unseasonal climate are cited as contributing factors. Officials note that the apparent rise in cases reflects both enhanced reporting through panchayat-level surveillance and insufficient preventive measures. District Medical Officer Shahirsha R emphasized the dual drivers: better case detection and gaps in source reduction. To curb spread, authorities have initiated vector-control activities under the Arogyabheri programme, with all 86 panchayats in the district implementing prevention initiatives. The situation underlines the need for intensified vector control and public health action to avert outbreaks of dengue and related illnesses.

triage.headline_ja: ケーララ州エルナクラム地区で疫病が増加中；2日間で43件のデング熱感染
triage.triage_reason: 季節性のデング熱増加であり、地方自治体レベルで対策が進められているが、重症度・死亡者数など詳細情報が不足しているため継続監視が適切。
triage.notes: ケーララ州エルナクラム地区での季節性デング熱流行。地方自治体（86パンチャーヤト全て）でArogyabheriプログラムによるベクター対策を実施中。重症度・死亡数の情報なし。地域限定的な公衆衛生対応であり、国際的な関心事項ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Người phụ nữ mắc cúm A kèm viêm phổi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A woman with influenza A and pneumonia.
article.articleSummary: Ms. Tinh, a 67-year-old woman in Ho Chi Minh City, was diagnosed with influenza A complicated by pneumonia and bronchospasm. Chest radiography at Tam Anh General Hospital showed diffuse patchy infiltrates in both lungs with left basilar atelectasis. She had myalgia, fever, nasal congestion, and cough, and tested positive for influenza A. Past medical history included dyslipidemia and type 2 diabetes. She received bronchodilators, antivirals, antibiotics, with glycemic and lipid control and inhaled therapy. After 5 days, respiratory status improved, she became afebrile, and cough eased before discharge. Influenza can progress to pneumonia, especially in older adults with chronic diseases; warning signs include dyspnea, tachypnea, chest pain, and fever. Recommendations: annual influenza vaccination, infection control, respiratory hygiene, and early medical evaluation for abnormal signs.

triage.headline_ja: インフルエンザA型と肺炎を併発した女性
triage.triage_reason: 単一症例の季節性インフルエンザ合併症報告であり、公衆衛生上の異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 個人の臨床症例報告であり、基礎疾患を持つ高齢者における季節性インフルエンザの合併症例。集団発生やアウトブレイクを示唆する情報はない。

article.articleHeadline: 潮州腊味厂用死因不明猪只制肉干 验出猪病毒 留意四大致病风险
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Chaozhou cured-meat factory uses pigs that died from unknown causes to make jerky; swine virus detected; be mindful of four major pathogenic risks.
article.articleSummary: 2026-09-21, Guangdong's Chaozhou: a cured-meat factory in East Feng Town, Chao’an District, was raided after inspectors found large quantities of dead pigs of unknown cause and finished jerky. Sampling confirmed porcine virus in the batch, worth about 210,000 RMB. Owner Chen Mouzhong has been handed to police for producing and selling unsafe food. Four health risks from consuming meat from diseased pigs: (1) zoonotic infections and bacterial disease, notably Streptococcus suis causing meningitis, sepsis, or deafness; Escherichia coli and Salmonella causing acute gastroenteritis with fever, vomiting and diarrhea. (2) putrefaction toxins (cadaverine, putrescine) that survive cooking and can trigger shock. (3) antibiotic residues and masking chemicals, including nitrite, industrial colorants and strong flavorings, with nitrite toxicity and long-term cancer risk. (4) parasitic infections (Trichinella spiralis and Taenia). Prevention: buy from reputable brands with clear labels and safety certificates; avoid unusually cheap products; seek medical care if fever or GI symptoms occur after eating unknown meat.

triage.headline_ja: 潮州の腊味工場、死因不明の豚を使って肉干を製造 豚由来ウイルス検出、四大健康リスクに注意
triage.triage_reason: 食品安全当局による摘発事案であり、実際のヒト感染事例の報告はなく、公衆衛生上の緊急性や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 本記事は食品安全（不明死因の豚肉を用いた加工食品）に関する摘発報道であり、実際のヒト感染症例の発生報告ではない。啓発目的で疾患リスクが列挙されているのみ。

article.articleHeadline: Ebolavaccin in Congo getest op zorgpersoneel in frontlinie
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola vaccine tested in Congo on frontline healthcare workers.
article.articleSummary: On 21 September 2026, the Democratic Republic of Congo launched a new Ebola vaccination campaign, aiming to curb the outbreak by immunizing 20,000 frontline healthcare workers in the hardest-hit regions. The Ervebo vaccine, developed for the Zaire ebolavirus (Zaïre variant), is being deployed to front-line staff. The Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain currently circulating has no vaccine. The campaign is supported by the World Health Organization and Doctors Without Borders (Médecins Sans Frontières). This effort emphasizes protection of health workers amid ongoing transmission, while the absence of a vaccine for the Bundibugyo strain highlights remaining gaps in outbreak containment.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラワクチンが最前線の医療従事者に接種試験
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）のアウトブレイクが継続中で、当該株に有効なワクチンが存在せず、WHOとMSFが支援するワクチン接種キャンペーンが実施されている。IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当し、国際的懸念も高い。
triage.notes: 現在流行中のブンディブギョ株にはワクチンが存在せず、既存のエルベボワクチン（ザイール株用）は最前線医療従事者の防護目的で使用されている。アウトブレイク制御にはギャップが残る。

article.articleHeadline: Kenali Influenza Tipe A, Kerap Terjadi Saat Peralihan Musim dan Kualitas Udara yang Buruk
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Recognize Influenza Type A, Which Often Occurs During Seasonal Transitions and Poor Air Quality.
article.articleSummary: Influenza Type A dominates in Indonesia, with cases rising toward year-end, driven by environmental factors such as volcanic eruptions, forest fires and prolonged dry seasons that degrade air quality. The disease, a respiratory illness, commonly affects at-risk groups: pregnant women, children under 5, adults 65+, and people with chronic conditions (HIV/AIDS, asthma, heart or lung disease, diabetes) as well as health workers. Symptoms include sudden fever, cough (often dry), headache, myalgia/arthralgia, sore throat, and runny nose; cough may persist two weeks or longer. Per Kemkes.go.id (cited 21/9), treatment includes rest, paracetamol or antipyretics, antivirals, and adequate fluids. Prevention emphasizes Healthy Living Behaviors (PHBS), regular handwashing with soap, masks for the sick and in public, cough etiquette, physical distancing from vulnerable groups, vaccination of at-risk groups annually.

triage.headline_ja: 季節の変わり目と大気質の悪化でしばしば発生するA型インフルエンザを知る
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザに関する一般的な健康啓発記事であり、異常な集団発生や公衆衛生上の緊急性を示す情報がない。
triage.notes: インドネシア保健省(Kemkes)の一般的な健康啓発情報であり、特定のアウトブレイクや異常事態を報告するものではない。

article.articleHeadline: Influenza A Mudah Menular pada Anak, Kenali Faktor Risikonya
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Influenza A Is Highly Contagious in Children, Know Its Risk Factors
article.articleSummary: Influenza A is highly contagious in children in Jakarta, Indonesia, according to IDAI’s Tropic Diseases Working Unit. Children under 5 are at the greatest risk, especially those in daycare settings and crowded, poorly ventilated rooms, as well as kids with neurological or developmental disorders, long-term care needs, or living in crowded areas. As of 21 September 2026, about 5% of pediatric influenza cases require hospitalization, with around 80% of hospitalized patients under 2 years old and about half younger than 6 months. Symptoms in children include nasal congestion, sore throat, high fever, fatigue, loss of appetite, body aches, and runny nose; recovery can take weeks. Prevention emphasizes PHBS (handwashing, healthy diet, hydration), influenza vaccination, sun exposure, improved ventilation, and avoiding crowded air-conditioned indoor spaces. Paracetamol is allowable; antibiotics are not recommended because influenza is viral.

triage.headline_ja: 小児にインフルエンザAが感染しやすい、そのリスク要因を知る
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザに関する一般的な健康啓発記事であり、異常な流行や公衆衛生上の緊急性を示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 記事はインドネシア・ジャカルタにおける小児のインフルエンザAに関する一般的な医療解説記事であり、通常の季節性疾患としての注意喚起にとどまる。特異的なアウトブレイクや異常な感染拡大の報告はない。

article.articleHeadline: கடலூரில் தீவிரமாகும் காய்ச்சல் பாதிப்பு -ஸ்தம்பிக்கும் அரசு மருத்துவமனை
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In Cuddalore, fever cases on the rise - Sthambikkum Government Hospital
article.articleSummary: In Cuddalore, Tamil Nadu, India, a surge in fever cases linked to viral fever outbreaks has strained local health services. At the Cuddalore District Government Headquarters Hospital, over 1,000 fever cases were treated in the past week. More than 200 patients are currently hospitalized, and this morning, over 300 fever patients queued to see a doctor. Twelve residents have been laboratory-confirmed with dengue fever in the district. The rising fever burden, including confirmed dengue cases, has prompted the district administration to call for fever-prevention camps to curb transmission. The report notes ongoing fever spread across Tamil Nadu and the immediate pressure on public hospitals in Cuddalore as authorities implement containment measures.

triage.headline_ja: クダロールで発熱症例が急増、政府病院が対応に苦慮
triage.triage_reason: インド・タミルナードゥ州クダロールでデング熱を含む発熱症例が急増し医療機関が圧迫されているが、季節性のデング熱流行であり異常性・国際的拡大リスクは低いため、続報を注視する。
triage.notes: デング熱は南インドで季節性に流行する疾患であり、本件は地域の医療体制圧迫が中心的な懸念点。国際的な拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低いが、症例数増加（週1000件超、入院200名超）と確定12件の状況は継続監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: 伊波拉疫情失控？民主剛果逾3,500人死亡　無國界醫生警告：疫情正在轉移
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Is the Ebola outbreak out of control? More than 3,500 people have died in the Democratic Republic of the Congo; Doctors Without Borders warns that the outbreak is shifting.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo virus Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has reached 7,475 confirmed cases and 3,605 deaths (1,798 recoveries) as of Sept 16, 2026, with Ituri Province hardest hit and rising cases in North Kivu. The May 2026 outbreak marks the largest Bundibugyo Ebola event on record. No vaccine or therapy specific to Bundibugyo exists; Ervebo (for Saï Ebola virus) is being evaluated in a research framework, with WHO/SAGE cautioning that current evidence does not justify routine use for Bundibugyo. About 70,000 doses of Ervebo are available in DRC: 50,000 for frontline health workers in Ituri’s Bunia, and 20,000 for clinical trials. Vaccination started Sept 19 in Bunia to protect frontline staff, aiming to cover ~20,000 personnel over 6–9 months. MSF warns declines in hospital admissions do not mean containment, as transmission expands to new areas and surveillance and health systems remain strained; continued international support is essential.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ疫情は制御不能か？民主コンゴで死者3,500人超　国境なき医師団が疫情の移動を警告
triage.triage_reason: 史上最大規模のBundibugyoエボラ流行が継続中で死者3,605人・感染7,475人に達し、新地域（北キブ）への拡大とサーベイランス逼迫、国際支援の必要性が明示されているため、フルRRAへ進めるべきシグナルと判断。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo型エボラは既存ワクチン（Ervebo）の効果が確立されておらず、MSFは病院入院数の減少が制圧を意味しないと警告。北キブ州への拡大が懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: Ujicoba Kertas Berinsektisida di Mimika, Senjata UPTD Malaria Center Basmi Nyamuk Pembawa Malaria
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Insecticide-Treated Paper Trial in Mimika, the Malaria Center UPTD's Weapon to Eradicate Malaria-Carrying Mosquitoes
article.articleSummary: In Mimika, Central Papua, Indonesia, the UPTD Malaria Center Mimika and the Ministry of Health are testing an innovative vector-control method using insecticide-treated paper installed inside homes. Thirty houses are designated as intervention sites and 30 as controls. Mosquito monitoring runs overnight from 18:00 to 06:00 WIT. The treated paper is mounted about two meters above the floor to align with mosquito flight and to minimize child access. When mosquitoes land on the surface, the insecticide causes physical distress, reduces the drive to bite humans, and death. A local kiosk owner participating in sampling reports mosquitoes weakening and falling, with officials claiming many deaths. The trial aims to assess whether indoor insecticide-treated paper can significantly reduce indoor mosquito populations and contribute to malaria elimination, though no numerical results are provided yet.

triage.headline_ja: ミミカでの殺虫剤処理紙の試験、マラリア媒介蚊駆除に向けたマラリアセンターUPTDの新兵器
triage.triage_reason: これはマラリア媒介蚊対策の試験的介入に関する通常の公衆衛生活動の報道であり、異常な流行や公衆衛生上の緊急事態を示すものではない。
triage.notes: 記事は既存の媒介蚊対策プログラムの試験報道であり、感染症の異常発生や増加を示すデータは含まれていない。

article.articleHeadline: IOM: Multi-Country Bundibugyo Ebola Virus Disease Outbreak - Situation Report No. 18 (7 to 13 September 2026)
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola Virus Disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) continues; as of 13 September 2026, the DRC MoH reports 7,258 confirmed cases and 3,510 deaths (crude CFR 48.4%). The outbreak remains concentrated in Ituri, North Kivu, Haut-Uélé, Tshopo and Bas-Uélé provinces, with 54 health zones affected. Response unfolds in a complex humanitarian and mobility context. Population movements within outbreak areas and across borders raise cross-border transmission risk. Preparedness at points of entry, border communities and other locations remains essential. Through mobility mapping, flow monitoring and border health interventions, IOM and partners are strengthening understanding of mobility corridors to prioritize surveillance, RCCE and readiness measures. Given ongoing transmission in eastern/north-eastern DRC, cross-border risk remains elevated with neighboring countries. Porous borders and informal crossings linked to trade, displacement, insecurity and service access may fuel transmission; investments in screening, surveillance, RCCE, IPC, data systems and pre-positioning are advised.

triage.headline_ja: IOM: 多国間ブンディブギョ・エボラウイルス病アウトブレイク状況報告書 No.18（2026年9月7日〜13日）
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で継続中のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクが7,258症例・3,510死亡（CFR48.4%）に達し、54保健地区に拡大、越境感染リスクも指摘されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大事案。
triage.notes: 記事内で言及されるIturi, Tshopo等はDRC国内の州であり、他対象国への感染拡大は具体的に報告されていないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。越境リスクは近隣国全般への懸念として言及されているが、対象国リスト中の具体国名は挙げられていない。

article.articleHeadline: Waspada Influenza A, Ini 5 Tips Jaga Imunitas Anak : Okezone Women
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Watch Out for Influenza A, Here Are 5 Tips to Boost Your Child's Immunity: Okezone Women
article.articleSummary: Influenza A concerns in Indonesia as of 21 September 2026. In Jakarta, authorities report rising Influenza A cases in several cities, but national trends are not significant and remain under control. Health official Aji Muhawarman indicates that much of the discussion around Influenza A on social media centers on children, with toddlers and the elderly identified as especially vulnerable to influenza infection. The article stresses that maintaining children's immune systems is an important protective step for families. While local increases are noted, there is no indication of a widespread nationwide outbreak. The piece emphasizes parental attention to child health amid the discussion of Influenza A, reinforcing that protecting children’s immunity is a key public health priority.

triage.headline_ja: インフルエンザAに注意、子どもの免疫力を守る5つのヒント：Okezone Women
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザAに関する一般的な健康啓発記事であり、当局も国レベルでは深刻な流行はないとしている。国際的懸念や異常性は認められない。
triage.notes: ジャカルタで局地的な増加が見られるが、全国的な流行拡大の兆候はなく、通常の季節性インフルエンザに関する健康啓発記事と判断される。

article.articleHeadline: 'சராசரியாக நீடிக்கும் டெங்கு பாதிப்பு'-விவரங்களை வெளியிட்ட தமிழக மருத்துவத்துறை
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Tamil Nadu Health Department released data on 'average-duration dengue infection'
article.articleSummary: On 20 September 2026, Tamil Nadu recorded 228 dengue fever cases in a single day, including 79 in Chennai. The daily tally averages around 200, indicating a sustained surge of dengue across the state. In response, government hospitals have set up dedicated dengue wards to provide care and containment, while authorities have appointed specialized dengue prevention officers to reinforce control measures. According to the Tamil Nadu Health Department, this year has seen 17,277 dengue infections to date, underscoring ongoing transmission and pressure on public healthcare. The data reflect provincial-level impact with clustered cases in urban centers such as Chennai and broader statewide spread.

triage.headline_ja: 「デング熱感染の平均持続期間」に関するデータをタミル・ナードゥ州保健局が公表
triage.triage_reason: タミル・ナードゥ州でデング熱の持続的な流行が確認されているが、季節性の既知疾患であり国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低いため、経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: デング熱は毎年インド各地で流行する既知の風土病であり、州政府は既に専用病棟設置・防疫担当者配置など対応を行っている。年間17,277例は例年並みの範囲か不明で、重症度・死亡者数の記載もないため深刻性は不明。

article.articleHeadline: Meet Rajarshi Mandal, the 16-year-old Lexington student whose malaria model showed the same mosquito-net supply could prevent twice as many infections; he won $50,000
article.articleSummary: Rajarshi Mandal, a 16-year-old Lexington High School student from Lexington, Massachusetts, built an ordinary differential equation malaria transmission model to optimize the allocation of insecticide-treated bed nets under limited supply. Using a framework that simulates transmission with seasonality, insecticide resistance, net degradation, and remote-area logistics, his results show the same global net supply could prevent twice as many infections if nets are distributed where they have the greatest impact, rather than by population alone. The study addresses backward bifurcation to ensure transmission persistence under realistic conditions and derives a reproduction number reflecting transmission risk. Mandal abandoned an initial Deep Q Network after instability and now directly scores allocations. The work highlights global nets distributed around 200 million annually and earned him a $50,000 Davidson Fellows Scholarship, with an image from the Democratic Republic of Congo illustrating logistical hurdles that can impede even well-planned programs.

triage.headline_ja: 16歳のレキシントン高校生、ラジャルシ・マンダル君に会う—蚊帳の同量供給で感染予防を2倍にできるマラリアモデルを構築し、5万ドルを獲得
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は学生による研究・受賞に関する科学ニュースであり、実際の感染症アウトブレイクや公衆衛生上の緊急事態を報じるものではない。
triage.notes: 記事は米国マサチューセッツ州の高校生によるマラリア感染モデル研究の受賞に関する内容。DRCは蚊帳配布の物流課題を示す一例画像として言及されているのみで、実際のアウトブレイク発生地ではないため verified_locations には含めない。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Swine Influenza A H1N1

article.articleHeadline: Kasus Influenza A Merebak, Pakar UGM Bagikan 6 Langkah Cegah Penularan
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Influenza A cases are spreading, UGM experts share 6 steps to prevent transmission.
article.articleSummary: Influenza A cases are rising in Indonesia, with Ministry of Health data up to 12 September 2026 showing a 38% positivity rate for lab-confirmed influenza in week 35, up from 22% the prior week. Of 175 specimens tested, 66 were positive, with the majority identified as influenza A(H1N1)pdm09. The Jakarta report notes the circulating A(H1N1) lineage is a genetic descendant of the 2009 pandemic virus that has undergone mutations. In response, Universitas Gadjah Mada (UGM) microbiology experts advocate six steps to prevent transmission, while cautioning against overreaction. Prof. Tri Wibawa emphasizes that despite genetic changes, mitigation remains important to reduce spread. The article highlights the need for ongoing laboratory confirmation and public health measures to curb transmission as influenza A(H1N1) continues to circulate in Indonesia.

triage.headline_ja: インフルエンザA型症例が拡大、UGM専門家が感染予防の6つのステップを共有
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザA(H1N1)pdm09の陽性率上昇と変異が報告されているが、重症度や国際的拡大の明確な証拠はなく、専門家も過剰反応を戒めているため、経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: H1N1pdm09系統の変異が指摘されているが、重症例や死亡例の報告はなく、専門家は過剰な懸念を否定している。今後の検査確認と流行状況の推移を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: ஒரே நாளில் புதிதாக 228 பேருக்கு டெங்கு! தமிழகத்தில் தீவிரமாக பரவும் காய்ச்சல் பாதிப்பு!
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue: 228 new cases in a single day! Fever outbreak spreading rapidly in Tamil Nadu!
article.articleSummary: As of 21 September 2026, dengue fever in Tamil Nadu shows rapid spread with 228 new cases in a single day, including 79 in Chennai. The state’s total dengue cases reach 17,277, averaging about 200 daily. In response, government hospitals have opened dedicated dengue wards and authorities continue surveillance, though the outbreak persists and criticisms about containment remain. Health experts stress vector control to curb transmission, noting that dengue-carrying mosquitoes breed in clean, standing water; identifying and eliminating standing-water sites is essential. Officials urge swift actions to reduce breeding and prevent further spread across Tamil Nadu.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱：単日で228人の新規感染！タミル・ナードゥ州で急速に拡大する発熱の流行！
triage.triage_reason: タミル・ナードゥ州における季節性のデング熱流行で症例数は多いが、死亡や重症化の具体的情報がなく、異常性・国際的拡大の根拠も乏しいため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 毎年季節的に発生するデング熱の流行報道であり、州政府が専用病棟を開設するなど国内で対応中。重症度・死亡者数の詳細情報は記事に記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: தமிழ்நாட்டில் நேற்று ஒரேநாளில் 228 பேருக்கு டெங்கு
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue in Tamil Nadu: 228 people infected in a single day yesterday.
article.articleSummary: On 20 September 2026, Tamil Nadu reported 228 dengue fever cases in a single day, with Chennai accounting for 79 dengue cases and 29 chikungunya cases in the same city. Madurai district recorded 38 dengue cases over the previous 21 days. Statewide totals rise to 17,277 dengue and 4,648 chikungunya cases to date. The districts with the highest burden include Chennai, Coimbatore, Erode, Tiruppur, Salem, and Krishnagiri. Authorities have intensified vector-control measures and set up medical camps in affected areas to curb transmission. The outbreak is concentrated in urban and peri-urban regions, prompting ongoing public health interventions to suppress mosquito populations and prevent further spread.

triage.headline_ja: タミル・ナードゥ州でデング熱：昨日1日で228人感染
triage.triage_reason: インド・タミル・ナードゥ州における例年発生するデング熱・チクングニヤの季節性流行で、症例数は多いが重症度や異常性を示す情報がなく、既知の風土病的流行の範囲内と考えられるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: デング熱・チクングニヤはインド南部で例年季節性に流行する媒介性感染症であり、州当局がベクター対策を強化中。重症度（死亡・重症例）に関する情報が記事にないため、深刻度は不明と評価した。

article.articleHeadline: 雲林男從中國走私禽流感疫苗 假劉德華名義虛報成「酸奶」 ｜ 公視新聞網 PNN
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Yunlin man smuggled avian influenza vaccine from China and, under the name of a fake Andy Lau, falsely declared it as 'yogurt' | Public Television News Network PNN
article.articleSummary: In Yunlin, Taiwan, a man surnamed Chen smuggled unauthorized avian influenza vaccines from China, disguising shipments as yogurt and using the fake recipient name 'Andy Lau' to evade customs. Coast Guard Yunlin interception team seized 93.6 liters of unapproved poultry vaccine packed in 200cc bottles, with over 20 boxes of vaccines confiscated. To bypass checks, the suspect rerouted deliveries through domestic logistics platforms and altered delivery points at the last moment. Prosecutors completed investigation and have indicted Chen under the Animal Drugs Administration Act, Article 33(1), for importing prohibited veterinary medicines. The seized goods are valued at over NT$500,000 and could have sufficed to treat about 100,000 poultry, had they been legitimate and properly tested. Authorities urge poultry producers not to use vaccines obtained from unverified sources to prevent legal penalties and potential risk to animal health.

triage.headline_ja: 雲林の男が中国から鳥インフルエンザワクチンを密輸、偽の劉德華の名義で『ヨーグルト』と虚偽申告｜公視新聞網 PNN
triage.triage_reason: 本件は鳥インフルエンザワクチンの密輸・虚偽申告に関する司法・税関事案であり、実際の感染症発生や公衆衛生上の異常事態を報じるものではない。
triage.notes: 記事は密輸・虚偽申告事件の司法手続きに関する報道であり、鳥インフルエンザの実際の発生や流行を示すものではない。台湾・中国のいずれも感染症発生地としては確認されないため、verified_locationsは空とした。

article.articleHeadline: 2040-ഓടെ കേരളത്തിൽ ഡെങ്കിപ്പനി ബാധ 16-20% വരെ വർധിച്ചേക്കാം: പഠനം
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue infection in Kerala could rise by up to 16-20% by 2040: study.
article.articleSummary: Dengue in Kerala could increase 16-20% by 2040, according to a GeoHealth study led by the Indian Institute of Tropical Meteorology under the Ministry of Earth Sciences. The study links the rise to climate factors—temperature, rainfall, humidity, and El Niño–La Niña—that influence Aedes mosquito reproduction, survival, biting, and viral growth. Researchers analyzed health department data from 2006–2019 and climate records, with contributions from Savitribai Phule Pune University, ICMR-National Institute of Translational Virology and AIDS Research, Kerala University of Health Sciences, and Thrissur Government Medical College. During the inter-monsoon period, about 60% of total dengue cases occur; pre-monsoon temperatures of 30.5–32.5 C and humidity of 66–79%, along with monsoon rainfall of 180–450 mm monthly, favor transmission. The team recommends AI-based machine-learning models to forecast disease risk up to five months in advance.

triage.headline_ja: 2040年までにケララ州のデング熱感染が16-20%増加する可能性:研究
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は2040年までの将来予測に関する学術研究の報道であり、現在進行中のアウトブレイクや公衆衛生上の緊急事態を示すものではないため、シグナルとしての優先度は低い。
triage.notes: 本記事はインド地球科学省傘下の研究機関による気候変動とデング熱発生率の将来予測に関する学術研究の紹介であり、現在の感染症アウトブレイクを報告するものではない。ケララ州が対象地域として言及されているため、Indiaのみをverified_locationsに含めた。

article.articleHeadline: அண்ணா பல்கலையில் டெங்கு பரிசோதனை.. 20+ மாணவர்களுக்கு உடல்நலக்குறைவு.. வீட்டுக்கு செல்ல அறிவுரை!
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue testing at Anna University campus... over 20 students fell ill... advised to go home!
article.articleSummary: Dengue testing at Chennai's Anna University campus amid monsoon-driven outbreak; about 200 students were tested and more than 20 showed thrombocytopenia (low blood platelet counts). Administration advised students with low platelets to return to their home towns for appropriate treatment; those unwilling to travel may stay in hospital under university supervision. Tamil Nadu reported 253 dengue cases yesterday, underscoring the surge during the monsoon season. The university noted three students died from scrub typhus, not dengue, and earlier one student died due to fever. Medical follow-up and laboratory monitoring of students are ongoing to track illness progression. Laboratory confirmation procedures are ongoing, with medical tests tracking platelet counts and symptoms.

triage.headline_ja: アンナ大学構内でデング熱検査を実施…20人以上の学生が体調不良…帰宅を勧告
triage.triage_reason: 季節性のデング熱流行に加え、大学構内で複数の学生が血小板減少を示し、ツツガムシ病による死亡例も報告されているが、詳細な感染経路や規模は不明であり、続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: デング熱はタミル・ナードゥ州で季節性の流行として毎年報告されており、大学構内のクラスターは監視下にある。ツツガムシ病による死亡例も併記されているが、デング熱とは別の感染症であり、混在した報告に注意が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Sambut World Rabies Day 2026, Riau Gelar Vaksinasi Rabies Gratis untuk Hewan Peliharaan
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: To Mark World Rabies Day 2026, Riau Holds Free Rabies Vaccinations for Pets
article.articleSummary: Rabies vaccination campaign offers free rabies vaccines for pets in Riau Province, Indonesia, from September 21–28, 2026, aligned with World Rabies Day 2026 and the Bulan Bakti Peternakan dan Kesehatan Hewan. Organized by the Riau Provincial Department of Livestock and Animal Health, the initiative aims to protect pets and prevent transmission of rabies to humans. Free vaccination is available according to scheduled service locations and times. Target animals include dogs, cats, and other rabies-susceptible species. Beyond vaccination, the program seeks to raise public awareness about pet health and encourage regular health checks. The effort underscores government-community collaboration to create safer environments for both humans and animals.

triage.headline_ja: 世界狂犬病デー2026を記念し、リアウ州がペット向け無料狂犬病ワクチン接種を実施
triage.triage_reason: 世界狂犬病デーに合わせた予防的な無料ワクチン接種キャンペーンの告知記事であり、実際の感染事例やアウトブレイクの報告はない。
triage.notes: 本記事は予防啓発キャンペーンの案内であり、感染症アウトブレイクの発生を示すものではない。

article.articleHeadline: 潮州爆"不明死因猪肉干"　检测证实：病毒阳性 - 国际 - 即时国际
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Chaozhou reports "pork jerky of unknown cause of death" — tests confirm: virus positive - International - Real-Time International
article.articleSummary: On 21 September 2026, Chaozhou, Guangdong, China, announced that a Dongfeng Town meat factory in Cha'an District used pork with unknown cause of death as raw material to make pork jerky. Law enforcement seized raw pork and semi-finished products; laboratory tests showed a pork virus positive, though the specific virus type was not disclosed. The implicated goods are valued at about 210,000 yuan, and the case has been handed to public security for criminal investigation under Article 143 of the PRC Criminal Law. Officials warn that raw-material safety is the first line of defense, and using meat from pigs with unknown death causes violates food-safety laws and criminal law. Producers are urged to enforce supplier checks, ensure traceability and quarantine documentation, and ban diseased, dead, unknown-cause, or unquarantined meat in foods.

triage.headline_ja: 潮州で「死因不明の豚肉から作られた豚肉干（ポークジャーキー）」発覚　検査でウイルス陽性と判明
triage.triage_reason: 死因不明の豚を用いた食品衛生法違反事案であり、ヒトへの感染事例や公衆衛生上の影響は報告されていない。行政・司法当局による摘発・押収で既に対応済みであり、シグナルとしての緊急性は低い。
triage.notes: ウイルスの具体的な種類は非公表。ヒト感染例の報告はなく、食品安全・動物衛生分野の取締り事案として処理されている。

article.articleHeadline: 呼吸道合胞病毒流行季提前了！感染呼吸道合胞病毒可不是小事
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: RSV season has started earlier than usual! RSV infections are no small matter.
article.articleSummary: RSV season has started earlier in China. Since late August, among hospitalized children aged 0-4 with severe acute respiratory infection (SARI), Respiratory Syncytial Virus (RSV) positivity has ranked in the top three etiologies for three consecutive weeks, with infections rising. Transmission occurs mainly via respiratory droplets and close contact, and can spread indirectly via objects contaminated with the virus. High-risk groups include children under 5 years, the elderly, and immunocompromised individuals. About 20-30% of infected infants may experience recurrent wheeze, and asthma risk increases within 2-5 years after infection. In severe cases, RSV can progress to respiratory failure or death. Data come from the Chinese Center for Disease Control and Prevention, underscoring the need for continued vigilance as the season progresses.

triage.headline_ja: RSV流行シーズンが例年より早く到来！RSV感染は軽視できない
triage.triage_reason: 季節性RSVの早期流行という通常の公衆衛生情報であり、IHR基準は該当しないが、流行の早期化という点でWPRO基準の一部に該当するため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: RSVは季節性の既知病原体であり、中国CDCによる通常のサーベイランス情報。流行開始時期の早期化のみが特徴的だが、重大な公衆衛生上の危機ではない。

article.articleHeadline: 질병청, 4분기 중점검역관리지역 32개국 지정...브라질·미국 추가
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: KDCA designates 32 countries as priority quarantine management regions for the fourth quarter... Brazil and the United States added.
article.articleSummary: KDCA designates 32 countries as the fourth-quarter core (priority) quarantine management region for five diseases: plague, avian influenza in humans, MERS, Ebola virus disease, and Nipah virus infection. India and Henan, China are removed from the core list, while Brazil, Michigan (USA), and Anhui and Jiangsu (China) are added. India remains in the Nipah core region with mandatory health-status reporting on entry. Ebola updates reference WHO declaring a PHEIC on May 17, with 7,043 cumulative cases and 3,400 deaths, and spread expanding to seven provinces in the DR Congo. Separately, the overall quarantine region (177 countries) adds seven and removes three countries; Japan and Hong Kong are added due to chikungunya outbreaks, and China is designated nationwide for chikungunya. All entrants with stay or transit in quarantine regions must report health status via a health declaration or Q-CODE. Effective Oct 1, 2026.

triage.headline_ja: 疾病管理庁、第4四半期の重点検疫管理地域として32カ国を指定…ブラジル・米国を追加
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱（DRCでPHEIC宣言済み、死者3,400人超）とチクングニア熱の中国全土・香港・日本への拡大など、複数の重大な感染症事象を背景に検疫規制強化が行われており、IHR基準に複数該当する。
triage.notes: 本記事は韓国疾病管理庁による検疫地域指定の行政発表であり、既知のエボラ出血熱（DRC、WHO PHEIC宣言済み）およびチクングニア熱の中国全土・香港・日本への拡大を背景としている。ブラジル・米国ミシガン州・中国安徽省/江蘇省の追加理由は具体的疾病名が明示されておらず不明。日本・香港は対象国リスト外のため verified_locations から除外し、香港のチクングニア関連情報は中国に統合して記載。

article.articleHeadline: يشبه إيبولا.. تصاعد تفشي فيروس جديد في وسط أفريقيا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Similar to Ebola... Escalation of a new virus outbreak in Central Africa.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo virus outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda; as of mid-June 2026, 695 laboratory-confirmed cases and 138 deaths. Outbreak officially declared in 2026 after a nurse died. Transmission by direct contact with bodily fluids; increased risk for families and healthcare workers, especially where infection-control is weak. Early symptoms mimic malaria and typhoid fever, requiring laboratory confirmation; limited access to specialized laboratories causes diagnostic delays of days to weeks, hindering isolation and contact tracing. Highlights gaps in outbreak preparedness, with focus often on more well-known viruses. No licensed vaccine or treatment for Bundibugyo virus; vaccines for other Ebola strains might offer partial protection, but no targeted tools available. Recommendations: develop broad-spectrum diagnostics and vaccines; strengthen cross-border health systems for rapid, coordinated responses to rare pathogens.

triage.headline_ja: エボラに類似…中央アフリカで新型ウイルスの流行が拡大
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国とウガンダでブンディブギョ・エボラウイルス（フィロウイルス科）の流行が拡大し、695例・138人死亡と重大な公衆衛生上の影響があり、ワクチン・治療法がなく国境を越えた拡大リスクが高いため、フルリスク評価に進むべきシグナルと判断。
triage.notes: ウガンダも発生国として記載されているが、対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。ブンディブギョウイルスは既知のエボラ株の一種であり、致死率約20%（138/695）、診断遅延・専用ワクチンなしという点で管理上の課題が大きい。

article.articleHeadline: CG के इस जिले में स्वाइन फ्लू के बाद स्क्रब टाइफस ने दी दस्तक! एक की मौत, दूसरा अस्पताल में भर्ती | After swine fever, scrub typhus strikes this district in Chhattisgarh! One dead, another hospitalized.
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: After swine flu, scrub typhus strikes this district in Chhattisgarh! One dead, another hospitalized.
article.articleSummary: As of 21 September 2026, Scrub typhus has emerged in Janjgir-Champa district, Chhattisgarh, with 5 confirmed cases this season; one death and another patient is hospitalized in a Bilaspur private hospital. About 10–15 samples sent for testing returned negative. Scrub typhus is caused by Orientia tsutsugamushi and transmitted by chigger mite larvae, with highest risk among farm/field workers in grassy, damp areas. Early symptoms resemble viral fever; without timely treatment it can progress to pneumonia, meningoencephalitis, kidney and liver injury, and multi-organ failure. Characteristic signs include high fever with chills, severe headache, myalgia, an eschar at the bite site, and a subsequent rash. Preventive advice includes covering skin and wearing long sleeves in tall grass. Separately, Swine Flu activity: 13 samples tested, 6 positive (1/3 from district hospital; 4/9 from ADC Lab; 1/1 from SJ Lab); one death reported on 6 September. District Surveillance Unit issued an advisory for vigilance.

triage.headline_ja: スワインフルー(豚インフルエンザ)後、スクラブチフスがチャッティースガル州のこの県を襲う！1人死亡、もう1人入院
triage.triage_reason: 地方(チャッティースガル州ジャンジギル・チャンパ県)での季節性スクラブチフス及び豚インフルエンザの小規模発生であり、症例数は少数(各5～6例)で国際的拡大の兆候はないが、死亡例が出ており継続監視が必要。
triage.notes: スクラブチフスはインドで季節性・地域流行性の疾患であり、今回の報告も地区単位の小規模発生（5例、1死亡）。豚インフルエンザも同地区で6陽性例・1死亡が報告されているが、いずれも国際的な公衆衛生上の懸念には至っていない。地区サーベイランス部門が警戒を呼びかけている点から一定の行政的関心はあるが、社会的関心の広がりは記事からは不明。

article.articleHeadline: 广东腊味厂死因不明猪肉原料和半成品 验出猪病毒呈阳性
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Unknown cause of death at Guangdong cured-meat factory; pork raw materials and semi-finished products tested positive for porcine virus.
article.articleSummary: In Chaozhou, Guangdong Province, China, authorities disclosed progress in a food-safety crackdown after a May raid on a cured-meat factory. They seized pork raw materials and semi-finished products with unknown cause of death; laboratory tests detected a porcine virus in these items. The case, linked to an individual with the surname Chen, is being processed by the authorities for producing and selling foods that do not meet safety standards, with the Chao’an District Market Regulation Bureau forwarding it to public security for filing. The seized goods were valued at about RMB 210,000 (roughly SGD 40,000). The broader crackdown targets illegal meat-product activity and online food issues, focusing on procurement, use, sale, and processing of meat of unknown origin, uninspected or unqualified products, meat-origin fraud, illegal additives, and excessive use of additives in cured meats and related products.

triage.headline_ja: 広東の腊味工場、死因不明の豚肉原料と半製品からブタウイルス陽性反応
triage.triage_reason: 食品安全違反（不明死因の豚肉使用）に関する行政摘発事案であり、ヒトの公衆衛生への直接的な感染症拡大リスクは記載されていない。
triage.notes: 本件は豚肉の食品安全・不正取引に関する摘発報道であり、ヒトや動物集団での感染症アウトブレイクの発生は確認されていない。ブタウイルスの種類も不明で、家畜疫病（例：ASF等）としての詳細情報がないためDISMISSと判断。

article.articleHeadline: 假冒 「劉德華」！走私禽流感疫苗遭海巡攔截 | LIFE生活網
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Impersonating "Andy Lau"! Smuggled avian influenza vaccines intercepted by the coast guard | LIFE Lifestyle Network
article.articleSummary: On 2026-09-21, Taiwan's Coast Guard Administration Yunlin Investigation Team, in collaboration with police, customs, and disease prevention agencies, intercepted 93.6 liters of unauthorized avian influenza vaccines imported from China during regional outbreaks. A man surnamed Chen attempted to order illicit vaccines twice via illegal channels, disguising the consignee name as pop star Andy Lau and concealing the packages as yogurt beverages to evade customs, with plans to route shipments through domestic logistics platforms to designated points for final delivery. The seizure occurred at entry, preventing potential spread to domestic poultry; the vaccines, with unknown ingredients and untested, could have served about 100,000 poultry. The case is prosecuted under the Animal Drug Management Act. Authorities warn against using unverified veterinary drugs and urge the public to report illegal activity via the 118 hotline for possible rewards.

triage.headline_ja: 偽物「劉徳華」！密輸された鳥インフルエンザワクチンが海巡に摘発される

Since Jan 1, ILI totals reached 1,788; dengue 3,155; leptospirosis 1,440; COVID-19 confirmed cases 94. No new cholera, typhoid fever or SARI cases; year-to-date totals stand at 4, 74, and 405 respectively. Data come from the Electronic Disease Case Surveillance and Information System (EDCS-IS) as of 7 a.m. Monday. Manila Mayor Isko Moreno Domagoso urged residents not to wait for symptoms to worsen and to seek prompt consultation at the nearest health facility during the rainy season; authorities advised avoiding stagnant water, drinking clean water, and maintaining cleanliness to reduce W.I.L.L.D. transmission.

article.articleHeadline: Главный эпидемиолог Башкирии предупредил туристов о смертельной опасности в Таиланде " Новости Уфы и Республики Башкортостан - UfaTime.ru
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The chief epidemiologist of Bashkortostan warned tourists about a deadly danger in Thailand.
article.articleSummary: Chief epidemiologist Azat Mukhametzyanov of Bashkortostan warned residents about a deadly tick-borne virus outbreak in Thailand: Severe Fever with Thrombocytopenia Syndrome (SFTS). Thailand has three cases this year, with two fatalities; from 2019–2026, there have been 10 cases, half fatal. SFTS was first described in China in 2009 and has since been detected in Japan, South Korea, and Thailand. Peak incidence occurs May–November when ticks are most active; incubation is 7–14 days. Early symptoms resemble a cold—fever over 38°C, weakness, headache, nausea—followed by thrombocytopenia, leukopenia, gingival bleeding, and hemorrhages; severe cases can progress to multiorgan failure and meningioencephalitis. No specific treatment exists. Prevention includes repellents, covered clothing, checking oneself and pets after walks, and avoiding tall grass and shrubs. If fever develops after travel, seek medical care promptly and report travel history.
