article.articleHeadline: Dengue Fever: அதிகரிக்கும் டெங்கு காய்ச்சல்: அறிகுறி, தடுப்பது எப்படி? என்ன செய்யக்கூடாது?- மருத்துவர் வழிகாட்டல்
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue Fever: Rising Dengue Fever: Symptoms, How to Prevent It? What Not to Do? - Doctor's Guidance
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever is surging across Tamil Nadu, India, caused by dengue virus and transmitted by Aedes mosquitoes; human-to-human spread is not direct. Aedes larvae thrive in standing water around homes—plastic bags, bottles, cups, water containers, plant saucers, and water collected behind refrigerators; as little as 10 ml of water supports development. Dengue and malaria share mosquito-borne transmission. Symptoms include sudden high fever (>102°F) from day one, severe body aches, eye/back pain, abdominal pain, and dark stools. Fever lasting three days then a sudden relief on day four is not reassuring. Prevention: cover stored water, keep surroundings clean, remove water-collecting items, and seek medical care rather than self-medicating. Abate larvicide (1 mL per liter) can be added to standing water; Pyrethrum spray may be used indoors; use mosquito nets and wear long sleeves; consult local government clinics.

article.articleHeadline: Kasus Malaria di Bangka Barat Alami Penurunan, Musim Kemarau Buat Nyamuk Anopheles Sulit Berkembang
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Malaria Cases in West Bangka Regency Have Declined as the Dry Season Makes Anopheles Mosquitoes Hard to Breed
article.articleSummary: Malaria cases in West Bangka Regency totalled 141 from January through September 14, 2026, per the Bangka Barat Health Office. Monthly counts: 3 (Jan), 2 (Feb), 1 (Mar), 2 (Apr), 9 (May), 24 (Jun), 45 (Jul), 44 (Aug); 11 by mid-September. May–September accounted for 133 cases (about 94.3% of the year’s total). The mid-September decline aligns with the peak dry season, as Anopheles breeding is hampered; mosquito lifecycles span 1–2 months, with adults unlikely to survive above 34°C. Groundwater puddles host malaria larvae, unlike dengue mosquitoes that breed in drums or water tanks. Control measures included releasing fish into wells and lagoons to consume larvae. Most cases are concentrated in tin-mining areas, indicating environmental risk linked to mining zones.

article.articleHeadline: Beban Dengue Tembus Hampir Rp9 Triliun
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue Burden Hits Nearly Rp9 Trillion
article.articleSummary: Indonesia's dengue burden cost USD 550.9 million (about Rp9 trillion) in 2024, with more than 2 million hospital visits, a figure presented at the Asia Dengue Summit 9 in Singapore (June 2026). As a hyperendemic tropical nation, Indonesia faces year‑round transmission; WHO notes 2024 as the world's highest dengue case year. Most costs in 2024 were borne by BPJS Kesehatan/JKN–covered patients: direct medical costs about Rp3 trillion, plus Rp3.5 trillion in out‑of‑pocket and nonmedical expenses. Per episode costs were Rp1.09–1.33 million for JKN patients, versus Rp4.27–5.60 million for those uninsured. The burden disproportionately affects lower‑income families and could hamper the government's 8% growth target for 2029. Interventions include vector control (PSN 3M Plus, Jumantik), surveillance, and vaccination. UGM analysis finds school‑age dengue vaccination cost‑effective, potentially saving 329.3–731.5 million USD and preventing 1.1–1.3 million DALYs over 20 years.

The government urges facilities to monitor cases closely and manage patients according to illness severity, emphasizing that hospitals should not overlook influenza presentations and must provide appropriate care, whether via outpatient management or timely referrals. There have been no reports of hospitals in East Java being overwhelmed or denying care due to increased Influenza A. Authorities will continue monitoring and invite public and health-facility reporting to respond rapidly to service pressures. The report notes that ISPA/Influenza A symptoms can worsen in vulnerable individuals, underscoring the need for cautious clinical assessment.

article.articleHeadline: Tiga Petunjuk Emas bagi Orang Tua saat Anak Terinfeksi Influenza A, Jangan Sampai Terlewat
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Three Golden Tips for Parents When Their Child Is Infected with Influenza A — Don’t Miss Them
article.articleSummary: Influenza A in children in Bandung, West Java, Indonesia, warrants vigilant parental monitoring beyond fever. IDAI Jawa Barat chair Prof. Dr. Anggraini Alam emphasizes three 'golden clues': activity level, fluid intake, and urine output. Fever alone is not a reliable severity marker; when fever subsides, a child who remains active, communicative, and engaged is typically safer. Parents should ensure the child continues to drink, and to urinate roughly every four hours, as hydration supports recovery. Immediate emergency care is advised if the child is difficult to wake, shows unusual behavior or agitation, experiences seizures, rapid breathing, appears blue, bleeds, or has not urinated for six hours. Although influenza can threaten the respiratory system, rare neurological complications may occur, especially in children with comorbidities or immune disorders, and require prompt treatment. The article notes vaccination, hygiene, and isolation when ill as key preventive measures.

article.articleHeadline: Africa CDC welcomes U.S. Convened G20+ Ebola Meeting and Calls for United Action, Faster Delivery and Full Transparency
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in DRC Ituri remains active; Uganda ended its outbreak on 27 August 2026. Africa CDC welcomes the U.S.-convened G20 meeting on Accelerating Collective Action to Defeat Ebola, scheduled for 23 September 2026 in New York on the UN General Assembly margins. Africa CDC Director General Dr. Jean Kaseya will represent the AU's 55 member states and 1.5 billion Africans, underscoring Africa's leadership in public health responses. The agency also welcomes participation from DR Congo authorities and Uganda; Uganda's involvement follows its outbreak's end. Transmission persists and geographic expansion risks further spread; gains must be consolidated, especially in Ituri. Following President Tshisekedi's guidance, Africa CDC promotes a village-centered approach with early detection and community trust. It calls for faster, transparent, accountable delivery via the Africa CDC Financial Tracking Mechanism to trace funds and connect resources to frontline action, in coordination with WHO and partners.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカCDC、米国主催のG20+エボラ会議を歓迎し、統一行動・迅速な支援提供・完全な透明性を要請
triage.triage_reason: DRC・Ituriで継続中のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクに地理的拡大リスクがあり、国際的な高レベル会議（G20+）が招集されるなど社会的・政治的関心が高いため、フルRRAへの移行が適切。
triage.notes: ウガンダは2026年8月27日にアウトブレイク終息を宣言済みのため対象国リストにも含まれず除外。米国・国連（ニューヨーク）は会議開催地であり感染発生地ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: La riposte à Ebola progresse, mais l'épidémie reste une urgence continentale, selon des scientifiques africains - Africa CDC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola response is progressing, but the outbreak remains a continental emergency, according to African scientists - Africa CDC.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo caused by Bundibugyo virus remains a continental emergency four months after designation as USP-SC/PHECS. In Ituri, declines in cases and deaths are encouraging, but transmission is still active and rising in Nord-Kivu. The epidemic peak has not yet been confirmed, and transmission has not been durably interrupted across all zones. Community deaths remain around 60% of fatalities, with ongoing gaps in contact tracing and disruption to essential health services. Immediate priorities: maintain and intensify the response, particularly in Nord-Kivu; strengthen identification and follow-up of contacts; improve data quality; deepen community engagement; protect and restore health services; sustain enhanced surveillance and vaccination studies, while acknowledging uncertainty about protection levels.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ対応は進展しているが、アフリカCDCによれば流行は依然として大陸規模の緊急事態である
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョウイルス）流行が継続しており、Africa CDCが大陸規模の公衆衛生緊急事態(PHECS)と位置付けている。IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当し、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: Ituriでは症例・死亡数が減少傾向にあるが、Nord-Kivuでは感染が拡大中で流行のピークは未確認。コミュニティでの死亡が全体の約60%を占め、接触者追跡や保健サービスに課題が残る。

article.articleHeadline: DR Congo expands Ebola vaccination to Ituri, over 3,700 people vaccinated
article.articleSummary: Ituri Province in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) expands Ebola vaccination with Ervebo, vaccinating over 3,700 people, as Bunia hosts the BRAVO study by MSF with Congolese health authorities and Africa CDC to vaccinate about 20,000 frontline workers in Ituri and North Kivu to assess Ervebo against Bundibugyo virus, which drives the outbreak. Ervebo is licensed against Zaire virus; its protection against Bundibugyo is unproven. The International Coordinating Group allocated 70,000 doses to the DRC in August (50,000 for health/frontline workers; 20,000 for a Phase 3 trial). By mid-September, 16,520 doses had been received; vaccination began Aug 27. As of Sept 17, 3,771 people had been vaccinated (3,063 in Tshopo, 708 in Bas-Uele). The DRC has 7,541 confirmed cases, 3,639 deaths ( CFR 48.3%), and 1,823 recoveries. Declared in May, the outbreak is the largest and deadliest in the DRC and the second-largest globally after 2014–2016 West Africa.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、イトゥリ州でエボラワクチン接種を拡大、3,700人以上が接種完了
triage.triage_reason: DRCで進行中のエボラ流行はCFR48.3%と極めて重篤で、DRC史上最大規模の流行。国際的な支援（MSF、Africa CDC、ワクチン供給）が継続的に必要とされている。
triage.notes: 記事はイトゥリ州でのワクチン接種拡大に関する続報だが、背景にあるエボラ流行自体は5月に宣言され、7,541症例・3,639死亡（CFR48.3%）と西アフリカ2014-2016に次ぐ世界2番目の規模。Bundibugyoウイルスによる流行でErvebo（Zaire株用ワクチン）の有効性は未実証であり、フェーズ3試験が進行中。アンゴラは発生地域に含まれるが記事本文で言及がないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Kisangani : le Festival Ngoma s'ouvre sous mesures sanitaires contre Ebola - LePotentiel
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kisangani: Ngoma Festival Opens Under Sanitary Measures to Combat Ebola
article.articleSummary: Kisangani’s 16th Ngoma Festival opens on September 21, 2026 in Kisangani, the capital of Tshopo, with sanitary measures to prevent the Ebola virus disease spread during performances. Coordinated by Magloire Bolunda, hygiene buckets are installed at several site points and entry temperature is screened with a thermo-flash, particularly for journalists. Organizers say barrier gestures will be enforced to reduce transmission risk and protect the public and artists throughout the festival. No Ebola case counts, outbreaks, laboratory confirmation, infection sources, or imported/exported cases are reported in the article; the focus is on preventive public‑health measures at a mass gathering in Kisangani.

triage.headline_ja: キサンガニ:第16回ンゴマ祭り、エボラ対策の衛生措置下で開幕
triage.triage_reason: 記事はエボラ流行そのものではなく、祭りにおける予防的衛生対策（手洗い設備、体温スクリーニング等）のみを報じており、症例数や発生確認情報が一切含まれないため、情報不足として経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 記事はマスギャザリング（祭り）での予防措置に焦点を当てており、エボラの実際の症例数、発生源、確認情報は報告されていない。DRCでは過去に複数回のエボラ流行歴があるため、対策自体は必ずしも新規発生を意味しない可能性がある。続報での症例確認情報の有無を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: В Демократической Республике Конго начались испытания вакцины против Эболы -- НИАТ "Ховар"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In the Democratic Republic of the Congo, trials of an Ebola vaccine have begun — NIAT "Khovar".
article.articleSummary: On 21 September 2026, in Bunia, Ituri Province, Democratic Republic of the Congo, the first frontline volunteers received the Ervebo Ebola vaccine as part of a trial. Over 9–12 months, about 20,000 volunteers will be vaccinated to determine protective efficacy against the Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain driving the current outbreak; efficacy against the Zaïre strain had been previously confirmed. The DRC is in its 17th Ebola epidemic. National Institute of Public Health data show 7,541 infections and 3,639 deaths, with 1,823 recoveries, and spread across seven provinces. In August, roughly 70,000 doses of Ervebo were allocated. According to health ministry spokesperson Steve Ahuki, while vaccine performance against Zaïr is established, effectiveness against Bundibugyo remains to be determined. The trial focuses on frontline personnel in affected regions.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラワクチンの試験が開始 ― NIAT「ホヴァル」
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で進行中の第17次エボラ流行（感染7,541人、死亡3,639人）は重大な公衆衛生上の影響があり、ブンディブギョ株による流行という異常性、国際的拡大・渡航制限のリスクも認められるためフルRRAへの移行が妥当。
triage.notes: 記事は主にエルベボ（Ervebo）ワクチンの臨床試験開始を報じているが、背景として進行中の大規模エボラ流行（致死率約48%、7州に拡大）が存在するため、既存流行の継続状況としてピックアップと判断。

article.articleHeadline: Dinkes Situbondo catat temuan puluhan kasus "flu-like illness"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Situbondo Health Office records dozens of influenza-like illness cases.
article.articleSummary: Influenza-like illness (ILI) in Situbondo, East Java, Indonesia: by mid-September 2026, 67 ILI cases across 10 kecamatan, with Kendit reporting the highest (14) and Kapongan 13. Symptoms include fever up to 38°C and cough. Cases span Sumbermalang, Mlandingan, Banyuglugur, Bungatan, Situbondo, Arjasa, Banyuputih, Besuki, and Kendit’s vicinity. Health authorities urge hygiene, regular handwashing, masks when ill, and immune strengthening. No 'super flu' cases have been detected so far; surveillance data from puskesmas and hospitals continues through week 36 of 2026. There is no mention of laboratory confirmation, pathogen identification, or imported/exported cases. Public health messaging targets residents of Situbondo to reduce transmission.

triage.headline_ja: シトゥボンド保健局、インフルエンザ様疾患数十例を記録
triage.triage_reason: 軽症のインフルエンザ様疾患が複数地域で発生しているが、病原体特定なく重症例・死亡の報告もないため、現時点でフルRRAの必要性は低いが経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: 病原体の検査確認なし。'スーパーフル'（重症型）の報告はないとされ、地域保健当局が通常のサーベイランス下で対応している状況。

article.articleHeadline: چند توصیه به دیابتی‌ها در صورت ابتلا به آنفلوآنزا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A few tips for diabetics if they contract influenza.
article.articleSummary: Influenza infection in diabetics requires vigilant glycemic management. Diabetes, characterized by irregular blood glucose and impaired immunity, can raise infection risk and slow recovery if glucose remains uncontrolled. Influenza can stress the body, reduce appetite, cause fatigue and dehydration, all of which destabilize glucose. Diabetics should check blood glucose every four hours and maintain appropriate eating patterns during illness. Hydration with fluids that do not raise glucose is essential to avoid dehydration and polyuria. Warning signs needing closer care include polyuria, dry mouth, confusion, abdominal pain or nausea, weight loss, reduced consciousness, fever, and rising glucose. Many OTC medicines, especially decongestants and cough syrups, can affect glucose; thus medical consultation is advised before use. The guidance is reported by Iranian health outlets citing Times of India.

triage.headline_ja: 糖尿病患者がインフルエンザに罹患した場合のいくつかのアドバイス
triage.triage_reason: 糖尿病患者向けの一般的な健康アドバイス記事であり、特定の疾病発生や公衆衛生上の異常事象を報告するものではない。
triage.notes: 記事はインフルエンザと糖尿病の併発時の健康管理に関する一般的な医療アドバイスであり、イラン・インドいずれにおいても具体的な感染症発生イベントを報じていない。Times of Indiaの記事をイランのメディアが引用したもの。

article.articleHeadline: 合胞病毒高发季来临 ！江苏小宝宝预防添新选择
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: RSV season is here! A new preventive option for infants in Jiangsu.
article.articleSummary: RSV season has arrived in Jiangsu with deployment of a long-acting imported RSV monoclonal antibody for infants. RSV is a highly contagious cause of infant lower respiratory infections and the leading cause of hospitalization in children under 2, with nearly all children infected by age 2. On September 21, 2026, the first doses were administered in Jiangsu: at Nanjing Children’s Hospital a 5-month-old received the vaccine, and at Jiangsu Province Maternal and Child Health Hospital, two-month-old twins were vaccinated. The antibody offers 5–6 months of protection and uses a single fixed dose regardless of weight. Two imported products are in use: the earlier weight-based regimen introduced in 2024 and a newer fixed-dose antibody approved in June 2026. RSV symptoms range from fever and cough to bronchiolitis or pneumonia; transmission occurs via droplets and close contact. Prevention emphasizes reducing exposure, good indoor ventilation, and monoclonal-antibody prophylaxis in clinical settings.

triage.headline_ja: 合胞病毒（RSV）流行シーズン到来！江蘇省の乳児予防に新たな選択肢
triage.triage_reason: 毎年季節性のRSV流行と予防接種（モノクローナル抗体）の紹介記事であり、異常な公衆衛生事象や社会的関心の高まりは見られない。
triage.notes: 季節性RSV流行と新規予防薬導入に関する通常の医療情報記事。異常事象ではない。

article.articleHeadline: 影/化名「劉德華」走私禽流感疫苗！雲林養鴨男遭起訴
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Alias 'Andy Lau' smuggled avian influenza vaccines! Yunlin duck farmer indicted.
article.articleSummary: On 2026-09-21, in Yunlin, Taiwan, a 40-year-old duck-farm operator Chen used the alias 'Liu Dehua' (Andy Lau) to smuggle 93.6 liters of avian influenza vaccine from mainland China by disguising it as yogurt, coordinating via domestic logistics platforms. A joint coast guard task force and prosecutors arrested him upon interception and indicted him for violating the Animal Drugs Management Act. Investigations show he twice ordered unapproved avian influenza vaccines to shield his farm during a regional outbreak in southern-central Taiwan. The unverified vaccine, with unknown ingredients, could vaccinate around 100,000 poultry if released, posing risks of disease spread and undermining Taiwan's animal health and public health. Authorities warn against using unknown veterinary medicines and urge reporting tips via the 118 hotline.

triage.headline_ja: 影/化名「劉德華」で禽流感ワクチンを密輸！雲林の養鴨業者が起訴される
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は台湾における鳥インフルエンザワクチンの密輸・起訴事件に関する法執行ニュースであり、疾病発生そのものの報告ではない。発生地域も対象国リストに含まれない台湾であるため、公衆衛生シグナルとしての優先度は低い。
triage.notes: 記事は密輸・起訴に関する法執行事件であり、実際の鳥インフルエンザ発生地は台湾（対象国リスト外）。中国本土はワクチンの出所として言及されているのみで、感染症発生地としての言及ではないため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Dinkes Kota Tasikmalaya Temukan 2.303 Kasus TB, 25 Orang Meninggal Dunia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Tasikmalaya City Health Office Finds 2,303 TB Cases, 25 People Have Died
article.articleSummary: Tasikmalaya City Health Office, West Java, Indonesia, reports 2,303 residents preliminarily positive for tuberculosis (TB) from January–September 2026 screening, with 25 deaths. Of these, 18 are identified as multidrug-resistant TB (TB-MDR). MDR-TB cases are receiving intensive treatment with special drugs such as isoniazid and rifampicin, though their condition typically fails to improve or worsens after six months of standard therapy, under tight supervision. Most patients remain hospitalized across several Tasikmalaya hospitals. Authorities are maintaining drug supplies and ongoing monitoring to curb spread. Common TB/TB-MDR symptoms include fever with chills, productive cough or coughing blood, chest pain, night sweats, appetite and weight loss, fatigue, and shortness of breath. In response, the Health Office urges adherence to clean-living practices, avoidance of direct contact with TB patients, a balanced diet, regular exercise, and periodic health checks for early detection.

triage.headline_ja: タシクマラヤ市保健局、結核2,303例を発見、25人死亡
triage.triage_reason: 結核は地域における既知の風土病であり突発的異常事象ではないが、MDR-TB症例の存在と死亡者数から継続的なモニタリングが必要。
triage.notes: 結核は既知の地域流行病であり、通常のサーベイランス活動の一環とみられる。MDR-TB18例の存在は懸念材料だが、地域保健当局が対応中であり、国際的な緊急対応を要する事象ではない。

article.articleHeadline: El brote de ébola en la RDC supera los 7.600 casos mientras el ECDC refuerza su respuesta sobre el terreno
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola outbreak in the DRC surpasses 7,600 cases as the ECDC strengthens its on-the-ground response.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the DRC, led by Ituri, North Kivu, Haut-Uélé, and Tshopo, reports 7,672 confirmed cases and 3,699 deaths (case fatality 48.2%), with active community transmission across seven provinces and 63 of 167 health zones affected as of Sept 19, 2026. In the last 24 hours, 58 new cases and 23 deaths were recorded; 15 recoveries. Ituri remains the epicenter with 5,913 cases and 2,703 deaths (77.1% of total; 65.5% of new cases). North Kivu: 1,402/850 (60.6% CFR); Haut-Uélé: 307/126; Tshopo: 39/14. Surveillance remains high: 2,399 alerts, 427 suspected validated, 417 investigated; 32,958 contacts under follow-up, with 26,319 monitored in the last 24 hours. Healthcare capacity strained in North Kivu (376 hospitalized; 95.6% occupancy; bed shortages in Butembo and Katwa). The ECDC deploys two epidemiologists to reinforce on-the-ground response; EU/EEA importation risk is very low. Cross-border surveillance with South Sudan; coordination with Ministry of Health and WHO.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行が7,600例を超え、ECDCが現地対応を強化
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常事態、国境を越えた拡大リスク）に加え、WPRO基準も全て該当する大規模かつ進行中のエボラ流行であり、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 南スーダンとの国境監視が言及されているが、南スーダンは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。CFR48.2%、致死率60%超の州もあり、医療キャパシティ逼迫（ブテンボ・カトワでのベッド不足）が深刻。ECDCが疫学専門家2名を派遣するなど国際支援が進行中。

article.articleHeadline: Wamendagri Dorong Desa di Pangandaran Ikut Perangi Tuberkulosis
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Deputy Minister of Home Affairs Urges Villages in Pangandaran to Join the Fight Against Tuberculosis
article.articleSummary: On Monday, 21 September 2026, Deputy Minister of Home Affairs Akhmad Wiyagus urged stronger cross-sector collaboration to accelerate tuberculosis (TB) control in Pangandaran Regency, West Java. He stressed TB management requires involvement beyond health agencies, reaching government and village levels. The remarks came during a cross-sector meeting and interactive discussion monitoring the integrated TB program under the Free Health Check Program (Cek Kesehatan Gratis, CKG) at Pandega Regional General Hospital (RSUD Pandega) in Pangandaran. Wiyagus linked TB control to productivity, noting that health problems that prevent people from working can disrupt family incomes, fuel poverty, elevate unemployment, and affect national economic growth. The initiative emphasizes a holistic approach to TB, integrating health services with social and economic factors at the local level.

triage.headline_ja: 内務副大臣、パンガンダラン県の村々に結核撲滅への参加を促す
triage.triage_reason: 既知の風土病である結核対策プログラムに関する行政的な取り組みの報道であり、異常な発生や公衆衛生上の緊急事態を示すものではない。
triage.notes: 結核は既知の流行病であり、本記事は地域レベルでの結核対策プログラム推進に関する行政的な内容。新規アウトブレイクや異常事態の報告ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Karantina Kalbar cegah wabah ikan mas di Kapuas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: West Kalimantan quarantine prevents goldfish outbreak in Kapuas.
article.articleSummary: In West Kalimantan, Karantina Kalbar responded to mass goldfish die-offs in floating cages along the Kapuas River in Kubu Raya Regency to prevent spread of HPIK (Quarantine Pests and Diseases of Fish). Inspectors collected water samples and dead fish for laboratory testing to identify the cause and halt transmission. They sterilized affected areas and educated farmers on prevention to stop spread to other cages or public waters. The Kapuas River is a vital aquaculture source, underscoring the need for swift quarantine to protect ecosystems and livelihoods in Rasau Jaya. Lab results will determine next steps, including disease identification and containment measures. Authorities urge breeders to report sick or dead fish promptly to accelerate response and mitigate potential economic losses.

triage.headline_ja: 西カリマンタン検疫当局、カプアス川での金魚大量死拡大防止に対応
triage.triage_reason: 魚類の大量死という動物・環境衛生事案であり、人への健康影響やヒト-ヒト感染の可能性を示す情報がなく、公衆衛生上の懸念基準に該当しない。
triage.notes: 人獣共通感染症の可能性を示す情報はなく、水産養殖業における魚病（HPIK）の事案。公衆衛生上のシグナルとしての優先度は低い。

article.articleHeadline: Thiếu niên viêm tinh hoàn do quai bị
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Teenage boy with orchitis caused by mumps.
article.articleSummary: Fourteen-year-old Minh in Ho Chi Minh City presented with fever and swelling of the parotid area, later diagnosed with orchitis as a complication of mumps. He was initially treated for salivary gland inflammation but did not improve and was admitted to Tam Anh General Hospital. On exam, the left testis was red, tender, enlarged (about 10×3 cm) with epididymal and vas deferens involvement, hydrocele, and scrotal edema. The physician diagnosed mumps-caused orchitis, a known viral complication that can also affect ovaries, pancreas, meninges, and inner ear. Symptoms typically include fever and testicular pain/swelling after parotitis. Parents were advised not to rely on recovery alone and to monitor for progression. The doctor emphasized full mumps vaccination to reduce infection and complications. Mumps transmits via respiratory secretions and close contact; patients should avoid sharing personal items and follow infection-control guidance.

triage.headline_ja: おたふく風邪による精巣炎を発症した少年
triage.triage_reason: 個別患者1名の臨床症例報告であり、集団発生や公衆衛生上の異常事態を示す情報がないため見送り。
triage.notes: 本記事はおたふく風邪（ムンプス）の合併症である精巣炎の一患者症例を扱った医療解説記事であり、アウトブレイクや集団感染の情報はない。

article.articleHeadline: Bé gái 18 tháng tím tái co giật sau hai ngày ho sốt
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: An 18-month-old girl with cyanosis and seizures after two days of cough and fever.
article.articleSummary: An 18-month-old girl from Vĩnh Long, Vietnam, developed fever and cough for two days, then had a generalized seizure with cyanosis. She arrived at VNVC Bình Minh vaccination center for emergency care; fever 38.5°C, seizure resolved after 30 minutes with cooling and supportive care. She was transported to Bệnh viện Nhi đồng Thành phố Cần Thơ; labs were normal and she was discharged after one day. Two days later she was well. Febrile seizures affect children 6 months–5 years, most commonly 12–18 months, triggered by fever from viral or bacterial infections. Not all febrile seizures are benign; first-time, prolonged, or recurrent events require medical evaluation to exclude meningitis or encephalitis. First aid: place child on side, protect from injury, avoid restraining or placing objects in mouth, call emergency if seizure lasts more than five minutes. VNVC operates 300 vaccination centers nationwide; staff trained for post-vaccination reactions and emergencies.

triage.headline_ja: 1歳6か月の女児、咳と発熱2日後にチアノーゼと痙攣
triage.triage_reason: 単発の熱性けいれん事例であり、検査は正常で1日で回復・退院しており、公衆衛生上の異常事態やアウトブレイクを示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 疾患名は『不明脳炎』とされているが、記事内容は個別の熱性けいれん症例であり、脳炎の確定診断や集団発生の報告はない。Bluedotの発生地域（Cần Thơ/ベトナム）は診療を受けた病院所在地であり、患者の居住地はVĩnh Longである。

article.articleHeadline: Wamendagri Wiyagus Dorong Kolaborasi Kebut Penanganan TB di Pangandaran
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Deputy Minister of Home Affairs Wiyagus Urges Collaboration to Accelerate Tuberculosis Control in Pangandaran
article.articleSummary: As of 21 September 2026, in Pangandaran Regency, West Java, Deputy Minister of Home Affairs Akhmad Wiyagus urged intensified cross-sector collaboration to accelerate tuberculosis (TB) control. He emphasized that TB management requires involvement beyond the health department, spanning provincial, regency, sub-district, and village levels, because TB affects productivity and household livelihoods. When illness reduces work capacity, family incomes and broader economic growth are endangered. Wiyagus called for a tiered intervention framework from provincial authorities down to villages and for establishing a TB-Ready Village (Desa Siaga TB) with ongoing administrative monitoring and weekly or tri-weekly evaluations. He stressed that strong leadership at the regency and village levels is essential to broaden outreach and ensure integrated TB treatment and prevention in Pangandaran, aiming for rapid implementation.

triage.headline_ja: 内務副大臣ウィヤグス氏、パンガンダランでの結核対策加速に向けた協力を推進
triage.triage_reason: 既知の風土病である結核に関する行政的な対策強化の呼びかけであり、異常な発生や公衆衛生上の緊急事態を示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 結核は地域における常在感染症であり、本記事は行政主導の対策強化・協力推進を伝える内容で、急性の公衆衛生上の脅威を示すものではない。

article.articleHeadline: El ECDC refuerza su presencia en República Democrática del Congo para contribuir a la respuesta frente al ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The ECDC reinforces its presence in the Democratic Republic of the Congo to contribute to the Ebola response.
article.articleSummary: Two epidemiologists will reinforce the EU’s ECDC presence in the Democratic Republic of the Congo to bolster the Ebola outbreak response. The move, announced on 2026-09-21, follows ongoing deployments since May and aims to intensify surveillance and overall outbreak management under the DRC Ministry of Health and the World Health Organization, with EU Health Working Group coordination. The risk of importing Ebola into the EU/EEA remains very low; sporadic, isolated introductions are possible, but multiple importations are unlikely even in a worst-case scenario. Since the outbreak began, ECDC experts have supported Africa CDC, led exit screening assessments at airports in the DRC and Uganda (June), and deployed staff in South Sudan. The ECDC also published risk assessment guidelines, infection prevention and control guidance, and laboratory resources to assist member states.

triage.headline_ja: ECDCがエボラ対応支援のためコンゴ民主共和国での駐在を強化
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で継続中のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクに対しECDCが人員増強するなど国際的な対応が続いており、重症度・伝播性・国際支援の必要性の観点からフルリスク評価が妥当。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCでの継続中のエボラアウトブレイクに対するECDCの支援強化について述べている。ウガンダ・南スーダンへの言及もあるが、これらは空港スクリーニング支援等の文脈であり、対象国リストにも含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。EU/EEAへの輸入リスクは非常に低いと評価されている。

article.articleHeadline: Le vaccin Ervebo administré aux agents de la riposte contre Ebola en
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ervebo vaccine administered to Ebola response personnel in.
article.articleSummary: In Ituri province, Democratic Republic of the Congo, frontline Ebola response personnel began receiving the Ervebo vaccine on September 19 in Bunia and Mongwalu health zones, as part of a scientific study to assess potential protection against the Bundibugyo strain of Ebola virus. MSF medical coordinator Dr. Nana Mumbu clarifies this is research; there is currently no vaccine or specific treatment for Bundibugyo EVD. Ervebo, proven against Zaire ebolavirus, could offer some cross-protection, but its efficacy against Bundibugyo remains unproven. The initial phase targets health workers and other high-exposure frontline staff. Governor General Gaby Kasongo, who received his dose, says protecting frontline personnel preserves the health system’s capacity to respond to the outbreak. Provincial health authorities urge staff to stay informed and continue preventive measures.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ対応要員にエルベボワクチンを接種（コンゴ民主共和国）
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国イツリ州でエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）のアウトブレイク対応が継続中であり、公衆衛生上重大かつヒト-ヒト感染リスクのある事案のため、IHR基準複数該当と判断。
triage.notes: 記事はブンディブギョ株エボラのアウトブレイクに対するワクチン接種（治験段階）についての続報。既存アウトブレイクの対応状況を示すものであり、MSFやWHO/CDCによる詳細なリスク評価が既に進行中である可能性が高い。ザイール株用ワクチンのブンディブギョ株への有効性は未証明。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola in RDC: MSF avvia uno studio sulla vaccinazione degli operatori in prima linea
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: MSF launches a study on the vaccination of frontline workers.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (Ituri and North Kivu) continues as MSF and Epicentre launch BRAVO, a study evaluating ERVEBO vaccination among frontline health workers. Launched Sept 19, 2026 at the WHO training center in Bunia, the study will run 9–12 months, with 3 months of vaccination and at least 6 months of follow-up. BRAVO will enroll about 20,000 frontline staff in Ituri and North Kivu, regions at high exposure risk, to generate real‑world data on ERVEBO's potential protection against Bundibugyo ebolavirus. ERVEBO is the only Ebola vaccine deployed at scale and is approved for Ebolavirus Zaire, not Bundibugyo; preliminary data suggest possible protection, but efficacy remains to be proven. The study is integrated with the national response led by the Ministry of Health; participation is voluntary, and vaccination does not replace standard prevention and infection control measures.

triage.headline_ja: DRCのエボラ流行：MSFが最前線医療従事者へのワクチン接種に関する研究を開始
triage.triage_reason: DRCでBundibugyoエボラウイルスの流行が継続中であり、承認外ワクチンの大規模研究が開始されるなど、公衆衛生上重大かつ異常な事態であるため。
triage.notes: 本記事はEbola（Bundibugyo species）のDRC（Ituri, North Kivu）における継続流行を報告。MSFとEpicentreによるERVEBOワクチンの実地研究（BRAVO試験）が開始された点が主topicであり、既存流行の継続情報としてPICKUP相当。ERVEBOはZaire株用に承認されており、Bundibugyo株への効果は未確立という点も異常性を示す。

article.articleHeadline: Kongo'da Ebola aşısı denemeleri başladı
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola vaccine trials began in Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola vaccine trials began in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) in Ituri Province, Bunia city, where frontline volunteers received the Ervebo vaccine. Local media reported that about 20,000 volunteers will be vaccinated over a 9–12 month period to evaluate protection against the Bundibugyo strain driving the current outbreak; efficacy against the Zaire strain is already established. The DRC is experiencing its 17th Ebola outbreak, with National Public Health Institute data showing 7,541 infections and 3,639 deaths, and 1,823 recoveries, with the virus now spreading across seven provinces. In August, roughly 70,000 doses of Ervebo were received. Health official Steve Ahuka notes known efficacy against the Zaire strain, while efficacy against Bundibugyo has not yet been determined.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラワクチン治験が開始
triage.triage_reason: DRCで進行中の第17次エボラ流行（感染7,541人、死亡3,639人）が7州に拡大しており、新規株（ブンディブギョ株）に対するワクチン治験が開始されるなど、公衆衛生上重大かつ異常な事態であるためフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 本流行は既にDRC国内で7州に拡大しており、致死率も高い。ブンディブギョ株に対するワクチン有効性は未確定であり、国際的な支援（ワクチン供給・治験）が継続的に必要とされている。

article.articleHeadline: Dinkes Situbondo Temukan 67 Kasus Penyakit Mirip Flu hingga Pertengahan September
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Situbondo Health Office Finds 67 Influenza-Like Illness Cases Through Mid-September.
article.articleSummary: Situbondo Regency Health Office in East Java reports 67 influenza-like illness (ILI) cases through mid-September 2026, spread across 10 districts. ILI is defined by fever up to 38°C with cough. The total is cumulative through week 36 of 2026, compiled from multiple puskesmas and hospitals in the Situbondo area, including districts Sumbermalang, Mlandingan, Banyuglugur, Bungatan, Kendit, Situbondo, Kapongan, Arjasa, Banyuputih, and Besuki, with cases centered in the Widoropayung Puskesmas service area. Kendit records the most cases (14), followed by Kapongan (13). Authorities urge continued preventive measures: clean-living practices, regular handwashing, masking when ill, and maintaining immune defense. No cases of a so-called “super flu” have been identified to date. Surveillance continues with ongoing data updates from puskesmas and hospitals to monitor the outbreak’s spread in Situbondo.

triage.headline_ja: シトゥボンド保健局、9月中旬までにインフルエンザ様疾患67例を発見
triage.triage_reason: 通常のILIサーベイランス報告であり、重症例や異常な流行の兆候はなく、当局も「スーパーフル」は確認されていないと明言している。
triage.notes: 地方保健局による定例のILIサーベイランス報告。67例は複数地区に分散し軽症（発熱・咳）で、重症化や異常な病原体の報告はない。対象国リストに厳密な国レベル感染症イベントとしての特筆性は乏しいためverified_locationsは空とした（Indonesiaは対象国だが、記事は日常的な地域サーベイランス報告でシグナルとしての重要性が低いためDISMISS判定）。

article.articleHeadline: ഫ്രാ​ങ്ക്ഫ​ർ​ട്ട് വി​മാ​ന​ത്താ​വ​ള​ത്തി​ന് പി​ന്നാ​ലെ ജ​ന​വാ​സ മേ​ഖ​ല​യി​ലേ​ക്കും മ​ലേ​റി​യ പ​ട​രു​ന്നു | Deepika | The Largest Read Malayalam Internet Daily | Online News
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The day after Frankfurt Airport, malaria spreads to the civilian population in Meghalaya as well.
article.articleSummary: Malaria linked to Frankfurt Airport in Germany has spilled into the civilian population in Schwanheim, with two residents testing positive and receiving specialist care. Earlier, six airport staff contracted malaria, two of whom died (one in July, one in August). Health authorities warn that 'airport malaria' can present in travelers or locals with fever, abdominal pain, vomiting, and fatigue; without timely treatment, death within 24 hours is possible. The infection is likely mosquito-borne, with Anopheles mosquitoes introduced via aircraft or luggage from tropical regions, enabling local transmission around the airport. Investigations are underway to link new cases to prior infections and to identify the exact source. Expatriates and residents near the airport are urged to seek medical help for unusual fever-like symptoms. The article also mentions Meghalaya, India, as affected.

triage.headline_ja: フランクフルト空港に続き、マラリアが民間居住区にも拡大 - メガラヤ州でも感染拡大
triage.triage_reason: 空港職員の死亡例（2名）に加え、感染が空港周辺の一般住民にも拡大している異常事象であり、蚊媒介経路の特定・管理に外部支援が必要となる可能性がある。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はドイツ・フランクフルト空港での『空港マラリア』の地域住民への拡大であり、Germanyは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。見出しにMeghalaya（インド）での拡大も明記されているため対象国として含めたが、詳細情報がなく続報の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Kasus Influenza A Meningkat, Pakar UGM Bagikan 6 Cara Mencegah Penularan
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Influenza A cases are increasing; UGM expert shares six ways to prevent transmission.
article.articleSummary: Influenza A cases are rising in Indonesia, with Ministry of Health data through 12 September 2026 showing a significant uptick. Of 175 specimens tested, 66 were positive for influenza, overwhelmingly the A(H1N1)pdm09 subtype, and the weekly positivity rate reached 38% in week 35 (up from 22% the previous week). The circulating virus is a lineage descended from the 2009 H1N1 pandemic strain with genetic changes. Symptoms include fever, cough, and muscle aches. Vulnerable groups—adults over 65, children under 5, and individuals with chronic diseases—are at higher risk. Universitas Gadjah Mada microbiology expert Tri Wibawa shares six self-implemented mitigation steps to reduce transmission, underscoring the need for consistent public health measures amid the ongoing rise.

triage.headline_ja: インフルエンザA型感染症例が増加、UGM専門家が感染予防の6つの方法を紹介
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザA(H1N1)pdm09の陽性率上昇が報告されているが、重篤性や異常性を示す具体的データ（重症例・死亡数等）は不明であり、通常の季節性流行の範囲内である可能性がある。
triage.notes: H1N1pdm09は既知の季節性株であり、遺伝子変化の詳細（抗原変異の程度など）は本文に記載がなく不明。陽性率上昇は経過観察が妥当。

article.articleHeadline: Dinkes Situbondo Catat 67 Kasus ILI di 10 Kecamatan, Warga Diminta Rajin Cuci Tangan
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Situbondo Health Office Records 67 Influenza-Like Illness (ILI) Cases in 10 Districts, Residents Urged to Wash Hands Regularly.
article.articleSummary: Situbondo Regency Health Office, East Java, reports 67 influenza-like illness (ILI) cases across 10 districts through week 36, by mid-September 2026. Affected districts include Sumbermalang, Mlandingan, Banyuglugur, Bungatan, Kendit (14 cases), Situbondo, Kapongan (13), Arjasa, Banyuputih, and Besuki within the Widoropayung Puskesmas catchment. ILI presents with fever up to 38°C and cough. Authorities urge hygiene, regular handwashing, mask-wearing when sick, and maintaining immunity. No 'super flu' cases have been detected in Situbondo to date. Health workers at puskesmas and hospitals continue monitoring and updating data to track ILI trends and potential outbreaks.

triage.headline_ja: スイトボンド県保健局、10郡でインフルエンザ様疾患(ILI)67例を記録、住民に手洗い徹底を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: 季節性ILIの通常レベルの報告であり、重症例や「スーパーフル」の発生も否定されている。異常性・国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 地元保健当局が定例的なサーベイランスとして報告した季節性ILI事例。重症化・異常株（スーパーフル）は否定されており、地域内での通常の公衆衛生対応の範囲内。

article.articleHeadline: 中國幼童呼吸道病毒感染人數上升
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rise in respiratory tract viral infections among Chinese children.
article.articleSummary: RSV (Respiratory Syncytial Virus) infections are rising among Chinese children, with southern provinces showing increasing RSV positivity and hospitalizations for severe acute respiratory infections (SARI). As of 2026-09-21, Beijing typically enters its RSV high season from October to April, while Guangzhou, Fujian, Guangxi, and Shenzhen report year-round circulation in the south. Week 37 surveillance (Sept 7–13) shows influenza-like illness accounting for 4.2% of outpatient visits nationwide (5.1% in the south, 3.1% in the north); RSV positivity has climbed in the south and is driving SARI hospitalizations there. In children aged 0–4, RSV positivity among hospitalized SARI rose to first place in Week 36, up from third in Week 35. RSV is the leading cause of lower respiratory tract infections in infants under 1 year; there is no specific antiviral treatment, making prevention crucial, including antibody injections, per Academician Zhong Nanshan.

triage.headline_ja: 中国の幼児における呼吸器系ウイルス感染者数が上昇
triage.triage_reason: 季節性RSV・インフルエンザの増加を報告する定例サーベイランス情報であり、異常性や国際的拡大の懸念は明確でないが、小児における重症化動向は継続監視が必要。
triage.notes: RSVおよびインフルエンザの季節性増加に関する通常のサーベイランス報告。中国当局（鍾南山院士）が予防策に言及しているが、パンデミックポテンシャルや異常事態を示す情報はない。

article.articleHeadline: El brote de ébola en RDC roza el umbral de los 3.700 muertos, con...
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola outbreak in the DRC nears the 3,700-death toll, with...
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) nears 3,700 deaths, with 7,672 confirmed cases and 3,699 fatalities; the latest 24 hours add 58 cases and 23 deaths, concentrated in Ituri. The outbreak has produced 1,879 recoveries; 886 people are hospitalized or in isolation. Case-fatality rate stands at 48.2%, and contact follow-up is 79.9%. Since the start, cases have been reported in seven provinces—Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Tshopo, Upper Uele, Lower Uele, and Ubangi—across 63 of 167 health zones. Investigations of suspected cases are 97.7% complete, though contact tracing has weakened in some zones. Authorities urge reinforcing preparedness and response along the river corridor and surrounding areas. This is the deadliest Ebola outbreak in the DRC's history, potentially surpassing the 2014–2016 West Africa outbreak (Guinea, Liberia, Sierra Leone) with about 28,616 cases and 11,325 deaths. The Kasai outbreak ended in December 2025; DRC has long Ebola experience since 1976 near Yambuku.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行、死者数約3,700人に迫る、確定症例は約7,700件
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国史上最悪規模のエボラ流行が継続し、致死率48.2%、複数州にまたがる拡大がみられ、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: リベリア・ギニア・シエラレオネは2014-2016年西アフリカ流行との比較として言及されているのみで、現行の発生国ではないため verified_locations から除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Alternating Droughts and Floods May Increase Dengue Outbreak Risk - PlusNews
article.articleSummary: Dengue outbreaks may rise with alternating droughts and floods, according to an international study that analyzed data from Latin America, Southeast Asia, the Philippines, and Australia. Rapid transitions from dry to humid conditions and from humid to dry conditions were frequently linked to outbreaks, with shifts from humid to dry more often preceding spikes. Dengue is a viral disease transmitted by Aedes mosquitoes, and environmental conditions shape the mosquitoes' life cycle and virus transmission. The study emphasizes that the speed of weather changes, not just drought or heavy rainfall, can drive risk. These patterns could improve early warning systems, strengthening surveillance and preventive measures after abrupt changes. In the context of climate change, more frequent or intense extreme weather may make this relationship particularly relevant in regions already conducive to dengue transmission.

triage.headline_ja: 干ばつと洪水の交互発生がデング熱アウトブレイクのリスクを高める可能性
triage.triage_reason: 特定の国・地域における実際のデング熱アウトブレイク発生を報じるものではなく、気候パターンとデング熱リスクの関連性に関する国際研究の紹介記事であるため、シグナルとしての緊急性はない。
triage.notes: 本記事は特定の発生イベントではなく、気候変動（干ばつ・洪水の交互発生）とデング熱アウトブレイクリスクの関連を分析した学術研究に関する解説記事。フィリピン・オーストラリアは研究データの分析対象地域として言及されているのみで、実際のアウトブレイク発生地ではないためverified_locationsには含めない。

article.articleHeadline: （有影片）／「劉德華」走私禽流感疫苗？　雲林海巡查緝隊查扣93.6公升起訴
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: (Video) / 'Andy Lau' Smuggling Avian Influenza Vaccine? Yunlin Coast Guard Investigation Team Seizes 93.6 Liters; Charges Filed.
article.articleSummary: Taiwan’s Yunlin County coast guard investigation team seized 93.6 liters of unapproved avian influenza vaccine, intended to be disguised as yogurt and shipped under the alias ‘Andy Lau’ to avoid checks. The operation, involving multiple agencies across Taoyuan and central coastal units, found two illicit orders from Mainland China, with goods routed through domestic logistics to evade inspection. The vaccine had not been approved or tested by the competent authorities, raising concerns about safety and biosecurity if introduced into the domestic poultry industry. The seizure could have enabled vaccination for about 100,000 poultry. The case has been forwarded to Yunlin District Prosecutors Office, with a man surnamed Chen charged. A multi-agency effort—coast guard, police, customs, and agricultural quarantine authorities—will continue border enforcement to prevent illegal animal medicines, and authorities urge poultry stakeholders and the public not to use unauthorized veterinary drugs; report suspicious activity via the 118 hotline.

triage.headline_ja: （動画）／「劉德華」を名乗り鳥インフルエンザワクチンを密輸？雲林海巡査緝隊が93.6リットルを押収、起訴
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は鳥インフルエンザの発生事例ではなく、無許可ワクチンの密輸・摘発に関する法執行事案であり、公衆衛生上の感染拡大リスクを示す内容ではない。
triage.notes: 記事は台湾での無許可鳥インフルエンザワクチンの密輸・摘発事件を報じるものであり、実際の鳥インフルエンザ発生や感染拡大とは無関係。台湾・中国とも対象国リストに合致する感染症アウトブレイクの主題ではないため、verified_locationsは空とした。

article.articleHeadline: Число умерших от Эболы в Конго превысило 3600 человек
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola death toll in Congo surpasses 3,600
article.articleSummary: Ebola death toll in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) reaches 3,699 with 7,672 confirmed cases; 58 new cases and 23 new deaths reported in the last 24 hours. More than 900 patients with Ebola-like symptoms are hospitalized. The outbreak spans seven of Congo’s 26 provinces. WHO data as of September 7 show a case fatality rate of 48% (nearly half of those infected have died). Transmission occurs via bodily fluids of infected individuals; early symptoms include weakness, fever, muscle and head pain, and sore throat, with late-stage vomiting, diarrhea, abdominal pain, rash, and kidney/liver injury. Six orthopoxiviruses? (orth EBOLAVIRUSES) species exist, three strains—Ebola, Sudan, and Bundibugyo—capable of causing large outbreaks. The largest Ebola outbreak on record occurred in 1976 in Sudan and the DRC.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでのエボラ出血熱による死者数が3,600人を超える
triage.triage_reason: DRCでエボラ出血熱により死者3,699人・症例7,672件、致死率48%、7州に拡大する大規模アウトブレイクであり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事中のスーダンへの言及は1976年の史上最大規模アウトブレイクに関する歴史的記述であり、現在の発生国はDRCのみ。スーダン(Republic of the Sudan)は対象国リストにも含まれない。

article.articleHeadline: Dengue chega a 878 casos e três mortes em Cuiabá em 2026 - Diário News
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue reaches 878 cases and three deaths in Cuiabá in 2026 - Diário News
article.articleSummary: Dengue in Cuiabá, Brazil reaches 878 confirmed cases and three deaths in 2026, per the latest municipal epidemiological bulletin. Locally transmitted infections rose from 569 cases by July 16 to 878 by September 16, a 309-case increase (about 54%) in two months, with an incidence of 113.3 per 100,000 inhabitants. Despite the surge, the cumulative total remains below 2025 levels. Vector-control efforts by the Municipal Health Secretariat show 805,397 property inspections through September; 87,158 properties treated; 97,270 breeding-site deposits treated; and 23,268 deposits eliminated that could serve as breeding grounds. Interim Health Secretary Loicy Cunha emphasizes continued street work and household prevention. Besides dengue, Cuiabá reports 133 chikungunya cases (no deaths) and 3 Zika confirmations among 9 notifications (no deaths).

triage.headline_ja: クイアバでデング熱が878例、3人死亡に達する（2026年）- Diário News
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・クイアバでの季節性デング熱流行の定期疫学報告であり、2025年の累積水準を下回っている。異常性や国際的拡大の兆候はなく、ルーティンなベクター対策が継続されている。

article.articleHeadline: Butembo: mise en service d'un nouveau centre de traitement Ebola de 80 lits - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Butembo: commissioning of a new 80-bed Ebola treatment center - ACP.
article.articleSummary: An 80-bed Ebola Treatment Center (ETC) with an integrated laboratory was commissioned in Butembo, North Kivu, eastern Democratic Republic of Congo, on 21 September 2026, with provincial government support and Ugandan assistance. Built in 18 days on ITAV Butembo land, the facility aims to relieve saturation, as bed occupancy across existing CTEs had reached about 98%. The ETC will operate alongside Congolese staff and Ugandan partners, with the ITAV laboratory coordinating with INRB to provide diagnostics. Ugandan health official Dr Ronald Baginture urged continued operation after Ugandan clinicians depart, noting that the integrated lab will yield results within six hours of receiving samples. The center serves Ebola virus disease of Bundibugyo strain in a region now described as an outbreak epicenter and complements plans for a Transit Center and a standardized Treatment Center.

article.articleHeadline: Mengenal Influenza A Karakteristik, Mutasi, dan Cara Mengendalikannya
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Understanding Influenza A: Characteristics, Mutations, and How to Control It.
article.articleSummary: Influenza A cases have recently increased, but the public is advised not to panic; Influenza A is not a new virus and is a dominant strain long known to cause flu in humans, according to Prof. Tjandra Yoga Aditama, Chair of the Indonesian Doctors Association of Pulmonologists (PDPI). Four influenza types exist: A, B, C, and D; A and B primarily affect humans; C rarely causes serious illness; D has not been shown to infect humans. Seasonal flu explains periodic rises rather than new viruses. Influenza A is subtyped by Hemagglutinin and Neuraminidase (e.g., H1N1, H3N2) and mutates, as seen in the 2009 pdm-09 pandemic. Whole genome sequencing is essential to monitor changes and guide management. Most cases are mild and recover with rest and symptomatic care; antivirals like oseltamivir are used for severe cases. Vaccination is strongly advised for high-risk groups; healthy lifestyle helps prevention; ongoing surveillance in Indonesia.

article.articleHeadline: Dinkes Ungkap 20 Kasus Influenza Terdeteksi di Kota Malang, Terbanyak Super Flu
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Health Office Reveals 20 Influenza Cases Detected in Malang City, Most of Them Super Flu.
article.articleSummary: 20 influenza cases detected in Malang City, Indonesia, from January through August 2026, comprising 12 H3N2, 7 H1N1, and 1 influenza B (Victoria lineage). Specimens collected via nasal swabs were analyzed at BBLabkesmas Surabaya and referred to Litbangkes for confirmation. H3N2 is the predominant subtype and labeled the 'super flu' due to heavier and more numerous symptoms, including hoarseness, fever, body aches, and headaches. Influenza is part of the acute respiratory infection (ISPA) group; milder cases resemble seasonal flu, while severe illness can become ILI or SARI. SARI cases are treated at RSUD Saiful Anwar Malang, though current SARI counts were not provided. Ongoing surveillance aims to monitor H3N2-dominant transmission and potential deterioration in patient condition.

article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The recipient used the alias 'Liu Dehua' to evade inspection; Yunlin man indicted for smuggling a Chinese avian influenza vaccine - Minshi News Network
article.articleSummary: Yunlin County, Taiwan: A duck farmer, Chen, used the alias 'Liu Dehua' to receive two shipments of avian influenza vaccine from China, misdeclaring the product as yogurt. The 40-year-old, who runs thousands of ducks, allegedly planned to profit from reselling the vaccine. Authorities seized 468 bottles, about 93.6 liters, enough for 100,000 chickens, after tracking a shipment pickup and forming a task force with the Coast Guard's Investigative Division and Yunlin District Prosecutors' Office. The case highlights risks of illicit animal medicines with unknown ingredients and potential public health gaps. The article notes the legal presumption of innocence until proven guilty.

article.articleSummary: New outbreak of sheep and goat pox reported near the Bulgarian-Greek border: Livadia village in the Greek municipality of Sindiki, adjacent to Bulgaria at the Kulata–Promahon crossing. Bulgarian authorities (Bulgarian Food Safety Agency) also disclosed a fresh outbreak of sheep and goat pox in the Plovdiv region. The earlier case was detected in the Serres region in early August. Overall in the region, 249 registered cases across 197 outbreaks have been recorded, with 42,271 animals culled to date. Details on infection sources or mortality are not provided in the report.

article.articleHeadline: Kolom Pakar: Lima Hal Influenza A dan Tiga Pengendaliannya
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Expert Column: Five Things About Influenza A and Its Three Control Measures
article.articleSummary: Influenza A drives most human influenza in Indonesia, with types A–D; A and B cause disease, while D has not been reported in humans. Seasonal flu reflects occasional rises in cases, but Influenza A remains dominant. Nomenclature uses hemagglutinin (H) and neuraminidase (N) with 18 H types (H1–H18) and 11 N types (N1–N11), producing hundreds of combinations (eg, H1N1). The H1N1 pandemic strain emerged in 2009 as H1N1pdm-09 after mutation. Three actions: 1) determine circulating H and N and check mutations via whole-genome sequencing; 2) management: most cases are mild with rest and symptomatic treatment; antivirals such as oseltamivir for severe disease; hospitalization for high-risk groups; vaccines for those at risk; 3) public health: keep healthy to strengthen immunity. Statement by Prof. Tjandra Yoga Aditama, PDPI, Jakarta.

article.articleHeadline: DR Congo: AZG start belangrijke studie naar bescherming van eerstelijnswerkers tegen ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DR Congo: AZG launches a major study into protecting frontline workers against Ebola.
article.articleSummary: DR Congo's Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak prompts the BRAVO study to evaluate ERVEBO® protection among 20,000 frontline workers in Ituri and North Kivu. Launched 19 September 2026 at the World Health Organization training center for health workers in Bunia, BRAVO aims to document and assess ERVEBO’s effectiveness against Bundibugyo virus, for which no licensed vaccine or treatment exists yet. The study is a collaboration among MSF (Doctors Without Borders), Epicentre, the Ministry of Health, Africa CDC, INRB, and partners. It runs 9–12 months, with 3 months for vaccination and at least 6 months of follow-up. While Bundibugyo-specific vaccines are in development and may become available soon, ERVEBO is used as temporary protection given its established safety by FDA, EMA, and WHO. Participation is voluntary; vaccination complements, but does not replace, existing infection prevention measures.

article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Recipient "Andy Lau"? Yunlin man indicted for smuggling Chinese avian influenza vaccines.
article.articleSummary: In Yunlin County, Taiwan, a 40-year-old man surnamed Chen was indicted for smuggling avian influenza vaccines intended for farmed ducks. Beginning in February, Chen purchased vaccines from a Chinese contact on two occasions, first for personal use after winter duck losses, then to profit by selling them. To evade customs, the recipient was listed under the alias 'Liu Dehua' (Andy Lau) and the vaccines were falsely declared as yogurt. A joint operation by the Coast Guard Investigative Division Yunlin Detachment and Yunlin District Prosecutors Office formed a task force, tracked a logistics firm, and seized a full truckload: 468 bottles, about 93.6 liters, enough for roughly 100,000 chickens. Authorities urge the public not to use illegal veterinary medicines with unknown ingredients to prevent biosecurity risks. The article notes that, before a final conviction, individuals are presumed innocent.

article.articleHeadline: 267 Mithuns die of FMD in Arunachal's Dibang Valley
article.articleSummary: Arunachal Pradesh’s Dibang Valley reports a Foot-and-Mouth Disease (FMD) outbreak affecting mithuns, with 1,402 animals exposed across 21 villages and 267 deaths since the last week of July. Veterinary authorities have intensified treatment, surveillance, and preventive measures; 1,225 animals have been treated while 267 have died (status as of September 20). A four-member rapid response team, aided by local staff, is conducting ongoing treatment and awareness activities. Laboratory confirmation from the National Institute of Foot and Mouth Disease, Odisha, identified FMD serotype O. The district has deployed medicines, sample-collection kits, and a subject-expert team has visited the area. Vaccination drives are conducted twice yearly at farmers' doorsteps; officials urge verification of livestock figures against official records to prevent misinformation.

article.articleHeadline: Ebola death toll rises to 3,699 in DR Congo as response continues
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo virus Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) continues with Ituri as the main epicentre. The death toll has risen to 3,699 from 3,639, with 7,541 confirmed cases reported. Frontline health workers in Ituri began vaccination on Saturday using the Ervebo vaccine under a compassionate-use programme, though Ervebo is licensed for a different Ebola strain; trials are underway to determine protection against Bundibugyo virus, for which no licensed vaccine or treatment exists. The World Health Organization describes the outbreak as out of control and warns it could surpass the 2014–2016 West Africa outbreak, which killed more than 11,000. The response is hindered by insecurity, population displacement and movement, and a health workers’ strike.

article.articleHeadline: Число умерших от Эболы в ДРК достигло почти 3700 человек
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The number of Ebola deaths in the DRC has reached nearly 3,700.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease (EVD) in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has reached 3,699 confirmed deaths, with 7,672 total cases, per the DRC National Institute of Public Health and reported by TASS. In the past 24 hours, 23 deaths and 58 new infections were recorded, with over 900 symptomatic patients hospitalized. The outbreak has spread to seven of the country’s 26 provinces. WHO data as of 7 September show a case fatality rate of 48%, roughly half of those infected. Transmission occurs via bodily fluids; early symptoms include weakness, fever, muscle and throat pain, followed by vomiting, diarrhea, abdominal pain, rash, and kidney/liver involvement. Six ebolaviruses exist, with Ebola, Sudan, and Bundibugyo capable of large outbreaks. The UN warned last month of rapid spread in a conflict-affected area whose territory is larger than France.

article.articleHeadline: Anna University student dies of scrub typhus after 4 days of fever: Warning signs to know
article.articleSummary: Twenty-year-old Anna University student in Chennai, Tamil Nadu, died after four days of fever from scrub typhus, a Orientia tsutsugamushi bacterial infection transmitted by infected mite larvae (chiggers) in scrub vegetation. He arrived at Government Kilpauk Medical College Hospital with altered sensorium and respiratory distress; dengue test negative, scrub typhus positive. Complications included multi-organ failure; ARDS and kidney failure are noted risks. Scrub typhus presents with fever, headache, myalgia; an eschar can aid diagnosis but is not universal. In India, it mimics dengue, leptospirosis and malaria; diagnosis relies on IgM ELISA as main lab test, with PCR as supplementary. Treatment should start with doxycycline if suspicion is high, even before confirmation. Severe disease warrants referral to higher-level care. Affected groups include those outdoors near vegetation; cases occur across India and parts of Asia, including Tamil Nadu.

article.articleHeadline: Ebola : MSF lance une étude sur l'Ervebo auprès de 20 000 soignants
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: MSF launches a study of Ervebo among 20,000 healthcare workers.
article.articleSummary: MSF launches BRAVO, a vaccine study in the Democratic Republic of the Congo to evaluate Ervebo against Bundibugyo Ebola virus among 20,000 frontline healthcare workers in Ituri and North Kivu. Participation is voluntary. Ervebo is licensed for Zaire ebolavirus and is the only large-scale vaccine with an established safety profile; preliminary data suggest it might offer some protection against Bundibugyo. The study aims to scientifically demonstrate potential protection to reduce severe disease and deaths amid an outbreak ongoing since May 2026. BRAVO runs nine to twelve months: three months of vaccination, followed by at least six months of real-world follow-up. Conducted with Epicentre, the Ministry of Health, Africa CDC, and INRB, the trial is transitional as Bundibugyo-specific vaccines are in development. MSF reports deploying over 2,800 healthcare workers and caring for more than 3,100 patients.

article.articleHeadline: Zambia : Anthrax Outbreak In Southern Province
article.articleSummary: As of 21 September 2026, Zambia’s Southern Province reports 257 anthrax-positive cattle cases from over 33,000 tested in regional camps. The outbreak prompts intensified controls: Ministry of Fisheries and Livestock Director Charles Maseka urged farmers and traders to obtain valid stock movement permits to prevent further spread, and directed abattoirs to admit only animals with permits for slaughter. Dr. Maseka said the next phase is to test all cattle in the districts, expanding surveillance beyond current camps. Acting Southern Province Permanent Secretary Gift Monde stated the provincial administration remains committed to stopping anthrax transmission and will engage traditional leaders to facilitate testing and prevention, including arrangements for conducting tests during traditional ceremonies. The response emphasizes movement controls, expanded testing, and community engagement to contain the outbreak.

article.articleHeadline: Behandelbare Tropenkrankheit Tungiasis kostet bis zu 575.000 gesunde Lebensjahre pro Jahr weltweit
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Treatable tropical disease tungiasis costs up to 575,000 healthy life years per year worldwide.
article.articleSummary: Tungiasis, a treatable tropical disease caused by sand fleas penetrating the skin, primarily affects disadvantaged groups in Sub-Saharan Africa and Brazil. It triggers severe itching, pain, inflammation, secondary infections, gangrene and lasting skin changes; secondary infections and comorbidities can be fatal. A multinational team led by Freie Universität Berlin’s Institute of Veterinary Parasitology and Tropical Veterinary Medicine estimated the global burden in BMC Global and Public Health, reporting 379,645 disability-adjusted life years (DALYs) annually due to tungiasis, rising to 575,298 when including comorbidities. The study provides a baseline for international control and calls for tungiasis to be addressed within One Health surveillance with WHO, WOAH and UNEP involved. Researchers urge large-scale prevalence studies in Ethiopia, Nigeria, Brazil, Burundi and Madagascar, spanning West, Central and East Africa and South America, to improve data and weightings in Global Burden of Disease methods. Per-capita burden is higher than for other soil-transmitted helminths and schistosomiasis; the absolute burden is comparable to echinococcosis, toxocariasis and fasciolosis.

triage.headline_ja: 治療可能な熱帯病テングス症（砂ノミ症）、世界で年間最大57万5000健康生存年を損失
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はテングス症（砂ノミ症）の世界的疾病負荷を推計した学術研究の発表であり、急性の発生・アウトブレイクに関する情報ではないため、シグナルトリアージの対象外と判断する。
triage.notes: 本記事はベルリン自由大学等の研究チームによるテングス症の世界疾病負荷（DALY）推計に関する学術論文の紹介であり、急性の感染症発生イベントではない。ブラジルは慢性的な流行国として言及されているが、新規アウトブレイクではないためDISMISSと判定。

article.articleHeadline: Wamendagri Wiyagus Dorong Pembentukan Desa Siaga Tuberkulosis di Pangandaran
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Deputy Home Affairs Minister Wiyagus Urges the Establishment of a Tuberculosis-Ready Village in Pangandaran.
article.articleSummary: On 21 September 2026, Deputy Minister of Home Affairs Akhmad Wiyagus urged Pangandaran Regency, West Java, to establish TB-Ready Villages as part of strengthening community-level tuberculosis management. The plan envisions a multi-tier government effort—from provincial to village levels—and integrated TB care, including through the Free Health Check Program (CKG) at Pandega Regional General Hospital. Wiyagus proposed weekly or tri-weekly administrative evaluations once Desa Siaga TB is formed to monitor and evaluate progress. He emphasized that TB control requires broad government and community participation beyond the health department, and urged timely establishment in Pangandaran with committed leadership at both the regency and village levels to ensure integrated TB response.

triage.headline_ja: 内務副大臣ウィヤグス氏、パンガンダランでの結核対策村設立を推進
triage.triage_reason: 既知の風土病である結核に対する行政の平時対策・啓発活動の記事であり、異常性や急性の公衆衛生上の脅威を示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 結核は既知の風土病であり、本記事は行政による地域単位の対策強化・体制構築の呼びかけであって、アウトブレイクや異常事象の報告ではない。

article.articleHeadline: டெங்கு காய்ச்சல் : அதிகாரிகளுக்கு முதல்வர் விஜய் முக்கிய அறிவுறுத்தல்!
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue fever: Chief Minister Vijay's important directive to officials.
article.articleSummary: On 21 September 2026, Tamil Nadu Chief Minister S. Joseph Vijay chaired a meeting to review dengue prevention ahead of the northeast monsoon and statewide containment efforts. The directive mandates continuous state-level dengue surveillance and district-wise tallies of dengue and fever patients, identification of high-risk areas and mosquito-breeding sites, and sustained larval and adult mosquito elimination with monitoring of fogging equipment. It emphasizes public awareness campaigns, urging prompt medical consultation and guidance on vector-control practices. Early detection with laboratory confirmation, patient evaluation, and warning-sign monitoring should be in place, along with treatment protocols, fluid therapy, and intensive care readiness in government hospitals and primary health centers. Departments must coordinate with public health to remove breeding sites and maintain environmental cleanliness. Attendees included ministers and district collectors from multiple districts, with videoconferences from several cities across Tamil Nadu (e.g., Erode, Viluppuram, Ramanathapuram, Tiruchirappalli, Thanjavur, Pudukkottai, Mayiladuthurai, Nagapattinam, Cuddalore, Tiruvallur, Kanchipuram, Kanniyakumari).

triage.headline_ja: デング熱：関係当局へのヴィジェイ州首相による重要指示
triage.triage_reason: 毎年季節的に発生するデング熱に対するタミル・ナードゥ州政府の予防的行政対応であり、異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められないが、モンスーン期の流行拡大可能性があるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 季節性デング熱に対する州政府の予防対策会議であり、感染症の異常発生や大規模アウトブレイクの報告はない。モンスーン期の媒介蚊対策強化が主内容。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC: MSF lance un projet pour tester l'efficacité d'un vaccin contre le virus Bundibugyo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: MSF launches a project to test the efficacy of a vaccine against Bundibugyo virus.
article.articleSummary: MSF launched the Bravo project on 19 September in the eastern Democratic Republic of Congo, vaccinating around Bunia and surrounding areas to collect data on Evrebo, a vaccine given to 20,000 health workers. The study aims to assess Evrebo’s efficacy against Bundibugyo ebolavirus while prioritizing frontline protection in ongoing Ebola transmission in the region. By vaccinating doctors and epidemiologists, researchers hope to obtain real-world evidence on whether this vaccine can reduce severe disease and mortality, a question linked to existing vaccines considered effective against Ebola Zaïre. MSF notes Evrebo could offer a temporary option pending trial results. The initiative comes as the DRC continues to face what is described as the worst Ebola outbreak in years, with vaccines currently in the testing phase.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ流行下のDRC：MSFがブンディブギョ株ワクチンの有効性を検証するプロジェクトを開始
triage.triage_reason: DRC東部で「数年来最悪」とされるエボラ流行が継続中であり、深刻な公衆衛生上の影響と異常性が認められるためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はワクチン試験（Bravoプロジェクト）が主題だが、背景として『数年来最悪』とされるDRCのエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）流行が継続していることが述べられており、既存の大規模アウトブレイクの一環としてモニタリングが必要。

article.articleHeadline: Caring for children with Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo
article.articleSummary: As of 21 September 2026, the Bundibugyo virus Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has become the country’s largest on record, centered in Ituri Province with Bunia as a focal point. Adults account for about two-thirds of confirmed cases; children comprise roughly 25% of cases but about one-third of deaths. Fatality among children under five exceeds 60%, versus under 30% in adults. WHO clinical guidelines emphasize paediatric care: close blood glucose monitoring, careful fluid and electrolyte management, treatment of shock and suspected bacterial infections, and ongoing clinical assessment. Five treatment centres across Ituri, with ALIMA and partners, coordinate care. Measures include involving recovered individuals in the red zone and adapting centres to allow family contact while maintaining safety. Children may join ongoing clinical trials with parental consent. Challenges include shortages of pediatric equipment, need for more nursing staff, and maintaining routine vaccination during the outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、エボラ出血熱に罹患した子どもたちのケア
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRCで史上最大規模のアウトブレイクとなっており、公衆衛生への深刻な影響と国際的拡大リスクがあるため、IHR基準を複数満たしフルRRAへ進むべき事案。
triage.notes: 本記事はWHO AFROによる報告で、DRC史上最大のエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）アウトブレイクにおける小児患者ケアに焦点を当てている。5歳未満の致死率が60%超と極めて高く、医療資源不足も指摘されており、国際支援の必要性が示唆される。

article.articleHeadline: Behandelbare Tropenkrankheit Tungiasis kostet bis zu 575.000 gesunde Lebensjahre pro Jahr weltweit
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Tungiasis, a treatable tropical disease, costs up to 575,000 healthy life years per year worldwide.
article.articleSummary: Tungiasis, a treatable tropical disease caused by sand fleas invading the skin, imposes a global burden of up to 575,298 disability-adjusted life years (DALYs) per year, with 379,645 DALYs from illness alone. A Berlin-led study in BMC Global and Public Health estimates the disease chiefly affects populations in Sub-Saharan Africa and Brazil, with major data gaps in Ethiopia, Nigeria, Burundi, Madagascar and Brazil. Symptoms include severe itching, pain, inflammation, and secondary infections that can cause wound gangrene and permanent skin changes; comorbidities may be fatal. Transmission involves humans, domestic animals, and the environment. Per capita burden is higher than schistosomiasis, while the absolute burden is similar to echinococcosis, toxocariasis, and fasciolosis. The study calls for WHO/WOAH/UNEP-driven coordinated action and large prevalence studies to improve data and guide control strategies.

triage.headline_ja: 治療可能な熱帯病テングス症（皮膚糸状虫症）、世界で年間最大57万5千健康寿命年を損失
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は砂ノミによる慢性熱帯病（テングス症）の世界的疾病負担に関する学術研究の紹介であり、急性アウトブレイクや新規発生事象ではないため、緊急のシグナルには該当しない。
triage.notes: 本記事は既知の慢性熱帯病（テングス症）に関する疫学研究のレビュー・報告であり、突発的な感染症アウトブレイクではない。ブラジルが主要な発生地域として言及されているため対象国として含めたが、その他の言及国（マダガスカル、エチオピア、ブルンジ、ナイジェリア）は対象国リストに含まれない。ドイツ（ベルリン）は研究実施拠点であり発生国ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: 本港一週錄七宗退伍軍人病 六宗社區感染一宗輸入｜METROHK.com.hk
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hong Kong records seven Legionnaires' disease cases in one week, six locally transmitted and one imported.
article.articleSummary: Seven Legionnaires' disease cases were reported in Hong Kong from Sep 13-19, six locally transmitted and one imported, all male aged 31-84. The Centre for Health Protection announced seven new cases this week, bringing 2026 year-to-date total to 147, compared with 167 in 2025 and 135 in 2024. Community-acquired cases affected residents in Sha Tin, Tsuen Wan, and Kwun Tong; five had pre-existing chronic illness, one was previously healthy. An imported case involved a 64-year-old man who had traveled to Mainland China during the incubation period. Preliminary epidemiology indicates sporadic, non-linked cases. Health authorities warn Legionella bacteria thrive in hot summer environments, hence higher summer case numbers. High-risk groups include men, aged 50+, smokers, drinkers, and those with weakened immunity. Advice: maintain hygiene, regularly clean faucet filters, drain water tanks quarterly, avoid old purifiers; immunocompromised individuals should use sterile water and consult doctors about home respiratory devices.

triage.headline_ja: 本港一週錄七宗退伍軍人病 六宗社區感染一宗輸入
triage.triage_reason: 香港における季節性のレジオネラ症散発例で、前年・前々年と同水準の発生数であり、異常性や重症クラスター等の懸念は認められない。
triage.notes: 症例は散発的で疫学的関連なし、既往症のある高齢男性が中心。例年の夏季増加パターンと一致し、2026年累計147例は2025年167例より少ない水準。

article.articleHeadline: 退伍軍人症增7人中招　其中六旬漢曾訪內地列輸入個案
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Seven more cases of Veterans' disease; among them, a man in his sixties who had visited Mainland China was listed as an imported case.
article.articleSummary: Seven new Veterans' disease cases in Hong Kong were reported for 13–19 September 2026: six are community infections and one is imported. The six community cases involve a 31-year-old male (Sha Tin), a 38-year-old male (Tsuen Wan), a 58-year-old male (Sha Tin), a 70-year-old male (Sha Tin), a 71-year-old male (Kwun Tong), and an 84-year-old male (Kwun Tong). The imported case is a 64-year-old male who had traveled to Mainland China during the incubation period. The Centre for Health Protection is conducting epidemiological investigations to identify infection sources and high-risk exposures; preliminary data show no established link with earlier Hong Kong cases. As of 19 September 2026, 147 Veterans' disease cases have been recorded this year; 2025 and 2024 totals were 167 and 135 respectively.

triage.headline_ja: 退役軍人病（レジオネラ症）でさらに7人感染、その中に本土訪問歴のある60代男性の輸入症例が1人
triage.triage_reason: 香港での退役軍人病（レジオネラ症）の定例サーベイランス報告であり、症例数は例年と同水準で異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 本記事は香港衛生防護中心による定例のレジオネラ症（退役軍人病）発生報告。年間症例数（147件）は過去2年（167件、135件）と同程度で異常な増加は見られない。輸入症例1件は本土渡航歴によるものだが、感染そのものは香港（中国特別行政区）内で発生している。

article.articleHeadline: Truyền hình trực tuyến: 'Chủ động ứng phó với nguy cơ dịch bệnh mới nổi, tái nổi'
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Online Television: "Proactively Responding to the Risk of Emerging and Re-emerging Infectious Diseases"
article.articleSummary: Online television program 'Proactively Responding to the Risk of Emerging and Re-emerging Infectious Diseases' was organized by Suckhoe & Doi Song with the Department of Disease Prevention, Ministry of Health. It aired live at 20:00 on Monday, 21 September 2026, on suckhoedoisong.vn and on YouTube, Facebook, and TikTok. Environmental change, globalization, and climate change heighten risks of emerging pathogens and re-emerging diseases. In Vietnam, new virus strains and outbreaks of dengue fever, hand-foot-mouth disease, and measles challenge the health system. The program advocates shifting from reactive to proactive prevention and early control, including stronger surveillance, improved diagnostic testing, and ready admission/treatment plans. Public vaccination, hygiene, and adherence to health guidance are emphasized. Guests: ThS.BS Võ Hải Sơn, Deputy Director of the Department of Disease Prevention (MoH); PGS.TS Tran Văn Giang, Director, Institute of Training and Research in Tropical Diseases, National Hospital for Tropical Diseases. Q&A via email or phone.

triage.headline_ja: オンラインテレビ番組:「新興・再興感染症のリスクへの積極的対応」
triage.triage_reason: 特定の異常な発生報告ではなく、既知の感染症（デング熱、手足口病、麻疹）への対策啓発を目的としたテレビ番組の告知記事であるため、シグナルとしての緊急性は低い。
triage.notes: 記事は具体的な発生イベントの報告ではなく、保健省後援の啓発番組の告知。デング熱・手足口病・麻疹は既知の季節性/流行病で新規性なし。

article.articleHeadline: Mengapa Anak Lebih Gampang Kena Influenza Ketimbang Orang Dewasa? Ini Penyebabnya : Okezone Women
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Why are children more susceptible to influenza than adults? Here are the causes: Okezone Women.
article.articleSummary: Jakarta, Indonesia — Children, especially infants and toddlers, are at higher risk for influenza due to their developing immune systems. Indonesian Pediatric Society's Unit of Coordination for Tropical Disease Infections (IDAI UKK) explains that influenza differs from the common cold: the influenza virus can replicate inside host cells and trigger inflammation that drives illness. After entering cells, the virus multiplies and is released, provoking inflammation in the respiratory tract and leading to symptoms that can persist for weeks. Prof. Anggraini Alam notes infections can become systemic if the virus and the body’s immune response extend beyond the airways. The remarks were delivered during a virtual IDAI press conference. The article emphasizes that influenza is more severe than a typical cold and highlights the vulnerability of young children.

triage.headline_ja: なぜ子どもは大人よりインフルエンザにかかりやすいのか?その原因とは:Okezone Women
triage.triage_reason: 特定の流行やアウトブレイクの報告ではなく、小児科医によるインフルエンザの一般的な医学解説記事であり、シグナルとしての要件を満たさない。
triage.notes: 記事は特定のアウトブレイクや異常事態を報告するものではなく、インフルエンザの一般的な病態生理に関する啓発・解説記事である。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC: MSF lance un projet pour tester l'efficacité d'un vaccin contre le virus Bundibugyo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: MSF launches a project to test the efficacy of a vaccine against the Bundibugyo virus.
article.articleSummary: MSF launches a project in the Democratic Republic of Congo to test the efficacy of a vaccine against Bundibugyo Ebola virus. As frontline health workers are vaccinated, the effort aims to determine whether the available vaccine—previously shown to be active against the Ebola Zaire virus—can reduce severe disease and mortality in the ongoing eastern DRC outbreak. By vaccinating doctors and epidemiologists on the front lines, researchers will collect real-world data to inform this outbreak and future ones. The NGO notes that the Evrebo vaccine, if available, could offer a temporary solution while results are awaited. The initiative is conducted under MSF's Bundibugyo vaccination project, described as 'Bundibugyo, respond with vaccination – we are in this together'.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱（DRC）：国境なき医師団（MSF）がブンディブギョ株ウイルスに対するワクチンの有効性を検証するプロジェクトを開始
triage.triage_reason: 東部DRCで進行中のエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）アウトブレイクに対し、MSFが新規ワクチン効果検証を開始しており、重症度・ヒト-ヒト感染リスク・国際支援の必要性が高い。
triage.notes: 記事は東部DRCで進行中のエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）アウトブレイクへの対応として、MSFが最前線の医療従事者にワクチン接種を実施し有効性データを収集するプロジェクトについて報じている。既存のZaire株用ワクチンがBundibugyo株にも有効かを検証する点が特徴的。感染拡大の地理的範囲や渡航制限の有無については記載なし。
