article.articleHeadline: Emerg. Microbes & Inf.: Novel emerging reassortant H6 avian influenza viruses with internal genes from G57 genotype of H9N2 pose potential zoonotic risk
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-09-21, a China-based study reports six novel reassortant avian influenza viruses: five H6N1 and one H6N2, isolated from chickens and Houdan chickens with respiratory symptoms. Genetic analyses show HA from ST339-like lineage (geese-origin) and NA from H9N2 or H5N1; all six internal genes derive from the H9N2 G57 genotype. In vitro, these H6 AIVs replicate in avian and mammalian cells. The H6N2 isolate displays dual receptor binding to both avian- and human-like receptors; five H6N1 strains show no detectable receptor binding in assays, though reverse-genetics suggests intrinsic dual affinity in the H6N1 HA. In vivo, H6N2 shows high virulence in mice; both H6N1 and H6N2 cause respiratory symptoms in chickens with efficient bird-to-bird transmission; shedding detected in infected and contact birds. Conclusion: H6 AIVs with G57 H9N2 internal genes are circulating in Chinese poultry and pose substantial public health risk; surveillance at poultry-human interface is needed.

triage.headline_ja: Emerg. Microbes & Inf.誌：H9N2 G57遺伝子型由来の内部遺伝子を持つ新規再集合H6型鳥インフルエンザウイルス、潜在的な人獣共通感染リスクの可能性
triage.triage_reason: 中国の家禽から新規再集合H6型インフルエンザウイルスが分離され、二重受容体結合性やマウスでの高い病原性が実験的に確認されたが、現時点でヒト感染事例の報告はなく、あくまで学術研究段階のリスク評価である。
triage.notes: 本記事は学術研究論文の報告であり、家禽（ニワトリ）における新規再集合H6型ウイルスの分子疫学・実験的病原性評価に関するもの。現時点でヒトへの感染事例は報告されておらず、鶏群内での効率的伝播と潜在的なズーノーシスリスクの指摘にとどまる。継続的なサーベイランスの必要性が示唆されており、続報を注視すべき事案。

article.articleHeadline: "추석 연휴 여행 가는데"...일본, 홍역 환자 10년 새 최다
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: "Going on a trip during the Chuseok holiday" ... Japan reports the highest measles cases in ten years.
article.articleSummary: Japan reports 549 measles cases through August, the highest in ten years, prompting traveler precautions during the Chuseok holidays. Measles is airborne and highly contagious; infection risk can exceed 90% for susceptible contacts. Symptoms include fever, cough, runny nose, conjunctivitis, and rash; two-dose MMR or verified vaccination is advised before travel. Influenza activity began in week 34, about five weeks earlier than usual. Southeast Asia remains a dengue risk for travelers to Vietnam, Thailand, and the Philippines; use mosquito repellent every 3–4 hours and wear long sleeves; report fever or headache on entry for dengue testing. In China, avoid live poultry farms and markets; travelers who visited Guangdong, Guangxi, Sichuan, Yunnan, Jiangxi, Chongqing, or Tianjin must submit Q-CODE or health declarations. Korea’s top Chuseok destinations are Japan (Osaka, Fukuoka, Tokyo), followed by Da Nang, Nha Trang, and Shanghai.

triage.headline_ja: 「秋夕連休に旅行に行くのに」...日本、麻疹患者10年で最多
triage.triage_reason: 主要な出来事は日本における麻疹症例の10年ぶりの増加であり、対象国リストに日本は含まれない。ベトナム・タイ・フィリピン・中国への言及は一般的な渡航健康注意事項であり、特定の発生イベントとしての報告ではない。
triage.notes: 記事は秋夕連休の旅行者向け一般的感染症注意喚起であり、日本の麻疹増加が主題だが日本は対象国リストに含まれない。ベトナム・タイ・フィリピンのデング熱、中国の鳥インフルエンザ関連の記述は具体的な発生報告ではなく渡航上の一般的注意事項として扱われている。

article.articleHeadline: RDC : MSF conduit une importante étude sur la vaccination des travailleurs de première ligne contre la maladie à Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: MSF conducts a major study on vaccinating frontline workers against Ebola virus disease.
article.articleSummary: MSF and Epicentre launch BRAVO, a prospective study vaccinating frontline workers against the Bundibugyo Ebola virus in the Democratic Republic of Congo, amid an ongoing outbreak in Ituri and North Kivu. The ERVEBO vaccine, the only widely used Ebola vaccine, is approved for Zaire ebolavirus and not Bundibugyo, though early data suggest partial protection. The study, launched Sept 19, 2026 at the WHO training center in Bunia, aims to enroll 20,000 frontline personnel over 9–12 months (3 months vaccination, at least 6 months follow-up). It will generate real-world data on ERVEBO's potential effectiveness in this outbreak context. Collaboration includes the Ministry of Health, Africa CDC, INRB, and partners. Participation is voluntary; vaccination is supplementary to infection prevention and control measures. Other Bundibugyo-specific vaccines are under development and may be available soon; ERVEBO could help reduce severe disease and deaths while those vaccines progress.

triage.headline_ja: DRC：国境なき医師団（MSF）がエボラウイルス病最前線対応者へのワクチン接種に関する大規模研究を実施
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で継続中のエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）アウトブレイクに対し、2万人規模の大規模ワクチン試験が開始されるという重要な進展であり、公衆衛生上の重大性と国際的な関与（WHO、Africa CDC等）からフルRRAの対象とすべきシグナルと判断する。
triage.notes: 本記事はDRCのイトゥリ州・北キブ州で継続中のエボラ（ブンディブギョ種）アウトブレイクに対するMSF/Epicentreによる大規模ワクチン試験（BRAVO研究）の開始を報じるもの。既存アウトブレイクの一環だが、ERVEBOワクチンの効果検証という新たな公衆衛生上の展開であり、継続的な感染拡大リスクの観点からピックアップが妥当。

article.articleHeadline: தமிழகத்தில் டெங்கு தடுப்பு தீவிரம்.. முதல்வர் விஜய் அதிரடி உத்தரவு
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue prevention intensifies in Tamil Nadu; Chief Minister Vijay issues a drastic directive.
article.articleSummary: Ahead of the northeast monsoon, Tamil Nadu Chief Minister Vijay directs intensified dengue prevention in coastal and delta districts. The state-wide review mandates ongoing dengue status tracking, including district-wise counts of dengue and fever patients, rising hotspots, and mosquito breeding sites. Actions include door-to-door larval source reduction by DBC workers, identification and removal of Aedes breeding sites, vector control, public awareness, and sustained monitoring in high-risk zones. Authorities urge immediate medical consultation for dengue symptoms and emphasize prevention methods. Government hospitals and primary health centers must be prepared for diagnostics, patient assessment, alert signs, timely treatment, hydration, and intensive care for severe dengue, with continuous medical surveillance. Inter-department coordination with Public Health and Family Welfare to eliminate breeding sites and maintain sanitation, plus ongoing northeast monsoon preparedness.

triage.headline_ja: タミル・ナードゥ州でデング熱予防対策を強化 チェンナイ首相ヴィジャイが緊急指示
triage.triage_reason: 季節性のデング熱予防対策に関する行政広報であり、異常な流行拡大や重症例急増を示す情報はないが、モンスーン時期の恒常的なリスクとして経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 毎年のモンスーン季節に伴う予防的行政対応であり、具体的な患者数や重症度データは記事に記載されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola à Beni : des agents de la riposte réclament quatre mois d'arriérés - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Beni: outbreak response workers demand four months' back pay - ACP.
article.articleSummary: As of 21 September 2026, Ebola outbreak response workers in Beni, North Kivu, Democratic Republic of the Congo, staged a protest over four months of back pay for their Ebola response duties. They burned tires and waved placards outside the health zone office, demanding payment despite government claims funds had been disbursed. The government, through the Ministry of Health, had begun paying frontline Ebola response bonuses on 27 July in Bunia after strikes and anger from responders including epidemiologists, investigators, drivers, and mortuary staff over arrears and difficult working conditions. Health Minister Samuel Roger Kamba said delays were not due to a lack of funds and denounced an 'Ebola Business' and manipulation of lists; he announced harmonization of bonuses for doctors, nurses, and community relays to eliminate pay disparities. The episode refers to the ongoing 17th Ebola outbreak since July.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ流行対応（ベニ）：対応要員が4か月分の未払い賃金を要求 - ACP
triage.triage_reason: 進行中の第17次エボラ流行（DRC）において、対応要員への未払い賃金を巡る抗議活動が発生しており、対応体制の機能不全が流行制御に影響を及ぼすリスクがあるため、フルリスク評価による状況確認が必要と判断。
triage.notes: 本記事は新規の疫学的変化ではなく、進行中の第17次エボラ流行における対応要員の賃金未払いを巡る労働争議が主題。ただし資金・人員体制の混乱は流行対応能力低下につながり得るため、進展を注視しフルRRAでの評価が望ましい。

article.articleHeadline: पशुओं में तेजी से फैल रही ये खतरनाक बीमारी, लक्षण दिखे तो तुरंत करें ये उपाय
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: This dangerous disease spreading rapidly among animals: if symptoms appear, take these measures immediately.
article.articleSummary: Lumpy skin disease (LSD) is spreading among cattle in Meerut district, Western Uttar Pradesh, India. Chief Veterinary Officer Pavitrajit Singh states vaccination has been accelerated since July in both rural and urban areas, with Meerut's cattle totaling about 209,488, of which around 112,000 have been vaccinated; remaining vaccination rounds will be completed soon. The disease is contagious and transmits between animals, so farmers are advised not to panic but to vaccinate and provide targeted care. Preventive measures include mosquito nets to limit vectors, maintaining cleanliness, and promptly consulting the veterinary department for vaccination. Home remedies such as giloy water and neem water rinses are suggested. For wounds, Betadine should be applied. Farmers can contact local animal department offices to arrange vaccination in rural areas.

triage.headline_ja: 家畜の間で急速に広がる危険な病気：症状が見られたら直ちにこれらの対策を
triage.triage_reason: ランピースキン病は牛のみに感染する動物疾患でヒトへの公衆衛生上の影響はなく、地域では既にワクチン接種対応が進行中であり社会的関心も限定的。
triage.notes: ランピースキン病(LSD)は牛の伝染病でヒトには感染しない。記事は農業・畜産分野の地方ニュースであり、ワクチン接種対応が既に進行中で当局によるコントロールが機能している。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola vaccine trial begins in DR Congo
article.articleSummary: Ebola vaccine trial begins in the Democratic Republic of the Congo’s Ituri province, with 20,000 Ervebo doses allocated for a research vaccination programme and 70,000 doses available to Congolese authorities for outbreak response and study. The trial aims to determine Ervebo’s efficacy against Ebola Bundibugyo virus and to protect frontline health workers and others involved in the response. Ervebo has been highly effective against Ebola Zaire in the past, but its efficacy against Bundibugyo is unknown; the WHO panel recommends the vaccine be used for research purposes initially and that unknown efficacy be clearly communicated. The outbreak’s epicenter remains Ituri, with spread to seven provinces since May. Latest data show more than 7,600 confirmed cases and over 3,670 deaths, with nearly 80% of infections in Ituri. Transmission is from wildlife to humans and person-to-person; the average case fatality rate is about 50%. WHO supports surveillance, contact tracing, clinical preparedness, supplies, and cross-border readiness.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラワクチン治験開始
triage.triage_reason: 既に7,600例超・死亡3,670人以上、CFR約50%、7州へ拡大している大規模エボラ流行の継続事案であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 記事はエボラ・ブンディブギョ株に対するワクチン(Ervebo)の効果検証を目的とした治験開始が主題。既存のアウトブレイクはイトゥリ州を中心に7州へ拡大し、致死率約50%と非常に深刻。国境を越えた対応準備についても言及があり、国際的拡大リスクも示唆される。

article.articleHeadline: Respiratory infection cases top 151,000 in Indonesia's forest fire-affected areas
article.articleSummary: Indonesia reports more than 151,000 acute respiratory infection (ARI) cases in seven provinces affected by forest and land fires, as of Sept 21, 2026. The Health Ministry deployed 1,898 health workers to improve access to care for over 13 million people and to support local medical personnel. To enable treatment and air-quality monitoring, authorities placed 1,691 community health centers, 360 referral hospitals, and 87 public health laboratories on standby. Residents are urged to limit outdoor activity and wear masks during the fire emergency, with particular emphasis on infants, young children, pregnant women, the elderly, and people with asthma or heart disease as especially vulnerable. The response underscores ongoing air-quality concerns and the need for medical capacity to address the respiratory illness surge in fire-affected areas.

triage.headline_ja: インドネシアの森林火災被災地域で呼吸器感染症症例が15万1000件を超える
triage.triage_reason: 森林火災による大気汚染で急性呼吸器感染症が7州で15万人超に拡大し、政府が大規模な医療動員を実施していることから社会的関心とWPRO基準（重症度・曝露継続）に該当する。
triage.notes: 本事象は感染症の病原体由来ではなく、森林火災による大気汚染に起因する呼吸器疾患の急増であり、ヒト-ヒト感染性はない点に留意。

article.articleHeadline: Tamil Nadu CM Vijay reviews Northeast monsoon preparedness, dengue prevention measures
article.articleSummary: On 21 September 2026, Tamil Nadu Chief Minister C. Joseph Vijay reviewed Northeast monsoon preparedness and dengue prevention. He directed officials to map areas vulnerable to sea-water intrusion and coastal erosion, ensure delivery of weather and storm warnings to fishermen, and prepare rehabilitation centres with safe drinking water, food, and medical facilities. The government will disseminate alerts via satellites and employ drones to survey roads, storm-water drains, and bridges for maintenance. Revenue Minister K.A. Sengottaiyan presented the Expert Advisory Committee's assessment of potential impacts from a strong El Niño. The CM emphasized intensified mosquito control, focusing on Aedes mosquitoes and larvae in dengue-affected areas, and stressed timely treatment for patients.

triage.headline_ja: タミル・ナードゥ州首相ヴィジャイ氏、北東モンスーン対策とデング熱予防措置を検討
triage.triage_reason: 季節性モンスーンに備えた行政の定例的な予防対策会議に関する記事であり、異常な感染拡大や重症例の急増を示す情報がないため。
triage.notes: 記事は行政の季節前準備（モンスーン対策・蚊媒介対策）に関する定例的な内容であり、デング熱の異常な流行や具体的な症例数の増加を示すデータは含まれていない。

article.articleHeadline: 美國明尼蘇達州爆禽流感　禽產品暫停進口本港
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Minnesota avian influenza outbreak; import of poultry products to Hong Kong suspended.
article.articleSummary: Highly pathogenic avian influenza H5N1 outbreak detected in Wright County, Minnesota, United States prompts Hong Kong's Centre for Food Safety to suspend imports of poultry meat, poultry products, and eggs from the region to protect public health. The action follows a notification from the World Organisation for Animal Health (OIE). In the first six months of 2026, Hong Kong imported about 24,190 metric tons of chilled or frozen poultry meat and about 20.2 million eggs from the United States. The Centre has contacted U.S. authorities and will continue to monitor OIE updates and local outbreak developments, adjusting measures as the situation evolves.

triage.headline_ja: 米国ミネソタ州で鳥インフルエンザ発生、香港が家禽製品の輸入を一時停止
triage.triage_reason: 米国の家禽におけるH5N1発生に対し香港が輸入停止措置を取った事例であり、対象国（ザンビア等)における発生ではなく、ヒトへの感染報告もないため、フルRRAには進まないが動向を注視する。
triage.notes: 発生地は米国ミネソタ州（家禽）であり、香港は輸入停止措置を取った側。記事は動物疾病としての家禽H5N1発生を報じており、ヒト感染例の記載はない。対象国リストに該当する発生国なし。

article.articleHeadline: Kasus Gangguan Pernapasan di Depok dan Bogor Melonjak Pascaerupsi Anak Krakatau
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Surge in respiratory disorders in Depok and Bogor following Anak Krakatau eruption.
article.articleSummary: West Java's Health Office reports a surge of respiratory disorders in Depok City and Bogor Regency, driven by accelerated transmission of influenza type A. Surveillance through influenza-like illness (ILI) and severe acute respiratory infection (SARI) data shows increasing cases, though detailed influenza A counts are still being processed due to high diagnostic costs and low swab uptake. The rise follows exposure to volcanic ash from the Anak Krakatau eruption. Overall case numbers remain below the monitoring threshold. Reported symptoms include high fever (often above 40 degrees Celsius), weakness, cough, runny nose, and body aches, with influenza A noted to have a more severe clinical course than typical flu. Authorities urge continued adherence to health protocols, hygiene, and mask use, especially for children, the elderly, and those with comorbidities, and prompt medical evaluation for pneumonia signs.

triage.headline_ja: アナク・クラカタウ噴火後、デポックとボゴールで呼吸器疾患が急増
triage.triage_reason: 西ジャワでインフルエンザA型による呼吸器疾患増加が報告されているが、症例数は監視閾値以下で国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは認められない。火山灰曝露との関連や重症度への言及があるため経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 症例数は監視閾値以下であり、火山灰曝露という特殊要因が関与しているため、通常の季節性インフルエンザとは異なる文脈での評価が必要。続報でインフルエンザA型の確定診断数や重症化率の推移を注視すべき。

article.articleHeadline: Folha da Região: Araçatuba registra 85 casos de dengue em agosto e acende alerta
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Folha da Região: Araçatuba records 85 dengue cases in August and raises the alarm.
article.articleSummary: Araçatuba, Brazil, recorded 85 dengue cases in August 2026, per the Municipal Health Secretariat on Friday, Sept 18. The August total is about 11% higher than August 2025 (77 cases) but still well below last year’s epidemic level. From January to August 2026, the city reported 2,232 dengue cases. The month with the highest number of cases so far is April (466); August ended with 85, while early September had 13 additional cases. In contrast, 2025 saw a dengue outbreak with 10,755 cases for the year, including more than 5,000 in January 2025. The data illustrate ongoing transmission and seasonal clustering, with notable year-to-year variation in dengue activity in Araçatuba.

triage.headline_ja: Folha da Região:アラサトゥーバ、8月にデング熱85例を記録し警戒呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・アラサトゥーバの地域的なデング熱定例報告であり、前年より低水準で、異常性・国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: デング熱は季節性の風土病であり、今回の報告は前年（2025年）のエピデミックレベルを大きく下回る通常の季節変動として扱われている。

article.articleHeadline: В ДР Конго число жертв Эболы приблизилось к 3 700
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In the DRC, the Ebola death toll has approached 3,700.
article.articleSummary: As of 21 September 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) reports 3,699 lab-confirmed Ebola deaths and 7,672 cases, a case fatality rate of 48.2%. In the last 24 hours, deaths rose by 23 and cases by 58. More than 900 patients with symptoms are hospitalized or in medical isolation, with seven of 26 provinces affected. The outbreak began on 15 May in the DRC and Uganda, making it the second-deadliest Ebola outbreak in Africa’s history. Uganda’s outbreak was declared over on 28 July, with the WHO confirming completion on 25 August. The largest prior outbreak occurred in 2014–2016 in Guinea, Liberia, and Sierra Leone, with about 28,600 cases and over 11,000 deaths. Ebola transmits from wildlife to humans; the first human infection was recorded in 1976 in the area that is now the DRC. This is the 17th Ebola outbreak on record.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、エボラ出血熱の死者数が3,700人に迫る
triage.triage_reason: DRCで史上2番目に致死率の高いエボラ流行が継続中で、死者数・症例数が急増しており深刻な公衆衛生上の脅威であるためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCにおける流行状況を主眼としており、ウガンダ・ギニア・リベリア・シエラレオネは過去または既に終息した流行の言及であり対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: حين يستيقظ الفايروس المنسي.. "بونديبوغيو" يفتح جبهة وبائية جديدة
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: When the forgotten virus awakens... Bundibugyo opens a new epidemic front.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugy o virus, a filovirus related to Ebola, is driving a widening epidemic in Central Africa, with the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda reporting 695 laboratory-confirmed cases and 138 deaths by mid-June 2026. The current outbreak surpasses the two prior incidents (2007, 2012) in scale. Initial symptoms resemble malaria, but the disease evolves to severe vascular damage and uncontrolled hemorrhage, risking multi-organ failure. A nurse died after care, highlighting transmission risk in healthcare settings. Diagnostic confirmation is hampered by limited laboratory capacity, delaying isolation, contact tracing, and infection control. The article criticizes global preparedness for neglecting rarer pathogens while focusing on headline viruses, urging development of vaccines and treatments that cover all pathogens capable of causing severe disease, not only historically feared ones. Emphasizes cross-border health systems for rapid response to future outbreaks.

triage.headline_ja: 忘れられたウイルスが目覚める時…『ブンディブギョ』が新たな疫学的前線を開く
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国とウガンダでブンディブギョ・エボラウイルスによる大規模流行（695例、138人死亡）が過去の流行を上回る規模で発生し、医療従事者感染や検査体制の不備も報告されているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当しフルリスク評価が必要と判断。
triage.notes: ウガンダも発生地域として記載されているが、対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。記事は主にDRCとウガンダの流行を扱うが、対象国基準に基づきDRCのみ列挙。

article.articleHeadline: IDAI Imbau Ortu Tingkatkan Kewaspadaan Influenza A pada Anak |Republika Online
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: IDAI Urges Parents to Heighten Vigilance for Influenza A in Children |Republika Online
article.articleSummary: Influenza A surge in Indonesia driven by H3N2 subclade K (Super Flu) detected in 13 provinces, with rising cases in East Java as influenza activity expands across Southeast Asia per WHO Respiratory Viruses Surveillance Bulletin through epidemiological week 35 of 2026. The Indonesian Pediatric Society (IDAI) warns that children are the most vulnerable, with 0–17-year-olds facing higher risk of symptomatic infection and greater viral shedding, increasing household and school transmission. Early detection and appropriate management are emphasized; laboratory confirmation via RT-PCR is essential to identify the subtype. For treatment, neuraminidase inhibitors such as oseltamivir are most effective when started within 48 hours of symptom onset. Preventive measures, including annual vaccination and strict infection-control practices, remain critical. Potential complications in children include pneumonia, asthma exacerbation, myocarditis, and encephalopathy.

triage.headline_ja: IDAI、子どものインフルエンザA型に対する警戒強化を保護者に呼びかけ｜Republika Online
triage.triage_reason: H3N2新亜系統（通称'Super Flu'）によるインフルエンザA流行がインドネシア13州に拡大し、WHO監視速報でも東南アジア全域での活動拡大が報告されており、子どもの重症化リスク（肺炎・脳症等）も指摘されているためフルリスク評価が妥当。
triage.notes: WHO Respiratory Viruses Surveillance Bulletin（第35週）に基づく報道であり、東南アジア地域全体での拡大傾向が言及されているが、他対象国での具体的発生地は記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: 35-year-old woman suspected of botulism after facial injections in Tsim Sha Tsui residential flat
article.articleSummary: A probable botulism case in Hong Kong linked to cosmetic injections is being investigated by the Centre for Health Protection. A 35-year-old woman visited a residential flat on Middle Road in Tsim Sha Tsui on 17 September, where injections claimed to be botulinum toxin were administered to facial areas including the forehead, glabella, and under the chin. She developed drooping eyelids, breathing difficulty, and weakness in all four limbs the next day and was admitted to Queen Elizabeth Hospital on 18 September, where she remains in stable condition. Public health authorities caution that botulinum toxin injections must be prescribed and performed by a locally registered doctor after clinical assessment. Verify the practitioner's full name against the Medical Council of Hong Kong register and avoid injections from dubious sources due to potential contamination or dosing issues. Symptoms may appear hours to weeks after treatment; seek prompt medical advice if unwell.

triage.headline_ja: 尖沙咀の住宅で顔面注射を受けた35歳女性がボツリヌス症疑い
triage.triage_reason: 美容目的の違法注射による単一のボツリヌス症疑い例であり、ヒト-ヒト感染や国際的拡大のリスクは低いが、違法施術の公衆衛生上の懸念として経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 香港の記事のため、対象国リストのChina(1814991)に分類。単一症例であり、違法な美容注射による中毒事例。感染症のヒト-ヒト伝播ではなく、食品/薬物安全性の問題として位置づけられる。

article.articleHeadline: Hepatites virais: conheça os tipos e as formas de transmissão
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Viral Hepatitis: Learn About the Types and Modes of Transmission.
article.articleSummary: Viral hepatitis remains a major global public health problem caused by five viruses (A–E). The World Health Organization targets elimination as a public health threat by 2030, aiming to cut new infections by 90% and deaths by 65%. Globally, about 1.3 million deaths occur annually from cirrhosis and liver cancer, and roughly 304 million people live with chronic HBV or HCV infection. Hepatitis A (fecal-oral) is rising in Brazil, with detection rising from 0.4 per 100,000 in 2022 to 1.7 per 100,000 in 2024 (~325% increase); transmission links to contaminated water/food and poor sanitation; most cases resolve spontaneously. Hepatitis B transmits sexually, via blood (needles/sharps), and mother-to-child; chronic HBV is often not curable but controllable with antivirals. Hepatitis C spreads mainly through blood; sexual transmission is less common, but maternal transmission can occur; HCV has strong treatment prospects. Acute infection symptoms include nausea, jaundice, dark urine, and fatigue; chronic forms may be asymptomatic.

triage.headline_ja: ウイルス性肝炎：種類と感染経路について知る
triage.triage_reason: 一般的な啓発記事であり、特定の急性アウトブレイクや異常事態を報告するものではないため、シグナルとしての緊急性は低い。
triage.notes: ブラジルにおけるA型肝炎の増加傾向（2022年0.4/10万人→2024年1.7/10万人）に言及があるが、記事全体は一般的な啓発・教育コンテンツであり、急性アウトブレイクの通報ではない。継続的な公衆衛生教育記事として位置づけられる。

article.articleHeadline: Rio confirma caso de raiva em cão; veja orientações | Rio de Janeiro | O Dia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rio confirms a case of rabies in a dog; see guidelines | Rio de Janeiro | O Dia
article.articleSummary: Rio de Janeiro confirms an urban-dwelling dog rabies case in August; the animal had contact with bats. The antigenic variant is still under analysis. Rabies is a viral, acute infection with near-100% fatality but preventable by vaccination and post-exposure prophylaxis. CRMV-RJ requests vaccination for professionals and students and antibody titration for those already vaccinated. Symptoms in severe stages include anxiety, fever, delirium, muscle spasms, hydrophobia, progressing to paralysis and cardiorespiratory complications. Transmission occurs via saliva; human incubation averages ~45 days. In dogs and cats, the virus can be shed before signs, and death typically occurs within about a week after onset; bats may harbor the virus long without symptoms. Brazil remains area-free for canine rabies but wild variants persist. Rio de Janeiro state has recorded two human rabies deaths from bats (2006, 2020). Public health actions include surveillance and control; residents should vaccinate pets and avoid unknown or wild animals, seeking care after bites.

triage.headline_ja: リオが犬の狂犬病症例を確認、注意事項を確認
triage.triage_reason: 都市部の犬1頭における狂犬病症例で、ヒトへの感染例はなく、ブラジルは犬由来狂犬病の清浄地域を維持している。コウモリ由来の野生株は既知のリスクであり異常性は低い。
triage.notes: 地域獣医評議会(CRMV-RJ)からの予防的ワクチン接種呼びかけを含む公衆衛生上の通常対応。犬から犬への伝播ではなくコウモリ由来の野生株が疑われ、ヒト感染例は報告されていない。

article.articleHeadline: La RDC inicia pruebas de la vacuna Ervebo contra el ébola en el epicentro de la epidemia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC begins trials of the Ervebo Ebola vaccine in the epicenter of the outbreak.
article.articleSummary: DRC begins Ervebo Ebola vaccine trial in the outbreak epicenter to evaluate efficacy against Bundibugyo, the current strain. The vaccination effort targets 20,000 frontline workers in Ituri and North Kivu to test Ervebo, approved for the Zaire strain, against Bundibugyo, for which no vaccine exists. The epidemic is described as the deadliest in the country's history, with 3,639 deaths and 7,541 infections, per the latest National Public Health Institute balance. Two vaccines are in clinical trials; WHO supports Ervebo testing in large-scale use. The nine to twelve month study started with first doses in Bunia, the Ituri capital, with MSF and WHO support. Officials say efficacy against Bundibugyo is unknown but cross-protection is possible. The virus transmits via bodily fluids and causes hemorrhagic fever; past RDC outbreaks have caused thousands of deaths (2018-2020).

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、エボラ流行の震源地でエルベボワクチンの試験を開始
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で2項目（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性）が該当し、WPRO基準も複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 本記事はワクチン試験開始に関する続報だが、同流行は同国史上最悪規模（死者3,639人、感染7,541人）とされ、Bundibugyo株に対するワクチンが未承認である点が特筆される。既存の大規模流行に関する情報のため、既にフルRRAの対象となっている可能性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC : 41 nouvelles guérisons enregistrées en 24 heures
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: 41 new recoveries recorded in 24 hours
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo: 41 new recoveries in the last 24 hours, 30 of them in Ituri, with total 7,614 confirmed cases, 1,864 recoveries, and 3,676 deaths. 909 patients are in isolation or hospitalized; contact tracing is 87.8% complete. Response spans 7 provinces and 63 health zones; frontline vaccination campaign ongoing in Bunia. Dungu in Haut-Uele is newly affected, with frontline vaccination starting Sept 19 supported by MSF. In North Kivu, the cold chain is operational to broaden vaccination coverage. Community outreach includes over 110,000 people sensitized in a single day. At entry/exit points, 97% of 281,145 travelers were screened and informed; 100% of strategic points functional, signaling solid cross-border surveillance as the outbreak nears Dungu near the South Sudan border. Actions aim to strengthen the response and adherence to prevention measures.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱：24時間で41人の新たな回復例
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で大規模なエボラ流行が継続中（確定7,614例、死亡3,676例）、複数州に拡大し南スーダン国境付近にも波及しており、国際的拡大リスクと重大な公衆衛生影響が認められる。
triage.notes: 南スーダン国境付近のDunguに拡大しており越境監視が強化されているが、南スーダン国内での症例発生は確認されていないためverified_locationsには含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Hà Nội ghi nhận 349 trường hợp mắc sốt xuất huyết tại 84 phường, xã
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hanoi records 349 dengue fever cases in 84 wards and communes.
article.articleSummary: Hanoi reported 349 dengue fever cases this week (Sept 11–18, 2026) across 84 wards/communes, with 27 active clusters. For 2026, total dengue is 3,206 cases in 118 wards/communes, with 0 deaths and 1,670 fewer cases than the five-year average. Fourteen new dengue outbreaks were identified this week, bringing the year’s total to 138; 27 remain active. Hand, foot-and-mouth disease: 139 cases in 74 wards, down from last week; 2026 total 5,288 with 87 outbreaks, 4 active. Measles: 2 cases; 396 cumulative. Pertussis: 1 case; 108 cumulative. Streptococcus suis, Japanese encephalitis, and meningococcal meningitis: 1 weekly case each (cumulative 4, 3, 2). COVID-19: 13 cases in 12 wards; cumulative 1,648. Actions: Hanoi CDC strengthens surveillance, sanitation, veterinary coordination, and vaccination messaging; residents should remove standing water, practice hygiene, and seek care for suspected dengue or other infections.

triage.headline_ja: ハノイ、84の坊・社で349件のデング熱症例を記録
triage.triage_reason: ハノイ市の定例感染症サーベイランス週報であり、デング熱を含む複数疾患とも死亡例なし・前年/5年平均を下回る水準で、異常な増加や重症化は見られない。
triage.notes: ハノイCDCによる週次定期サーベイランス報告。デング熱は5年平均より1,670件少なく、死者数も0。手足口病・麻疹・百日咳・COVID-19等も通常範囲内の推移であり、通常業務としての監視強化のみが記載されている。

article.articleHeadline: 48 dengue cases reported in Erode this month
article.articleSummary: 48 dengue cases reported in Erode district this month, including eight on Monday, September 21, per District Health Officer P. Aruna. The district-wide dengue tally for the year reaches 480, with 10 scrub typhus cases also recorded. To curb transmission, 1,209 Domestic Breeding Checkers (DBCs) have been deployed district-wide to identify and eliminate mosquito-breeding sources; the Erode Corporation has added 436 DBCs to target Aedes aegypti breeding. Special fever wards are in place at the Government Hospital for fever cases. Residents are urged to prevent water stagnation in discarded tyres, broken articles and unused containers. With the northeast monsoon approaching, DBCs are conducting regular checks to curb dengue spread in Erode.

triage.headline_ja: エロード地区、今月48件のデング熱症例を報告
triage.triage_reason: インドの一地区における季節性のデング熱・つつが虫病の通常の発生状況であり、地域保健当局が定期的な対策（DBC配備、発熱病棟設置）を実施している。異常性や国際的拡大の懸念は認められない。
triage.notes: デング熱・つつが虫病は毎年季節的に発生する感染症であり、地元当局が通常の対策（DBC配備、発熱病棟）で対応中。国際的な公衆衛生上の懸念や社会的関心の高まりを示す情報はない。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Swine Influenza A H3N2

article.articleHeadline: Waspada Super Flu H3N2 Subklad K di Indonesia, IDAI Ingatkan Risiko pada Anak
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Beware of the H3N2 Subclade K Super Flu in Indonesia, IDAI Warns of Risks to Children.
article.articleSummary: Influenza A H3N2 subclade K, dubbed 'Super Flu', has been detected in 13 provinces of Indonesia, with rising cases in East Java as Southeast Asian influenza activity rises, per WHO Respiratory Viruses Surveillance Bulletin for week 35 of 2026. The Indonesian Pediatric Association (IDAI) warns children are most vulnerable; ages 0–17 have roughly double the risk of symptomatic infection versus adults and may shed more virus longer, increasing transmission at home and school. In children with risk factors, influenza can trigger pneumonia, asthma exacerbation, myocarditis, or encephalopathy. Lab confirmation via RT-PCR is advised for precise subtyping; oseltamivir is most effective if started within 48 hours of symptoms. Global burden is about 1 billion infections annually. IDAI recommends annual vaccination from 6 months, hygiene, isolating sick children for at least 24 hours after fever resolves, and prompt care for warning signs.

triage.headline_ja: インドネシアでH3N2サブクレードK『スーパーフル』に警戒、IDAIが子どものリスクを警告
triage.triage_reason: 新亜株インフルエンザA(H3N2 subclade K)がインドネシア13州に拡大し、小児の重症化リスク（肺炎・脳症等）が指摘されるなど複数のWPRO基準に該当し、メディア・専門学会の注目も高いため。
triage.notes: WHO Respiratory Viruses Surveillance Bulletin (2026年第35週)を引用し、東南アジア全体でインフルエンザ活動が上昇していると言及されているが、他対象国での具体的発生状況は記載なし。季節性インフルエンザの新亜株のため重症度・拡大性の観点から続報確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: العالم من حولنا - ارتفاع حصيلة وفيات فيروس إيبولا بالكونغو الديمقراطية إلى 3676 حالة
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The World Around Us - Ebola death toll in the Democratic Republic of the Congo rises to 3,676.
article.articleSummary: Ebola deaths in the Democratic Republic of the Congo rose to 3,676 with 7,614 confirmed cases as of 18 September, yielding a case fatality rate of 48.3%. The UN on 21 August urged urgent resources to contain the outbreak in a region long torn by conflict and large humanitarian needs. On 17 May, WHO classified the outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and neighboring Uganda as a Public Health Emergency of International Concern, citing elevated regional risk. A Nature Medicine study indicates the outbreak was driven by a previously unknown strain of Bundibugyo ebolavirus, most likely a zoonotic spillover from an animal source. The report highlights ongoing transmission and the need for continued surveillance and international support.

triage.headline_ja: 私たちの周りの世界 - コンゴ民主共和国におけるエボラウイルスの死者数が3,676人に増加
triage.triage_reason: WHOがPHEIC宣言した進行中のエボラ大規模流行であり、死者数7,600人超・致死率48.3%と深刻。新規株による人獣共通感染起源で国際的懸念が高い。
triage.notes: ウガンダも発生地域に含まれるが対象国リスト外のため除外。新規Bundibugyoエボラウイルス株による人獣共通感染性流行で、WHOがPHEICを宣言済み。継続的なサーベイランスと国際支援が求められている。

article.articleHeadline: La OMS lanza un programa de vacunación de investigación frente al ébola para sanitarios en el este de RDC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO launches an investigational Ebola vaccination program for healthcare workers in eastern DR Congo.
article.articleSummary: World Health Organization launches an investigational Ebola vaccination program for healthcare workers in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo (Ituri) amid an outbreak approaching 7,700 cases and 3,700 deaths. The BRAVO pilot vaccinates health workers and frontline staff at high exposure risk using 20,000 doses of ERVEBO to study efficacy against Bundibugyo ebolavirus, the strain behind the current outbreak, which lacks approved vaccines or treatments. The effort, led by the Congolese Ministry of Health with oversight by the INRB, is part of a broader delivery of 70,000 ERVEBO doses to DRC to support response and related investigations. ERVEBO is highly effective against Zaire ebolavirus, but data on Bundibugyo protection are preliminary; some early signals hint partial protection. MSF stresses that any benefit would strengthen, not end, the response, while BRAVO scientifically evaluates outcomes. DRC has the world's Ebola experience and faces a historically deadly outbreak trajectory.

triage.headline_ja: WHOがコンゴ民主共和国東部の医療従事者向けにエボラワクチン研究プログラムを開始
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国東部でブンディブギョ型エボラウイルスによる大規模流行（約7,700症例、3,700人死亡）が継続しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 承認されたワクチン・治療法がないブンディブギョ型エボラウイルスによる歴史的に致死率の高い流行。ERVEBOワクチンの試験的投与（BRAVO試験）が実施されているが有効性データは限定的。

article.articleHeadline: Число жертв Эболы в ДР Конго приблизилось к 3,7 тысячи
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola death toll in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has approached 3,700.
article.articleSummary: As of 21 September 2026, Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has claimed about 3,699 lives, with the death toll nearing 3,700. According to TASS citing the National Institute of Public Health, seven of the DRC's 26 provinces have been affected; more than 900 patients are hospitalized. In the past 24 hours, deaths rose by 23. The disease begins with flu-like symptoms: low fever, weakness, headache, muscle pains. After the incubation period, the dry phase features high fever; this is followed by the wet phase with skin rash, vomiting, diarrhea and hemorrhagic syndrome. In severe cases, patients may experience gum bleeding, hemorrhages in the eyes and internal bleeding, and this stage frequently ends in death.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ死者数が3700人に迫る
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で大規模なエボラアウトブレイクが継続しており、死者数約3700人・入院900人超と深刻な公衆衛生インパクトがあり、7州に拡大していることから国際的拡大リスクも懸念される。
triage.notes: 疾患名にInfluenzaが含まれるが、記事内容はエボラのみを扱っており誤タグと考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: RDC : L'armée passe à l'attaque à Point Zéro pendant qu'Ebola tue encore - Ce que vous devez savoir - Cameroun24.net infos actus news
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: The army launches an offensive at Point Zéro as Ebola continues to kill - What you need to know - Cameroun24.net infos actus news
article.articleSummary: Eastern Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) is facing a dual crisis: in South Kivu’s Fizi, government forces launched a major offensive to retake Point Zéro from the AFC/M23/Twirwaneho coalition, a strategic locality on the road to Minembwe about 25 km away. Point Zéro, abandoned July 4, remains a flashpoint as fighting persists despite Doha-brokered ceasefire talks. The M23 movement—formed by deserters in 2012 and now controlling over 100 towns—faces accusations from Kinshasa of Rwandan backing, which Kigali denies. Meanwhile, Ebola deaths rise: 3,699 laboratory-confirmed (up 23) and 7,672 cases (up 58) across 7 of 26 provinces, with a 48.2% fatality rate and more than 900 patients hospitalized or isolated. The outbreak began May 15 in DRC and Uganda; Uganda declared an end on July 28 (confirmed by WHO on Aug 25), but Congo’s outbreak persists. Transmission is animal-to-human; symptoms include fever, vomiting, sore throat, kidney/liver damage, and sometimes bleeding. This is the 17th Congo Ebola outbreak and among Africa’s deadliest.

triage.headline_ja: DRC:軍がポイント・ゼロで攻勢を開始、その間もエボラは死者を出し続ける - 知っておくべきこと
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で進行中のエボラ流行が7,672症例・致死率48.2%に達し、複数州に拡大、紛争地域での対応困難という複合的リスクが認められるためフルRRAへ進む。
triage.notes: ウガンダの流行は既に終息宣言済み（WHO確認8/25）のため対象外。ルワンダ・フィジーはM23紛争関連の文脈のみで感染症発生地ではないため除外。武力紛争下での医療アクセス困難がリスクをさらに高めている。

article.articleHeadline: سیلاب کا پانی کم ہونے پر محکمہ صحت الرٹ، پانی سے پیدا ہونے والی بیماریوں سے بچنے کے لیے بلیچنگ پاؤڈر کا چھڑکاؤ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: As floodwaters recede, the Department of Health is on alert to prevent waterborne diseases by spraying bleaching powder.
article.articleSummary: On 21 September 2026, Bhagalpur district, as floodwaters recede, the health department has begun preventive measures against waterborne and communicable diseases. With floods receding, the risk from contaminated water, filth, and standing water elevates the threat of diarrhea, dysentery, typhoid, and skin infections in Sabour, Pirpenti, Gopalpur, Kahalgaon, and other blocks. The department is conducting large-scale preventive and remedial activities to avert a post-flood outbreak. ASHA workers and health personnel are spraying bleaching powder in streets, drains, and other potential contamination sites, following standard procedures. Special sanitation campaigns are underway in affected villages to reduce exposure and transmission. No specific case counts are reported.

triage.headline_ja: 洪水後の水系感染症予防のため保健当局が警戒、漂白粉散布を実施
triage.triage_reason: 洪水後の予防的措置に関する報道であり、具体的な症例数の報告はないため実際の発生規模が不明。今後の症例報告動向を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 洪水後の予防的公衆衛生対応の記事であり、腸チフス等の具体的な症例数は報告されていない。ビハール州バガルプール県が主な発生地域として言及されている。

article.articleHeadline: A ward to treat dengue cases set up at Thanjavur Medical College and Hospital
article.articleSummary: Twenty dengue beds with mosquito-net covers have been arranged in a dedicated ward at Thanjavur Medical College and Hospital to treat dengue fever cases. The ward is monitored by a special medical team formed to manage dengue patients. As of 21 September 2026, a patient from Pudukottai district is undergoing treatment in this ward, with the patient's condition stable. The initiative provides focused infrastructure within the hospital to handle dengue cases and to ensure dedicated care for dengue fever patients. No additional cases or outcomes are reported in the article, which emphasizes the new facility as a measure to bolster dengue treatment capacity in the hospital setting.

triage.headline_ja: タンジャヴール医科大学病院にデング熱治療専用病棟を設置
triage.triage_reason: デング熱は当該地域の風土病であり、記事は通常の医療対応（専用病棟設置）を報じるのみで、異常な発生拡大や重症例急増などの情報は含まれていない。
triage.notes: 記事はタミル・ナードゥ州タンジャヴールにおける単一患者への通常の医療対応を報じるのみで、流行拡大や異常事態を示す情報はない。

article.articleHeadline: 即食生蠔樣本檢出大腸桿菌含量超標
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Escherichia coli levels exceed standards in ready-to-eat raw oyster samples
article.articleSummary: Escherichia coli levels exceed standards in American Pearl ready-to-eat raw oysters imported into Hong Kong. The Centre for Food Safety, under the Food and Environmental Hygiene Department, reported a sample of American Pearl oysters imported by Ji Fu Ya Zhou Limited, collected on 14 September 2026, with a maximum possible E. coli count of 790 CFU per 100 grams. The guideline threshold for direct-consumption raw or live bivalve molluscs is 700 CFU/100 g; the result is deemed unsatisfactory. The center has notified the importer of violations and instructed immediate cessation of sale, removal from shelves, and a recall of affected batches. No illnesses are mentioned in the report. This incident underscores the ongoing import screening and public health safeguards for high-risk shellfish products.

triage.headline_ja: 即食生牡蠣サンプルから大腸菌が基準値を超えて検出
triage.triage_reason: 食品検査における基準値超過事例であり、疾病発生や患者報告はなく、規制当局による通常の回収対応にとどまるため、公衆衛生上の重大な懸念には該当しない。
triage.notes: 香港食物安全中心による輸入牡蠣の定期検査結果で、患者発生の報告なし。回収措置は通常の規制対応であり、シグナルとしての重大性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: 29歲男確診猴痘被列為輸入個案　潛伏期內曾離港與一名陌生男有高風險接觸 (20:32) - 20260921
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 29-year-old man diagnosed with monkeypox classified as an imported case; during the incubation period he left Hong Kong and had high-risk contact with a male stranger (20:32) - 2026-09-21
article.articleSummary: As of 21 September 2026, Hong Kong public health authorities report a 29-year-old man diagnosed with monkeypox classified as an imported case. The patient, during the incubation period after leaving Hong Kong, had high-risk contact with a male stranger. There are no confirmed epidemiological links to previously reported local cases; the Centre for Health Protection is conducting ongoing epidemiological investigations and will trace and notify high-risk contacts, and will report to the World Health Organization. In response to rising monkeypox cases, authorities urge high-risk contacts, especially those with strangers, to maintain vigilance and protective measures, including vaccination. Public education has been strengthened, including a dedicated monkeypox hotline (2125 2373) for health assessments, guidance, and vaccination arrangements, enhanced social media outreach, and reminders to doctors to report suspected cases.

triage.headline_ja: 29歳男性が猴痘（Mpox）と確診、輸入症例に分類―潜伏期間中に香港を離れ見知らぬ男性と高リスク接触
triage.triage_reason: 香港における単発の輸入Mpox症例で、地域内伝播の確認はないが、当局が接触者追跡・WHO報告を実施中であり続報を要する。
triage.notes: 香港はChina (1814991)に含める。単発の輸入症例で、地域内感染拡大の証拠は現時点でなし。当局は接触者調査とワクチン接種案内を強化中。

article.articleHeadline: Hog culling begins
article.articleSummary: African swine fever (ASF) has infected 52 pigs and killed 14 across three upland Cebu City barangays—Toong, Buhisan, and Pamutan— triggering 500-meter containment radii, mandatory depopulation, and border police checks to prevent movement of animals. The outbreak has expanded to Ginatilan, where first cases were confirmed on Sept. 20, 2026, in Cagsing and Calabawan. Officials are isolating affected zones, conducting blood testing (samples sent to the Department of Agriculture for lab confirmation), and tracing infection sources through trade routes involving Consolacion, Liloan, and Lapu-Lapu City; origin remains undetermined. Compensation schemes provide P4,000 per head for young weanlings, P8,000 for growing pigs, and P12,000 for breeders, with supplemental aid via the Cebu City government for those outside eligibility. Alternative livelihoods are planned; farmgate prices stand at P140–P160/kg, with authorities urging continued monitoring and stricter entry bans on infected provinces.

triage.headline_ja: 豚の殺処分開始
triage.triage_reason: アフリカ豚熱（ASF）は豚のみに感染し、ヒトの健康への直接的影響はない。フィリピンでは繰り返し発生している既知の家畜疾病であり、地方自治体が補償・封じ込め策で対応しておりIHR基準・社会的関心ともに低い。
triage.notes: ASFは豚のみに感染するウイルス性疾患でヒトへの感染性はないため、公衆衛生上のリスクは限定的。セブ市とその周辺での家畜伝染病アウトブレイクとして農業当局・地方政府が対応中。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola : 7 614 cas et 3 676 décès en RDC au 18 septembre
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: 7,614 cases and 3,676 deaths in the DRC as of September 18.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) reached 7,614 confirmed cases and 3,676 deaths (case fatality 48.3%) as of Sept 18, 2026, per COUSP Situation Report No. 127 (Sept 19). On Sept 18, 73 new cases were reported: Ituri 46, North Kivu 18, Haut-Uele 6, Tshopo 3; 37 deaths (25 community, 12 in treatment centers) and 41 recoveries (cumulative 1,864). 909 people are in isolation; contact follow-up 87.8%. Dungu in Haut-Uele becomes the 63rd health zone affected, on South Sudan border, prompting cross-border surveillance. Ituri remains hotspot with 5,875 cases and 2,688 deaths; North Kivu 1,388 cases, 843 deaths (CFR 60.7%); Haut-Uele 302; Tshopo 38; Bas-Uele 7; Sud-Kivu 3; Sud-Ubangi 1. MSF says epidemic is moving, not under control. Vaccination began Sept 19 in Bunia and Mongwalu under Ervebo study for Bundibugyo; efficacy uncertain. Uptake is low in Tshopo; Bas-Uele lacks microplans; 42 days without cases are required to end.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ:コンゴ民主共和国で9月18日時点7,614症例、3,676死亡
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で進行中の大規模エボラ流行が63保健区域に拡大し、致死率48.3%、南スーダン国境地域にも波及しており、MSFが「制御不能」と表明するなど国際的拡大・公衆衛生上の重大な懸念がある。
triage.notes: 南スーダン国境に近いDunguが63番目の被害保健区域となり越境サーベイランスが開始された点が国際拡大リスクの根拠。ただし南スーダン自体は対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsには含めていない。既存の継続的アウトブレイクの定期シットレップであり、IHR通知は既に行われている可能性が高いが、状況悪化の兆候（拡大継続、低ワクチン受入率、管理体制不十分）から引き続きフルリスク評価の対象とすべき。

article.articleHeadline: சென்னை மாநகராட்சியில் கொசு ஒழிப்பு நடவடிக்கைகள் தீவிரம்
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mosquito control measures intensified in Chennai Corporation.
article.articleSummary: Chennai Corporation intensifies dengue prevention across all 15 zones, deploying door-to-door vector-control and fever surveillance. From 14 to 19 September 2026, field surveys covered 1,102,385 houses, identifying 4,192 mosquito-breeding sites that were destroyed. The effort involves 140 Urban Primary Health Centers, 16 Urban Community Health Centers, 200 Urban Health Centers, Dandayarpettai Infectious Disease Hospital, three maternity hospitals, and ten dialysis centers. Staffing includes 15 District Health Officers, 15 Vector-control Officers, 44 Health Inspectors, 200 Health Investigators, 35 Field Assistants, and 3,697 Field Workers, with each visiting 80–100 homes daily. Training and awareness campaigns accompany fever surveillance; fever patients returning home are monitored for three days. Abate larvicide and Mosquito Larvicidal Oil are used to treat water bodies; fogging is conducted indoors and outdoors. Supplies include 521 pressurized sprayers, 49 power sprayers, 132 battery sprayers, 15 vehicle-mounted sprayers, 272 hand sprayers, 200 mini-sprayers, and 92 vehicle-mounted fogging units; breaches face fines.

triage.headline_ja: チェンナイ市がデング熱対策の蚊駆除活動を強化
triage.triage_reason: デング熱に対するルーティンの予防・対策活動の報告であり、症例数や重症例、異常な流行拡大についての具体的言及がないため、現時点でのフルRRAの必要性は低いが、季節性デング熱の動向として経過観察対象とする。
triage.notes: 記事はチェンナイ市当局によるデング熱予防・蚊駆除の行政対応を報じたものであり、具体的な症例数・死亡者数・異常な増加傾向についての記載はない。地方自治体レベルの通常業務として位置づけられる。

article.articleHeadline: Zambia : Mpulungu District Records 102 Dog-bites
article.articleSummary: As of 21 September 2026, Mpulungu District, Zambia, records 102 dog-bite cases and four confirmed rabies cases in dogs. The joint statement by the Ministry of Livestock and Veterinary Services and Ministry of Health warns of a rising dog-bite burden and the deadly risk of rabies transmitted via saliva from unvaccinated, stray dogs. Authorities urge urgent animal-control measures, public education, and immediate post-exposure medical care to prevent rabies. Planned actions include mass dog vaccination campaigns and dog-cropping to reduce stray populations around markets, health facilities, and schools. District leaders call for intensified community outreach, stricter enforcement of animal-control laws, and sustained vaccination funding. Residents should report stray or aggressive dogs, seek prompt medical care after bites, and participate in vaccination programs to curb transmission.

triage.headline_ja: ザンビア:ムプルング郡で犬咬傷102件を記録
triage.triage_reason: 犬由来の狂犬病確定例4件と咬傷102件が報告されているが、地域限定的な人獣共通感染症で当局が既にワクチン接種等の対策を開始しており、国際的拡大や渡航制限の兆候はない。続報を注視する。
triage.notes: 狂犬病はザンビアで地方病的に発生しており、今回の事例は特定地区(Mpulungu)における犬由来感染の増加と地元当局(家畜獣医省・保健省)の共同対応が中心。人への死亡例は報告されていない。国際的な公衆衛生上の懸念や渡航制限のリスクは低いが、野犬対策・ワクチン接種状況の推移を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: MSF evalúa la eficacia de una vacuna contra el ébola en 20.000 sanitarios en RD del Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: MSF evaluates the efficacy of an Ebola vaccine in 20,000 healthcare workers in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: MSF launches the Bravo study in the Democratic Republic of the Congo to evaluate Ervebo Ebola vaccine efficacy among 20,000 healthcare workers amid a Bundibugyo-strain outbreak. Ervebo is a Zaire ebolavirus–targeted vaccine and the only scalable option with FDA, EMA, and WHO approvals; preliminary data suggest it could offer partial protection against Bundibugyo, which would help reduce disease severity and deaths. The Bunia, Ituri-based study will vaccinate over three months and follow participants for 9–12 months to generate real‑world effectiveness data. The outbreak totals 7,672 cases and 3,699 confirmed deaths since May 15, with 1,879 recoveries and 886 hospitalized or in isolation (case fatality 48.2%). It spans 63 health zones across seven provinces: Ituri, Tshopo, Bas-Uélé, Haut-Uélé, North Kivu, South Kivu and Ubangi del Sur. Uganda’s related outbreak ended Aug 26 with 20 cases (15 imported from DRC) and two deaths. Two Bundibugyo vaccines remain in Phase 1 trials.

triage.headline_ja: MSFがコンゴ民主共和国で医療従事者2万人を対象にエボラワクチンの有効性を評価
triage.triage_reason: DRCで進行中のBundibugyo株エボラ流行は7,672例・致死率48.2%と極めて重篤で、既にウガンダへの越境拡大も確認されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: ウガンダでの関連アウトブレイクは既に終息（8月26日、20例・2死亡）しており、対象国リストにも含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。現行流行はDRC国内（Ituri, Tshopo, Bas-Uélé, Haut-Uélé, North Kivu, South Kivu, Ubangi del Sur の7州63保健地域）に限定。

article.articleHeadline: Número de casos de Mpox sobe para 596, depois de registados três novos infectados na Lunda-Sul
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mpox cases rise to 596 after three new infections were registered in Lunda-Sul.
article.articleSummary: Mpox (monkeypox) cases in Angola rise to 596, with three new infections in Lunda-Sul, bringing the province to seven. The Ministry of Health reactivated the National Contingency Plan in July to respond to mpox near the Democratic Republic of Congo border, aiming to detect suspected cases, confirm them, identify contacts, and monitor spread and control measures. Mpox is caused by a virus transmitted from wildlife to humans, with fever, headache, fatigue, muscle pains, lymphadenopathy, and generalized skin eruptions; incubation is five to 21 days. Preventive measures include regular handwashing or sanitizing, avoiding hunting or eating monkey or rodent meat, avoiding contact with their meat or blood, and limiting contact with symptomatic people. A new clade 1b was identified in the DRC in September 2023 and has appeared in neighboring countries. The WHO notes mpox can be more severe than previous forms and has declared an emergency due to close-contact transmission.

triage.headline_ja: アンゴラでMpox感染者数596人に増加、ルンダ・スル州で新たに3人の感染確認
triage.triage_reason: MpoxクレードⅠbによるDRC国境地域での感染拡大がアンゴラで継続しており、WHOが緊急事態を宣言している疾患であるため、国際的拡大リスクと重症度の観点からフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はアンゴラ（ルンダ・スル州）における感染者増加であり、対象国リストに含まれない。DRCは国境付近の感染源として言及されているが、記事本文では実際の感染拡大地としてDRC国内での新規症例は明示されていないため、verified_locationsには含めなかった。

article.articleHeadline: உண்ணிக் காய்ச்சல்: கண்ணுக்கு தெரியாத பூச்சி உயிரை பறிப்பது எப்படி? அறிகுறி மற்றும் சிகிச்சை
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Unnik Fever: How does an unseen insect drain life? Symptoms and treatment.
article.articleSummary: Scrub Typhus, caused by Orientia tsutsugamushi and transmitted by chigger mites, is a rickettsial infection common in vegetation-rich areas. In India, the NCDC notes it is not confined to specific land types. In Chennai, a 20-year-old student at Anna University hostel died last week after falling ill with Scrub Typhus. Early symptoms include abrupt high fever, chills, and severe headache; the illness can progress to liver, kidney, lungs or brain involvement and may cause acute respiratory distress syndrome requiring ventilation. About 50% develop an eschar at the bite site. If untreated, mortality can exceed 30%; early diagnosis and treatment makes it curable. Globally about 1 million new infections occur annually, with cases reported in India, Afghanistan, Pakistan, Russia, Korea, Indonesia and Australia. The disease is caused by gram-negative rickettsiae in mites; prevention focuses on avoiding bites in vegetated areas and seeking care for fever lasting more than five days.

triage.headline_ja: ツツガムシ病：目に見えない虫がどのように命を奪うのか？症状と治療法
triage.triage_reason: 既知の風土病（ツツガムシ病）に関する一般啓発記事で、チェンナイでの単発死亡例を紹介する内容。異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められず、社会的関心も限定的。
triage.notes: 記事はツツガムシ病の啓発・教育目的の一般記事。チェンナイの大学生1名の死亡例を挙げているが、これは既知の風土病の単発事例であり、集団発生やアウトブレイクを示す情報はない。ヒト-ヒト感染はなく、ベクター（ツツガムシ）媒介性疾患のため国際的拡散リスクも低い。他国（パキスタン、韓国、インドネシア、オーストラリア、アフガニスタン、ロシア）は疫学的背景情報として言及されているのみで、当該記事の主題イベントの発生国ではないため verified_locations には含めていない。

article.articleHeadline: Penyakit AHS dan Strangles Mengintai Kuda, Petugas di Purwakarta Cek Darah dan Feses
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: African Horse Sickness (AHS) and Strangles Threaten Horses, Officials in Purwakarta Check Blood and Feces.
article.articleSummary: In Purwakarta Regency, West Java, Indonesia, animal health officers are conducting surveillance to detect African Horse Sickness (AHS) and Strangles in horses. Diskanak Purwakarta is collecting blood, tracheal swabs, and feces for laboratory testing. AHS is an Orbivirus transmitted via Culicoides biting midges, not by direct horse contact, and can cause high fever, respiratory distress, and edema around the eyes, head, and neck; severe respiratory illness may include coughing and foamy nasal discharge, with mortality in susceptible horses reported up to 70–95%. Strangles is caused by Streptococcus equi subsp. equi and spreads readily through direct contact or contaminated equipment, feed, and water, including nasal discharge or pus. Symptoms include fever, loss of appetite, purulent nasal discharge, and swollen lymph nodes that can form abscesses and hinder breathing. The effort aims for early detection through ongoing surveillance.

triage.headline_ja: AHSと腺疫が馬を脅かす、プルワカルタの担当者が血液と糞便を検査
triage.triage_reason: 馬の動物疾病（AHSと腺疫）に関するサーベイランス活動の報告であり、ヒトの公衆衛生への影響はなく、監視体制も既に機能しているため見送りとする。
triage.notes: AHSと腺疫はいずれも動物(馬)の疾患であり、人獣共通感染症ではないためヒトへの公衆衛生リスクは想定されない。地方獣医当局による通常のサーベイランス活動の一環。

article.articleHeadline: AI Based Cough Analysis for Pulmonary Tuberculosis Triage and Diagnosis: A Technical Review - npj Biomedical Innovations
article.articleSummary: Pulmonary TB accounts for ~90% of TB cases; cough-based AI is explored for triage and diagnostic support. A review of 29 cough-based analyses identifies 17 unique acoustic datasets (16 cough-based, 1 respiratory-auscultation-based); only three are publicly accessible, with most datasets under 200 participants; Swaasa TB, CIDRZ TB, and CODA exceed 500. Study designs are largely retrospective/cross-sectional, focusing on TB vs non-TB, TB vs healthy, or TB vs COVID-19. Datasets show substantial heterogeneity in elicitation mode, controls, devices (smartphones to microphones), sampling rates (8-44.1 kHz), and cough durations; Peru TB dataset collected serial coughs; TASK captured natural coughs; CODA spans seven international sites. Geographically biased toward South Africa and China; Central/West Africa, Central Asia, and much of Southeast Asia are underrepresented. Phase-space analysis places TB-positive proportions typically 30-60%, with CODA in high-N, lower TB-positive; Peru TASK near 100% TB-positive. Limitations: representativeness, longitudinal follow-up, deployment-ready evaluations.

triage.headline_ja: 結核トリアージ・診断のためのAIによる咳分析：技術レビュー - npj Biomedical Innovations
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はAIを用いた咳分析による結核診断技術のレビューであり、実際の感染症発生イベントを報告するものではないため、トリアージ対象のシグナルとはならない。
triage.notes: 本記事は既存の咳分析データセット（南アフリカ、中国、ペルー等収集）を用いた技術的レビューであり、特定の国での結核発生・アウトブレイクを報じるものではない。ペルー、南アフリカ、アンゴラは対象国リストに含まれず、中国も技術データセットの出典地として言及されているのみで実際の発生イベントではないため、verified_locationsは空とした。

article.articleHeadline: کرونا دوباره در حال شیوع است! افزایش ۵ هفته‌ای نرخ ابتلا و هشدار جدید برای بیماران
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: COVID-19 is spreading again! A five-week increase in the infection rate and a new warning for patients.
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 rebounds in Iran: the Ministry of Health reports a fifth consecutive weekly rise in respiratory infections, with COVID-19 positivity reaching 17% in week 26, double the 8.9% of the previous year, prompting intensified respiratory precautions. Although outpatient visits slightly declined, admissions with severe respiratory illness increased. Influenza activity is rising as well, with more than 32% of positive influenza cases in children; those under 2 and ages 2–15 are most affected. Among influenza types, B accounts for 75.4% of identified strains. Provincially, Bushehr leads with 25.3% influenza incidence, crossing the alert threshold; Hormozgan and Khuzestan are also in warning status. Internationally, East Asia and Europe report rising COVID-19 and influenza activity, while the Southern Hemisphere influenza wave remains past its peak. Public health authorities urge heightened respiratory protective measures.

triage.headline_ja: コロナが再び流行中！5週間連続の感染率上昇と患者への新たな警告
triage.triage_reason: 記事の主題はイランにおける季節性のCOVID-19・インフルエンザ流行であり、対象国（中国等）は地理タグに含まれるものの記事本文では主題として扱われていない。
triage.notes: 発生地域にShanghai Shi（中国）が含まれるが、記事本文は主にイランの季節性呼吸器感染症動向を報告しており、東アジアや欧州の状況は一般的言及に留まる。対象国が実際の発生国として特定できないためverified_locationsは空。

article.articleHeadline: Perú registra 67 muertos por dengue en lo que va de año
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Peru reports 67 dengue deaths so far this year
article.articleSummary: Through September 2026, Peru has recorded 67 dengue deaths and 55,943 cases, a 79% increase versus the same period in 2025, per the Ministry of Health (Minsa). Transmission is concentrated in the northern coastal region bordering Ecuador and in Amazonian areas where temperatures have remained above 30°C. Health authorities attribute the rise to El Niño‑related heat, noting there was no winter this year and that high temperatures promote Aedes aegypti breeding. An epidemiological alert is being prepared as rains are expected to drive cases higher in coming months. The most affected regions are Piura, La Libertad, and Lambayeque in the north, plus Ucayali, Loreto, and Madre de Dios near Brazil. In 2024 Peru reported over 271,000 dengue cases. Dengue causes high fever, headaches, nausea, vomiting, muscle pain, and can progress to hemorrhagic dengue and death. Globally, about half the population is at risk, with 100–400 million infections annually.

triage.headline_ja: ペルー、今年に入りデング熱による死者67人を記録
triage.triage_reason: 報告されている感染拡大はペルー国内の事象であり、対象国リストに含まれる国での発生ではないため見送りとする。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はペルーにおけるデング熱流行であり、対象国（ブラジル含む）は地理的近接性の言及のみで実際の発生国ではないため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Ébola: UE envia mais epidemiologistas para a RDCongo para ajudar a controlar epidemia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: EU sends more epidemiologists to DR Congo to help control the outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) continues, with 7,672 confirmed cases and 3,699 deaths since May. In the last 24 hours, 58 new cases and 23 deaths were reported, with 15 recoveries bringing total recovered to 1,879. Current hospitalizations or isolations total 886, yielding a case fatality rate of 48.2%. The outbreak is the deadliest in DR Congo’s history, surpassing the 2018–2020 episode. The European Centre for Disease Prevention and Control (ECDC) will deploy two epidemiologists this week to bolster surveillance and response, under the leadership of the DR Congo Ministry of Health and the World Health Organization, coordinated by the EU Health Working Group. The risk of Ebola importation to the EU/EEA remains very low, though sporadic cases are possible and multiple imports are unlikely even in pessimistic scenarios. Published 2026-09-21.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱:EUがコンゴ民主共和国での流行制御を支援するため、さらに疫学者を派遣
triage.triage_reason: DRCで史上最悪規模のエボラ流行が継続中(致死率48.2%、死者3,699名)であり、国際機関(ECDC/WHO)による支援が行われている。公衆衛生への深刻な影響、国際的関心・支援の必要性からIHR/WPRO基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 史上最悪のエボラ流行として既にWHO/EU等の国際支援が動いており、継続的なモニタリングが必要。EUへの輸入リスクは低いとされるが、DRC国内の状況は深刻。

article.articleHeadline: 美國進口即食生蠔樣本被檢出大腸桿菌含量超標
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: US-imported ready-to-eat raw oyster samples found to have excessive levels of Escherichia coli.
article.articleSummary: As of 21 September 2026, the Hong Kong Food Safety Centre announced that a United States–imported ready-to-eat raw oyster sample, branded American Pearl, exceeded microbial limits for Escherichia coli. The centre ordered importer Ji Fu Ya Zhou Co., Ltd. to immediately suspend sale, withdraw the affected product from shelves, and recall it, and urged the industry to stop using or selling the affected lots. The reported maximum probable E. coli count was 790 per 100 g, surpassing the 700 threshold defined by the Food Microbiological Content Guidelines for dissatisfaction. The incident illustrates strict import-safety oversight for U.S.-origin shellfish in Hong Kong.

triage.headline_ja: 米国産輸入即席生牡蠣サンプルから大腸菌基準値超過を検出
triage.triage_reason: ヒトの感染症例報告はなく、食品中の大腸菌基準値超過による回収措置という食品安全規制対応であり、疾病アウトブレイクのシグナルには該当しない。
triage.notes: 香港食品安全中心による輸入牡蠣の微生物検査での基準値超過検出・回収命令であり、感染者発生報告は記事中に無い。US産食品の香港での検出事例のためChinaのみverified_locationsに含めた（米国は対象国外）。

article.articleHeadline: Caso de raiva em cão é confirmado no Rio; confira orientações
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A rabies case in a dog is confirmed in Rio; see guidelines.
article.articleSummary: Rabies in a dog confirmed in urban Rio de Janeiro city, August this year; the dog had contact with bats and the antigenic variant is under analysis. Rabies is a viral, almost 100% fatal disease; public health measures include human and animal vaccination and post-exposure prophylaxis. Early symptoms can progress to severe agitation, fever, delirium, muscle spasms, hydrophobia with laryngeal/pharyngeal involvement, potentially leading to paralysis and cardiorespiratory failure. The Rio de Janeiro CRMV-RJ reports ongoing surveillance and control actions. The infection source is likely wildlife reservoirs (bats) bridging to urban pets; Brazil has had only two human rabies deaths in decades, both bat-related: 2006 São José do Vale do Rio Preto and 2020 Angra dos Reis. Public guidance: vaccinate dogs and cats annually, leash pets, avoid unknown or wild animals, seek medical care after exposure, and observe a owned dog for 10 days if possible.

triage.headline_ja: リオでイヌの狂犬病感染が確認、注意事項を確認
triage.triage_reason: 都市部でのイヌの狂犬病症例（コウモリとの接触が疑われる）が確認されたが、現時点で人への感染例はなく、既存の監視・対策プログラムで対応中のため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 記事はイヌの狂犬病症例であり、人への感染は報告されていない。ブラジルでは過去にコウモリ由来の人への狂犬病死亡例が数十年間で2件のみ。都市部での野生動物由来感染源の拡大が懸念されるため、続報を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Flávio Roscoe, candidato do PL ao Governo de MG, é diagnosticado com Covid-19
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Flávio Roscoe, PL candidate for the Governorship of Minas Gerais, is diagnosed with COVID-19.
article.articleSummary: Flávio Roscoe, the PL candidate for Governor of Minas Gerais, tested positive for COVID-19 while hospitalized for pneumonia with sinusitis, bronchitis, and airway inflammation. He has been in hospital since Saturday, September 19, at Hospital Madre Teresa in the Centro-Sul region of Belo Horizonte. Despite clinical improvement, the COVID-19 diagnosis prevents his attendance at the Record Minas debate scheduled for Monday, September 21, as a precaution for others. He is vaccinated and reportedly not showing specific COVID-19 symptoms. The campaign said he was preparing to participate and hoped for discharge to join the broadcast. Roscoe is formally backed by PL and by Flávio Bolsonaro for the presidency. A Itatiaia/Ver poll released on September 21 places him 6th in Minas Gerais with 1.8% of voting intentions.

triage.headline_ja: PL党のミナスジェライス州知事候補フラビオ・ロスコー氏、COVID-19と診断
triage.triage_reason: 単一の政治家個人のCOVID-19感染事例であり、公衆衛生上の異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 個人の健康状態に関する政治ニュースであり、公衆衛生シグナルとしての意義は認められない。

article.articleHeadline: Co-Diagnostics to Participate in Global Health Roundtable on Ebola and Outbreak Innovation
article.articleSummary: Ongoing Ebola outbreak caused by Bundibugyo virus in Africa prompts a Global Health Technologies Coalition/Adjuvant Capital roundtable in New York City on Sept. 22, 2026. Co-Diagnostics, Inc. (CODX) will be represented by Chief Commercialization Officer Seth Egan alongside U.S. State Department Global Health Security and Diplomacy officials and global health R&D leaders to assess systems, technologies and partnerships enabling rapid outbreak response. Co-Dx highlights progress on Bundibugyo and pan-Ebola tests via its CoSara Diagnostics Pvt. Ltd. joint venture for centralized laboratories and third-party evaluation requested by India’s Centre for Cellular and Molecular Platforms (C-CAMP). A new collaboration with ReadyGo Diagnostics will evaluate using ReadyGo’s GoCollect sample-preparation with the Co-Dx PCR platform for blood-based molecular testing at the point of need, initially for decentralized Ebola detection; this platform is not FDA-cleared or for sale.

triage.headline_ja: Co-Diagnostics社、エボラ出血熱とアウトブレイク対応イノベーションに関するグローバルヘルス円卓会議に参加
triage.triage_reason: 既存のエボラ（ブンディブギョウイルス）流行への言及はあるが、本記事は診断機器企業の会議参加・技術提携に関するPR的内容であり、具体的な発生国や新規の公衆衛生上のリスク情報は示されていない。
triage.notes: 記事は既存のエボラ（ブンディブギョウ種）アウトブレイクに言及しているが、具体的な発生国名（DRC等）は明記されておらず、『Africa』という大陸レベルの記載のみのため対象国として確認できない。記事の主題は診断技術企業のイベント参加であり、感染症発生状況そのものの報告ではない。

article.articleHeadline: India Approves Qdenga, Its First-Ever Dengue Vaccine
article.articleSummary: India grants marketing authorization for its first dengue vaccine, Qdenga (Dengue Tetravalent Vaccine, Live, Attenuated), manufactured by Takeda GmbH and to be imported/distributed by Takeda Biopharmaceuticals India Pvt. Ltd. CDSCO approved on 21 July 2026 after review under the Drugs and Cosmetics Act. Qdenga is a live, attenuated tetravalent vaccine engineered on a dengue serotype-2 backbone with surface-protein genes from DEN-1, DEN-3 and DEN-4 to provide balanced protection against all four serotypes, mitigating antibody-dependent enhancement. Licensed for ages 4–60, it is administered in two doses three months apart, with no pre-vaccination screening required. India experiences about 3–4 million dengue cases annually, with outbreaks peaking during the monsoon; globally, dengue infects 100–400 million people annually. Qdenga is approved in 42 countries. Takeda is partnering with Biological E to boost domestic supply; rollout will address pricing, availability, and integration with vector-control measures.

triage.headline_ja: インドが初のデング熱ワクチン「Qdenga」を承認

article.articleHeadline: চোখ রাঙাচ্ছে ডেঙ্গি, দ্বিতীয়বার ডেঙ্গিতে আক্রান্ত হলে কেন তা ভয়ের? যা বলছেন চিকিৎসক
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue is looming; why is a second dengue infection feared? What doctors say.
article.articleSummary: Dengue is looming in Kolkata amid erratic monsoon weather, even though a dengue vaccine has been approved, rollout is delayed. There are four dengue virus serotypes—DENV-1, DENV-2, DENV-3, and DENV-4. Infections with serotypes 1 or 3 are generally less likely to cause severe disease, while infections with serotypes 2 or 4 carry higher risk. ICMR reports that all four serotypes are circulating in some states, and some patients show co-infections with multiple serotypes. Immunity to one serotype is lifelong, but infection with other serotypes remains possible and can be dangerous. Doctors at Fortis Hospital Anandapur warn that a second dengue infection is feared because it can trigger severe dengue, including dengue shock syndrome, capillary leak syndrome, bleeding, and a marked drop in platelets. Clinicians should note prior dengue history, monitor closely for complications, and watch for multi-organ failure and respiratory distress from abdominal and pulmonary edema during reinfection.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱に警戒、2度目の感染がなぜ危険なのか？医師が解説
triage.triage_reason: デング熱の季節的流行と重症化リスクに関する啓発記事であり、特定の急増や異常事態を報告するものではないが、季節性流行として経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はコルカタ（西ベンガル州）における季節性デング熱と再感染による重症化リスクについての医学解説記事であり、具体的な症例数急増や異常事態の報告ではない。

article.articleHeadline: लम्पी से बचाव के लिए 43,500 गोवंशों का टीकाकरण
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Vaccination of 43,500 cattle to prevent Lumpy Skin Disease.
article.articleSummary: 43,500 cattle have been vaccinated in the district to prevent Lumpy Skin Disease (LSD), per the Department of Animal Husbandry. Vaccination camps also disseminate knowledge on symptoms and cattle care. Twenty-four teams across all development blocks are conducting door-to-door vaccination, aided by Mobile Veterinary Unit MVU-1962 under the Seva Sankalp campaign. Daily awareness camps provide free medicines for diseased animals. Chief Veterinary Officer Dr. Bishan Singh Vikal emphasized timely vaccination against LSD, a Capripoxvirus infection spread by blood-sucking vectors such as flies, mosquitoes, and ticks. Typical symptoms include high fever, nodular lesions, nasal discharge, leg swelling, appetite loss, and reduced milk yield. LSD does not transmit to humans. Farmers are advised to isolate infected animals, avoid self-medication, maintain clean cattle sheds, and implement vector control.

triage.headline_ja: 牛肺結節性皮膚病(LSD)予防のため43,500頭の牛にワクチン接種
triage.triage_reason: Lumpy Skin Diseaseはヒトに感染しない家畜疾患であり、記事内容もインドの一地域における通常のワクチン接種キャンペーンの報告に留まるため、公衆衛生上のシグナルには該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: Vigilância da raiva humana e animal é discutida em webinar do CRMV-TO - Conexão Tocantins - Portal de Notícias
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Human and animal rabies surveillance is discussed in CRMV-TO webinar - Conexão Tocantins - News Portal
article.articleSummary: Rabies surveillance in Tocantins highlighted at CRMV-TO webinar 'A Saúde é Única'—second edition on 22 September 2026 at 7 p.m. local time, live on the CRMV Tocantins YouTube channel. The program covers human and animal rabies in Brazil, surveillance of hematophagous bats, and rabies cases in herbivores; notes a confirmed animal rabies case in August in Palmas, Tocantins, within the broader Brazilian context and Palmas outbreak. Speakers include Sirlene Manrique (Ministry of Health), Raydleno Tavares (Adapec), Iza Alencar (Secretary of Health of Tocantins, president of the CRMV-TO One Health Commission), and Leandro Chaves (Palmas Zoonoses Unit). The webinar aims to educate health professionals and the public on transmission via bites or scratches with saliva, the near-100% fatality, and the importance of animal vaccination for prevention.

article.articleHeadline: Influenza Meningkat, H1N1pdm09 Dominan: Belum Menunjukkan KLB
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Influenza on the rise, H1N1pdm09 dominant: not yet showing an outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Influenza activity in Indonesia rose in week 35 of 2026 but has not reached outbreak status. In Jakarta, sentinel surveillance for 5–12 September 2026 found 66 of 175 specimens positive for influenza: 63 influenza A(H1N1)pdm09, 2 influenza A(H3N2), and 1 influenza B Victoria. The ministry reported a 38% positivity rate, yet overall influenza activity remains low. Epidemiologist Dicky Budiman notes the dominant subtype this week is A(H1N1)pdm09 rather than H3N2, reflecting normal inter-seasonal shifts rather than a novel virus. WHO states A(H1N1)pdm09 is now part of seasonal influenza. Surveillance is sentinel-based, from selected health facilities, to monitor trends rather than to estimate population burden. Therefore, 38% positivity cannot be interpreted as 38% of Indonesians with flu, and hospital occupancy cannot be directly attributed to influenza.

article.articleHeadline: 'Exotic' pets are a growing health risk for humans and wildife
article.articleSummary: Psittacosis (avian chlamydiosis), caused by Chlamydia psittaci, is a zoonosis linked to handling birds in the pet trade, where poor traceability and close contact raise spillover risk. In Mumbai, Dr. Rina Dev, an avian vet, was hospitalized for four days with a lung infection. A 2024 India case involved parrot exposure; in 1994, Belgian customs officers contracted the infection from parakeets. A 2021 ICAR review calls avian chlamydiosis a neglected zoonosis with spillover potential. The 2026 Humane World for Animals report says 75% of emerging diseases are zoonotic, with about 1.7 million unknown viruses in mammals/birds, up to 0.85 million infecting humans; longer trade duration increases shared pathogens. A study of 2,079 traded species links pathogen sharing to trade presence. Other risks include Aspergillosis, salmonellosis from reptiles, primate TB, Lyme disease, and ticks; 2,500 Salmonella-positive sliders were euthanised in Singapore in July 2025. Import of venomous snakes raises antivenom gaps.

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en Ituri : 400.000 gels et 5.000 Thermoflash remis aux établissements scolaires - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Ituri: 400,000 hand sanitizer gels and 5,000 Thermoflash distributed to schools - ACP.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in Ituri, Democratic Republic of Congo: In Bunia and the northeast Ituri province, health authorities distributed 400,000 hydroalcoholic gel bottles (500 ml) and 5,000 Thermoflash infrared thermometers to the education sector to strengthen preventive measures amid the Ebola response. The hand sanitizers and temperature screening devices were allocated through the health system's development program management unit, funded by the World Bank, and will be delivered to the provincial governor for deployment to schools. Dr. Claude Sese, a development program expert, said the aim is to bolster hygiene, prevention, and sanitary protection for students and staff as schools open. This action accompanies ongoing Ebola control efforts in the province, though the article does not specify current case counts or laboratory-confirmed infections. Date: 21 September 2026.

article.articleHeadline: TN CM Vijay chairs high-level meeting on monsoon preparedness, dengue control
article.articleSummary: On 21 September 2026, Tamil Nadu Chief Minister C. Joseph Vijay chaired a Chennai-based high-level meeting to boost Northeast Monsoon preparedness and dengue control. With the monsoon (October–December) delivering about half of the state’s rainfall, officials were asked to map coastal and flood-prone areas, finalize evacuation plans, and ready storm shelters, multipurpose centers, schools and community halls as relief camps. Measures include standby rescue teams with boats, life rafts, generators, and dewatering pumps; drones to inspect roads, bridges, and stormwater drains; and emergency communications, including satellite phones, with SMS weather advisories. Dengue control priorities encompass door-to-door Domestic Breeding Checker surveys to eliminate Aedes larvae, continuous surveillance in high-risk zones, and public awareness on early symptoms and prevention. article.articleHeadline: Ituri : les parents appelés à éviter tout retard de prise en charge Ebola - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ituri: Parents Urged to Avoid Any Delay in Ebola Care - ACP
article.articleSummary: As of 21 September 2026, in Bunia, Ituri Province, northeastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, parents were urged to quickly route any family member showing Ebola signs to health facilities. Dr. Michel Mbuyi, a member of the surveillance pillar, warned against delays in care for symptoms such as fever, headache, diarrhea, or vomiting. He decried that some health facilities see low attendance while patients are kept at home or taken to traditional healers, which hampers response and can drive community deaths. He emphasized early hospital-based management, urged against self-medication and prolonged use of traditional remedies before referral to an Ebola Treatment Center (ETC). The appeal aims to reduce home care and community transmission, ensuring swift isolation and treatment of suspected cases.

article.articleHeadline: Wamenkes Dorong CKG Jadi Senjata Tekan Kasus TBC di Indonesia Termasuk di Ciamis
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Deputy Health Minister Pushes CKG to Become a Weapon to Curb TB Cases in Indonesia, Including in Ciamis
article.articleSummary: On 2026-09-21, Deputy Health Minister Benjamin Paulus Octavianus urged expanding Free Health Check (CKG) screenings to curb tuberculosis (TB) across Indonesia, including in Ciamis, West Java. During a visit to RSUD Ciamis and the Ciamis Regency, he noted TB treatment outcomes in Java are among the best but transmission remains high due to close-contact exposure. He proposed routine screening of household contacts: those without symptoms would receive TB preventive therapy (TPT), while those with active disease would start treatment promptly. Acknowledging TB can be asymptomatic and contagious, he emphasized sustained contact tracing over several years; three consecutive years of screening could significantly reduce national TB cases. He cited improved case finding: 2020 estimates of 824,000 TB cases with about 48% detected; last year, 1.09 million estimated with ~867,000 detected (≈80%).

article.articleHeadline: 17,000 dengue cases reported in Tamil Nadu this year: Health Minister Arunraj
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-09-21, Tamil Nadu has reported about 17,000 dengue cases this year, lower than two years ago. Health Minister K. G. Arunraj said government hospital beds are adequate and doctors have been instructed to follow standard fever-treatment protocols. The Aedes mosquito, which transmits dengue, can breed in tiny rainwater containers and bites mainly during daylight. In a video conference with Chief Minister C. Joseph Vijay on northeast monsoon preparedness, officials were urged to prevent rainwater stagnation and ensure readiness for monsoon-related contingencies. To strengthen the health system, 4,724 nurses will be recruited district-wise through district welfare societies. The update underscores ongoing dengue activity in Tamil Nadu and emphasis on vector control, patient management, and healthcare capacity.
