article.articleHeadline: 5 Persen Suspek Terkonfirmasi Positif TBC dalam Program Pelacakan di Blitar
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 5 Percent of Suspected Tuberculosis Cases Confirmed Positive in a Contact Tracing Program in Blitar
article.articleSummary: Blitar Regency, East Java, Indonesia: five percent of suspects in an intensive contact-tracing program were confirmed with tuberculosis (TB). The program began in early August 2026, targeting 40 locations by year-end; 16 locations have been traced so far. With about 100 suspects per location, roughly five TB positives are found per site, totaling 80 positive cases across 16 locations from 1,600 suspects tested. From January–July 2026, routine screenings added to 870 newly diagnosed TB cases in Blitar. Authorities expect a substantial uptick in detected cases by completing the 40-location target. The initiative is a national Ministry of Health program, integrated with the Free Health Check program under President Prabowo Subianto.

article.articleHeadline: MSF probará vacuna contra ébola en 20,000 sanitarios
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: MSF to test Ebola vaccine in 20,000 healthcare workers
article.articleSummary: MSF launches Bravo, a vaccine-efficacy trial in the Democratic Republic of the Congo testing Ervebo in 20,000 healthcare workers to counter the Bundibugyo Ebola strain driving the outbreak. Ervebo is the only large-scale vaccine for Zaire ebolavirus; preliminary data suggest partial protection against Bundibugyo, which Bravo will confirm. The study began in Bunia, Ituri, at a WHO training center, and will last 9–12 months, with three months for vaccination and at least six months of follow-up. As of 21 September 2026, the outbreak has 7,672 cases and 3,699 deaths since May 15, with 1,879 recoveries and 886 still hospitalized or isolated (case fatality 48.2%). It spans 63 health zones across Ituri, Tshopo, Bas-Uélé, Haut-Uélé, North Kivu, South Kivu, and South Ubangi. Uganda reported a separate exit: 20 cases (15 imported from DRC) and 2 deaths, with the end declared on Aug 26. Two Bundibugyo vaccines are in Phase 1.

article.articleHeadline: Várzea Grande recebe capacitação para fortalecer diagnóstico e tratamento da hanseníase na Baixada Cuiabana
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Várzea Grande receives training to strengthen the diagnosis and treatment of Hansen's disease in the Cuiabá Lowlands.
article.articleSummary: Hansen's disease (leprosy) training takes place in Várzea Grande, Brazil, from 21 to 25 September 2026, to strengthen early detection and clinical management across the Cuiabá Lowlands’ Baixada Cuiabana region. The 40-hour Theory and Practice Capacitation, organized by the Mato Grosso Public Health School (ESP-MT), offers 40 vacancies: 20 for Várzea Grande and two for each of Acorizal, Barão de Melgaço, Chapada dos Guimarães, Cuiabá, Jangada, Nossa Senhora do Livramento, Nova Brasilândia, Planalto da Serra, Poconé, and Santo Antônio do Leverger. Participants are professionals from Primary Health Care and Health Surveillance. Activities blend theory at Unifacc with practical work at Parque do Lago and Maringá health units, culminating in case discussions. The program aligns with a new Ministry of Health financing model linked to performance indicators and reinforces recognition of Hansen's disease signs—skin lesions with altered sensation, numbness, tingling, or weakness—prompting timely evaluation and treatment. Part of Continuing Health Education to bolster the Baixada Cuiabana's regional response.

article.articleHeadline: Macaé reduz casos de dengue em 88% e reforça alerta nas chuvas | Macaé | O Dia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Macaé reduces dengue cases by 88% and reinforces alert during the rains | Macaé | O Dia
article.articleSummary: 70 dengue cases from January through August 2026, 88% fewer than 579 in the same period of 2025. Aedes aegypti, the vector for dengue, Zika, and chikungunya, remains a concern as rains intensify. Over 90% of identified breeding sites are inside homes, so inspections focus on households. About 120 surveillance agents conducted 225,548 property inspections and 80 outreach drives in high-risk areas. Ovitraps detect eggs to signal mosquito presence, guiding targeted interventions. Prevention emphasizes eliminating standing water in plant pots, tires, buckets, and water tanks, reinforced by the national “10 Minutes Saves Lives” campaign. The rainy season accelerates mosquito development, underscoring that vigilance must persist even as case counts fall.

article.articleHeadline: 8 Kebiasaan Sederhana yang bisa Lindungi Anak dari Penularan Influenza A
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 8 Simple Habits That Can Protect Children from the Transmission of Influenza A.
article.articleSummary: Influenza A is spreading in Indonesia, with children identified as a vulnerable group at risk of serious complications. The JawaPos.com report notes increased transmission across several regions. Transmission occurs via droplets from coughs, sneezes, or talking and can spread through contaminated surfaces. To reduce pediatric exposure, six practical steps are advised: 1) annual flu vaccination—reduces severity and complications; WHO GISRS monitors strains and updates northern and southern hemisphere vaccine compositions twice yearly. 2) teach children to wash hands with soap and water for at least 20 seconds, or use alcohol-based sanitizer (≥60%). 3) avoid close contact with the sick and refrain from sharing utensils or towels; maintain 1–2 meters distance when possible. 4) model proper cough and sneeze etiquette—cover with tissue or elbow and wash hands. 5) wear masks when sick or in crowded settings. 6) maintain environmental hygiene and launder linens and clothing of ill family members.

triage.headline_ja: 子どもをインフルエンザA型感染から守る8つのシンプルな習慣

article.articleHeadline: 'டெங்கு, உண்ணி காய்ச்சல் குறித்து மக்கள் விழிப்புடன் இருக்க வேண்டும்' - செல்வப்பெருந்தகை
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: People should stay vigilant about Dengue and Chikungunya fever - செல்வப்பெருந்தகை
article.articleSummary: As of 21 September 2026, dengue and chikungunya risk is rising in Tamil Nadu due to monsoon and rainy-season conditions. Former Tamil Nadu Congress leader Selvar Perundhagai urges public vigilance. Fever with high fever, severe headache, body pains, retro-orbital pain, vomiting, or extreme fatigue should prompt immediate medical evaluation at government hospitals or primary health centers for testing. Preventive steps include removing standing water around homes and offices, since mosquitoes breed in old tires, coconut shells, broken plastics, and containers. Livestock and pet areas should be kept clean to curb breeding. Do not self-medicate; seek a doctor's advice for suspected dengue or chikungunya. The government should intensify vector-control and ensure accessible testing and treatment, with public cooperation; prevention remains the best protection.

He also outlined measures to prevent any potential spread of Ebola, as the outbreak continues in neighboring Democratic Republic of Congo. The remarks reflect a public health push to bolster vaccination coverage, improve care quality, and strengthen cross-border disease surveillance amid ongoing Ebola activity in the DRC. The report provides no specific case or death counts, laboratory-confirmation details, or infection sources, and centers on leadership commitments and public health messaging rather than clinical data for policymakers and health workers.

article.articleHeadline: Live rodents, faecal contamination risks: FDA suspends licenses of online delivery platform, mithai shops in Mumbai
article.articleSummary: On 21 September 2026, Mumbai FDA suspended licenses of several food outlets after live rodents, droppings, and faecal contamination risks were found. Swiggy Instamart dark store in Ballard Estate (Swinsta ENT) had live rodents in handling areas, gnawed rice bags, droppings, and live cockroaches over products; a near-storage toilet posed airborne/faecal-oral risk. Olympia Coffee House in Colaba faced similar hygiene lapses. Amazon Kandivali East dark store (Acculogicx) showed broken drainage tiles, wastewater stagnation, oily slime, lack of segregation of food/non-food, and missing temperature logs. Suleman Usman Mithaiwala on Mohammed Ali Road had no physical separation from drains, enabling trap-less drains to carry sewage and pathogens like E. coli and Salmonella onto surfaces. Licenses were suspended for Nice Enterprises (Chembur), Jain Sweet & Bhelpuri House (Kandivli West), Go Green Food Hospitality (Ghatkopar East), Swad Snacks Corner (Lalbaug/Parel), and Lucknowi Kebab & Zaika Moradabadi (Yari Road, Versova/Andheri West).

article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Influenza A Trend Spikes, East Java DPRD Immediately Summons the Health Office.
article.articleSummary: Influenza A cases rise across East Java, prompting East Java DPRD Commission E to summon the provincial Health Office to clarify the real situation on the ground amid rising reports in Surabaya and other districts. Chair Sri Untari Bisowarno said the inquiry seeks transparency and to map the causes and implications for health services, especially for children. Deputy Governor Emil Dardak acknowledged a downward trend in Malang but noted increased ISPA/Influenza A complaints elsewhere and urged hospitals to stay vigilant and not neglect patients presenting Influenza A symptoms. The provincial government reports no patient refusals or hospital overload so far, but authorities welcome timely information. Major hospitals are urged to stay prepared as the health office investigates drivers and service impacts of the surge.

article.articleHeadline: Saúde de Maceió realiza semana de conscientização sobre hanseníase
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Maceió Health Department Holds Leprosy Awareness Week.
article.articleSummary: Leprosy awareness week in Maceió, Brazil, runs 21–25 September 2026, organized by the Municipal Health Department through the Municipal Leprosy Control Program. Actions include health professional training, epidemiological surveillance, specialized care, and community education to promote early detection and timely treatment. Early diagnosis with prompt, free treatment reduces permanent damage; regimens include a monthly supervised dose plus a self-administered dose, generally 6 months for early detection or up to 12 months for late detection, with drugs provided by SUS. Symptomatic individuals should seek care at local health units, with referrals to a reference network when needed. Monday 21 at US Antônio de Pádua (Petrópolis) opens the week with MORHAN; Thursday 24 (Jaraguá) offers leprosy training for dentists; Friday 25 (Praça da Maravilha) features a patient roundtable.

article.articleHeadline: Wamendagri Tegaskan Penanggulangan TBC Butuh Kolaborasi Lintas Sektor
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Deputy Minister of Home Affairs emphasizes that TB control requires intersectoral collaboration.
article.articleSummary: On 21 September 2026, Deputy Minister of Home Affairs Akhmad Wiyagus urged cross-sector collaboration to strengthen tuberculosis control in Ciamis Regency, West Java, noting TB's impact on productivity and family economies. Ciamis has drafted a Regional TB Action Plan (RAD), formed the TB Acceleration Team (TP2 TB), and integrated these measures into the Local Government Work Plan (RKPD). The effort includes declaring TB-ready villages and urban areas. He noted that health is not only a health ministry matter, with Kemenkes providing technical guidance while Kemendagri oversees health-related administrative affairs at provincial, district, and subdistrict levels down to Puskesmas and Posyandu. He urged Forkopimda and local officials from kecamatan to desa to educate communities about TB prevention and treatment, including TB Preventive Therapy (TPT). The forum was attended by Deputy Health Minister Benjamin Paulus Octavianus and Ciamis Regent Herdiat Sunarya.

article.articleHeadline: Az EU szakértőket küld Kongóba: Kongó Ebola-vakcinát kap klinikai vizsgálatokhoz
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The EU sends experts to the Congo: Congo to receive an Ebola vaccine for clinical trials.
article.articleSummary: Two European epidemiologists travel to the Democratic Republic of Congo’s Ebola outbreak epicenter in Ituri as Ervebo vaccine clinical trials begin. The ECDC notes the European risk remains very low and has provided direct support since the outbreak’s start, including May expert aid to Africa CDC and June airport health screenings at DRC and Uganda, with deployments to South Sudan. Authorities report over 7,600 confirmed Ebola virus disease cases and more than 3,670 deaths, with nearly 80% of infections in Ituri. The World Health Organization states the outbreak is driven by Bundibugyo virus; no licensed vaccine or approved treatment exists for this strain. Ervebo, previously effective against Ebola Zaire, is being tested for protection against Bundibugyo, with 20,000 doses available for this purpose as part of a 70,000-dose package to Congolese authorities. EU risk to travelers remains very low, though sporadic introductions could occur and are unlikely to cause sustained EU transmission.

article.articleHeadline: AB, Kongo'daki Ebola salgınına uzman gönderiyor: Klinik denemeler için aşılar ulaştı
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: EU sends an expert to the Ebola outbreak in Congo: Vaccines have arrived for clinical trials.
article.articleSummary: Two European epidemiologists are heading to the Democratic Republic of the Congo’s Ebola outbreak epicenter in Ituri, as the EU’s ECDC announces on 2026-09-21. The aim is to bolster surveillance and response; since May, ECDC and Africa CDC have supported field operations, including airport exit screenings in the region and neighboring South Sudan. Current figures: over 7,600 confirmed Ebola Virus Disease cases and more than 3,670 deaths, with roughly 80% of cases in Ituri. European risk to travelers remains very low; transmission occurs via contact with blood, secretions, organs, or body fluids, and via contaminated bedding or clothing. On the same day, WHO launched a trial of Ervebo, the licensed Ebola vaccine, among health workers in Ituri to assess protection against Bundibugyo virus. 20,000 doses are set aside for this purpose, within a 70,000-dose package; the vaccine’s efficacy against Bundibugyo is not yet established.

article.articleHeadline: Ebola-Ausbruch im Kongo: EU schickt Experten, Kongo erhält Impfstoffe für Studien
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in the Congo: the EU sends experts, the Congo receives vaccines for trials
article.articleSummary: Two European epidemiologists travel to the epicenter of the ongoing Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) as the EU’s ECDC reinforces surveillance and response. Since May, Africa CDC-led teams have operated on the ground; in June, ECDC assessed airport exit screening in DRC and Uganda, with additional experts now in South Sudan. Globally, there are over 7,600 confirmed infections and more than 3,670 deaths, with nearly 80% of cases in Ituri Province. The EU assesses the risk to Europe as very low, though isolated introductions are possible due to human-to-human transmission via blood, secretions, organs, body fluids, or contaminated belongings. In Ituri, the WHO reports the start of a vaccine trial with Ervebo (rVSV-ZEBOV) to assess protection against Bundibugyo Ebola; 20,000 doses are allocated for this study within a 70,000-dose contingency for DR Congo. Ervebo has shown high efficacy against Ebola Zaire; protection against Bundibugyo remains unclear.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ流行：EUが専門家を派遣、コンゴはワクチン試験用の供給を受ける

article.articleHeadline: La UE envía expertos al Congo por el brote de ébola, el país recibe vacunas para ensayos clínicos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The EU Sends Experts to the Congo for the Ebola Outbreak, the Country Receives Vaccines for Clinical Trials
article.articleSummary: Two European epidemiologists head to the Democratic Republic of the Congo's Ituri region to bolster Ebola outbreak surveillance as the WHO launches a vaccine trial with Ervebo for frontline workers. The EU's ECDC has supported the response since May, including airport exit-screening in DRC and Uganda and deployments to South Sudan. Authorities report over 7,600 confirmed Ebola cases and more than 3,670 deaths, with nearly 80% of cases in Ituri. Transmission is via direct contact with blood, secretions, organs, or contaminated bedding. EU risk to Europe remains very low, with sporadic imported cases possible but unlikely to be multiple independent introductions. The WHO vaccination program allocates 20,000 Ervebo doses to study protection against Bundibugyo virus, part of 70,000 doses available to Congolese authorities; efficacy against Bundibugyo is unknown.

triage.headline_ja: EUがコンゴのエボラ流行に専門家を派遣、同国は臨床試験用ワクチンを受領
triage.triage_reason: DRCで7,600人超の確定症例、3,670人以上の死亡という大規模流行であり、国際機関(EU/ECDC/WHO)が対応・ワクチン試験を展開しているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC : l'essai du vaccin Ervebo démarre en Ituri
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: the Ervebo vaccine trial begins in Ituri.
article.articleSummary: Ebola Bundibugyo outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo progresses with frontline vaccination in Ituri's Bunia using Ervebo. About 20,000 individuals in Ituri and Nord-Kivu are slated to participate in a trial to evaluate Ervebo’s effectiveness against Bundibugyo. Ervebo is the only vaccine deployed at scale but is licensed for the Ebola Zaïre (Zaire) strain, not Bundibugyo, and no Bundibugyo-specific vaccine exists yet. Some 70,000 doses have been allocated from the global stock to support response and research. The trial, led by Congolese authorities with WHO, Africa CDC, and MSF, spans 9–12 months, with vaccination ~3 months and at least 6 months of follow-up. Earlier vaccinations exceed 3,500 in Tshopo and 980 in Bas-Uele. SAGE cautions that data are insufficient to confirm clinical protection. Other Bundibugyo vaccines are in development. The outbreak is the largest in RDC mortality terms, with 7,672 cases and 3,699 deaths across seven provinces and 63 health zones, 1,879 recovered, 886 isolated or hospitalized, declared mid-May.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱（コンゴ民主共和国）：Ervebo（エルベボ）ワクチンの試験がイトゥリ州で開始
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で死亡者数として過去最大規模のエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）アウトブレイクが継続しており、致死率の高さと国際機関（WHO、Africa CDC、MSF）の関与から、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響と異常性が認められるためフルRRAへの移行が妥当。
triage.notes: 本アウトブレイクはコンゴ民主共和国内（イトゥリ州、北キブ州、チョポ州、バ・ウエレ州等7州63保健地区）に限定されており、国境を越えた拡大の報告はないが、致死率3,699/7,672例と極めて深刻。エルベボはザイール株用ワクチンでブンディブギョ株への有効性は未確認であり、SAGEも臨床的防御効果のエビデンス不足を指摘している点は継続的なモニタリングが必要。

article.articleHeadline: Waspada, Kasus Influenza Type A Naik, Kemenkes Pastikan Terkendali
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Be vigilant: Influenza A cases rise, the Ministry of Health confirms they are under control.
article.articleSummary: Indonesia’s Ministry of Health reports rising influenza activity as of 18 September 2026 (week 36). Of 185 specimens tested nationwide, 86 were positive for influenza (46%), up from 37% in week 35. Among positives, 76 were influenza A(H1N1)pdm09, 8 were influenza A(H3N2), and 2 were influenza B/Victoria. Despite the uptick, overall influenza activity at hospitals and primary care clinics remains low and under control. The Health Ministry continues surveillance through Influenza-Like Illness (ILI) and Severe Acute Respiratory Infections (SARI). Officials say the uptick in detections warrants continued observation to determine whether it reflects seasonal patterns or a potential shift in activity. Data from Jakarta, Indonesia; ongoing nationwide monitoring.

article.articleHeadline: EU sends experts to Congo as Ebola outbreak continues
article.articleSummary: Two European epidemiologists head to the epicenter of the Democratic Republic of the Congo Ebola outbreak as the EU's ECDC reinforces surveillance and outbreak response. Since May, ECDC has supported Africa CDC and, in June, led exit-screening assessments at DRC and Uganda airports. As of 21 September 2026, there are more than 7,600 confirmed Ebola cases and 3,670 deaths, with about 80% of infections in Ituri. Transmission occurs through direct contact with blood, secretions, organs, or contaminated bedding or clothing; risk to Europeans remains very low. Sporadic EU importations are possible, but multiple independent importations are unlikely. WHO launched a vaccination program in Ituri using Ervebo—the only licensed Ebola vaccine—for health workers and frontline personnel. 20,000 doses will test protection against Bundibugyo virus; total 70,000 doses are available to Congolese authorities. Ervebo was highly effective against Zaire; protection against Bundibugyo is unknown; no licensed vaccine or treatment exists for Bundibugyo.

article.articleHeadline: Miraí planeja ações preventivas contra dengue e outras arboviroses
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Miraí plans preventive measures against dengue and other arboviral diseases.
article.articleSummary: On 2026-09-21, Miraí’s Arboviruses Control Committee met to discuss prevention and response for dengue, Zika, chikungunya, and other Aedes aegypti–transmitted diseases. Organized by the Endemias Sector of the Municipal Health Secretariat, the meeting linked El Niño–related higher temperatures and shifting rainfall to increased mosquito proliferation risk. Planning emphasizes intensified actions such as community clean-up drives, lectures, educational blitzes, and population outreach to raise awareness. The aim is to preemptively bolster prevention and mobilization across sectors before periods of higher risk, integrating cleaning, guidance, and education with broad community participation as a central pillar. The committee prepared a scalable action agenda that can be expanded as needed in the municipality.

triage.triage_reason: 実際の感染拡大や症例報告ではなく、季節性リスクに備えた自治体の予防計画会議に関する記事であり、異常性・緊急性は認められない。
triage.notes: 記事は具体的な症例数や流行状況を報告しておらず、市の予防的行政対応に関する内容のため見送りと判断。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola à Mambasa : les jeunes appelés à collaborer avec les équipes de riposte - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Mambasa: Young people urged to cooperate with outbreak response teams - ACP
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in Mambasa, Ituri province, North-East Democratic Republic of Congo, prompts a call for youth engagement with response teams. On September 21, 2026, Mungeni Yuma, head of Mambasa civil society, urged young residents to cooperate with Ebola response teams during dignified and secure burials (EDS) and post-mortem examinations, to curb transmission. He warned that resistance persists in some neighborhoods and that refusal to follow burial protocols markedly increases spread. He cited the PK51 area in the Nia-Nia health zone, where early handling of bodies and unguarded funerals contributed to a surge in cases. The appeal emphasizes community collaboration with response teams to jointly control the outbreak and ensure safe handling of the deceased.

triage.headline_ja: マンバサでのエボラ出血熱：若者に対応チームへの協力を呼びかけ - ACP
triage.triage_reason: DRCイツリ州マンバサでエボラ出血熱の集団発生が継続しており、埋葬慣行への抵抗が感染拡大要因となっている。重篤な感染症であり、地域社会での感染拡大リスクが高いためフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 既存のエボラアウトブレイクに関する続報。PK51地域（ニアニア保健区）での早期遺体処理や無管理の葬儀が感染急増の要因として指摘されており、コミュニティの協力体制の欠如が懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: Somalia Strengthens Ebola Readiness Through National Simulation Exercise - OpEd
article.articleSummary: Somalia conducted a 3-day national Ebola preparedness simulation in Mogadishu to detect, verify, report and respond to a suspected imported Ebola case; no confirmed case exists in Somalia. Seventy participants from the Federal Ministry of Health and Human Services, the National Institute of Health, federal member states and partners took part in tabletop and functional sessions on coordination, points of entry, referral, information sharing, risk communication and incident management. The exercise coincides with the Democratic Republic of the Congo’s Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak; as of 7 September 2026, WHO reported 6,757 confirmed cases and 3,267 deaths across 61 health zones in six provinces. Somalia’s readiness is challenged by conflict, climate shocks, displacement, measles, diphtheria, circulating vaccine-derived poliovirus type 2, and funding gaps. Six tabletop scenarios plus a Public Health Emergency Operations Centre drill identified gaps in reporting lines, notification/referral, entry points, governance of public communication, and ownership of actions; an improvement plan was created. No patients or specimens were involved; scenarios did not reflect a Somali event. WHO supported.

triage.headline_ja: ソマリア、国家シミュレーション演習を通じてエボラ対応準備を強化 - 論説
triage.triage_reason: 記事の文脈で言及されているDRCのエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）アウトブレイクは、2026年9月7日時点で6,757例確定・3,267人死亡、61保健地域に拡大しており、深刻な公衆衛生影響と国際的拡大リスクを有するためフルRRAでの評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事本体はソマリアにおけるエボラ輸入例対応の国家シミュレーション演習に関するものであり、ソマリア国内に確定エボラ症例はない（Somaliaは対象国リスト外のためverified_locationsから除外）。ただし記事内で言及されているDRCのブンディブギョ・エボラアウトブレイクは進行中の重大な公衆衛生事象であり、既存のRRA有無を確認の上、DRCの状況について継続的な監視・評価が必要。ソマリア国内では麻疹、ジフテリア、cVDPV2の流行も併存しており、脆弱な保健システムが懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: Objavljeni podaci o opasnom virusu u Srbiji: Čak 43 slučaja sa neuroinvazivnim oblikom bolesti
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Published data on a dangerous virus in Serbia: as many as 43 cases of the neuroinvasive disease form.
article.articleSummary: From June 1 to September 20, 2026, Serbia reported 46 cases of West Nile fever, including 43 neuroinvasive infections. Cases occurred across ten districts: Belgrade City (16); South Bačka (9); Šumadija (6); Central Banat (5); South Banat (4); North Banat (2); West Bačka (1); Rasina (1); Braničevo (1); Pomoravlje (1). Among patients, 28 were male and 18 female; mean age 66.6 years. West Nile fever is a seasonal, mosquito-borne illness, with the main vector Culex pipiens; transmission in Serbia typically runs June–November. Preventive measures include personal protection (repellents, long sleeves/pants, light-colored loose clothing), avoiding outdoor activity at dusk and dawn, screens on windows/doors, indoor air conditioning, and reducing standing water (weekly emptying of containers, disposal of tires and other water-holding items). Travelers to tropical/subtropical regions should follow precautions. Any neuroinvasive symptoms warrant prompt medical consultation.

triage.headline_ja: セルビアの危険なウイルスに関するデータが公表：神経浸潤型の症例が43件に達する
triage.triage_reason: セルビアにおける季節性の西ナイル熱の流行報告であり、対象国（India等）は記事の主題ではなく発生地域リストに誤って含まれているのみ。対象国での発生ではないため見送り。
triage.notes: 記事はセルビアにおける西ナイル熱の季節性流行（2026年6月~9月、46例、うち神経浸潤型43例）を報告。インドは発生地域リストに含まれているが、記事内容には一切登場せず、Bluedotの地域付与ミスと判断。対象国リストにセルビアは含まれないため、verified_locationsは空配列とする。

article.articleHeadline: ANTHRAX CASES HIT 21 IN MUCHINGA AS WILDLIFE DEATHS CLIMB TO 39 - Zambia 24
article.articleSummary: Anthrax outbreak in Muchinga Province, Zambia, now 21 cases after seven new infections, as wildlife deaths climb to 39 (28 hippos, 4 buffaloes, 6 elephants, 1 crocodile). Permanent Secretary Dr. Tuesday Bwalya says all patients are stable and receiving treatment in health facilities. Vaccinations are underway and livestock remain safe with no domestic cases reported so far. Officials warn against selling meat from domestic animals that die on their own before it is certified safe for consumption. Nabwalya in Mpika and surrounding districts are advised to take precautions. The PS is confident the outbreak will be contained with measures in place.

triage.headline_ja: ムチンガ州で炭疽症例が21人に増加、野生動物の死亡も39頭に達する - ザンビア24
triage.triage_reason: ヒトの炭疽症例が21例に増加し野生動物の大量死（39頭）を伴う人獣共通感染症アウトブレイクであり、当局が対応中で政府の関心も高いため、フルRRAでの精査が望ましい。
triage.notes: 人の症例は全て安定しており死亡例は報告されていないが、野生動物の大量死（カバ、バッファロー、ゾウ、クロコダイル）が継続しており、感染源として環境曝露のリスクが続く可能性がある。ワクチン接種が実施され、家畜への感染は確認されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Nursing students at Lucknow's KGMU protest after fellow student dies of dengue
article.articleSummary: Lucknow, Sep 21: Nursing students at King George's Medical University (KGMU) protested after fellow student Divyanshi Yadav died allegedly of dengue. The second-year BSc Nursing student reportedly had dengue but continued attending college. Students allege administration pressures attendance and denies medical leave, even when seriously ill. One protester recalled being unwell a week earlier; another said Divyanshi attended while on a deathbed, with teachers allegedly directing students to come after taking medicine. The demonstrations underscore concerns about student safety and patient care amid an outbreak context. KGMU spokesperson Prof KK Singh said a five-member committee has been formed to look into the matter, comprising Chief Medical Superintendent Dr BK Ojha; Dean of the Faculty of Nursing Prof Amita Pandey; Vice Dean Prof Smriti Agarwal; Chief Proctor Prof RAS Kushwaha; and Principal of the College of Nursing Suchana Roy Bhowmik.

triage.headline_ja: ラクナウのKGMUで看護学生がデング熱で死亡、同級生らが抗議
triage.triage_reason: 個別のデング熱死亡例と大学の労務管理問題が主題であり、大規模な公衆衛生上の異常事態を示す情報は乏しいが、アウトブレイクの文脈が言及されており継続的な確認が必要。
triage.notes: 記事は個別死亡例に伴う学生抗議と大学の対応（調査委員会設置）が主題。デング熱自体はインドで季節性に流行する疾患であり、この記事単独では大規模アウトブレイクの規模・拡大状況は不明。

article.articleHeadline: Hà Nội ghi nhận 349 ca sốt xuất huyết trong 7 ngày: Người từng mắc bệnh vẫn có thể 'dính' lần nữa
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hanoi records 349 dengue fever cases in seven days: People who have had dengue before can still contract it again.
article.articleSummary: From Sep 11–18, 2026, Hanoi recorded 349 dengue fever cases across 84 wards/communes, with hotspots in Ha Dong, Dan Hoa, Hong Van, Tu Liem, An Khanh, and Binh Minh. Weekly cases declined by 10 from the prior week. Dengue is transmitted by Aedes aegypti and Aedes albopictus, which breed in clean water containers around homes; daytime biting peaks in the morning and late afternoon. Dengue virus has four serotypes (DEN-1 to DEN-4); infection with one type provides lifelong immunity only to that type, allowing reinfection with other serotypes, which can lead to more severe disease. Symptoms typically appear 3–5 days after infection and include high fever (39–40°C), severe headache, and muscle/joint pain. Emphasizes vector control and preventive measures in Hanoi to curb transmission.

triage.headline_ja: ハノイで7日間に349件のデング熱症例を確認：過去に感染した人も再感染の可能性あり
triage.triage_reason: ベトナム・ハノイで例年発生するデング熱の季節的増加であり、症例数は前週より減少傾向。IHR基準の明確な該当はないが、地域流行の継続監視が必要。
triage.notes: デング熱はベトナムで毎年季節的に発生する疾患であり、今回の報告は既知の流行パターンの一部と考えられる。重症例・死亡者数の情報は記事に含まれていない。

article.articleHeadline: Invité Afrique Midi - Ebola en RDC: à Butembo, "il n'y a pas assez de lits pour accueillir tous les cas confirmés"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Guest on Afrique Midi - Ebola in the DRC: in Butembo, 'there are not enough beds to accommodate all confirmed cases'.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo remains uncontrolled, centered in Nord-Kivu with transmission in Butembo and Katwa, while Ituri shows some improvement. Case numbers are rising again over the past 2–3 weeks. Two Ebola treatment centers operated by MSF and Médair in Butembo offer only 50 beds in total, with transit sites for suspects; capacity is insufficient for an estimated 2 million people in the region. Consequently, many confirmed patients cannot access Ebola-standard care, some are treated in non-specialized facilities, or sent back to the community. As of 18 September, Nord-Kivu recorded 843 deaths (case fatality around 61%). Fear, misinformation, and weak community engagement hinder care-seeking and containment. Frontline health workers face elevated risk due to inadequate personal protective equipment and support. MSF notes a shortage of humanitarian actors and resources to mount an adequate response.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカ特派員インタビュー - コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱：ブテンボでは『確定症例全員を収容するベッドが足りない』
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国北キブ州でエボラ出血熱の症例が再び増加し、致死率約61%、病床不足で標準治療を受けられない患者が多数存在するなど、公衆衛生上深刻かつ制御不能な状況が継続している。
triage.notes: 北キブ州ブテンボ・カツワを中心に感染が再拡大し、致死率61%、医療資源・人道支援の不足が深刻。イツリ州は改善傾向にあるが全体としては制御不能な状態が続いている。

article.articleHeadline: Συναγερμός στα Φίτζι: Εκτοξεύτηκαν οι διαγνώσεις HIV - "Εθνική κρίση υγείας" κήρυξε η κυβέρνηση - ink
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Alarm in Fiji: HIV diagnoses surged - the government declared a 'national health crisis' - ink.
article.articleSummary: Fiji declared HIV a national health crisis as infections surged, linked to injection drug use and Pacific drug routes. In 2025, 2,016 new HIV diagnoses were recorded—about 16 times the figure, and twelvefold since 2010—showing the epidemic spreading beyond high-risk groups to the population of 900,000. Adult prevalence nearly tripled over five years; about 1 in 60 adults live with HIV, and among pregnant women the rate is 2 in 100. In 2025, 59 babies were born with HIV, 18 died before age one. The government, led by Health Minister Ratu Antonio Lalabalavu, expanded free testing, prevention, and treatment, including rapid tests, PrEP, harm-reduction, and free ART. UNAIDS welcomed the declaration, noting most transmissions are sexual and 42% relate to injection drug use; testing nationwide, with Moonlight free testing in Suva. Australia, New Zealand, India, the Global Fund, and the UN back the effort.

triage.headline_ja: フィジーで警戒:HIV診断が急増 - 政府が「国家保健危機」を宣言
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準のうち深刻な公衆衛生影響と異常性の2基準に該当し、政府が国家保健危機を宣言するなど社会的・政治的関心も高いためフルリスク評価への移行が妥当。ただし発生国フィジーは対象国リストに含まれない。
triage.notes: 本イベントの発生国はフィジーであり、対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsは空とした。インドは支援国として言及されているのみで、発生国ではない。

article.articleHeadline: More beds for lepto cases in Metro - DOH
article.articleSummary: Leptospirosis in Metro Manila: the Department of Health allocated 48 beds in private hospitals, including 11 surge beds; current admissions are two, leaving 46 beds vacant. The Medical Center of Muntinlupa has the most available beds (10), followed by Olivarez General Hospital (8). F.Y. Manalo Medical Foundation Inc. has seven, while Fatima University Medical Center and Marikina St. Vincent General Hospital each have five. Nationwide, the DOH has recorded 8,317 leptospirosis cases, up 14% from 7,280 last year. As of 2026-09-21, the public is advised to visit the nearest health center for proper diagnosis and treatment if they experience fever, vomiting, nausea, muscle pain, headache, or reddish eyes.

triage.headline_ja: 首都圏でレプトスピラ症患者向け病床を増床-保健省
triage.triage_reason: フィリピンでレプトスピラ症の症例が前年比14%増加しているが、現状は病床に余裕があり管理下にあるため、継続的な経過観察が適切と判断される。
triage.notes: レプトスピラ症はフィリピンで毎年（特に雨季・台風後）発生する風土病的疾患であり、今回の記事は保健省の病床確保状況を報告する定例的な内容。現時点で病床には十分な余裕があり、重症例の急増や医療逼迫の兆候は見られない。

article.articleHeadline: Minister leads dengue awareness drive at Paikpara hotspot
article.articleSummary: Dengue hotspot in Paikpara’s Lockgate footbridge area, Ward 6 of Kolkata Municipal Corporation, records 54 dengue cases this year—the most in the KMC area. State urban development and municipal affairs minister Agnimitra Paul led a dengue awareness drive there, urging cleanliness to curb mosquito breeding. Citywide totals show 585 dengue cases last year vs 539 so far in 2026, about 8% fewer overall, but officials warn against complacency given the Paikpara spike. Paul warned that discarded construction materials and debris can collect rainwater and breed mosquitoes; authorities will seize such materials and impose hefty fines. Residents were urged to routinely check flower pots, rooftops, and balconies for stagnant water and seek immediate testing if fever develops. The government reaffirmed plans to keep footpaths free from encroachment and unauthorized parking, with railings to prevent parking on pavements.

triage.headline_ja: 大臣がパイクパラのデング熱ホットスポットで啓発活動を主導
triage.triage_reason: 地域的なデング熱発生であり、前年比で症例数は減少傾向。通常の季節性公衆衛生対応の一環で、国際的懸念や異常性は認められない。
triage.notes: コルカタ市の特定地区（パイクパラ）でのデング熱ホットスポットに関する地方自治体の啓発活動報告。市全体では前年比約8%減少しており、通年の媒介蚊対策の一環。

article.articleHeadline: लखनऊ : केजीएमयू में नर्सिंग छात्रा की डेंगू से मौत, देर शाम प्रिंसिपल ने दिया इस्तीफा
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Lucknow: Nursing student at KGMU dies of dengue; principal resigns late in the evening.
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever death at King George's Medical University in Lucknow: BS Nursing second-year student Divyanshi died after dengue infection. Fever began September 11; dengue was confirmed on September 16 after testing for dengue, malaria, and typhoid. Despite illness, she reportedly was not granted leave and was assigned OPD duties. On September 17 her parents took her to Banaras (Varanasi); she died at a private hospital on September 19, 5:00 am. In the hostel, seven other students are also ill with typhoid or dengue, and the cook is sick as well. Residents alleged the hostel water tank is fouled with algae and not cleaned, with residents forced to drink dirty water; vaccination is not being provided. The college principal resigned amid protests; investigations are ongoing, with the vice chancellor guiding discussions and potential further actions based on findings.

triage.headline_ja: ラクナウ：KGMUの看護学生がデング熱で死亡、深夜に学長が辞任
triage.triage_reason: 単一の学生寮内での散発的なデング熱・チフス関連の死亡・集団発症事例であり、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低いが、衛生管理不備（水タンク汚染）による集団感染の可能性があり経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 学長辞任や住民の抗議など地域的な社会的関心は高いが、感染症としての国際的懸念は限定的。寮内の衛生環境（水タンク汚染）が集団感染の一因とされており、今後の感染拡大や当局の対応を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Médicos Sem Fronteiras lança importante estudo de vacinação contra a doença do Ebola entre trabalhadores da linha de frente - Maranhão Hoje
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Doctors Without Borders launches an important vaccination study against Ebola virus disease among frontline workers - Maranhão Hoje.
article.articleSummary: MSF (Doctors Without Borders) and Epicentre launched Bravo, a pivotal study to evaluate ERVEBO vaccination among frontline workers in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) amid the Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreak. The trial, integrated with the MOH response in Ituri and North Kivu, began September 19, 2026 in a WHO training center in Bunia and aims to enroll about 20,000 health workers over 9–12 months. The protocol includes three months of vaccination and at least six months of follow-up. ERVEBO, the only Ebola vaccine deployed at scale, has a safety profile and regulatory approvals (FDA, EMA, WHO) but was developed for the Zaire ebolavirus, not Bundibugyo. Early data suggest potential partial protection against Bundibugyo. The study will generate real-world evidence on efficacy in this outbreak context. Other Bundibugyo-specific vaccines are under development; vaccination is voluntary and does not replace infection prevention measures.

triage.headline_ja: 国境なき医師団、コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクで最前線医療従事者を対象とした重要なワクチン接種研究を開始
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国（イトゥリ州・北キブ州）でブンディブギョ・エボラウイルスによるアウトブレイクが継続しており、国際機関（MSF、WHO、FDA、EMA）が関与する大規模なワクチン試験が開始されたことから、公衆衛生上重大かつ国際的関心の高い事象と判断される。
triage.notes: 本記事はワクチン試験の開始に関する内容だが、その背景にあるブンディブギョ・エボラウイルスのアウトブレイク自体が既に進行中の重大イベントであり、フルRRAでの継続評価が必要。承認済みERVEBOワクチンがザイール株用に開発されたものであり、ブンディブギョ株への効果は部分的とされる点も注視すべき。

article.articleHeadline: Вирус Западног Нила потврђен у Војводини! ЗАБРИЊАВАЈУЋИ ПОДАЦИ "БАТУТА"! Јужнобачки округ међу најпогођенијима, ово је просечна старост оболелих
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: West Nile virus confirmed in Vojvodina! Disturbing data from 'Batuta'! South Bačka District among the most affected; this is the average age of the infected.
article.articleSummary: West Nile fever, transmitted by Culex pipiens mosquitoes, is now confirmed in Serbia with 46 total cases, 43 of which are severe, per Batut Institute. Belgrade reports the highest number (16), followed by Southern Bačka (9), Šumadija (6), Central Banat (5), Southern Banat (4), North Banat (2), and single cases in West Bačka, Rasina, Braničevo, and Pomoravlje districts. Among the infected, 28 are male and 18 female; average age 66.6 years. Transmission is seasonal from June to November; there is no human vaccine, so prevention centers on reducing bites and mosquito populations: repellents, long clothing, avoiding peak outdoors times (dawn/dusk), protective housing, screens, and air conditioning. Remove standing water weekly and dispose of tires or other containers that collect water. Symptoms appear 3–14 days after the bite; ~80% are asymptomatic, 20% have fever, headache, nausea, vomiting, with rarer lymphadenopathy or rash. Neuroinvasive disease occurs in about 1 in 150 infections, causing meningitis/encephalitis signs and potentially lasting neurological damage.

triage.headline_ja: ヴォイヴォディナで西ナイルウイルス確認！『バトゥタ』研究所の憂慮すべきデータ！南バーチカ郡が最も被害を受けた地域の一つ、感染者の平均年齢はこちら
triage.triage_reason: セルビアにおける西ナイル熱の季節性発生報告であり、モニタリング対象国（Zambia, Philippines, Thailand, Ghana, DRC, Brazil, Indonesia, China, Myanmar, Vietnam, India）に該当しないため対象外と判断。
triage.notes: 記事はセルビア（ヴォイヴォディナ地方など）における西ナイル熱の季節性流行を報じたもの。発生地域リストにインド（Uttar Pradesh等）が含まれるが、記事本文はセルビアの状況のみを扱っており、インドでの発生は確認されない。対象国リストにセルビアが含まれないため、verified_locationsは空配列とした。

article.articleHeadline: लखनऊ : केजीएमयू में नर्सिंग छात्रा की डेंगू से मौत, देर शाम प्रिंसिपल ने दिया इस्तीफा
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Lucknow: A nursing student at KGMU dies of dengue fever; the principal resigns late in the evening.
article.articleSummary: In Lucknow, at King George’s Medical University (KGMU), a BSc Nursing second-year student, Divyanshi from Banaras (Varanasi), died of dengue fever. She developed fever on Sept 11; on Sept 16 dengue, malaria, and typhoid tests were conducted with dengue positive. Her family alleges she was not granted leave despite illness and was assigned OPD duties; she was moved to Banaras and died Sept 19 at a private hospital. In the hostel, seven other students and the mess cook fell ill; some have typhoid or dengue. Allegations include unsanitary conditions, dirty water in the hostel tank, lack of preventive measures, and no vaccination. The principal resigned late, with students demanding the dean’s resignation; investigations are ongoing, and actions will follow based on the report, though most tests reportedly showed normal platelet counts.

triage.headline_ja: ラクナウ:KGMUの看護学生がデング熱で死亡、夜遅くに学長が辞任
triage.triage_reason: 単一施設内での学生死亡例と複数の体調不良者が報告されているが、地域的な流行拡大や公衆衛生上の深刻な影響を示す情報は不足している。

article.articleHeadline: Nord-Kivu : à Beni, des agents de la riposte contre Ebola en grève pour réclamer plusieurs mois d'arriérés de salaires - LePotentiel
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: North Kivu: In Beni, Ebola response workers on strike to demand several months' back pay.
article.articleSummary: Contracted Ebola response workers in Beni, North Kivu, Democratic Republic of Congo, began a strike on 2026-09-21 over months of back pay. The walkout covers communications and community engagement teams, psychosocial staff, and community relays, who report three to four months of unpaid primes. Demonstrators gathered in front of the Beni Health Zone office, posted signs, lit tires at the entrance, and a fire was set outside the coordination office before police intervened to extinguish it. Despite prior appeals to the coordination team, no concrete resolution on salaries has been announced. The strikers have halted work and await a response from Ebola response leadership. At the time of reporting, the Health Zone coordination had not issued an official statement regarding the situation.

triage.headline_ja: 北キブ州ベニ:エボラ対応従事者が数か月分の未払い賃金を求めてストライキ
triage.triage_reason: エボラ症例そのものの情報ではなく、対応要員の賃金未払いによるストライキであるが、対応体制の中断リスクがあるため経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はエボラ対応従事者の労働争議に関するもので、疾患の疫学的状況（症例数・死亡者数等）についての情報は含まれていない。対応活動の中断がエボラ対応能力に影響を与える可能性があるため、続報を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Prefeitura de Sonora inicia Mutirão de Limpeza para combater o Aedes aegypti - O melhor da informação!
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Sonora City Hall launches Cleanup Drive to combat Aedes aegypti - The best in information!
article.articleSummary: Sonora City Hall launches a multi-sector Cleanup Drive against Aedes aegypti, the vector for dengue, Zika, and chikungunya. The program, led by the Municipal Departments of Public Works and Urban Services, Health, and Economic Development and Environment, aims to remove water-holding containers from residences to reduce breeding sites. The operation unfolds in three sectors: East, Central, and West. East Sector discard is scheduled 14-20 September with collection 21-25 September; Central Sector discard 21-27 September and collection 28 September-2 October; West Sector discard 28 September-4 October with collection 5-9 October. Residents must place materials on the sidewalk in front of their homes on the specified dates. Items like tires, bottles, cans, pots, and other containers that can hold water are eligible; construction debris and pruning remnants are excluded. Late submissions may not be collected and could incur notices or fines. Community participation is essential to prevent dengue, Zika, and chikungunya in Sonora.

triage.headline_ja: ソノラ市役所、ネッタイシマカ対策のための清掃活動を開始
triage.triage_reason: デング熱等の予防的な清掃キャンペーンに関する行政広報であり、実際の症例発生や異常な流行を示す情報が含まれていないため。
triage.notes: 記事は自治体による蚊媒介性疾患予防のための清掃活動の告知であり、実際の症例数や流行状況についての言及はない。ブラジル・ソノラ市が主題だが、対象国リストにブラジルは含まれるものの、本記事は予防啓発活動が中心で疫学的シグナルとしての重要性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: El PNUD y MinSalud evalúan avances del Programa de Malaria en el estado Amazonas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: UNDP and the Ministry of Health evaluate progress of the Malaria Program in Amazonas State
article.articleSummary: On 2026-09-21, Venezuela's Ministry of Health and the United Nations Development Programme (UNDP) evaluated progress of the Malaria Program in Amazonas state, targeting prevention, treatment, and control in endemic communities. The session at the Dirección Estadal de Salud (DES) reviewed training and supervision activities in tropical zones and showcased field-support outcomes and epidemiological response. Janeida García, Director of Environmental Health, said the meeting optimized regional human-resource operations and strengthened technical and logistical capacity for malaria control across Amazonas. The program aims to curb resurgence, reduce incidence, and ensure timely, efficient care. UNDP recently started a malaria diagnostic and certification workshop for 15 municipal spokespeople in Amazonas, covering thick-blood-smear preparation with Giemsa, quality control, Plasmodium species identification, and parasitemia calculation. The initiative seeks to fortify state laboratory networks and enhance surveillance in indigenous communities.

triage.headline_ja: UNDPと保健省、アマゾナス州のマラリアプログラムの進捗を評価
triage.triage_reason: ベネズエラ・アマゾナス州における通常のマラリア対策プログラムの進捗評価に関する記事であり、異常な流行や公衆衛生上の緊急事態を示す内容ではない。
triage.notes: 発生地域にBrazilが含まれているが、記事はベネズエラのアマゾナス州における保健省とUNDPのマラリアプログラム進捗評価であり、Bluedotの地名（Amazonas）誤認識と思われる。ベネズエラは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations は空。

article.articleHeadline: Belum Ada Kasus Influenza Tipe A di Jogja, Puskesmas Diminta Tetap Waspada
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: There are no Influenza A cases yet in Yogyakarta; Public Health Centers urged to remain vigilant.
article.articleSummary: As of 21 September 2026, there have been no reported Influenza A cases in Yogyakarta City (Kota Jogja). Mayor Hasto Wardoyo urged public health centers (puskesmas) to bolster screening and referral systems for patients with prolonged respiratory symptoms. He highlighted that a persistent cough and runny nose lasting more than two weeks, or a fever that stays high, should trigger closer evaluation beyond initial assessment. Extended symptoms should prompt additional testing, including swabs or laboratory analyses, to identify the cause and enable early detection of potential new influenza strains entering the city. Puskesmas should refer qualifying patients to higher-level facilities for further care. Regarding testing capacity, samples can be sent for PCR testing at large hospitals with PCR facilities, and transport logistics are reportedly manageable. The measures aim for early detection despite the absence of current Influenza A cases.

triage.headline_ja: ジョグジャカルタでインフルエンザA型の症例なし、保健所は引き続き警戒するよう要請
triage.triage_reason: 記事はジョグジャカルタでインフルエンザA型の症例が確認されていないことを報告しており、予防的な警戒喚起に過ぎず、実際の感染事例や公衆衛生上の影響は確認されていない。
triage.notes: 記事は実際の症例発生ではなく、当局による予防的な監視強化の呼びかけに関するもの。インドネシアでの実際のインフルエンザA発生は確認されていないため、対象国としての該当なしと判断。

article.articleHeadline: Record-Breaking Bundibugyo Ebola Outbreak "Still Serious" And Not Fully Controlled, Despite Officials Claiming It's Past Its Peak
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo remains serious and not fully controlled. WHO reports 7,258 confirmed cases and 3,510 deaths, with the outbreak expanding to Sud-Ubangi province, bordering the Central African Republic and the Republic of the Congo. The national transmission rate stays high; 1,674 new confirmed cases in the past 21 days, a 6.1% decline from the prior period. Ituri province remains epicenter, while Nord-Kivu experiences a sharp, sustained rise, now accounting for about one-third of new cases and deaths. National deaths are down 14.7% over the latest period, but Nord-Kivu deaths increase to 299, a 40.4% rise. A revised government plan to fund surveillance and contact tracing costs US$1.3 billion. On Aug 17, 70,000 Ervebo doses arrived (50,000 for health workers; 20,000 for a Bundibugyo-focused phase 3 trial); effectiveness against Bundibugyo is unknown. Results from a Bundibugyo-specific vaccine via Oxford’s ChAdOx1 platform are expected by month’s end.

triage.headline_ja: 記録的規模のブンディブギョ型エボラ流行、ピークを越えたとの当局発表にもかかわらず「依然深刻」で完全制圧に至らず
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で7,258例・死亡3,510例に及ぶ大規模エボラ流行が継続し、新州(南ウバンギ)への拡大や中央アフリカ共和国との国境近接など国際拡大リスクが高く、IHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 中央アフリカ共和国(CAR)は国境接壌国として言及されているが、感染発生地としては明記されていないため対象国リストにも含まれず除外。南ウバンギ州は既存流行地域の拡大先としてDRC国内に含まれる。

article.articleHeadline: 刚果（金）启动埃博拉疫苗试验
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DR Congo launches Ebola vaccine trial.
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has launched an Ebola vaccine trial in Ituri Province, enrolling frontline health workers and outbreak responders. The World Health Organization allocated 20,000 Ervebo doses to the Ituri study to assess Ervebo’s efficacy against Bundibugyo ebolavirus and protect high‑risk groups. Since May, the outbreak has spread to seven provinces, but the epicenter remains Ituri; confirmed cases exceed 7,600 and deaths exceed 3,670, with nearly 80% of infections in Ituri. WHO is boosting surveillance, contact tracing, clinical readiness, and supply, while emphasizing community engagement and cross‑border coordination. In total, 70,000 vaccine doses have been provided to support response and research. Ervebo is the only vaccine approved for Ebola outbreaks, but its effectiveness against Bundibugyo remains unclear, though limited data suggest possible protection. Ebola virus disease transmits via contact with infected body fluids and has a high fatality rate.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、エボラワクチン治験を開始
triage.triage_reason: DRCで進行中のエボラ流行（症例7,600超、死亡3,670超、7州に拡大）に関する重大情報であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 既存の大規模エボラ流行（Bundibugyoウイルス）に対するワクチン治験開始の続報。流行自体は継続中で死亡者数が非常に多く、国際的懸念が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Congo faces unprecedented Ebola outbreak without approved vaccine protection
article.articleSummary: DRC faces an unprecedented Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak, with no approved vaccine. As of 7 September, WHO reports 6,757 confirmed cases and 3,267 deaths (case fatality rate 48.3%), across six provinces; Ituri is the epicenter, with ongoing transmission in North Kivu, Haut-Uélé, and cases in South Kivu, Tshopo and Bas-Uélé. UNICEF notes children account for about a quarter of cases and nearly a third of deaths; 155 health workers have been infected, 45 of whom died. The outbreak began mid-January, before its mid-May declaration. No Bundibugyo-specific vaccine exists; Zaire vaccines like Ervebo have limited evidence of cross-protection. Thousands of Ervebo doses are being sent to the DRC. CEPI is funding up to $8.5 million to Hilleman Laboratories to develop a Bundibugyo vaccine using the rVSV platform, aiming for first trial doses by year-end and scale-up if successful. Other Bundibugyo candidates in early human trials include Moderna mRNA-1469 (Canada) and Oxford ChAdOx1 BDBV (India/Africa).

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ、承認済みワクチンなしで前例のないエボラ出血熱の大流行に直面
triage.triage_reason: DRCでBundibugyo型エボラの前例のない大規模流行（6,757例、致死率48.3%）が複数州に拡大し、承認ワクチンが存在しないため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当し国際的関心・支援ニーズも高い。
triage.notes: IndiaとCanadaはワクチン候補（Oxford ChAdOx1 BDBV、Moderna mRNA-1469）の開発拠点として言及されているのみで、発生国ではないため verified_locations から除外した。

article.articleHeadline: У Србији забележено 46 случајева грознице Западног Нила
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In Serbia, 46 cases of West Nile fever have been recorded.
article.articleSummary: West Nile fever in Serbia reaches 46 cases (June 1–Sept 20 surveillance), with 43 neuroinvasive forms. Cases span 10 districts: Belgrade 16; Southern Bačka 9; Šumadija 6; Central Banat 5; Southern Banat 4; North Banat 2; West Bačka 1; Rasina 1; Braničevski 1; Pomoravski 1. Among patients, 28 men and 18 women; mean age 66.6 years. In the EU/EEA region by Sept 17, 2026, 14 countries report locally acquired West Nile fever: Italy (652), Greece (355), Spain (114), Romania (91), France (81), North Macedonia (66), Netherlands (29), Croatia (13), Cyprus (11), Belgium (9), Austria (6), Hungary (4), Germany (4), Albania (2); total 1,437 cases. North Macedonia and Albania also affected regionally. Transmission is mosquito-borne; main vector is Culex pipiens; Serbia’s transmission season typically June–November. Preventive measures emphasized: repellents, long sleeves/pants, light-colored clothing, avoid peak mosquito activity at dusk/dawn, bed nets, air-conditioned spaces, and avoiding high-insect areas like forests and marshy regions.

triage.triage_reason: セルビアにおける季節性の西ナイル熱発生であり、対象国（Zambia, Philippines, Thailand, Ghana, DRC, Brazil, Indonesia, China, Myanmar, Vietnam, India）に該当する国での発生が確認できないため見送り。

article.articleHeadline: Ações contra o Aedes aegypti serão realizadas em 17 bairros de Juiz de Fora | Rádio Itatiaia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Actions against Aedes aegypti will be carried out in 17 neighborhoods in Juiz de Fora | Rádio Itatiaia
article.articleSummary: From 2026-09-21 to 2026-09-25, actions against Aedes aegypti will be conducted in 17 neighborhoods across Juiz de Fora, Brazil, by Endemics Control Agents. The program combines territorial investigation with door-to-door visits to identify and eliminate breeding sites, employing focal larvicide treatment in standing water (e.g., water tanks, drains, containers). Access to interiors is essential; when entry is denied, control is compromised and dengue, Zika, and chikungunya risks rise. Agents, in green uniforms with ID badges, will perform home visits across regions: Northeast — Grama, Parque Independência; West — Jardim Casablanca, Jardim Universitário, Martelos, Santana; North — Esplanada, Francisco Bernardino, Nova Era, Vila Esperança; Central — Dom Bosco; South — Cruzeiro do Sul, Ipiranga, Jardim América, Santa Luzia; East — Progresso; Southeast — Alto Santo Antônio. Reports of suspected Aedes habitats can be made via WhatsApp (32) 98432-4608, email dengue@pjf.mg.gov.br, the JF Contra o Aedes platform, or at DIGA units.

article.articleHeadline: DOH raises 'code blue' over Bicol as dengue cases continue to rise
article.articleSummary: Dengue in the Bicol region of the Philippines triggers a DOH-CHD Bicol “code blue” alert as dengue cases rise to 2,167 from January 1 to September 5, 2026—up 19% from the same period last year. Bed utilization reached 107% as of September 17, signaling hospital strain. Regional Memorandum 2026-0165 directs DOH hospitals, provincial DOH offices, Health Emergency Management Services Point Persons, and Disaster Risk Reduction and Management health coordinators to maintain heightened vigilance, submit flash reports on dengue incidents, and coordinate with LGUs and partner agencies for a unified response. Public Health Preparedness and Response Units should actively monitor dengue events and coordinate with LGUs and facilities. Communities are urged to implement the 4S strategy: search and destroy mosquito breeding sites, seek early consultation for symptoms, self-protect against bites, and support fogging in hotspots with clustering cases. Published September 21, 2026.

article.articleHeadline: Dharwad dist sees spike in flucases, H1N1 count touches 53
article.articleSummary: Hubballi, Dharwad district, Karnataka, reports a spike in H1N1 infections in September 2026: 35 H1N1-positive cases from 80 throat swabs, with 53 positives from 119 samples tested Jan–Sept. Seasonal weather changes are linked to a surge in viral fever, affecting all ages and spreading within households; patients report high fever, vomiting, severe cough, cold, and extreme fatigue, with some experiencing loss of taste and weakness due to poor intake. Most cases are managed via OPD; July had 5 positives and August 9, including five children. District health officials urge calm, noting typical viral infections improve in 2–3 days and recommending vulnerable groups exercise extra caution. Testing should occur at government facilities, and antivirals should be used only under a doctor’s advice to avoid masking complications. Public health advice includes drinking boiled water and consuming leafy greens, vegetables, and seasonal fruits to strengthen immunity.

article.articleHeadline: Επικίνδυνη επιδημία Εβόλας στη Δημοκρατία του Κονγκό χωρίς εμβόλιο " OnCamera.gr
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dangerous Ebola epidemic in the Democratic Republic of the Congo without a vaccine
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of Congo faces the largest Ebola outbreak in its history, with 6,757 confirmed cases and 3,267 deaths (case fatality 48.3%) as of 7 September. The Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain is involved; no licensed vaccine targets Bundibugyo. WHO warns the epidemic is spreading at unprecedented speed. CEPI announced on 30 July a funding of up to $8.5 million to Hilleman Laboratories to advance a vaccine based on the rVSV platform, aiming to produce doses for human trials; IAVI had identified favorable candidates as of May. Children make up about 25% of cases, and roughly one-third of deaths occur in this group. Healthcare workers are heavily affected: 155 infections and 45 deaths. The outbreak likely started in January, with early cases misdiagnosed as malaria or typhoid. A new vaccine effort offers hope, with first doses expected before year-end.

article.articleHeadline: Upaya kolektif atasi endemis schistosomiasis (bagian 2)
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Collective Efforts to Tackle Endemic Schistosomiasis (Part 2)
article.articleSummary: Endemic schistosomiasis (demam keong) remains a public health concern in Poso Regency, Indonesia, prompting intensified government action. The program combines ecological and clinical surveillance: regular stool surveys and examinations of locally collected snail samples to map transmission. Residents in the snail-focus area are required to submit stool samples every six months, with testing conducted at two laboratories in the region. Authorities emphasize that infection can recur in people who continue activities within the snail-infested zone, making periodic re-testing essential. The measures reflect a coordinated, ongoing effort to monitor transmission dynamics, confirm cases through laboratory testing, and guide targeted interventions to reduce schistosomiasis burden in Poso.

article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Collective effort to tackle endemic schistosomiasis (Part 1)
article.articleSummary: Schistosomiasis, a parasitic disease caused by Schistosoma blood flukes with freshwater snails as intermediate hosts, remains endemic in parts of Indonesia. In Central Sulawesi, the Napu and Bada highlands of Poso Regency and the Lindu highlands of Sigi Regency harbor transmission foci. In Poso, the snail Oncomelania hupensis lindoensis focal distribution reached 269 locations across 23 villages and five districts. In Lindu, there are 14 snail-focus areas across five villages. The report frames this as part of a collective effort to tackle endemic schistosomiasis, highlighting geographical mapping of snail hosts and transmission sites. article.articleHeadline: World Cup travel and low vaccination fuel Latin American measles outbreaks
article.articleSummary: Measles outbreaks in the Americas surged in 2026, driven by low vaccination coverage and World Cup travel. From January–August, over 51,000 confirmed measles cases were reported across the Americas, the highest in 22 years, with 2025 recording 15,152. PAHO warns risk is very high, urges strengthened vaccination and surveillance. Guatemala, Mexico, the United States, and Peru account for about 95% of year-to-date cases; the US reports 3,471 confirmed cases and 39 outbreaks by mid-September. Only about 85% of the region has two MMR doses, and 73% of cases were unvaccinated; herd immunity (95%) remains unmet in most countries. Brazil reports 15 imported cases in the first 28 weeks of 2026, with no sustained transmission. Measles, highly contagious, causes fever, cough, runny nose, conjunctivitis, rash, and can lead to pneumonia or encephalitis; airborne spread. Public health measures focus on rapid case response and closing vaccination gaps.

triage.headline_ja: ワールドカップの渡航と低いワクチン接種率がラテンアメリカの麻疹流行を助長
triage.triage_reason: 米州全体で22年ぶり最多の麻疹流行（51,000例超）が発生し、PAHOがリスク「非常に高い」と警告。ワクチン未接種者が大半でヒト-ヒト感染の拡大リスクがあり、IHR基準複数該当。
triage.notes: 記事の主要流行国（グアテマラ・メキシコ・米国・ペルー）は対象国リストに含まれないため除外。ブラジルは輸入例15件で持続的感染なしと明記されているが、対象国リストに該当し記事内で具体的な感染状況が述べられているため含めた。ワールドカップ関連の国際的な人の移動が流行拡大要因として指摘されており、今後の拡大動向を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Upaya kolektif atasi endemis schistosomiasis (bagian 3)
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Collective efforts to tackle endemic schistosomiasis (Part 3)
article.articleSummary: In Wuasa Village, Lore Utara District, Poso Regency, Central Sulawesi Province, Indonesia, collective efforts are advancing the eradication of endemic schistosomiasis (snail fever). The program emphasizes preventing spread by instilling awareness from an early age. Schools serve as a pivotal platform to educate children about schistosomiasis risks, the local environment, and protective practices. Complementing education, schools also administer preventive medicine to children, ensuring protection while learning. The article highlights strong community involvement as essential to lasting elimination, combining health education, environmental awareness, and preventive treatment. Ongoing collaboration among residents, educators, and health workers aims to sustain gains in transmission interruption and safeguard affected communities through integrated measures.

triage.headline_ja: 住血吸虫症の風土病対策への集団的取り組み（第3部）
triage.triage_reason: インドネシア・ポソ県で以前から知られる風土病対策(教育・予防投薬)に関する継続的な報道であり、新規性・異常性・国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 住血吸虫症はポソ県ローレリンドゥ地域で長年風土病として知られており、本記事は既存の対策啓発活動を伝えるもの。新規アウトブレイクの兆候はない。

article.articleHeadline: More than 17,000 dengue cases reported across the state: Minister Arunraj
article.articleSummary: Dengue remains a public health concern in Tamil Nadu, with more than 17,000 dengue cases reported across the state in 2026 as of 21 September. In Erode district, 329 dengue cases have been recorded this year, down from 462 last year, as authorities urge vigilance before the northeast monsoon. Health and Family Welfare Minister KG Arunraj called for continued preventive measures, emphasizing removal of stagnant rainwater around homes to curb transmission. The data were shared during a video-conference with Chief Minister C. Joseph Vijay to review monsoon preparations. The report centers on state- and district-level counts and does not detail laboratory confirmation or infection sources, nor mention imported/exported cases. The situation underscores the need for household vector-control and ongoing public health measures during the upcoming monsoon season.

triage.headline_ja: 州全体で17,000件以上のデング熱症例が報告される：アルンラージ大臣
triage.triage_reason: インドのタミル・ナードゥ州で例年発生するデング熱の季節的報告であり、異常性や国際的拡大の兆候はないが、症例数が多く経過観察の対象とする。
triage.notes: デング熱はタミル・ナードゥ州で毎年季節的に発生している疾患であり、記事も予防的対策の呼びかけが主眼。重症度や死亡者数についての言及はなし。

article.articleHeadline: Santo André, no ABC Paulista, começa a vacinar bebês contra o sarampo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Santo André, in the ABC Paulista region, begins vaccinating babies against measles.
article.articleSummary: Santo André in the ABC Paulista region began vaccinating babies aged 6 to 11 months and 29 days with a zero-dose of the measles-mumps-rubella (MMR) vaccine, aimed at expanding protection amid ongoing measles risk. The measure, implemented after a measles case was recorded in the city, targets a highly susceptible age group and helps prevent further transmission. The vaccine is not a substitute for vaccines in the National Vaccination Calendar, publicly offered by the Unified Health System (SUS) for individuals aged 12 months to 59 years. In São Paulo state this year, 36 measles cases have been confirmed, with most in the city of São Paulo (32); Santo André has one; São Bernardo do Campo two; Guarulhos one. The information underscores a localized outbreak risk and public-health response.

triage.headline_ja: サンパウロ州サントアンドレ（ABCパウリスタ地域）で麻疹予防のため乳児へのワクチン接種開始
triage.triage_reason: サンパウロ州で麻疹36例が確認され、感受性の高い乳児への追加ワクチン接種が開始されたが、重症例や国際的拡大の情報はなく、局地的な公衆衛生対応にとどまるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 地方自治体レベルでの予防接種強化措置であり、重症例・死亡例の報告はない。今後の症例増加や地域拡大があれば再評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Gesundheitskrise in Uganda: Ugandas Kampf gegen Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Health crisis in Uganda: Uganda's fight against Ebola.
article.articleSummary: At Mulago National Referral Hospital's Ebola isolation ward in Kampala, Uganda battles the Ebola Bundibugyo virus amid severe PPE shortages. Of Uganda's 20 registered cases by July 4, 2026, 18 were treated at the isolation unit; 16 have been discharged or recovered, with 2 deaths and 2 still under care. Four Ugandan infections occurred among health workers in private facilities; the fifth was a driver who transported a patient from the Democratic Republic of Congo (DR Congo). Healthcare workers face protective equipment deficits, though staff adhere to strict infection-control measures. Financing gaps persist: donors pledged over $100 million by end-May 2026, but disbursement remains uncertain; Uganda intends to self-fund shortfalls and establish cross-border testing/treatment centers in DR Congo to curb spread. The US added about $160 million in May, with a further $300 million pledged for broader humanitarian measures. The government emphasizes self-reliance while contending with international aid discussions.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダの健康危機：エボラ出血熱との戦い
triage.triage_reason: エボラ（ブンディブギョ株）のヒト-ヒト感染・医療従事者感染・死亡例が確認され、DRCとの国境を越えた感染連鎖も示唆されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAに進むべき。
triage.notes: 主な発生地はウガンダ（対象国リスト外）だが、DRCからの搬送患者による感染例やDRC国境地域での検査・治療センター設置計画が言及されており、DRCも感染拡大に関連する地域として含めた。ウガンダ自体は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には計上していない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola Vaccine Trial Begins In DR Congo: WHO
article.articleSummary: Ebola vaccine trial underway in DR Congo's Ituri province, enrolling frontline health workers and response staff. The World Health Organization allocated 20,000 Ervebo vaccine doses for a research vaccination programme to assess effectiveness against Ebola Bundibugyo virus and to protect individuals most exposed. WHO support includes strengthened surveillance of infection and transmission, contact tracing, clinical preparedness and case management, and delivery of supplies, with emphasis on community engagement and cross-border preparedness. Community engagement is highlighted as critical to bringing outbreaks under control. Current authorities report more than 7,600 confirmed Ebola cases and over 3,670 deaths, with nearly 80% of infections in Ituri. Ervebo is the only vaccine licensed for Bundibugyo virus outbreaks.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラワクチン治験開始:WHO
triage.triage_reason: エボラ（ブンディブギョ株）による大規模流行が継続中で、7,600例超の確定例・3,670例超の死亡が報告されており、国際的なワクチン支援・越境対策の必要性が高いため。
triage.notes: エボラ・ブンディブギョウイルス株による流行で、Erveboワクチンは本株には未承認だが研究的接種プログラムとして実施。感染者の約80%がイトゥリ州に集中。

article.articleHeadline: Братскую могилу с телами умерших во время пандемии COVID-19 нашли в Румынии
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A mass grave containing bodies of people who died during the COVID-19 pandemic was found in Romania.
article.articleSummary: Mass grave of COVID-19 victims found in Slatina, Romania, during cemetery renovations. The excavation revealed bones and special bags containing decomposing bodies, with burial dates marked on the bags and described as resembling those used during the pandemic. Mayor Mario De Mezzo said the arrangement violated cemetery rules and that remains were uncovered as the administration redeveloped one of the crypts. The cemetery had been privately managed for 16 years; the municipality is suing to re-register the site as municipal property, per Informat.ro. Separately, Russians cancel trips to Thailand amid a COVID-19 surge there, with some tourists contracting illness during holidays. The White House published data on its website asserting laboratory origin of SARS-CoV-2.

triage.headline_ja: ルーマニアでCOVID-19パンデミック時の死者を埋葬した集団墓地が発見された
triage.triage_reason: 記事の主題はルーマニアでの過去のパンデミック時の集団墓地発見という歴史的・行政的な出来事であり、現在進行中の公衆衛生上の緊急事態ではない。タイのCOVID-19サージへの言及は付随的で詳細情報がなく、対象国での主要な感染症イベントとは言えない。
triage.notes: 記事はルーマニアでの集団墓地発見（過去のパンデミック関連）が主題。タイでのCOVID-19サージへの言及は断片的で、記事の主題ではないため対象国として含めなかった。ルーマニアは対象国リストに含まれない。
