article.articleHeadline: Chennai private hospitals face 12-hour bed waits as flu, dengue surge
article.articleSummary: Chennai private hospitals report 12-hour bed waits amid a surge of respiratory infections and dengue. Hospitals show packed outpatient departments, full wards and long ER-to-bed delays; dengue deaths have occurred, including a 65-year-old patient at Apollo who developed haemorrhagic shock after fever-positive dengue. Respiratory illnesses caused by RSV, adenovirus, rhinovirus and parainfluenza are the most common, followed by influenza (including H1N1) and dengue. Elderly and people with comorbidities such as diabetes, hypertension, heart disease, kidney disease or cancer are most at risk of severe illness. Patients present with high fever, sore throat, cough, body and leg pains, chest discomfort, fatigue, poor appetite; children may have prolonged fever, exhaustion and delirium. The year’s first surge began unusually early in May, with a July–Sept continuation; several clinics note ICU-to-ward transfer delays. Public Health says 2026 cases are not alarming, but clinicians warn of dengue deaths and overwhelmed capacity.

triage.headline_ja: チェンナイの民間病院、インフルエンザとデング熱の急増により12時間のベッド待ちに直面
triage.triage_reason: デング熱による死亡例や呼吸器感染症（RSV、インフルエンザ含む）の季節外れの早期急増により民間病院の医療キャパシティが逼迫しており、IHR基準（深刻な影響・異常性）を2つ満たすためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はチェンナイ（タミル・ナードゥ州、インド）の民間病院における呼吸器感染症・デング熱の急増を扱っており、他国への言及はない。公衆衛生当局は「憂慮すべき水準ではない」としているが、臨床現場からは死亡例と病床逼迫の懸念が報告されている。

article.articleHeadline: 8 AU students hospitalised with high fever
article.articleSummary: Death from scrub typhus at Anna University campus in Chennai preceded a fever screening by Greater Chennai Corporation that identified eight students with high fever and hospitalised in Madurai and Kallakurichi. While dengue remains unconfirmed among the eight, officials note that a separate postgraduate student admitted to Rajiv Gandhi Government General Hospital tested positive for dengue. The university, with about 12,000 students, reported 222 fever cases on campus through Sept 9, including two dengue cases. The eight hospitalised cases are reported as stable, and no cause for alarm is declared. More than 20 students have returned to their hometowns after developing viral fever. Ongoing screening and hospital admissions reflect cluster-level fever activity in Chennai and related districts as of 21 September 2026.

triage.headline_ja: アンナ大学の学生8人が高熱で入院
triage.triage_reason: スクラブチフスによる死亡例発生後、大学構内で発熱症例のクラスターと確認済みデング熱症例があり、地元当局がスクリーニングを継続実施しているため、社会的関心とWPRO基準の複数該当が認められる。
triage.notes: スクラブチフスとデング熱はインド南部で季節性・地域流行性の疾患であり、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低いが、大学キャンパスでの発熱クラスターおよび死亡例の発生を受け、地元自治体（Greater Chennai Corporation）がスクリーニングを実施中。続報での症例数・重症度の推移を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Leptospirosis infections, death toll in Davao drop
article.articleSummary: Leptospirosis infections in the Davao Region declined in 2026 compared with 2025, with 403 cases from January 4 to September 5 and 30 deaths, down from 430 cases and 68 deaths in the same period last year. However, health officials warn of an unusual mid-year spike, beginning in early July and peaking in late July–early August, diverging from the typical January–February pattern. The infection is caused by Leptospira bacteria transmitted through water or soil contaminated with urine of infected animals, especially rats; common symptoms include fever with chills, headache, calf pain, red eyes, and jaundice. DOH-Davao urges avoiding floodwaters, wearing boots, covering wounds, washing with soap and water, and seeking care if fever lasts more than two days. Davao stockpiles of doxycycline remain sufficient; avoid self-medication. Data updated Sept 9 noted 395 cases and 23 deaths as of Aug 29.

triage.headline_ja: ダバオ地域でレプトスピラ症感染者数・死亡者数が減少
triage.triage_reason: レプトスピラ症は地域の風土病であり全体件数は減少傾向だが、例年と異なる時期（7〜8月）の感染急増が報告されており、今後の推移を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 全体の感染者・死亡者数は前年より減少しているが、例年の1〜2月ピークとは異なる7〜8月の異常な感染急増がDOH-Davaoにより指摘されている。ドキシサイクリンの備蓄は十分であり、現時点で外部支援の必要性は示されていない。

article.articleHeadline: DM directs officials to focus on vector-borne disease hotspots | Kanpur News
article.articleSummary: Kanpur district magistrate Jitendra Pratap Singh directed officials to prioritize vector-borne disease prevention in hotspot areas—Ambedkar Nagar, Kakadeo, Sanigwan, Kalyanpur, Sujanpur, Gujaini Colony, Panki, Barra, Swaroop Nagar, Ratanlal Nagar, Chaman Ganj, Tilak Nagar, Vijay Nagar, Sarvodaya Nagar, and Chunniganj. He mandated inter-departmental coordination among the municipal corporation, panchayati raj, education, and health departments with fever cases reported promptly to trigger preventive actions. The Special Communicable Disease Control Campaign runs Oct 1–31, and the Dastak Campaign Oct 12–31, kicking off at Sanigwan on Oct 1. Fever desks will be set up at district hospital and community health centers; fever patients will be monitored and malaria/dengue testing conducted as required. Dengue rose in Kishunpura; the DM directed seeking clarification from MOIC Chaubepur, and a health department team later arrived to bring the situation under control. Door-to-door screening and awareness are planned during Dastak.

triage.headline_ja: 地区行政官、ベクター媒介感染症のホットスポット対策に注力するよう職員に指示 | カンプールニュース
triage.triage_reason: 地方自治体による通常の季節性ベクター媒介感染症（マラリア・デング熱）予防キャンペーンの実施報告であり、異常な感染拡大や重症化の情報はなく、通常の行政対応の範囲内。
triage.notes: Kishunpuraでのデング熱増加への言及があるが、具体的な症例数や重症度の記載はなく、通常の予防的行政対応（Special Communicable Disease Control Campaign、Dastak Campaign）の一環と判断される。

article.articleHeadline: Santo André inicia vacinação de bebês contra o sarampo após registro de caso
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Santo André begins vaccinating babies against measles after a case is reported.
article.articleSummary: Santo André, in ABC Paulista, began giving a zero-dose of the MMR vaccine (measles, mumps, rubella) to infants aged 6 months through 11 months 29 days after a measles case was confirmed in the city. The preventive measure aims to boost immunity in early infancy and does not replace the routine vaccination schedule provided by Brazil’s Unified Health System (SUS), which remains mandatory for children from 12 months and for residents up to 59 years old. In São Paulo state, 36 measles cases have been confirmed this year, with 32 in the capital (São Paulo city). Additional cases have been reported in São Bernardo do Campo (two cases) and Guarulhos. Vaccination is emphasized as the primary tool to prevent further spread of measles in the region.

triage.headline_ja: サントアンドレ、麻疹症例確認後に乳児への麻疹ワクチン接種を開始
triage.triage_reason: サンパウロ州で麻疹36例（うち32例は州都）が確認され、地域行政がゼロ回接種を開始したが、症例数・重症度・国際的拡大の詳細情報が不足しており、現時点ではルーティンの公衆衛生対応に留まる可能性が高い。
triage.notes: サンパウロ州（サントアンドレ、サンパウロ市、サンベルナルド・ド・カンポ、グアルーリョス）で麻疹症例が報告され、地方自治体が乳児への予防接種を強化。国際的な拡大や渡航制限の情報はなく、地域レベルの通常対応と見られるため続報を注視。

article.articleHeadline: Santo André, no ABC Paulista, começa a vacinar bebês contra o sarampo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Santo André, in the ABC region of São Paulo, begins vaccinating babies against measles.
article.articleSummary: Santo André in the ABC region of São Paulo begins vaccinating babies against measles to expand immunity amid a local outbreak. The move follows the detection of a measles case in the city and aims to protect a highly susceptible age group while limiting further transmission. The vaccination dose does not replace the vaccines listed in Brazil’s National Immunization Calendar and remains available for free through the Unified Health System (SUS) for people aged 12 months to 59 years. In São Paulo state this year, 36 measles cases have been confirmed, with the majority in the capital (32). São Bernardo do Campo has two cases, Guarulhos one, and Santo André one. The region’s public health authorities are monitoring changes in transmission as immunization coverage expands to younger children.

triage.headline_ja: サンパウロ州ABC地域のサントアンドレ、麻疹予防のため乳児へのワクチン接種を開始
triage.triage_reason: サンパウロ州で麻疹36例が確認され乳児への接種拡大が行われているが、重症度や死亡例の報告はなく、国際的な影響も現時点では確認できないため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: サンパウロ州内で36例確認（うち32例は州都）、局地的な麻疹アウトブレイクへの対応として乳児への追加接種を実施。重症度・死亡例の記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: GCC identifies 593 mosquito breeding hotspots in city, intensifies measures for prevention of dengue
article.articleSummary: Chennai’s Greater Chennai Corporation (GCC) intensified dengue control after identifying 593 hotspots as dengue cases rose to 767 in Chennai Corporation zones on Monday (654 Sunday). Fever cases in September total 5,296. GCC deployed 3,697 vector-control workers, each covering 80-100 houses daily, with 11,02,385 houses checked and 4,192 found with larvae. Mass source reduction targeted 1,127 government buildings, 1,020 educational institutions, 383 hospitals, and 8,114 construction/commercial sites. A fine of ₹5.91 lakh was imposed on building owners with breeding on premises. Street-level fogging (outdoor and indoor) is ongoing. Fever surveillance is maintained across hospitals/clinics/labs, with three-day follow-up for discharged fever patients; daily school-absence data support containment. 40 medical camps were held in hotspot areas with nilavembu kudeneer distributed; adult mosquitoes collected and sent to the lab for dengue-virus identification. GCC ensured stock of fever-management drugs in all facilities.

triage.headline_ja: GCC、市内で593カ所の蚊発生源ホットスポットを特定、デング熱予防対策を強化
triage.triage_reason: 季節性デング熱の増加であり行政は既存の対策枠組みで対応中。国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低いが、症例数増加の推移を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: チェンナイ市当局が主体的に対応しており、地元行政の通常業務範囲内の季節性デング熱対策と判断される。重症度や死亡者数についての情報がなく不明。

article.articleHeadline: 'Coughless cold' joins cough and cold in season of viral infections
article.articleSummary: Kolkata reports a ‘coughless cold’ affecting hundreds, with runny or blocked nose and watery eyes but no chest congestion or cough, following a prolonged influenza outbreak that has left thousands with cough and cold over the past three months. Experts say the absence of a cough may reflect infection localized to the nasal passages/upper airways, not reaching the lower respiratory tract. Rhinoviruses and seasonal adenoviruses can cause nasal blockage, sneezing and throat irritation without a prominent cough, while influenza typically causes nasal blockage, headaches and a dry, mild cough; if the infection stays in the upper airways, sputum may be absent. If irritation remains localized, a cough may never develop; mild sinusitis would usually include headache. Persistent symptoms warrant reassessment due to possible secondary bacterial infection. Overall, viral infections, including influenza, account for about 70% of cases. Most improve with symptomatic care, hydration and rest.

triage.headline_ja: 「咳のない風邪」がウイルス感染症の季節に咳と鼻水に加わる
triage.triage_reason: 季節性のウイルス感染症（風邪・インフルエンザ）に関する一般的な健康情報記事であり、重症例や異常な公衆衛生上の脅威は報告されていない。
triage.notes: 記事は季節性の軽症ウイルス感染症（インフルエンザ、ライノウイルス等）による症状の違いについての解説記事であり、重症化・死亡・アウトブレイクの急拡大等の報告はない。対症療法で改善するとされており、公衆衛生上の緊急性は認められない。

article.articleHeadline: Four new H1N1 cases reported in Bhopal; 17 under watch
article.articleSummary: As of 21 September 2026, Bhopal reports four new H1N1 cases, bringing the city's cumulative confirmed H1N1 infections this year to 72. Of these, 46 were recorded in September. The tally rose by four cases between 14 and 20 September. Currently, 17 patients are under active monitoring, including 11 admitted to hospitals and six in home isolation. Health authorities continue surveillance as seasonal changes are linked to more respiratory infections. Residents with flu-like symptoms—fever, cough, sore throat and body aches—are advised to seek medical care, particularly if symptoms persist or worsen. The update indicates ongoing local transmission of H1N1 in Bhopal, with continued monitoring and treatment of affected individuals.

triage.headline_ja: ボーパールでH1N1新規4例確認、17人が経過観察下に
triage.triage_reason: 季節性H1N1の局地的な継続的発生であり、重症度や国際的拡大の情報は乏しいが、監視継続の必要性があるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 季節性インフルエンザ(H1N1)の地域的な症例報告であり、重症度・死亡数等の詳細情報が不足している。

article.articleHeadline: New dengue figures come up in public domain
article.articleSummary: Tamil Nadu's Health department publicized three-year dengue figures: 2023 56,863 cases; 2024 46,971; 2025 25,585. These exceed NCVBDC counts (9,121; 27,378; 23,407 for the same years), though deaths match: 12 in 2023, 13 in 2024, 12 in 2025. Officials say Tamil Nadu's figures include cases diagnosed by NS1/IgM tests plus rapid diagnostic tests, whereas NCVBDC data reflect laboratory-confirmed NS1/IgM only. The department’s higher totals were already in public circulation before the official release, and both datasets align on mortality. Experts note that testing scope and population size affect reported burden; states with broader surveillance report higher counts. Historically, Tamil Nadu saw dengue peaks in 2012 (13,204 cases, 66 deaths) and 2017 (23,294 cases, 65 deaths).

triage.headline_ja: デング熱の新たな数値が公表される
triage.triage_reason: デング熱は同地域で流行が既知の疾患であり、本記事は統計の集計方法の違いに関する行政的な内容で、異常な流行拡大や重症化の急増を示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 記事は過去数年の統計データの集計方法の違い（NS1/IgM検査 vs 迅速診断検査の扱い）についての行政的説明であり、新規の異常な流行を示すものではない。死亡者数は年ごとにほぼ一致しており、突発的な公衆衛生上の懸念は認められない。

article.articleHeadline: Collector inspects dengue prevention measures in Cuddalore
article.articleSummary: On 21 September 2026, Cuddalore Collector Sibi Adhithya Senthil Kumar inspected dengue-prevention measures within Cuddalore Corporation, visiting Sellankuppam and Semmandalam ahead of the Northeast monsoon. Health Department and local bodies are carrying out preventive actions to curb dengue transmission across Cuddalore district. He warned that rainwater stagnation in discarded coconut shells, plastic containers, unused vehicle tyres, and other waste can create Aedes breeding grounds, and urged residents to remove objects that collect rainwater, prevent water stagnation in household articles, and clean overhead water tanks weekly. Special wards have been set up in all government hospitals to treat dengue patients. A total of 116 dengue patients are undergoing treatment, with around 60% being non-local: workers from other districts and college students.

triage.headline_ja: 行政官がクダロールでデング熱予防対策を視察
triage.triage_reason: 行政による通常のデング熱予防・監視活動を報じる内容であり、異常な流行拡大や重症例急増を示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 季節性のデング熱予防対策に関する行政視察の記事。116人の患者が治療中とあるが、地域の通常の流行状況を示す情報であり、深刻な公衆衛生上の異常事態を示すものではない。

article.articleHeadline: У Србији 46 случајева грознице Западног Нила
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In Serbia, 46 cases of West Nile fever.
article.articleSummary: Serbia reports 46 West Nile fever cases across ten districts as of 17 September 2026, with Belgrade City leading (16), followed by South Bačka (9), Šumadija (6), Central Banat (5), South Banat (4), North Banat (2), West Bačka (1), Rasina (1), Braničevo (1) and Pomoravlje (1). The affected cohort includes 28 men and 18 women, with an average age of 66.6 years. West Nile fever is a seasonal, mosquito-borne illness. In the wider region, 14 European Union/European Economic Area countries plus neighboring states have reported 1,437 locally acquired cases in 2026, led by Italy (652), Greece (355), Spain (114), Romania (91), France (81) and North Macedonia (66); other totals include the Netherlands (29), Croatia (13), Cyprus (11), Belgium (9), Austria (6), Hungary (4), Germany (4), and Albania (2).

triage.headline_ja: セルビアで西ナイル熱46例
triage.triage_reason: セルビアおよび周辺欧州諸国での季節性・毎年発生する西ナイル熱の通常の流行報告であり、対象国（GeoNames ID指定国）に該当する発生国が存在しないため見送りとする。
triage.notes: 記事はセルビアおよび欧州域内での季節性西ナイル熱の定例報告。発生地域リストにIndia (Uttar Pradesh) が含まれるが、記事本文はセルビア・欧州のみを扱っており、インドでの発生は言及されていないため除外。対象国（Zambia, Philippines, Thailand, Ghana, DRC, Brazil, Indonesia, China, Myanmar, Vietnam, India）のいずれにも該当する発生事例なし。

article.articleHeadline: Santo André Amplia Vacina Contra Sarampo Para Bebês - ABC Agora
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Santo André Expands Measles Vaccination for Babies - ABC Now
article.articleSummary: Santo André, Brazil, expanded measles vaccination by offering a zero-dose of the measles-mumps-rubella (MMR) vaccine to babies aged 6 months through 11 months and 29 days, after a confirmed measles case in the municipality. The aim is to boost protection for the most vulnerable in the 2026 outbreak across São Paulo state. The zero-dose does not replace the routine schedule; the first MMR dose remains at 12 months and the second at 15 months. The municipality reported a 2026 measles case involving a 36-year-old man with a vaccination record. Statewide, 36 cases have been confirmed in 2026: 32 in São Paulo city, 2 in São Bernardo do Campo, 1 in Guarulhos, and 1 in Santo André. August saw a Day D multivaccination across 33 Basic Health Units. Measles is highly contagious; vaccination reduces transmission. Parents should check vaccination cards and visit health units for guidance.

triage.headline_ja: サントアンドレ、乳児向け麻疹ワクチン接種を拡大 - ABCアゴラ
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・サンパウロ州で麻疹症例が拡大しており（州内36例）、自治体がゼロ用量接種を導入するなど公衆衛生対応が強化されているため、経過を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: サンパウロ州で2026年に36例の麻疹症例が確認されており、サントアンドレ市が生後6か月〜11か月29日の乳児にMMRワクチンのゼロ用量接種を開始。麻疹は感染力が高く、地域内での感染拡大リスクがあるため注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: 中國南方多省爆發非洲豬瘟疫情 | 中國生豬疫情 | 病死豬流入市場 | 豬肉食品安全
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: African swine fever outbreaks across several southern Chinese provinces | China's domestic pig epidemic | Dead pigs entering the market | Pork safety
article.articleSummary: African swine fever (ASF) outbreaks are reported across southern China as Laos, neighboring Yunnan, declares ASF emergency, halting pork slaughter, sales, and consumption. In China, outbreaks span Guangdong, Guangxi, Jiangxi, Yunnan, Guizhou, Hainan, Chongqing, Sichuan, and Fujian, with sporadic northern cases. Large numbers of diseased and dead pigs are entering markets, amid allegations of government concealment. Jiangxi is described as the worst-hit, with tens of thousands of pigs in neighboring towns and among group and outsourcing farms dead; pig sales and disposal often occur at night. PRRS (blue-ear disease) is described as severe this year and is said to worsen ASF outcomes. Large integrated farms (about 70% market share) use closed housing, but market oversupply keeps pork prices below cost. Henan and Shandong also report ASF; Jiangxi pigs are slaughtered at Shandong’s Linyi facility, stored cold, and sold to school cafeterias or markets.

triage.headline_ja: 中国南部の複数省でアフリカ豚熱（ASF）流行、病死豚が市場に流入、豚肉食品安全問題
triage.triage_reason: 中国広域（広東・広西・江西・雲南・貴州等）でASFが同時多発し、隠蔽疑惑や病死豚の市場流入という食品安全問題に発展。隣国ラオスが緊急事態宣言し豚肉取引を停止するなど国際的拡大・貿易制限も発生しているため、IHR基準の複数項目に該当しフルRRAへ進めるべき。
triage.notes: ASFは動物疾病であり人への直接感染はないが、病死豚肉の食品安全問題および隣国ラオスへの拡大・貿易停止という点でIHR基準に該当。ラオスは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。中国国内の食品安全・獣医当局の対応状況の続報を確認する必要あり。

article.articleHeadline: Aan de frontlinie van de ebola-uitbraak: 'Ik ben niet bang om dit werk te doen'
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: On the front line of the Ebola outbreak: "I'm not afraid to do this work."
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo continues to overwhelm the response, with over 3,600 deaths. In Djatsi—a village partly built around a refugee camp—frontline responders led by Claude spray chlorine-based disinfectant on homes and communal toilets to cut transmission, since Ebola spreads by direct contact with infected bodily fluids. An outreach team is tracing contacts of a 39-year-old woman hospitalized after contracting Ebola. Claude, a local pharmacist, says he is not afraid; his aunt died of Ebola, motivating him to stop transmission. The region’s insecurity—armed groups, ethnic violence, and gold-driven poverty—drives the outbreak into new areas with weak facilities. UNICEF official Dr Pomme warns rumours about hospital infections and transport costs keep people from seeking care, hindering control.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱流行の最前線で:「この仕事をするのは怖くない」
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国東部で続くエボラ出血熱の流行は死者3,600人超と深刻で、治安悪化や医療忌避により対応が困難化しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ進めるべき。
triage.notes: 記事はコンゴ民主共和国東部（Djatsi村）における進行中のエボラ流行の現場ルポであり、死者数3,600人超という記述から既に大規模な公衆衛生危機として認識されている可能性が高い。治安悪化、医療忌避、資金・人材不足など管理困難要因が多数指摘されている。

article.articleHeadline: சென்னையில் டெங்கு காய்ச்சல் வேகமாகப் பரவுகிறது: தமிழகத்தில் 2,000 பேருக்கு சிகிச்சை
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue fever spreading rapidly in Chennai: treatment for 2,000 people in Tamil Nadu.
article.articleSummary: As of 21 September 2026, dengue fever is spreading rapidly in Tamil Nadu, with Chennai the epicenter. Daily dengue infections exceed 200, and about 2,000 patients in public and private hospitals are under treatment. statewide, 228 people were affected in the latest period, including 79 in Chennai; Chennai alone has recorded over 900 cases this month. The year’s dengue total in Tamil Nadu is 17,277, linked to a surge in Aedes aegypti mosquitoes. Mild cases are managed at home; health authorities urge prompt medical care for persistent fever. Separately, scrub typhus outbreaks have prompted concern: a death at Anna University was attributed to scrub typhus, not dengue. Across Tamil Nadu, 29 scrub typhus cases were confirmed recently, bringing the year total to about 4,700. Chief Minister Vijay chaired a meeting to intensify pre-monsoon and dengue-control measures; El Niño disaster-management insights were presented by Minister Sengottayan.

triage.headline_ja: チェンナイでデング熱が急速に拡大：タミルナドゥ州で2,000人が治療中
triage.triage_reason: タミルナドゥ州でデング熱（年間17,277件、日次200件超）と発疹チフス（年間約4,700件、死亡例あり）が同時に流行しており、州政府が緊急対策会議を開催するなど社会的・行政的関心が高い。
triage.notes: デング熱は毎年季節性に発生する疾患だが、今回は症例数が非常に多く、加えて発疹チフスの同時流行と死亡例が報告されている。州首相主導の緊急対策会議が開催されており行政的関心が高いためPICKUPと判断したが、国際的拡大リスクは低く、渡航・貿易制限の可能性もない。

article.articleHeadline: Minsalud y el PNUD evalúan avances del Programa de Malaria en el estado Amazonas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ministry of Health and UNDP assess progress of the Malaria Program in the Amazonas State.
article.articleSummary: Minsalud and the United Nations Development Programme (UNDP) evaluated progress of the Malaria Program in Amazonas state, Venezuela, during a working meeting at the Dirección Estadal de Salud to review training and field supervision. The operational balance outlined efforts to strengthen malaria prevention, diagnosis, treatment, and control in tropical zones and vulnerable Amazon communities. Janeida García, Director of Environmental Health, noted improved operational performance and critical logistics for the epidemiological response. Participants included Dr. Edinson Sotto (Ministry), Jorman Blanco (Malaria Program Coordinator), and José Antonio Kelly (UNDP), underscoring an international partnership for health sovereignty and the welfare of Venezuelan families. The meeting emphasized ongoing capacity-building and continued support for malaria control in the Amazonas region.

triage.headline_ja: 保健省とUNDP、アマゾナス州のマラリアプログラムの進捗を評価
triage.triage_reason: ベネズエラのアマゾナス州における既存マラリア対策プログラムの進捗評価・行政会議に関する記事であり、新規発生や異常事態を示す内容ではない。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はベネズエラ・アマゾナス州でのマラリア対策プログラムの定例評価会議であり、対象国リストに該当する国（ブラジル含む）は主題として登場しない。ブラジルは発生地域に含まれるが記事本文には言及がないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: CM reviews preparedness for northeast monsoon and dengue prevention
article.articleSummary: Chennai and across Tamil Nadu, the 21 September 2026 briefing outlines northeast monsoon preparedness and dengue prevention. Chief Minister C. Joseph Vijay directs identification of flood-prone districts and coastal villages vulnerable to sea-water incursion, with timely weather and marine alerts sent to fishermen and residents in low-lying areas. Officials must establish evacuation plans, cyclone shelters, and multi-purpose relief centers, ensuring schools and community halls are equipped with water, food, electricity, sanitation, and medical facilities to serve as camps. District rescue teams should carry boats, lifebuoys, ropes, generators, and dewatering pumps. On dengue, authorities will intensify door-to-door inspections to eliminate Aedes larvae, conduct fogging, and increase vigilance in high-risk areas, complemented by public awareness campaigns and prompt medical consultation. Hospitals and PHCs must stock diagnostic kits and essential staff for critical care and patient monitoring. Inter-departmental coordination is urged; El Niño climate trends discussed. Delta and coastal region collectors attended.

triage.headline_ja: 州首相、北東モンスーンとデング熱予防の準備状況を確認
triage.triage_reason: 季節性のモンスーン対策とデング熱の通常予防措置に関する行政の準備会議であり、異常な感染拡大や重大な公衆衛生上の危機を示す情報はない。
triage.notes: デング熱の流行状況ではなく、季節性の予防・準備策に関する定例的な行政報告記事である。

article.articleHeadline: Santo André amplia vacinação de bebês após caso de sarampo - Hora de S. Paulo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Santo André expands infant vaccination after measles case - Hora de S. Paulo
article.articleSummary: On September 21, 2026, Santo André in the ABC Paulista region started administering a zero-dose of the measles, mumps and rubella (triple viral) vaccine to children aged 6 months through 11 months 29 days, after a measles case was confirmed in the municipality. The aim is to broaden protection for a highly transmissible disease that can cause complications in young children. The measure is a supplementary, temporary strategy and does not replace routine vaccination under the SUS calendar. In block-vaccination scenarios, the zero-dose is not considered valid for the regular schedule; children must follow the standard vaccination calendar later. Nationwide, São Paulo state has 36 confirmed measles cases in 2026: 32 in the capital, 2 in São Bernardo do Campo, 1 in Guarulhos, and 1 in Santo André. Parents should bring the child's vaccination card to health units.

triage.headline_ja: サントアンドレ、麻疹症例確認後に乳児への予防接種を拡大
triage.triage_reason: 麻疹は感染力が高くWPRO基準の一部（流行しやすさ・継続的曝露）に該当するが、重症例・死亡や国際的拡大の情報はなく、地域内の補完的ワクチン接種対応に留まるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: サンパウロ州で2026年に36件の麻疹確定例（州都32件、サンベルナルドドカンポ2件、グアルーリョス1件、サントアンドレ1件）が報告されており、地域的な感染拡大の兆候があるため今後の症例数増加に注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: 86,489 stray dogs vaccinated against rabies in Chennai
article.articleSummary: Rabies vaccination drive in Chennai: 86,489 stray dogs vaccinated as of Sept 20, 2026 under the Greater Chennai Corporation mass immunisation, aiming for a rabies-free Chennai. Vaccination and internal/external parasite-control treatment are being delivered across the city. Completion milestones: Tiruvottiyur, Manali, Tondiarpet, Madhavaram, and Royapuram zones finished; Ambattur, Anna Nagar, and Alandur zones are ongoing, including streets, schools, and hospitals. Zone-wise tallies: Ambattur 18,627; Madhavaram 16,956; Tondiarpet 12,477; Tiruvottiyur 12,313; Anna Nagar 9,653; Royapuram 8,598; Manali 7,200; Alandur 665. The drive will extend to Thiru. Vi. Ka. Nagar, Teynampet, Kodambakkam, Valasaravakkam, Adyar, Perungudi, and Sholinganallur, with anti-rabies vaccination planned for around two lakh dogs across all zones within 39 working days.

triage.headline_ja: チェンナイで野良犬86,489匹に狂犬病ワクチン接種
triage.triage_reason: これは狂犬病予防のための計画的なワクチン接種活動の進捗報告であり、ヒトの感染事例や異常な流行を示す内容ではない。
triage.notes: 記事は狂犬病の予防的な動物ワクチン接種プログラムの進捗を報じるもので、ヒト感染症の発生を示すものではないため対象国としてカウントしない。

article.articleHeadline: Ouroeste promove entrevista de conscientização sobre combate e prevenção à dengue nesta quinta-feira
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ouroeste hosts an awareness interview on dengue control and prevention this Thursday.
article.articleSummary: Dengue awareness and community prevention take center stage in Ouroeste as authorities plan a special broadcast to reinforce actions against the Aedes aegypti mosquito, dengue vector. On Thursday, September 24, 2026, Ouroeste hosts a live segment of the Momento Saúde program, broadcast on local radio from 11:00. The session features expert Eunice Livoratti, who will share updated guidance on domestic prevention habits, eliminating standing water, and the community’s decisive role in breaking the mosquito’s reproductive cycle. Health department officials stress that individual engagement is the most effective strategy to safeguard the community against potential dengue outbreaks in the region. Citizens are encouraged to regularly inspect yards and properties for possible breeding sites to keep transmission under control.

triage.headline_ja: Ouroesteが木曜日にデング熱の対策と予防に関する啓発インタビューを実施
triage.triage_reason: 実際の感染拡大や症例報告ではなく、地域ラジオ番組でのデング熱予防啓発活動に関する告知記事であり、シグナルとしての緊急性は認められない。
triage.notes: 記事は具体的な症例数や発生状況を報告するものではなく、地域住民向けの予防啓発イベント（ラジオ番組）の告知に過ぎない。ブラジルでの実際のアウトブレイク報告ではないため対象国から除外。

article.articleHeadline: DF reforça combate à dengue antes das chuvas e aposta em novas tecnologias contra o mosquito
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Federal District strengthens the fight against dengue ahead of the rains and bets on new technologies against the mosquito.
article.articleSummary: As of 21 September 2026, dengue remains a major concern in the Federal District, Brazil, ahead of the rainy season. SES-DF maintains a year‑round vector-control strategy blending domiciliary visits, vulnerability monitoring, and technologies to eliminate breeding sites before outbreaks. Drones locate breeding sites in hard‑to‑reach areas; over 4,600 ovitraps have been installed in 2026. Indoor residual spraying with long‑lasting insecticide targets schools, bus terminals, health units, and metro stations. Nearly 2,500 Larvicide Disseminating Stations were installed in Sol Nascente/Pôr do Sol, Recanto das Emas and Água Quente. Wolbachia‑infected mosquitoes released across ten administrative regions total over 65 million by March 2026, linked to more than 60% reduction in dengue, Zika, and chikungunya transmission. By July, 900 Environmental Health agents conducted about 1.2 million home visits; residents should inspect yards weekly and keep water containers sealed or inverted.

triage.headline_ja: 連邦直轄区、雨季を前にデング熱対策を強化し蚊対策の新技術に注力
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は行政による予防的な蚊媒介感染症対策の取り組みを紹介する内容であり、異常な流行や深刻な公衆衛生への影響を示す情報はなく、むしろ制御が進んでいることが強調されている。
triage.notes: デング熱・ジカ熱・チクングニア熱は例年ブラジルで季節的に発生する媒介動物感染症であり、本記事は予防的な行政施策（Wolbachia蚊放出、ドローン監視、殺虫剤散布等）の成果を報告する内容。新規の異常発生や急増を示す記載はない。

article.articleHeadline: Teen suffers memory loss after Indonesian school-meal poisoning
article.articleSummary: Indonesia's nationwide MBG free meals program has triggered a new wave of mass food poisoning, with nearly 3,500 cases among students from Sept 1–9 and about 50,000 sick in 560 incidents since January 2025. In North Sumatra's Karo Regency, 16-year-old Febiola Purba developed memory loss after a school meal (fish) on Aug 13; she collapsed, was hospitalised in Jakarta, and now experiences memory and speech difficulties. Other reported cases include vomiting and dehydration; some students require IV fluids. Lab tests in North Sumatra found harmful bacteria in MBG meals, notably Escherichia coli and Staphylococcus aureus, raising concerns about storage, handling, and temperature control. The National Nutrition Agency, facing leadership turnover, says kitchens run by foundations are responsible, while critics point to systemic supply-chain failures. Legal notices and police investigations are underway, including a kitchen in Karo.

triage.headline_ja: インドネシアの学校給食中毒で10代少女が記憶喪失
triage.triage_reason: インドネシア全国の無償給食プログラムで大規模な食中毒（E. coli等）が継続発生し、入院や神経学的後遺症を伴う重症例もあり、政府機関の対応・社会的関心も高いため。
triage.notes: 食品由来（E. coli, S. aureus）の集団食中毒であり、ヒト-ヒト感染のリスクは低いが、全国規模の給食プログラムにおける構造的な食品安全管理の問題として社会的・政治的関心が高い。国際的な感染拡大リスクは低いためIHR基準は限定的。

article.articleHeadline: Flávio Roscoe testa positivo para Covid e segue internado
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Flávio Roscoe tests positive for COVID-19 and remains hospitalized.
article.articleSummary: Minas Gerais gubernatorial candidate Flávio Roscoe tested positive for COVID-19 and remains hospitalized at Hospital Madre Teresa in Belo Horizonte, Brazil. He was admitted since Saturday for pneumonia with sinusitis, bronchitis, and airway inflammation. Although vaccinated, he reports no specific COVID-19 symptoms. The positive test prevents his participation in the Record Minas debate scheduled for Monday, September 21, 2026. A medical bulletin indicates discharge could occur between Monday and Tuesday if his condition remains favorable, after which he will continue recovery at home under medical supervision. No infection source or other cases are detailed.

triage.headline_ja: フラビオ・ロスコエ氏、新型コロナ陽性で入院継続
triage.triage_reason: 個人の感染事例に関する報道であり、公衆衛生上の異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 個人の著名人の感染・入院に関する単発報道であり、公衆衛生上のシグナルとしての意義は低い。

article.articleHeadline: EU šalje stručnjake u Kongo zbog ebole, počinje testiranje cjepiva
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: EU sends experts to Congo because of Ebola, vaccine testing begins.
article.articleSummary: Two European epidemiologists from the European Centre for Disease Prevention and Control (ECDC) head to the Ebola epicenter in the Democratic Republic of the Congo to bolster surveillance and outbreak response as of 2026-09-21. The outbreak has confirmed over 7,600 Ebola cases and more than 3,670 deaths, with roughly 80% of infections in Ituri province, northeastern DRC. Transmission remains through direct contact with blood, secretions, or other bodily fluids of infected individuals and via contaminated clothing or bedding. Europe remains at very low risk for sustained importation, though sporadic introductions are possible. The World Health Organization reports a vaccine trial in Ituri using Ervebo, the only licensed Ebola vaccine, primarily for healthcare workers and other high-risk personnel. Twenty thousand doses will test whether Ervebo protects against Bundibugyo, the strain driving the current outbreak; previous data show strong protection against Zaire, but protection against Bundibugyo is not yet known.

triage.headline_ja: EUがコンゴにエボラ対策で専門家を派遣、ワクチン試験開始
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の大規模アウトブレイク（7,600例超、死亡3,670例超）で国際機関(ECDC/WHO)が介入し新規株への対応が必要な状況であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準共に複数該当する。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo株による大規模アウトブレイクで、既存ワクチンEvebo(Zaire株用)の有効性が未確認という新規性・不確実性が高い点に注意。ECDC専門家派遣とWHO主導のワクチン試験は国際的関心の高さを示す。

article.articleHeadline: தஞ்சாவூா் அரசு மருத்துவமனையில் டெங்கு சிகிச்சைக்கு தனிப் பிரிவு
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A separate dengue treatment unit at Thanjavur Government Hospital.
article.articleSummary: Two facilities in Thanjavur have established dedicated dengue treatment units: Thanjavur Government Medical College Hospital and Government Raja Mirashudar Hospital. A 20-bed ward is ready at the medical college, with a Pudukkottai district patient admitted for dengue fever who is currently in good condition after treatment. A medical team has been formed to monitor dengue cases, and all necessary arrangements are in place. Public health guidance urges avoiding daytime mosquito bites and preventing stagnant water near homes and public areas to curb breeding; those sleeping on roadside at night should be protected from bites. Anyone with fever should promptly consult a nearby doctor for appropriate treatment.

triage.headline_ja: タンジャーヴール州立病院にデング熱専用治療病棟を設置
triage.triage_reason: デング熱は当該地域で季節的に発生する疾患であり、通常の医療対応（専用病棟設置・監視体制)の範囲内で、異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 季節性デング熱に対する地域の通常対応（治療病棟設置、患者監視、公衆衛生啓発）に関する記事であり、重症例の急増や異常な流行パターンは報告されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Ituri : le désengorgement des sites de déplacés présenté comme une urgence face à Ebola(Ève Bazaiba) - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ituri: the decongestion of internally displaced persons sites presented as an emergency in the face of Ebola (Ève Bazaiba) - ACP
article.articleSummary: In Bunia, Ituri Province, Ebola risk drives decongestion of internally displaced persons (IDP) sites as part of an emergency response. Eve Bazaiba, State Minister for Social Affairs, Humanitarian Action and National Solidarity, urged clearing crowded displacement camps to disrupt the transmission chain of Ebola during her humanitarian mission to Ituri's capital. She arrived from Beni in Nord-Kivu. The measure is framed as part of a sustainable humanitarian intervention, enabling displaced people to gradually return to their areas of origin. Return will be voluntary and contingent on security assessments, with infrastructure rehabilitation to follow. The second facet of her mission provides urgent humanitarian aid, including the distribution of food and non-food items to internally displaced populations. The effort emphasizes reducing Ebola spread while addressing long-term displacement and recovery needs.

triage.headline_ja: イトゥリ:避難民サイトの過密解消がエボラ対策の緊急課題として提示される（エーヴ・バザイバ）- ACP
triage.triage_reason: DRCでエボラ流行に対する緊急人道対応（避難民キャンプの過密解消）が進行中であり、重症度の高い感染症かつ人道危機下での感染拡大リスクがあるためフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 記事はエボラ流行そのものの新規発生報告ではなく、既存アウトブレイクへの人道的対応（避難民キャンプの過密解消）を報じるもの。国家大臣レベルの現地訪問があり政治的関心は高い。詳細な症例数・死亡者数など疫学情報は記事に含まれず不明。

article.articleHeadline: Butembo: inauguration d'un centre de traitement Ebola de 30 lits avec crèche intégrée - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Butembo: inauguration of a 30-bed Ebola treatment center with an integrated nursery - ACP.
article.articleSummary: An Ebola Treatment Center (ETC) with 30 beds and an integrated six-bed pediatric nursery was inaugurated in Matanda, Butembo, North Kivu, in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo, on 21 September 2026. This marks the fourth ETC in Butembo, with two centers in Katwa health zone and two in Butembo zone. The Matanda facility comprises 10 beds for suspected cases and 20 beds for laboratory-confirmed patients, and includes six nursery beds for children. Funded by the International Medical Corps (IMC), the center aims to expand local capacity, speed isolation of symptomatic individuals to interrupt transmission chains, and provide holistic care (medical, psychosocial, and nutritional) for admitted patients. Officials emphasized community-driven responses and collaboration between authorities and humanitarian actors to strengthen the Ebola response in the region.

triage.headline_ja: ブテンボ:30床のエボラ治療センターが保育所併設で開設 - ACP通信
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国北キブ州ブテンボにおいてエボラ治療センターが新設されたことは、同地域で継続中のエボラ流行対応を示唆しており、致死率の高い感染症であることからフルリスク評価が必要と判断される。
triage.notes: 記事自体は治療センター開設という施設整備に関する報道だが、北キブ州ブテンボで継続的なエボラ対応が行われていることを示しており、進行中の流行状況を確認するための続報・詳細情報の収集が推奨される。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola: les élèves du collège saint Vincent de Paul sensibilisées aux mesures préventives - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: Students of Saint Vincent de Paul College Sensitized to Preventive Measures - ACP
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease awareness session conducted at Saint Vincent de Paul College in Isiro, Haut-Uele Province, northeastern Democratic Republic of Congo, on September 21, 2026. A DPS Haut-Uele official, Sidony Mutombo, warned that Ebola is present in the province and stressed barrier measures, including hand washing and physical distancing, and reporting of suspected cases while advising against handling the body of a deceased Ebola patient. She highlighted fever, vomiting, and diarrhea as warning signs and urged students to disclose symptoms. The session also addressed prevention of exploitation and sexual abuse during humanitarian aid, recalling past outbreaks when providers departed leaving vulnerable girls pregnant; attendees were asked to denounce any abuse. The event, held on the school esplanade before the afternoon classes, included Sister Bernadette Falanga, the college prefect, a parents committee chair, and a World Health Organization representative.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：サン・ヴァンサン・ド・ポール中学校の生徒たちが予防対策について啓発を受ける - ACP
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国オート・ウエレ州にてエボラ出血熱が継続的に存在するとの当局発言があり、WHO関係者も同席する啓発活動が実施されている。重篤な疾患であり、ヒト-ヒト感染や国際支援の必要性が示唆されるためフルRRAへ進む。
triage.notes: 記事は啓発活動に関する内容であり、新規症例数や発生規模の具体的情報は含まれていない。DRC保健当局者がエボラの州内存在を明言しており、既存または継続中のアウトブレイクの一環と考えられる。続報で症例数・致死率等の詳細確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola dans la Tshopo : la société civile de Bafwasende appelle à l'implication populaire - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Tshopo: The Civil Society of Bafwasende Calls for Public Participation - ACP
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease in Tshopo’s Bafwasende territory, Democratic Republic of the Congo, prompts urgent public participation, as civil society urges stricter adherence to preventive measures, reporting of suspected cases, and collaboration with health and political authorities. In Kisangani, on 21 September 2026, Patrick Ibrahim, president of the Civil Society forces vives de Bafwasende, calls on residents to tighten compliance with barrier measures to prevent Ebola spread and to assist in surveillance, especially through community leaders and traditional chiefs who must accurately convey risks, preventive steps, and precautions for suspected cases. Since Tshopo was listed among affected provinces, Bafwasende has faced hostility toward outreach workers delivering preventive messages. Provincial authorities, with partners, plan a second mission to establish a sub-coordination of response and to intensify communication against the infodemic within the territory's communities.

triage.headline_ja: ツショポ州のエボラ:バフワセンデ市民社会が住民参加を呼びかけ - ACP
triage.triage_reason: DRCのツショポ州（バフワセンデ）でエボラ出血熱の発生が継続し、住民の抵抗や誤情報（インフォデミック）が対応を妨げているとの報告があり、公衆衛生上の重大性・拡大リスクが認められるためフルRRAへ進めるべき。
triage.notes: 記事はエボラの新規症例数や死亡者数などの具体的疫学データを提供していないため、詳細な重症度・規模の評価は不明。住民の非協力（アウトリーチワーカーへの敵意）と誤情報拡散がリスク要因として明記されている。

article.articleHeadline: டெங்கு பரவாமல் தடுக்க முன்னெச்சரிக்கை நடவடிக்கை! புதுச்சேரி முதல்வா் என்.ரங்கசாமி
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Preventive measures to curb dengue spread! Puducherry Chief Minister N. Rangasamy.
article.articleSummary: As of 21 September 2026, Puducherry has recorded 533 dengue cases this year, with 488 in Puducherry and 45 in Karaikal; no dengue-related deaths have been reported. Health authorities urge anyone with fever plus headache or body aches to seek treatment at government hospitals promptly. With dengue spreading in Tamil Nadu, Puducherry’s health department has intensified surveillance. Chief Minister N. Rangasamy chaired a high-level meeting at his office to strengthen containment measures, involving Minister Malladi Krishna Rao, opposition leader A. M. Najim (DMK), MLA A. Senthilkumar, Health Department Director Seval, Public Works Department Chief Engineer Veerselvam, and Urban Development Director Aadash. The government ordered adequate medicines and supplies for hospitals, and emphasized vector-control activities, sanitation, and cleanliness to curb transmission.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱の拡大を防ぐための予防措置！プドゥチェリー州首相N.ランガサミー
triage.triage_reason: デング熱は季節性で毎年発生する既知の疾患であり、死亡者もなく重症度は低いが、行政が対策会議を開くなど一定の関心が見られるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: プドゥチェリー及びタミル・ナードゥ州で季節性デング熱が拡大しているが死亡例なし。州政府が予防・媒介制御対策を強化している段階で、国際的な影響は限定的。

article.articleHeadline: Bahia tem alta de 364,9% na chikungunya; saiba como prevenir | A TARDE
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Bahia records a 364.9% increase in chikungunya; learn how to prevent.
article.articleSummary: Bahia, Brazil reports 9,990 probable chikungunya cases from January 1 to September 15, 2026, a 364.9% rise from 2,149 in the same period in 2025, with two confirmed deaths. Across 201 Bahia municipalities, 22 districts have incidence above 100 per 100,000. Health authorities warn higher temperatures fuel Aedes aegypti proliferation, especially as droughts promote water storage in unsealed containers, raising outbreak risk during warmer periods aided by El Niño. While chikungunya surges, dengue cases fell 16.5% to 23,285 probable by Sep 15, 2026, with 12 dengue deaths; zika rose 3.2% to 260. Vaccination for dengue is available in public networks for priority groups and in private networks for ages 4–60. For differential diagnosis, Sabin offers a single-blood-sample PCR test detecting six Aedes-transmitted viruses—dengue, zika, chikungunya, oropouche, yellow fever, and Mayaro—available in multiple Salvador metropolitan units and via mobile services; appointments at sabin.com.br or WhatsApp.

triage.headline_ja: バイア州でチクングニア熱364.9%増加、予防法を紹介
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・バイア州でチクングニア熱の症例が前年同期比364.9%増加し、死亡例も報告されているが、国際的な拡大や渡航・貿易制限の兆候はなく、地域当局が既存の対応（検査・ワクチン提供）で対処している段階のため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: El Salvadorは発生地域に含まれるが記事本文では言及がなく、対象国リストにも含まれないため除外。デング熱・ジカ熱の動向も併記されているが、主題はバイア州のチクングニア熱急増。

article.articleHeadline: Sarampo: especialista orienta sobre vacinação e prevenção na região Norte
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Measles: Specialist Advises on Vaccination and Prevention in the Northern Region.
article.articleSummary: Measles vaccination and prevention were emphasized for Brazil’s Northern Region, especially Amazonas, amid circulating measles virus and cross-border movement in the Brazil-Peru-Colombia tri-border area. In an interview on Nacional Jovem, infectious disease specialist Dra. Solange Dourado, SBIm representative in Amazonas, urged keeping the Measles vaccine schedule up to date as part of the SUS National Immunization Calendar to protect individuals and communities, including Indigenous populations. The discussion highlighted challenges in border areas with intense population exchange and the need for tailored health responses when suspected or confirmed cases arise, considering the unique characteristics of each Indigenous community. The interview also covered recognizing measles signs, seeking care for suspected cases, and guidelines for those unsure about their vaccination status. Emphasizing prevention, the program underscores vaccination as key to controlling circulation in the region.

triage.headline_ja: 麻疹:専門家が北部地域でのワクチン接種と予防について助言
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル北部（アマゾナス州）で麻疹ウイルスの循環と国境地域での人口移動が言及されているが、具体的な症例数や重症度など詳細情報が不足しているため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジル・ペルー・コロンビアの三国国境地帯における麻疹の予防啓発が主題。ペルー・コロンビアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。具体的な症例数・発生規模の記載はなく、専門家インタビューによる予防啓発記事の性質が強い。

article.articleHeadline: Bharat Biotech is 'back in action' after Covid reset: Krishna Ella on TB vaccine, Nipah-Ebola shots, gene therapy, IPO plans & what's next
article.articleSummary: Back in action after a two-year Covid reset, Bharat Biotech founder Krishna Ella says the company is expanding beyond vaccines into cell and gene therapy and monoclonal antibodies, while pursuing Nipah, Ebola, TB, chikungunya, malaria, Zika and antimicrobial resistance vaccines. TB vaccine Phase 2 is complete with dossier submitted; Phase 3 awaits questions. Nipah and Ebola vaccines are prioritized for pandemic preparedness, though Ella critiques current Ebola vaccine strategy and emphasizes a T-cell–based approach; Ebola is not viewed as a revenue driver. The firm may pursue an IPO to fund new therapies and potential acquisitions. Bengaluru hosts a gene-therapy setup; Odisha vaccine plant received ₹1,500 crore investment, and GSK’s vaccine plant in Gujarat was acquired. Revenue around ₹2,000 crore and debt-free; succession plans place son Raches in human vaccines/gene therapy and daughter Jalachari in veterinary work. An emphasis on hospital-acquired infection strategies in India complements vaccine development.”}{

triage.headline_ja: コロナ禍からの再始動を果たしたバーラト・バイオテック:クリシュナ・エラ氏が語るTBワクチン、ニパ・エボラワクチン、遺伝子治療、IPO計画と今後の展望
triage.triage_reason: 実際の感染症アウトブレイクではなく、ワクチン製造企業の事業戦略・企業活動に関する記事であり、公衆衛生上の緊急事態を示すものではない。
triage.notes: 本記事は企業の事業展開・ワクチン開発パイプライン・IPO計画に関する経済ニュースであり、実際の疾患アウトブレイクを報じるものではないため、感染症サーベイランスのシグナルとしては該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: 'আগামী বছরই ভারতে আসছে ডেঙ্গুর টিকা
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue vaccine to arrive in India next year
article.articleSummary: Takeda's four-serotype dengue vaccine, Q-DENGA, will be marketed in India via a Dr. Reddy's Laboratories partnership, with arrival in the first half of 2027 after July 2026 regulatory approval. The vaccine is for ages 4–60 and requires two 0.5 mL doses given three months apart, without prior dengue infection testing. In trials, one year after the second dose, efficacy against laboratory-confirmed dengue was 80.2%, and 18 months later protection against dengue-related hospitalization reached 90.4%. India faces dengue as a major public health challenge, with 2025 recording 113,450 dengue cases and 95 deaths. While Q-DENGA adds a new tool, traditional measures—mosquito breeding-site elimination, removal of standing water, and measures to prevent bites—remain essential in control.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱ワクチン、来年インドに登場
triage.triage_reason: ワクチン承認・市場投入に関する情報提供記事であり、新規の異常な公衆衛生事象ではないため。
triage.notes: デング熱自体は既知の流行病であり、記事はワクチン承認・市場投入に関する内容。2025年の症例数95死亡は既存の年間統計であり突発的増加を示すものではない。

article.articleHeadline: 12 Kasus Influenza H3N2 Terdeteksi di Malang, Warga Wajib Waspada
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 12 Cases of Influenza A(H3N2) Detected in Malang, Residents Urged to Be Vigilant
article.articleSummary: Influenza A(H3N2) detected in Malang, East Java, with 12 cases reported from January through August 2026, the subtype most commonly identified alongside 7 H1N1 and 1 influenza B (Victoria). Malang's Dinas Kesehatan records 20 total influenza cases in the period; samples were tested at BBLabkesmas Surabaya and Litbangkes. H3N2 is highlighted due to potentially heavier symptoms, sometimes referred to as a 'super flu' in local reporting. Symptoms resemble ordinary flu, but severe cases may feature marked hoarseness, fever, and body aches, particularly headaches. Environmental factors such as dust and smoke exposure from indoor/outdoor sources, vehicle exhaust, and burning may worsen respiratory illness. Severe cases are managed as ILI; escalating to SARI is treated in hospitals, including RSUD Saiful Anwar Malang (no reports yet). ILI surveillance shows 59 suspects with 20 positives and 39 negatives; authorities urge masking and reduced exposure to pollutants.

triage.headline_ja: マランでインフルエンザA(H3N2)12症例検出、住民に注意喚起
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザ（H3N2/H1N1/B型）の通常のサーベイランス報告であり、重症例の急増や異常な流行パターンは見られず、国際的な拡大リスクも認められない。
triage.notes: 2026年1月〜8月の期間でマラン県において季節性インフルエンザ20症例（H3N2:12、H1N1:7、B型:1）が検出された。地元保健当局が通常のサーベイランスとして報告しており、重症化例やSARIへの進展例は報告されていない。ILIサーベイランスの一環としての通常報告と判断される。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola no Congo pode ter começado já em fevereiro - 21/09/2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the Congo may have started as early as February - September 21, 2026.
article.articleSummary: Outbreak of Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of Congo is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, officially declared May 15, 2026, with 80% of cases in Ituri province, centered in Mongbwalu and Bunia. The first retrospective case was a health worker in Mongbwalu with symptoms around April 24–25, who died in Bunia. May 5 WHO alerted to a high-mortality disease in Mongbwalu; May 15 laboratory confirmation by INRB led to the declaration. Africa CDC criticized the slow response, noting about three weeks between first symptoms and confirmation due to low clinical suspicion among local health workers. A Red Cross report (May 16) cites fear since March 30 and deaths with Ebola-like symptoms, with a funeral exposing people to a contaminated body and coffin, fueling spread in Mongbwalu and Bunia. MMWR (June) suggests February start; sequencing supports February origin, with early cases misattributed to malaria/typhoid; 'swine Ebola' appears in discussions.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ出血熱、2月にはすでに始まっていた可能性 - 2026年9月21日
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国におけるエボラ出血熱アウトブレイク（Bundibugyoエボラウイルス）に関する事後分析記事であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 本記事は既知のエボラアウトブレイク（2026年5月15日公式発表）の発生起源を遡及的に分析したもの。初期症例がマラリア・腸チフスと誤診されていた点、地域住民の低い臨床的疑い、葬儀を介した拡大などが報告されており、既存のアウトブレイク対応の一環として継続的なモニタリングが必要。

article.articleHeadline: รู้จัก 'ลีเจียนแนร์' โรคร้ายที่มากับละอองน้ำ 1 ใน 4 โรคเฝ้าระวังใหม่
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Legionnaires' disease, a deadly illness transmitted by aerosolized water droplets, is one of four newly monitored diseases.
article.articleSummary: Legionnaires' disease (Legionellosis) is among four newly monitored diseases in Thailand. Department of Disease Control data show 371 cumulative Legionella cases and 7 deaths from 2013–2026; 44 cases and 1 death occurred in 2026. Affected populations include Thai citizens and international travelers. Legionella pneumophila is transmitted via aerosolized water droplets and water-related equipment. Symptoms include anorexia, fatigue, myalgia, headache, and fever, typically 2–5 days after exposure, followed by abdominal pain and diarrhea. Pneumonia presents with patchy lung infiltrates and may progress to bilateral involvement and respiratory failure; Pontiac fever is a milder, non-pneumonic form. Historical notes: first case in 1947; a 1976 Philadelphia outbreak at an American Legion Convention (182 cases, 29 deaths) led to identification of the bacterium.

triage.headline_ja: 『レジオネラ症』水しぶきが原因の危険な病気を知る——新たな監視対象4疾患の1つ
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はタイの新規サーベイランス対象疾患の一つとしてレジオネラ症を解説する教育的内容であり、急性の集団発生や異常事態を示すものではない。2013年以降の累積データも低頻度で推移しており、シグナルとしての緊急性は認められない。
triage.notes: 記事はタイ疾病管理局のデータに基づく啓発的解説記事で、フィラデルフィアの1976年の歴史的アウトブレイク事例は背景説明として引用されているのみで、現在の発生地ではない。米国・ペンシルベニア州・フィラデルフィアは対象国リスト外のため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: India to get first vaccine to fight dengue in 2027
article.articleSummary: Qdenga dengue vaccine, developed by Takeda, received India’s drug regulator approval in July 2026; Dr Reddy’s Laboratories signs an agreement to promote and distribute in India, with availability expected in the first half of 2027 after regulatory and market authorisation. Dengue remains a public health concern in India, transmitted mainly by Aedes mosquitoes that breed in stagnant water, with seasonal outbreaks during and after the monsoon. Qdenga is a tetravalent vaccine covering all four dengue serotypes, for ages 4–60, administered as two 0.5 ml injections three months apart, without pre-vaccination testing regardless of prior exposure. Efficacy data show ~80.2% protection against confirmed dengue cases one year after the second dose and ~90.4% efficacy against dengue-related hospitalisations after 18 months. India recorded 1,13,450 dengue cases and 95 deaths in 2025 (provisional).

triage.headline_ja: インドで2027年にデング熱対策のワクチンが初めて導入へ
triage.triage_reason: 既存の季節性デング熱流行に対するワクチン承認・流通の話題であり、新規異常事象ではなく通常の公衆衛生対応の範疇。

article.articleHeadline: В ДР Конго число жертв Эболы приблизилось к 3,7 тыс.
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In DR Congo, the Ebola death toll neared 3,700.
article.articleSummary: Lab-confirmed Ebola deaths in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) neared 3,700, with 3,699 fatalities and 7,672 total cases reported by the National Institute of Public Health in its daily bulletin. In the past 24 hours, 58 new cases and 23 additional deaths were recorded, yielding a case fatality rate of 48.2%. More than 900 patients with Ebola symptoms are hospitalized or in medical isolation, and the outbreak has touched 7 of the DRC’s 26 provinces. The flare-up began on 15 May in both the DRC and Uganda, becoming the second-deadliest Ebola outbreak on Africa’s recorded history. Ugandan authorities declared the outbreak over on 28 July, and the World Health Organization confirmed its end there on 25 August.

article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Stringent measures to prevent dengue fever: Chief Minister Vijay's directive
article.articleSummary: Rising dengue cases in Tamil Nadu prompt Chief Minister S. Joseph Vijay to order comprehensive prevention. A Secretariat meeting discussed Northeast monsoon precautions: identify coastal zones vulnerable to seawater intrusion and floods, and prepare profiles of affected coastal communities. Plans ensure fishermen receive timely weather and sea alerts, evacuations from flood-prone zones, and readiness of cyclone shelters. Schools and community halls will serve as relief camps with drinking water, food, electricity, sanitation, and medical facilities ready. Emergency teams, boats, lifting devices, ropes, generators, and water pumps will be on standby. Inspect roads, storm drains, and bridges via drones for maintenance; raise public awareness and surveillance to prevent spread. Dengue control: monitor state and district dengue status, locate breeding sites, eradicate larvae and adult mosquitoes, and ensure medical guidance and fogging supplies. Hospitals and primary health centers ready for early treatment. L-Nino report submitted by K. A. Sengottaiyan.

article.articleHeadline: Monitoramento aponta queda de 47% na presença de ovos do Aedes aegypti
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Monitoring indicates a 47% drop in the presence of Aedes aegypti eggs.
article.articleSummary: In Campo Grande, Brazil, ovitrapping for Aedes aegypti showed a July–August 2026 drop in eggs (July: 148,731; August: 79,110), a 47% month-to-month decline, though March 2026 remained the peak (223,412). Total eggs counted in 2026 reached 4,886,013, with an Index of Egg Density (IDO) of 7.46 and an Ovitrapping Positivity Index (IPO) of 28.14%. Monitoring is conducted by Sesau, via Cievs and GCEV, installing and weekly-maintaining ovitr traps to map reproductive activity and guide vector-control actions. Despite the decrease, eggs persist, indicating continued Aedes aegypti reproduction and ongoing risk for dengue, Zika, and chikungunya transmission in the municipality. Public guidance emphasizes eliminating standing water around homes (e.g., in vases, containers, tires, bottles) while maintaining indoor precautions.

article.articleHeadline: Manila logs 32 new flu-like cases
article.articleSummary: Manila, Philippines, on Sept. 21 logged 32 new influenza-like illness (ILI) cases—the largest single-category increase in the city’s latest report on water-borne diseases, influenza, leptospirosis and dengue. The Manila Health Department also recorded 22 dengue cases, 15 leptospirosis cases, and one newly confirmed COVID-19 case. This year totals: ILI 1,788; dengue 3,155; leptospirosis 1,440; COVID-19 94. Mayor Francisco Isko Moreno Domagoso urged residents to seek care promptly if unwell. The report notes ongoing rainfall-related risk to these illnesses and underscores early consultation at health facilities. This update reflects ongoing monitoring by the Manila Health Department during the rainy season. Residents are advised to seek medical care promptly if sick.

article.articleHeadline: What to know about bird flu in Washington state - The Daily Chronicle
article.articleSummary: Washington state reports 2.2 million birds tested positive for Type A H5N1, including 52 backyard flocks and three commercial flocks, amid a three-year bird flu outbreak that has killed millions of animals nationwide. Since 2022, about 14 Washingtonians have tested presumptively positive, all commercial farmworkers; Louisiana recorded the country's first human death from bird flu in January. Public risk remains low, though state epidemiologist Dr. Scott Lindquist warns the virus could mutate to be more infectious to humans. The outbreak traces to highly pathogenic avian influenza (HPAI), which emerged in Guangdong in 1996 and has since spread among wild birds and farms. Symptoms in birds include sneezing, ruffled feathers, and reduced egg production; in humans, fever, cough, pink eye, and body aches. Transmission occurs via contaminated surfaces, saliva, mucus, or feces; poultry is safe if properly cooked. CDC advises testing after exposure.

article.articleHeadline: Piraúba usa drones para reforçar combate ao Aedes aegypti
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Piraúba uses drones to reinforce the fight against Aedes aegypti.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-09-21, the municipality of Piraúba has begun using drones to support Aedes aegypti control and dengue prevention. Drones provide aerial mapping of areas difficult to access, enhancing the observation capacity of endemic agents. Imagery allows identification of locations that may foster mosquito breeding, enabling targeted inspections and interventions. The technology acts as an add-on to field teams, not a replacement, and the aerial mapping becomes part of the municipality's prevention measures. The initiative strengthens vector surveillance and control efforts by expanding situational awareness and guiding searches for potential breeding sites. While the article does not report dengue cases or lab confirmations, the use of drones signals a strategic step to improve planning and resource allocation in dengue prevention in Piraúba.

article.articleHeadline: Rio registra caso de raiva em cão e acende alerta para cuidados com animais; veja como se prevenir
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rio de Janeiro reports a case of rabies in a dog and raises awareness about animal care; see how to prevent it.
article.articleSummary: Rio de Janeiro city reports an August case of rabies in an urban-dwelling dog, with prior contact with bats; the antigenic variant is under analysis by the CRMV-RJ. Rabies is an acute viral disease transmitted mainly through saliva via bites, scratches, or mucous membranes. In animals, signs include behavioral changes, hypersalivation, ataxia, and paralysis; humans have an average incubation of about 45 days, varying by bite site and viral dose. In dogs and cats, virus may be present in saliva 2–5 days before symptoms and persists until death, typically 5–7 days after onset; bats can remain infected without symptoms. Prevention emphasizes annual vaccination of dogs and cats, leashing in public spaces, avoiding unknown or ill animals, and seeking prompt medical care after exposure (wound washing, antiseptic, possible vaccination and immunoglobulin). RJ state has recorded two human rabies deaths historically (2006, 2020) from bat transmission; authorities continue surveillance and control per CRMV-RJ.

article.articleHeadline: Após alta em julho, contagem de ovos do Aedes aegypti cai na Capital
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: After July's rise, Aedes aegypti egg counts fall in the capital.
article.articleSummary: Campo Grande, Brazil, recorded a 46.8% drop in Aedes aegypti egg counts from July to August 2026, with ovitraps collecting 148,731 eggs in July and 79,110 in August. Despite the decline, the mosquito continues to reproduce in the city. Ovitrap surveillance—containers that attract egg-laying females—guides vector-control actions. The year’s peak was March (223,412 eggs); May and June logged 63,515 and 75,797, respectively. The arbovirus panel shows August neighborhood notifications: Panama with 16 detections, 63 discarded, two open. In July, Centro-Oeste led with 20 records; 159 discarded and three dengue cases reported. The data do not establish a direct link between egg counts and disease notifications. Residents are advised to eliminate standing water in pots, tires, bottles and other containers; ovitraps remain in use to monitor transmission risk.

article.articleHeadline: ¡DENGUE SE DISPARA EN PERÚ! Casos aumentan 79 % y ya suman casi 56 MIL contagios y 67 fallecidos | ESTAS REGIONES PREOCUPAN
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue Surges in Peru! Cases Rise 79% and Now Stand at Nearly 56,000 Infections and 67 Deaths | These Regions Are Of Concern.
article.articleSummary: Dengue surge in Peru: As of September 12, 2026, Peru reports 55,943 confirmed or probable dengue cases, up 79% from 31,266 in the same period of 2025, with 67 deaths (vs 51 last year). The CDC-Minsa maintains weekly epidemiological surveillance of dengue, a disease transmitted by Aedes aegypti. Piura records the highest caseload (over 10,644), with La Libertad, San Martín, Lambayeque, Lima, Ucayali, Loreto, Amazonas, Madre de Dios, Tumbes and Junín also affected. By deaths, San Martín leads with 18, followed by Lambayeque (14) and Madre de Dios (8). The rise is attributed to higher temperatures linked to El Niño, especially in the north. Dengue symptoms include fever, severe headache, retro-orbital pain, and muscle/joint pains. Despite the increase, current year totals remain below 2023–2024 levels when Peru exceeded 200,000 cases.

article.articleHeadline: In the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Ebola continues to spread - The World from PRX
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo continues to grow, with transmission shifting from the original epicenter to new regions that have limited healthcare infrastructure; cases have plateaued in the epicenter, but the outbreak is expanding elsewhere. There is no approved treatment or vaccine for this strain. An experimental vaccine trial for healthcare workers is underway. The World’s Marco Werman speaks with John Johnson, vaccination and epidemic response expert at Doctors Without Borders, about the latest developments, outbreak dynamics, and response challenges in settings with constrained medical resources. The report frames the situation as of 2026-09-21, highlighting expanding transmission beyond the initial center and the operational realities faced by frontline responders.

article.articleHeadline: புதுகை மாவட்டத்தில் 9 பேருக்கு டெங்கு ஆட்சியா் தகவல்
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Nine people infected with dengue in Pudukkottai district.
article.articleSummary: Nine people in Pudukkottai district have dengue fever confirmed, announced at a Monday review by the District Collector. A total of 453 fever tests have been conducted district-wide, with 9 dengue cases confirmed and patients receiving treatment in government and private hospitals. To strengthen prevention, 15 dengue surveillance supervisors have been appointed and 535 dengue-control workers are deployed across local bodies. The meeting, attended by health department officials, local body commissioners, and executive officers, urged coordinated interdepartmental action across departments to curb transmission. Authorities emphasized multi-sector collaboration, including health, municipal administration, and local bodies, to sustain transmission reduction. No details on the infection source or imported/exported cases were provided. Published 2026-09-21.

article.articleHeadline: Horror outbreak rocks Aussie tourist hotspot
article.articleSummary: Fiji declared a national HIV crisis after a dramatic spike; about 1 in 60 Fijian adults live with HIV. In 2025 Fiji recorded over 2,000 new HIV diagnoses; 2019–2024 cases rose about 1,219%. UNAIDS tallies 280,000 new infections in Asia-Pacific last year; HIV funding fell to $7.3B in 2025. Transmission remains mainly sexual, but needle sharing is rising as syringe scarcity and stigma impede prevention and care. A 2024 rapid assessment found 48% of new treatment initiates cited injecting drug use as their primary risk. 'Koda'—dissolving meth in a syringe with water or blood—drives contamination. Syringes are scarce; pharmacies require prescriptions; reuse and sharing are common. Cross-border risks to Australia and New Zealand exist via travel; Kirby Institute projects 25,000 Fijians infected by 2029 without action.

article.articleHeadline: DRC Ebola outbreak update - September 19
article.articleSummary: As of 19 September 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) reports 58 new confirmed Ebola Virus Disease (EVD) cases, including 13 community deaths. Ten healthcare facility deaths (6 in Ituri, 3 in North Kivu, 1 in Tshopo) raise the day’s total deaths to 23. Fifteen patients were recovered (13 in Ituri, 2 in North Kivu) after testing negative for EVD on two occasions. Since outbreak onset, cumulative confirmed cases reach 7,672 with 3,699 deaths (case fatality rate 48.2%). Ituri remains the epicenter, accounting for 77.1% of all confirmed cases across seven provinces and 65.5% of the day’s new cases. No new health zones were affected in the last 24 hours; 63 of 167 health zones (37.7%) across seven provinces are affected. Provincial breakdown: Ituri 28/36, North Kivu 16/34, Haut-Uélé 7/13, Tshopo 7/23, South Kivu 1/34, Bas-Uélé 3/11, South Ubangi 1/16.

article.articleHeadline: Combate à dengue é intensificado, mas vacinação preocupa | Campos | O Dia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Fight against dengue intensified, but vaccination concerns | Campos | O Dia
article.articleSummary: Campos dos Goytacazes intensifies fight against Aedes aegypti to curb dengue, Zika, chikungunya, and urban yellow fever, via CCZ and the Municipal Vector Control Program. Continuous mutirões, door-to-door visits, trap surveillance, and aerial blocks target neighborhoods with the highest infestation. Yet vaccination coverage for dengue is critically low, threatening the immunological blockade against virus circulation. The Qdenga vaccine has been available in the public network since June 2025 for ages 10–14 (about 34,110 residents). Through 2025, 8,346 doses were administered (7,139 first doses; 1,207 second doses); by mid-September 2026, 3,544 first doses and 2,113 second doses were recorded. Officials stress that a lone first dose is insufficient; the second dose is essential. The vaccine offers ~80% protection against symptomatic dengue and reduces hospitalizations by over 90% after the second dose. Multi-dose vaccination campaigns are being promoted, with residents urged to bring SUS cards and vaccination books to clinics.

article.articleHeadline: RDC: le président Félix Tshisekedi ne se rendra pas à l'ONU en raison des restrictions de voyage dues à Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: President Félix Tshisekedi will not attend the United Nations due to Ebola-related travel restrictions.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreaks in the north-eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo trigger U.S. travel restrictions on travelers from the DRC, Uganda, and South Sudan, including a 21-day pre-travel period in a third country. President Félix Tshisekedi will not attend the 81st United Nations General Assembly in New York; the DRC will be represented by Prime Minister Judith Suminwa and Foreign Minister Thérèse Wagner. A government communiqué issued on September 20 states the PM will depart Kinshasa with a reduced delegation via Air Congo through Europe. Although exemptions exist for heads of state, the presidential delegation is deemed too large to qualify, a factor also cited for Tshisekedi’s prior decision to skip a U.S. trip in July. The article notes the Ebola outbreak persists in several north-eastern provinces but does not provide case counts.

article.articleHeadline: Rio confirma caso de raiva em cão que teve contato com morcego
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rio confirms a rabies case in a dog that had contact with a bat.
article.articleSummary: A dog in an urban area of Rio de Janeiro's West Zone was diagnosed with rabies in August and euthanized; the animal had contact with bats. An epidemiological survey followed in Santa Cruz after confirmation by the municipal animal protection service. People exposed received post-exposure antirabies vaccination and were monitored; no human rabies cases were reported. The last human cases in Rio de Janeiro state were in 2006 (São José do Vale do Rio Preto) and 2020 (Angra dos Reis), both bat-transmitted. Vaccination campaigns for dogs and cats are annual; the 2026 campaign is scheduled for Saturday, September 26. SES-RJ coordinates guidance and monitoring across municipalities. Precautions include leash and indoor housing for pets, avoiding contact with bats, and using PPE for veterinarians. In bites or scratches from any mammal, seek care immediately and wash wounds; dogs/cats involved in aggression should be observed for 10 days.

triage.headline_ja: リオ、コウモリと接触した犬の狂犬病症例を確認

article.articleHeadline: Lung Bacteria Found to Worsen Influenza Through a Metabolic Trap in Immune
article.articleSummary: Influenza A virus (IAV) severity in mouse lung models is amplified by lung microbiota dysbiosis, driven by enrichment of Bacillus cereus and its metabolite xanthosine, which downregulates nt5e (CD73) on alveolar macrophages, impairing viral phagocytosis and promoting viral replication and lung damage. The findings come from multi-omics analysis and mouse models at Qiqihar University, Harbin Veterinary Research Institute, and Heilongjiang Academy of Agricultural Sciences in Heilongjiang, China. Severity scales with dysbiosis level; more B. cereus correlates with weaker macrophage response and worse outcomes. Importantly, targeted phage therapy to remove B. cereus reverses the impairment and alleviates IAV-induced lung lesions, demonstrating that precise microbiota editing—rather than broad antibiotics—can restore antiviral protection. The xanthosine-nt5e axis links microbial metabolites to innate immunity and influenza pathogenesis.

triage.headline_ja: 肺細菌がインフルエンザを悪化させることが判明 - 免疫細胞の代謝トラップを介したメカニズム
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は基礎研究論文の発表報道であり、実際の患者発生事例ではなく、マウスモデルと in vitro 実験の結果報告である。公衆衛生上の現在の脅威を示すイベントではない。
triage.notes: 本イベントは感染症の実際の発生（患者クラスタ、アウトブレイク）ではなく、中国の研究機関による基礎研究論文の発表報道である。マウスモデルでのメカニズム研究であり、現在進行中の公衆衛生危機に該当しない。検出シグナルトリアージの対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Somalia Strengthens Ebola Readiness Through National Simulation Exercise -By Kestér Kenn Klomegâh
article.articleSummary: Somalia held a 3-day Ebola readiness simulation in Mogadishu to test detection, verification, reporting and response to a suspected imported Ebola case. Organized by the Ministry of Health and Human Services and the National Institute of Health with WHO support, the exercise drew 70 participants from federal and state agencies and partners. Six tabletop scenarios plus a functional phase examined coordination within the Health Emergency Operations Centre and incident-management structure under incomplete information, including regional alerts, entry-point issues and risk communication. No real patients or alerts were involved. Findings were captured in an improvement action plan to strengthen reporting lines, referral pathways and governance of communication. Somalia has not reported any confirmed Ebola case, but the Democratic Republic of the Congo is facing a large Bundibugyo-virus Ebola outbreak with 6,757 cases and 3,267 deaths across 61 health zones in 6 provinces as of 7 Sep 2026. WHO supported the exercise to advance readiness.

The event emphasizes public health education and community engagement to reduce transmission, with the aim of building a healthier future. Organized by the Guaratinguetá municipal health authorities, the session highlights ongoing efforts to inform residents and promote accessible guidance for dengue and arboviral disease prevention.

article.articleHeadline: Cachorro contrai raiva após contato com morcego no Rio e autoridades alertam sobre vacinação
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dog contracts rabies after contact with a bat in Rio de Janeiro, and authorities warn about vaccination.
article.articleSummary: Rabies case confirmed in a dog in Rio de Janeiro's Oeste Zone (Santa Cruz) after direct contact with a bat in August; the animal was sacrificed and a Sept 18 official notice pinpointed Santa Cruz as the case site. An epidemiological survey followed; exposed individuals received post-exposure prophylaxis and are under medical monitoring, with no human transmission reported in Rio de Janeiro state to date. Rabies, a viral encephalitis with near-100% fatality after symptom onset, underscores vaccination as a preventive pillar; the state’s 2026 vaccination campaign is scheduled for Sept 26. Preventive guidance includes keeping pets vaccinated, avoiding free-roaming dogs, and housing cats indoors. Do not touch bats and contact municipal zoonoses for safe removal. Any dog/cat bite or exposure requires immediate medical care; injured animals should be observed for 10 days, with notification if behavioral changes, illness, or death occur.

article.articleSummary: Rabies case confirmed in a dog in Rio de Janeiro's Santa Cruz neighborhood after contact with a bat. Rabies is a viral zoonosis causing progressive brain inflammation with near 100% fatality once symptoms appear. The Rio de Janeiro State Health Secretariat notes the last human rabies cases in the state occurred in 2006 (São José do Vale do Rio Preto) and 2020 (Angra dos Reis), both transmitted by bats. In response, veterinarians urge pet owners to keep dogs’ and cats’ rabies vaccinations up to date. Officials emphasize that vaccination and careful handling around bats are key public health measures to reduce human risk.

article.articleHeadline: Khẩn trương xử lý môi trường, phòng chống dịch bệnh sau mưa lũ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Urgent environmental sanitation and disease prevention after floods.
article.articleSummary: Flood aftermath in Hà Trung district, Thanh Hoa Province, Vietnam triggers urgent environmental sanitation and disease prevention. In 32 of 71 hamlets, about 4,300 households are affected; 595 wells, 1,143 latrines, and 262 livestock pens flooded. Directly affected: 18,751 people, with 430 displaced. In Tống Sơn and Hoạt Giang communes, canal overflows worsened flooding, leaving mud, debris, and animal carcasses that threaten water and environmental quality. As waters recede, the risk of diarrhoeal, conjunctival, skin, and dengue illnesses rises unless rapid sanitation, water-source disinfection, and health surveillance are implemented. Hà Trung Health Center deploys mobile outbreak teams, maintains supplies of chemicals and equipment, and coordinates environmental cleaning, water decontamination, and public hygiene campaigns. Residents are advised to boil or treat water (Chloramin B/Aquatabs), disinfect wells, clean homes, and discard spoiled foods. Health authorities and CDC inspect response and reinforce Chloramin B availability to prevent community transmission and mosquito-borne diseases.

article.articleHeadline: WHO begins trials of Ervebo vaccine in Ebola-affected DRC
article.articleSummary: WHO begins trials of the Ervebo vaccine in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), targeting Ituri province where 20,000 doses are allocated for a research vaccination programme as part of 70,000 doses available to DRC authorities for outbreak response and related research. The trial seeks to determine if Ervebo, previously highly effective against Ebola Zaire, offers meaningful protection against Ebola Bundibugyo virus, which is currently driving transmission in the DRC. The outbreak was first declared an emergency after several Ituri cases around May and has since spread to seven provinces. As of now, more than 7,600 confirmed Ebola infections have been reported, with over 3,670 deaths. The vaccine’s effectiveness against Bundibugyo remains unknown.

article.articleHeadline: Clogged drains, vacant plots pose challenge to anti-dengue drive in Patiala - The Tribune
article.articleSummary: Patiala, India is contending with dengue as clogged drains, vacant plots, and stagnant water hinder anti-dengue efforts. The Tribune found choked Badi Nadi, Choti Nadi, and Jacob Drain near the Municipal Corporation building with weeds and standing sewage, creating mosquito-breeding sites. During door-to-door checks, officials inspected water containers, coolers, flower pots, and refrigerator trays; dengue larvae were detected in several homes, destroyed on the spot, with challans issued. The district administration directed vacant-plot owners to remove garbage, drain stagnant water, and secure properties, with penalties for non-compliance. District Magistrate Dr Himanshu Aggarwal urged residents to report unhygienic vacant plots and open dumps via WhatsApp at 95920-03366. Senior Deputy Mayor Harinder Kohli urged residents to empty and dry water-holding containers weekly, emphasizing public participation as weather remains conducive to the spread of vector-borne diseases.
