article.articleHeadline: Chikungunya crônica: por que as dores podem durar anos | A TARDE
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Chronic chikungunya: why the pains may last for years | A TARDE.
article.articleSummary: Bahia, Brazil, reports 9,990 probable chikungunya cases from January 1 to September 15, 2026, a 364.9% rise from the same period in 2025, with 2 confirmed deaths and cases in 201 municipalities. Chikungunya evolves through three phases: acute (5–14 days), post-acute (15–90 days), and chronic (>90 days). While many recover after the acute phase, a substantial proportion develop persistent arthralgia—severe joint pain with swelling and, in some, deformities. Chronic evolution is linked to individual predisposition to autoimmune or rheumatic diseases, with the virus acting as a trigger; more than half of arthralgia cases may become chronic. In advanced stages, symptoms affect large and small joints, limbs, and may include musculoskeletal issues and, in severe cases, neurological manifestations (encephalitis, myelitis, Guillain-Barré), plus mental-health impacts. Treatment is symptomatic; corticosteroids and immunosuppressants may be used in subacute/chronic phases, with physiotherapy as indicated. Coinfections with dengue or other arboviruses are possible; diagnosis relies on clinical assessment and laboratory tests when needed.

article.articleHeadline: Kasus Influenza A Lagi Naik, Kenali Beda Gejala dengan Flu Biasa
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Influenza A cases are rising again; learn how its symptoms differ from the seasonal flu.
article.articleSummary: Influenza A is rising again in Jakarta, Indonesia, with subtypes including H1N1 and H3N2 driving ongoing outbreaks. While Influenza B causes local outbreaks, A-type strains can trigger larger waves and severe illness, especially in infants and young children. Symptoms often appear abruptly and include cough, runny nose, sore throat, fever, headache, muscle aches, fatigue, and sometimes vomiting or diarrhea. Diagnosis uses rapid nasal or throat swabs; positive results are treated with antivirals such as oseltamivir, zanamivir, peramivir, and baloxavir marboxil (Xofluza, FDA approved since 2018). Contagiousness starts 1 day before symptoms and lasts about 5 days, longer in severe cases. Prevention centers on annual vaccination, hand hygiene, covering coughs, avoiding crowds, and staying home with fever. High-risk groups—babies, toddlers, and older adults—should seek care promptly if symptoms worsen.

article.articleHeadline: 登革热不是南方"专利"了？北京本地风险不大，"出行防蚊"要重视
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Is Dengue Fever No Longer Exclusive to the South? Beijing's Local Risk Is Low, but Travelers Should Take Mosquito Precautions.
article.articleSummary: Beijing currently has low local risk for dengue fever, but imported cases sustain potential transmission. As of August 2026, Beijing reported 14 dengue cases, all imported from overseas. Dengue fever, chikungunya fever, and Zika virus disease are mosquitoborne concerns; the main Beijing vector is Aedes albopictus, not a major driver of local outbreaks. Nevertheless, importation can spark secondary cases via travel with dengue-affected countries. Risk areas for residents include: National Day trips to southern China when vector density peaks; travel to Southeast Asia (Thailand, Indonesia, Malaysia); and outdoor time in Beijing parks, where Aedes albopictus bites at dawn and dusk. Prevention emphasizes outdoor wear (long sleeves, light colors), repellents with DEET, picaridin, or IR3535; interior measures include intact screens and removing standing water. If after travel fever with headaches, eye/joint pains, or redness on face/neck/chest occurs, seek medical advice and report travel history.

article.articleHeadline: 孙志洋督导检查蚊媒传染病防控和安全生产工作
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Sun Zhiyang supervises and inspects the prevention and control of mosquito-borne infectious diseases and production safety work.
article.articleSummary: Guangzhou Mayor Sun Zhiyang inspected Baiyun District on Sept 21 to oversee prevention of mosquito-borne infectious diseases and safety production ahead of the Mid-Autumn Festival and National Day holidays. He visited Shimen Street’s Ya Gang Economic Union to review environmental sanitation and mosquito-control work, urged continuous cleanliness campaigns, strict gatekeeping, and removal of mosquito breeding sites in vacant houses, rooftops, and back alleys. At the San Yuanli Village urban-renewal site, he checked safety measures and observed smart construction demonstrations, stressing strict safety accountability on construction sites, precise protections, and scheduling to ensure timely relocation housing. He called for heightened risk prevention in key sectors—large commercial complexes, scenic spots, hotels—along with construction, road traffic, and town gas safety, eliminating hazards early. Emphasizing on-duty leadership and the use of AI and big data to bolster monitoring and response, he prioritized holiday traffic management and culturally themed activities to sustain consumption and safety.

article.articleHeadline: 4 Cebu provincial hospitals prepare to offer TB infection blood tests
article.articleSummary: Four Cebu provincial hospitals—Capitol-run in Balamban, Bogo, Carcar, and Danao—prepare to offer Interferon-Gamma Release Assay (IGRA) blood tests for TB infection, in a WHO and DOH-7 Central Visayas collaboration. IGRA detects TB infection from a single blood draw, unlike skin tests that require follow-up visits; samples are sent to laboratories for analysis, and a positive result does not by itself indicate active TB. Those with positive results will undergo medical evaluation and may receive chest X-rays or sputum testing. The program targets high‑risk individuals and close household contacts to identify latent TB and guide preventive treatment. Cebu’s expansion follows WHO Philippines discussions to strengthen TB testing; the Philippines ranks third globally for TB burden (about 6.8% of world cases) with ~500 new cases per 100,000 people in 2024.

article.articleHeadline: Congo rolls out Canadian-developed vaccine to fight Ebola outbreak
article.articleSummary: Congolese authorities launch Merck’s Ervebo vaccine to shield 20,000 front-line health workers in Ituri and North Kivu amid a Bundibugyo Ebola virus outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo. The outbreak has infected more than 7,670 and killed nearly 3,700, making it the worst Ebola epidemic in Congo’s history and spreading faster than the world’s biggest outbreak, which killed more than 11,300 people in Liberia, Guinea and Sierra Leone from 2014 to 2016. Ervebo, licensed for the Zaire virus, has unknown effectiveness against Bundibugyo; a nine-to-twelve month study will assess protection in a large-scale campaign. Preliminary data from a Winnipeg National Microbiology Laboratory animal study showed Ervebo protected ferrets against Bundibugyo. No proven Bundibugyo vaccine exists; other candidates (including Moderna’s) are in early trials, while Canada’s past funding gaps and travel restrictions linked to Congo are noted.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ、エボラ出血熱流行対策としてカナダ開発ワクチンを展開
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で7,670人感染・約3,700人死亡という同国史上最悪のエボラ(ブンディブギョ株)流行が進行中であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: 記事では過去の西アフリカ(リベリア・ギニア・シエラレオネ)2014-2016年流行との比較のみで、現行流行の国際的拡大は明記されていないため『不明』とした。ブンディブギョ株に対するワクチンの有効性は未証明で、大規模実地試験中。

article.articleHeadline: Kasus ISPA Jakarta Naik di Tengah Wabah Influenza A
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: ARI cases in Jakarta rise amid Influenza A outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Acute Respiratory Infection (ARI) cases in Jakarta are rising amid a national Influenza A outbreak. DKI Jakarta Health Office reports ARI cases up about 15.7 percent based on Puskesmas data, while noting ARI can be caused by multiple pathogens and not solely by Influenza A. Hospital bed occupancy at referral facilities remains stable and SIRS Online shows no significant surge in visits. National surveillance indicates Influenza A positivity reached 51 percent in week 36, with the surge dominated by Influenza A strains now circulating as seasonal flu. Most affected are preschool and elementary school children presenting with high fever. Officials urge continued protection measures: hygiene, hand washing with soap, masking when sick or in crowded places, cough etiquette, and good nutrition, hydration, and rest. Seek care at puskesmas or hospitals if fever persists beyond 2-3 days or if shortness of breath occurs; avoid panic.

triage.headline_ja: インフルエンザA流行の中、ジャカルタでARI(急性呼吸器感染症)症例が増加
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザAによるARI症例増加であり、病床占有率や来院数に大きな増加は見られず、公的機関も過度な混乱を避けるよう呼びかけているのみで、通常の季節流行の範囲内と判断される。
triage.notes: 季節性インフルエンザA(H1N1等)の流行によるARI増加であり、当局は病床占有率が安定していることを確認、パニックを避けるよう呼びかけている。特段の異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。

article.articleHeadline: Dengue prevention: GCC finds mosquito breeding sources in 4,192 houses
article.articleSummary: As of 21 September 2026, Greater Chennai Corporation (GCC) reports dengue prevention efforts locating mosquito breeding sources in 4,192 houses in Tondiarpet Zone (Bharathiyar Street and Sundarar Street near Erukkancheri Main Road). A total of 3,697 field workers are deployed for mosquito control, with each worker visiting 80–100 houses daily to identify and remove breeding sources and raise resident awareness. Medicines for fever treatment are stocked at 140 Urban Primary Health Centres, 16 Urban Community Health Centres, and 200 Urban Health and Wellness Centres. Medical officers have received training on dengue and fever management. Fever surveillance data are being collected from hospitals, clinics, laboratories, training centres, households and government centres to strengthen surveillance, and fever patients discharged from hospitals are monitored for 3 days.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱予防:GCCが4,192軒の家屋で蚊の発生源を発見
triage.triage_reason: 毎年恒例のデング熱予防対策活動の報告であり、異常な流行拡大や重症例増加を示す情報はなく、行政の通常業務として管理されている。
triage.notes: 地元自治体（GCC）による通常のデング熱対策・サーベイランス活動の報告記事。感染者数や重症度、異常な増加傾向についての具体的データは記載されておらず、季節性の予防対策として管理下にある事案と判断される。

article.articleHeadline: Ministers, MLAs told to oversee dengue prevention measures in educational institutions
article.articleSummary: Dengue and other vector-borne disease prevention efforts in educational institutions across Tamil Nadu are being overseen as of 22 September 2026, directed by Chief Minister Joseph Vijay. In Madurai, Higher Education Minister P Viswanathan said all Ministers and MLAs of the TVK government have been instructed to visit campuses in their jurisdictions, supervise disinfection, and mobilize mass cleaning drives to shield students from dengue and related illnesses. The initiative emphasizes disinfection and community cleaning to curb transmission in schools and colleges, though no case counts, laboratory confirmations, or infection sources are cited. The report also notes ongoing governance matters, with the Chief Minister holding meetings with the Tamil Nadu Governor about appointing Vice-Chancellors, indicating parallel administrative concerns alongside public health measures. No details on imported or exported cases are provided.

triage.headline_ja: 教育機関でのデング熱予防対策を大臣・州議会議員が監督するよう指示
triage.triage_reason: デング熱は当該地域の風土病であり、症例数や異常な増加を示す情報がなく、通常の予防対策実施の報道であるため。
triage.notes: 症例数・検査確定・感染源などの具体的データは示されておらず、通常の予防的行政対応に関する記事である。

article.articleHeadline: 추석 연휴 일본 여행객 어쩌나... '이 병' 환자 10년 만에 최다
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: What will happen to Japanese travelers during the Chuseok holiday... the number of patients with "this disease" is at a 10-year high.
article.articleSummary: Measles in Japan reached 549 cases by late August 2026, the highest in a decade, prompting travel caution for Chuseok. Measles spreads airborne; infection risk exceeds 90% after exposure. Symptoms: fever, cough, runny nose, conjunctivitis, and rash; infants and pregnant women face pneumonia or encephalitis. Travelers should verify MMR vaccination status before departure. Influenza season in Japan is advancing, starting in week 34—about five weeks earlier than usual; practice hand hygiene and masking when symptomatic. Dengue remains endemic in parts of Southeast Asia; use mosquito repellent every 3–4 hours and wear light-colored long sleeves; seek free dengue testing if fever or headache develops after exposure. In China, avian influenza precautions advise avoiding live poultry markets; travelers crossing Guangdong, Guangxi, Sichuan, Yunnan, Jiangxi, Chongqing, or Tianjin must complete Q-CODE or health forms. Korean travelers during Chuseok favor Japan, led by Osaka, with Fukuoka and Tokyo next; Danang and Shanghai also popular.

triage.headline_ja: 秋夕連休の日本旅行はどうする…「この病気」患者が10年ぶりの最多
triage.triage_reason: 記事は日本の麻疹流行・インフルエンザ早期流行・東南アジアのデング熱・中国での鳥インフルエンザ一般注意を旅行者向けにまとめた総説的内容であり、対象国リストに該当する国での新規具体的アウトブレイク報告はない。
triage.notes: 主な疾患（麻疹・インフルエンザ）の発生国は日本であり、対象国リストに含まれない。中国の鳥インフルエンザ言及は生鳥市場回避などの一般的渡航注意であり、具体的な新規症例・アウトブレイク報告ではないため verified_locations から除外した。ベトナム（ダナン）は人気旅行先としての言及のみで疾患発生地ではない。

article.articleHeadline: RD del Congo comienza campaña con nueva vacuna ante la crisis por el ébola - teleSUR
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC begins vaccination campaign with a new vaccine amid the Ebola crisis
article.articleSummary: DR Congo launches a vaccination campaign amid an Ebola outbreak that has caused 3,639 deaths and more than 7,541 infections since May, the deadliest on record for the country. WHO and Doctors Without Borders began a study to test the Ervebo vaccine in Ituri and North Kivu—the outbreak's epicenters—starting Sept 18–19. The effort targets 20,000 frontline health workers over 9–12 months to reduce transmission to caregivers. Ervebo is not designed to combat the Bundibugyo strain driving this crisis, though some international reporting notes possible cross-protection against Zaire and Bundibugyo strains. Muyembe noted that in Mongwalu unvaccinated people developed severe disease, reinforcing the vaccination effort. INRB Director-General Dr. Jean-Jacques Muyembe said a substantial number of doses are available in Bunia (Ituri), and vaccination is to extend to Ituri after starting in Tshopo. Some treatments for Bundibugyo exist but remain unproven; emphasis remains on primary care.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、エボラ危機の中で新ワクチンによる接種活動を開始
triage.triage_reason: 5月以降の死者3,639人・感染者7,541人超という同国史上最悪のエボラ流行であり、深刻性・異常性ともにIHR基準に複数該当するためフルRRAへ進むべき事案。
triage.notes: 現行使用中のErvebo（rVSV-ZEBOV）は今回の流行株であるBundibugyo株を主対象としておらず、有効性に不確実性が残る点は今後の評価で重視すべき。国境を越えた拡大の有無・貿易制限措置の有無は記事内で言及がなく不明。

article.articleHeadline: 'Super Flu' Terdeteksi di 13 Provinsi, IDAI Wanti-wanti Risikonya pada Anak
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 'Super Flu' Detected in 13 Provinces, IDAI Warns of the Risk to Children.
article.articleSummary: Influenza A H3N2 subclade K, nicknamed 'Super Flu', has been detected in 13 Indonesian provinces, with rising activity in East Java amid Southeast Asia transmission per WHO surveillance through week 35, 2026. The Indonesian Pediatric Association (IDAI) warns children are most vulnerable to influenza and its complications. Globally, children aged 0–17 have about twice the risk of symptomatic infection versus adults. Early RT-PCR confirmation and timely antiviral therapy with oseltamivir within 48 hours of symptom onset are emphasized, along with annual vaccination and nonpharmaceutical measures. WHO Western Pacific Region data (Sept 2025–Aug 2026) show escalating SEA influenza activity; Indonesia’s sentinel monitoring shows fluctuations with peaks late 2025 and mid-2026. About 5% of infected children require hospitalization; 80% of hospitalized are under 2 years, and 50% under 6 months. Children can shed virus from 24 hours before to 10 days after onset, warranting home isolation and precautions.

triage.headline_ja: 『スーパーフル』が13州で検出、インドネシア小児科学会が子どもへのリスクに警鐘
triage.triage_reason: 新型インフルエンザA(H3N2) subclade K『Super Flu』がインドネシア13州で検出され、東南アジア全域で感染が拡大中。小児科学会が公式に警告を発しており、社会的・行政的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 発生地域にUnited States、American Samoaが含まれるが、記事本文はインドネシアにおける新規インフルエンザサブクレードの検出と拡大に焦点を当てているため、これらは除外した。

article.articleHeadline: मौसम बदलते ही बढ़ा संक्रमण, ठीक होने पर भी लंबे समय तक हो रही खांसी और कमजोरी
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Infection rises with the changing seasons; even after recovery, a prolonged cough and weakness persist.
article.articleSummary: As of September 22, 2026, Bilaspur, Chhattisgarh reports a rise in viral infections and seasonal illnesses with weather changes. Patients commonly endure prolonged mild cough and weakness after recovery. Ayurvedic doctor Aastha Mishra advises that while seasons can’t be controlled, diet and simple precautions can lessen infection impact: eat fresh meals, avoid stale and junk food, and stay away from contaminated water. She stresses drinking clean water and, if possible, boiling it before cooling. For home relief, she suggests saunth (dry ginger) decoction—boil saunth in water, strain, and take in the morning, optionally with turmeric and jaggery. However, Mishra cautions that such remedies are not a substitute for medical treatment, and persistent or worsening symptoms require professional medical advice.

triage.headline_ja: 季節の変わり目で感染症が増加、回復後も長引く咳とだるさ
triage.triage_reason: 季節性のウイルス感染症に関する一般的な健康啓発記事であり、異常性・国際的拡大リスク・社会的関心のいずれも認められない。

article.articleHeadline: 5 dấu hiệu sốt xuất huyết dễ nhầm với cúm, sốt virus
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 5 Signs of Dengue Fever That Are Easily Mistaken for Flu or Viral Fever
article.articleSummary: September 2026 in Vietnam saw ongoing dengue activity across multiple provinces, alongside seasonal influenza and other viral respiratory illnesses affecting children and adults. Dengue begins with high fever up to 40°C lasting 2–7 days, plus headache, retro-orbital pain, muscle–joint aches, nausea, and sometimes rash; fever can subside temporarily but may herald plasma leakage, shock, bleeding, or organ injury. Influenza-like illness starts abruptly with fever, chills, fatigue, sore throat, cough and runny nose; most cases resolve in about a week. Distinguishing clues include cough and nasal symptoms for flu, while retro-orbital pain, rash, or bleeding can suggest dengue, though diagnosis requires medical assessment and testing. Dengue is transmitted by Aedes aegypti; prevention includes vector control and protective measures. The Qdenga dengue vaccine is available in Vietnam for ages 4+ (two doses, 3 months apart), with schedule to be completed before pregnancy if planned. Annual influenza vaccination uses four brands and reduces infection, hospitalization, and death. Do not initiate IV fluids or NSAIDs without medical indication.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱とインフルエンザ・ウイルス熱を見分けにくい5つの兆候
triage.triage_reason: 季節性のデング熱・インフルエンザに関する一般的な健康啓発記事であり、異常な流行拡大や重篤化の兆候は報告されていない。
triage.notes: 内容は季節性のデング熱とインフルエンザの症状鑑別、ワクチン情報を扱う一般啓発記事であり、緊急性のあるアウトブレイク情報ではない。

article.articleHeadline: IDAI Ungkap Alasan Anak Lebih Rentan Tertular Influenza Tipe A dan B
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: IDAI Reveals Why Children Are More Susceptible to Contracting Influenza Type A and B
article.articleSummary: As of 22 September 2026, Indonesian pediatric health group IDAI warns that children are more susceptible to influenza A and B than adults due to smaller body size and developing immune systems. In Jakarta, Prof. Anggraini Alam notes that children, being shorter, are likelier to inhale fine droplets when adults speak, sneeze, or cough. Highest risk groups include children under 5, those in daycares with poor ventilation, children with neurological or developmental disorders, and residents of long‑term care facilities or crowded settings. Symptoms in children appear rapidly and can be more severe: high fever, nasal congestion or discharge, sore throat, extreme fatigue, and loss of appetite, with recovery potentially lasting weeks. Infected or immunocompromised children may shed virus longer. Prevention emphasizes PHBS (handwashing, nutrition, hydration), vaccination, regular sunlight exposure, good ventilation, and avoiding crowded, air‑conditioned spaces. Paracetamol may relieve symptoms; antibiotics are not recommended since influenza is viral, and environmental cleanliness reduces surface transmission.

triage.headline_ja: IDAI、子どもがインフルエンザA型・B型に感染しやすい理由を明らかに
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザに関する一般的な啓発・注意喚起記事であり、異常なアウトブレイクや公衆衛生上の緊急性を示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 記事は季節性インフルエンザに対する小児の脆弱性に関する専門家の一般的な健康啓発情報であり、特定のアウトブレイクや感染急増を報告するものではない。

article.articleHeadline: State directs PMC to intensify vector-borne disease surveillance
article.articleSummary: Maharashtra's Pune Municipal Corporation (PMC) was directed by the state public health department to intensify vector-borne disease surveillance, focusing on migrant workers and labour camps amid rising dengue and chikungunya. A training session led by state entomologist Dr. Mahendra Jagtap instructed PMC to conduct rapid malaria tests at labour camps and start treatment immediately on a positive result, without waiting for lab confirmation. In September, PMC logged 334 suspected dengue cases and 21 confirmed dengue up to September 19, plus six chikungunya cases that month. For the year, 1,489 suspected dengue, 68 confirmed dengue, 27 chikungunya, and one malaria have been reported. The city recorded 2,246 mosquito-breeding sites. Officials will enhance dengue prevention in housing societies and strengthen mosquito-control and IEC activities at construction sites and labour camps for early detection and treatment.

triage.headline_ja: 州がプネー市当局(PMC)に媒介生物感染症のサーベイランス強化を指示
triage.triage_reason: デング熱・チクングニア熱の季節的増加に対する行政対応であり、通常の公衆衛生対策の範囲内。IHR基準は該当なしだが、媒介生物感染症の拡大リスクとして経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: 季節性のデング熱・チクングニア熱の増加に対する州レベルの予防的サーベイランス強化措置であり、深刻な公衆衛生上の異常事態を示すものではない。移民労働者・労働キャンプが焦点。

article.articleHeadline: Rio de Janeiro confirma caso de raiva animal após cão ter contato com morcego
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rio de Janeiro confirms an animal rabies case after a dog came into contact with a bat.
article.articleSummary: Rabies case confirmed in a domestic dog in the Santa Cruz neighborhood, Western zone of Rio de Janeiro. The urban dog had direct contact with bats, deteriorated clinically, and was euthanized. Contacts identified by municipal surveillance received post-exposure prophylaxis and are being monitored; no human infections reported. SES-RJ issued an epidemiological alert and emphasizes maintaining up-to-date vaccination for dogs and cats. The annual pet immunization campaign is scheduled for Saturday, September 26, 2026, to curb viral circulation in urban areas. Rabies is a fatal viral zoonosis that attacks the central nervous system, with near 100% case fatality once symptoms appear. Public health guidance includes preventing pets from roaming, avoiding handling bats (live or dead), and promptly washing wounds with soap and water and seeking urgent medical care for vaccination or rabies immunoglobulin after exposure.

triage.headline_ja: リオデジャネイロでコウモリと接触した犬の動物狂犬病症例を確認
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・リオデジャネイロで犬1匹の狂犬病感染が確認されたが、人間への感染はなく、地元衛生当局（SES-RJ）が接触者への暴露後予防措置とワクチン接種キャンペーンで適切に対応している単発事例。
triage.notes: 動物由来（コウモリ→犬）の狂犬病症例で人への感染報告なし。地元自治体による接触者追跡・暴露後予防措置とペットワクチン接種キャンペーンで管理されている。ブラジルは対象国リストに含まれるためverified_locationsに記載。

article.articleHeadline: 48岁男梅毒第2期现非典症状 医生：泰年轻病例续增加 - 国际 - 国际拼盘
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 48-year-old man with secondary syphilis presents SARS-like symptoms; doctors say younger cases in Thailand are continuing to rise.
article.articleSummary: 48-year-old man with secondary syphilis in Bangkok, Thailand, developed a Jarisch-Herxheimer reaction after intramuscular penicillin injections, not a penicillin allergy. At Vichaiyut Hospital, the HIV-positive patient on antiretroviral therapy for 11 years presented with trunk, arm, and thigh rash and mild itching for about a week; he had unprotected sex two months earlier. Serology confirmed syphilis by two methods. Within about six hours of treatment, fever and body aches appeared, and the rash worsened; symptoms resolved within 24 hours after acetaminophen. Clinicians explained that the Jarisch-Herxheimer reaction results from rapid spirochete killing releasing inflammatory substances, typically occurring 2–8 hours after treatment. They noted rising syphilis infections in Thailand, especially among younger people, and advised regular STI screening for high-risk groups, even when palms and soles are not affected.

triage.headline_ja: 48歳男性の第2期梅毒でSARS様症状発現、医師『タイでは若年層の症例が増加続く』
triage.triage_reason: 個別患者の臨床事例（治療反応としてのヤーリッシュ・ヘルクスハイマー反応）であり、公衆衛生上の緊急性や急性の感染拡大リスクは認められない。梅毒の若年層増加傾向は言及されているが、具体的な集団発生やアウトブレイクではない。
triage.notes: 記事は個別の臨床ケース報告であり、梅毒治療後のヤーリッシュ・ヘルクスハイマー反応の解説が主題。タイにおける若年層の梅毒症例増加傾向への言及はあるが、具体的な統計や公衆衛生上の対応措置は記載されていない。

article.articleHeadline: ผู้ป่วยชาย ติดHIV กินยาต้าน 11ปี คุมได้ดี ไปมีเพศสัมพันธ์ไม่ป้องกัน พบเป็นซิฟิลิส
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Male patient with HIV on antiretroviral therapy for 11 years, well controlled, had unprotected sex and was diagnosed with syphilis.
article.articleSummary: 48-year-old Thai man with HIV on stable antiretroviral therapy (11 years) presented with a trunk, arm, and thigh erythematous rash after unprotected sex two months earlier. Serology confirmed secondary syphilis: reactive RPR 1:32 (previously negative 10 and 7 years ago) and positive treponemal antibody, diagnosing secondary syphilis with HIV coinfection. Exam showed no fever, no hand/foot rash, and no lymphadenopathy, though the rash was pruritic. Treatment: benzathine penicillin G 1.2 million units IM in each buttock (total 2.4 million units). Six hours post-injection, fever and malaise with apparent worsening of the rash occurred; paracetamol provided relief and symptoms improved within 24 hours. This transient worsening is Jarisch-Herxheimer reaction, typically 2–8 hours after the first penicillin dose. The article notes rising syphilis in Thailand, especially among youth.

triage.headline_ja: HIV陽性の男性患者、11年間の抗レトロウイルス療法でコントロール良好も、無防備な性交渉後に梅毒と診断
triage.triage_reason: 個別症例報告であり、公衆衛生上の緊急性や異常性、国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 記事はタイにおける梅毒の若年層での増加傾向に言及しているが、本症例自体は個別臨床報告であり、公衆衛生上のシグナルとしての緊急性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: 聯馥食品「法國乾酪」驗出大腸桿菌！2批不合格須退運
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Lianfu Foods' "French Cheese" tests positive for Escherichia coli! Two batches fail quality standards and must be recalled.
article.articleSummary: Taiwan’s FDA reported on 2026-09-22 border inspections of imported foods, flagging several noncompliances. Escherichia coli was detected in two batches of Lianfu Foods’ French cheese; samples exceeded safety limits, requiring recall and disposal of 2.16 kg and 2.40 kg. Indonesian shipments (three batches: cassava chips and Millennium cookies) contained prohibited saccharin and cyclamate; total 1,100 kg, 1,325 kg and 1,000 kg returned or destroyed. Other imports include Mainland China fresh white radish with fenpropathrin at 0.002 mg/kg (above 0.001 mg/kg); 26,600 kg must be recalled or destroyed. Japan brown algae contained inorganic arsenic 3.3 mg/kg (limit 1.0 mg/kg); 1 kg affected. Thailand dried cabbage with saccharin 0.01 mg/kg (16,800 kg); Sri Lanka black sesame with pendimethalin 0.05 mg/kg and glyphosate 0.13 mg/kg (90,000 kg); Japan pepper with 達特南 2.0 mg/kg and 氟芬隆 0.28 mg/kg (2.5 kg). France cheeses over six months show 0.5% noncompliance; enhanced sampling 9/22–10/21.

triage.headline_ja: 聯馥食品「フランスチーズ」から大腸菌検出！不合格2ロットは返送・廃棄へ
triage.triage_reason: 台湾の食品輸入検査における通常の国境検疫報告であり、公衆衛生上の緊急性や異常な感染拡大の兆候は認められない。
triage.notes: 本記事は台湾FDAによる輸入食品の国境検査結果報告であり、大腸菌や残留農薬・添加物基準超過が複数の輸入品（フランス産チーズ、インドネシア産食品、中国産大根、日本産海藻・コショウ、タイ産キャベツ、スリランカ産ゴマ）で検出されたことを伝える通常の規制業務報告。感染症のヒト-ヒト感染や公衆衛生危機を示す内容ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Minsalud y PNUD evalúan Programa de Malaria en Amazonas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ministry of Health and UNDP evaluate Malaria Program in Amazonas.
article.articleSummary: Malaria program in Amazonas state is being evaluated by Venezuela's Ministry of Health (Minsalud) and the United Nations Development Programme (UNDP). In a session at the State Health Directorate, officials reviewed training and supervisory results from the malaria program activated in Amazonas, highlighting field support and progress in prevention, treatment, and effective malaria control in the state's tropical regions. Janeida García, Director of Environmental Health, underscored the strategic impact of the training plan in boosting operational capacities of regional health workers and strengthening the technical and logistical response for malaria control and epidemiological management across communities. The meeting, attended by Edinson Sotto (Minsalud), Jorman Blanco (Malaria Program Coordinator), and José Antonio Kelly (UNDP), reinforces strategic partnerships to improve health coverage and epidemiological surveillance in high-vulnerability areas, ensuring timely, effective responses for Amazonas residents.

triage.headline_ja: 保健省とUNDP、アマゾナス州のマラリア対策プログラムを評価
triage.triage_reason: ベネズエラ・アマゾナス州における既存マラリア対策プログラムの定例評価・研修に関する行政報告であり、異常な流行拡大や重症例増加などの兆候は見られない。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はベネズエラ・アマゾナス州のマラリア対策プログラム評価であり、対象国リストにベネズエラは含まれない。発生地域にブラジルが挙がっているが記事本文では言及されておらず、主題国でもないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: What is scrub typhus
article.articleSummary: Death of a Government Kilpauk Medical College Hospital student in Chennai on Sept 18, 2026 from scrub typhus highlights its burden; Anna University has begun screening students for scrub typhus alongside dengue and leptospirosis. Scrub typhus is caused by Orientia tsutsugamushi and transmitted by chiggers, not mosquitoes. It is now the most common infectious cause of acute encephalitis syndrome (AES) in southern India, supported by a 2025 study of 587 children from Karnataka, Andhra Pradesh and Tamil Nadu. A 2021 systematic review found scrub typhus accounted for 25.3% of AUFI and community seroprevalence of 34.2%. Symptoms appear within about 10 days and include fever, chills, headache, body aches, eschar, mental changes, lymphadenopathy, and rash. Diagnosis via IgM ELISA or PCR; treatment with doxycycline or azithromycin—combination therapy reduced complications versus monotherapy (NEJM 2023). No vaccine; prevention focuses on avoiding chigger bites and reducing habitats; early diagnosis reduces mortality; surveillance needed.

triage.headline_ja: ツツガムシ病とは何か
triage.triage_reason: 南インドで既知の風土病であるツツガムシ病に関する解説記事であり、単発の学生死亡例を契機とした啓発内容。新規アウトブレイクや異常な増加を示す情報はなく、シグナルとしての緊急性は低い。
triage.notes: 記事は特定の集団発生を報じるものではなく、ツツガムシ病の疫学・臨床的解説が中心。大学でのスクリーニング開始は地域レベルの通常対応であり、国際的リスク評価の対象とはならない。

article.articleHeadline: Update Terkini Influenza RI: H1N1Pdm09 Mendominasi, 'Super Flu' Ada di 13 Provinsi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Latest Update on Influenza in Indonesia: H1N1pdm09 Dominates, the 'Super Flu' Is Detected in 13 Provinces.
article.articleSummary: Influenza activity in Indonesia remains low overall in week 36 (as of Sept 19, 2026) despite a rise in the proportion of positive specimens. Of 185 samples tested, 86 were positive: 76 were influenza A(H1N1)pdm09, 8 were influenza A(H3N2), and 2 were influenza B (Victoria lineage). About 42% of detected cases occurred in children aged 0–4 years. The A(H3N2) Subclade K, nicknamed the 'Super Flu,' was detected in 13 provinces, with the highest proportions in Jawa Timur (East Java) and Kalimantan Selatan (South Kalimantan) at 24% each, followed by DKI Jakarta at 14.8%. Data come from 13 B/BLKM laboratories, nine hospitals, and the Health Biol­ogy Laboratory and are provisional. Primary care surveillance showed influenza-like illness at 0.40% of total visits, up from 0.31% the prior week, with overall influenza activity still categorized as low.

triage.headline_ja: インドネシアのインフルエンザ最新情報：H1N1pdm09が優勢、『スーパーフル』が13州で検出
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザの通常サーベイランス報告であり、全体活動レベルは低いとされている。H3N2サブクレードKへの言及はあるが、重症度・異常性を示す具体的根拠はなく、社会的関心の高まりも記載されていない。
triage.notes: 『スーパーフル』という呼称はメディア表現であり、季節性インフルエンザA(H3N2)サブクレードKを指す。全体的な活動レベルは低く、通常の季節性サーベイランスの範囲内と判断される。

article.articleHeadline: Kasus Influenza A Mulai Melonjak, Komisi E DPRD Bakal Panggil Dinkes Jatim
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Influenza A cases begin to surge; Commission E of the East Java DPRD will summon the East Java Health Office.
article.articleSummary: Influenza A cases surge in East Java, with reports from several Surabaya hospitals triggering action by the East Java Regional Legislature. Commission E of DPRD Jatim says it will summon the East Java Health Office (Dinas Kesehatan) to clarify the real situation, causes, and implications for health services, especially for children. DPRD chair Sri Untari Bisowarno emphasized the need for a precise briefing amid circulating social media posts about rising Influenza A. The vice governor, Emil Elestianto Dardak, said on a press briefing that a visit to Malang showed a downward trend, but other districts show increases; hospitals should stay vigilant and report any capacity strain. Influenza A is a viral infection affecting the respiratory tract (nose, throat, lungs). As of 21 September 2026, the article does not provide case counts or laboratory-confirmed outbreak details.

triage.headline_ja: インフルエンザA症例が急増、東ジャワ州議会第E委員会が保健局を招集へ
triage.triage_reason: インフルエンザA症例増加が報告され地元議会が対応を検討しているが、症例数や検査確認情報がなく、季節性インフルエンザの範囲か判断できないため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 症例数や検査確認情報が不足しており、通常の季節性インフルエンザ流行との区別ができない。地元議会・行政の関心は高いが国際的懸念には至っていない。

article.articleHeadline: Kasus Influenza A Meningkat, Apa Bedanya dengan Flu Biasa? Kenali Gejalanya
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rising Influenza A Cases: How Is It Different from Regular Flu? Know Its Symptoms.
article.articleSummary: Influenza activity in Indonesia rose in week 36 of 2026 (as of Sep 19), with 86 of 185 tested specimens positive (~46%), up from 35% the prior week. Surveillance shows predominantly Influenza A, especially A(H1N1)pdm09 (76 cases), followed by A(H3N2) (8 cases) and Influenza B/Victoria (2 cases). Despite the uptick, the Ministry of Health still classifies national influenza activity as low and controlled. Influenza A is caused by influenza A viruses; subtypes circulating in humans include A(H1N1)pdm09 and A(H3N2). Flu (common cold) is typically caused by rhinovirus and presents more gradually with runny nose, nasal congestion, sneezing, and sore throat, while fever tends to be milder or absent. Influenza A tends to abrupt onset with fever or chills, cough, myalgia, headache, and fatigue; diagnosis may require influenza testing, especially for severe illness or high-risk groups.

triage.headline_ja: インフルエンザA型の症例増加、通常の風邪との違いは？症状を知る
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザの検査陽性率上昇を報じる一般向け健康情報記事であり、インドネシア保健省も国内の流行状況を「低く管理下にある」と評価しているため、緊急性・異常性は認められない。
triage.notes: 季節性インフルエンザ（主にA(H1N1)pdm09）の通常サーベイランス報告。保健省は流行状況を低・管理下と分類しており、異常な公衆衛生事象とは判断されない。

article.articleHeadline: В Конго на добровольцах начались испытания новой вакцины от Эболы
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In Congo, trials of a new Ebola vaccine have begun with volunteers.
article.articleSummary: First volunteers in Bunia, Ituri Province, Democratic Republic of Congo, received the Ebola vaccine Ervebo. The trials plan to enroll about 20,000 volunteers over 9–12 months to assess protective efficacy against the Bundibugyo strain responsible for the current outbreak. Frontline health workers and other frontline staff are prioritized, with Ervebo used while parallel studies seek a vaccine specifically approved for this outbreak. The Ministry of Health spokesperson Roger Kamba said the strategy aims to defend those on the front lines. National Institute of Public Health data show 3,639 deaths and 7,541 infections, with 1,823 recoveries, as the virus has spread to seven provinces. In August, Congo allocated about 70,000 doses of Ervebo.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラワクチンの治験がボランティアを対象に開始
triage.triage_reason: DRCで進行中のエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）流行が7州に拡大し、死者3,639人・感染7,541人という深刻な公衆衛生被害が確認されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 既に大規模な流行（7州、死者3,639人）が進行中であり、ワクチン治験開始のニュースだが、既存アウトブレイクの深刻度が高いためピックアップ判定とした。

article.articleHeadline: 男梅毒第2期现非典症状 泰医：年轻病例续增加 | 中國報 China Press
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Secondary syphilis in men presents with atypical symptoms; Thai doctors say cases among young people continue to rise.
article.articleSummary: Bangkok, Thailand—A 48-year-old man with secondary syphilis treated at Vichaiyut Hospital developed a rapid worsening of a trunk, arm, and thigh rash with fever and myalgia about six hours after penicillin injections. Clinicians diagnosed a Jarisch–Herxheimer reaction, not a drug allergy, and urged the patient to continue antibiotic therapy rather than stop treatment. The case illustrates atypical presentations of syphilis in men and aligns with reports of rising cases among younger people in Thailand. The patient has HIV infection for 11 years, well controlled on antiretroviral therapy, with unprotected sex two months earlier, a likely exposure. Health professionals urged regular screening for high-risk groups. The report emphasizes awareness of Herx reactions after penicillin in syphilis treatment and reinforces the need for ongoing, complete therapy and follow-up.

triage.headline_ja: 男性の第2期梅毒に非典型症状、タイの医師：若年層の症例が増加続く
triage.triage_reason: 個別患者の臨床症例報告であり、公衆衛生上の緊急性や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。若年層での梅毒増加傾向への言及はあるが、集団発生や新規異常事態を示すものではない。
triage.notes: 記事は単一患者のJarisch–Herxheimer反応に関する臨床報告が中心。タイでの若年層の梅毒増加という一般的傾向への言及はあるが、具体的な統計データやアウトブレイクの詳細は示されていない。

article.articleHeadline: சென்னையை உலுக்கும் டெங்கு ! தமிழகம் முழுவதும் 2000 பேருக்கு சிகிச்சை! குறுக்கே வந்த உண்ணி காய்ச்சல்!
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue sweeping through Chennai! Treatment for 2000 people across Tamil Nadu! A sudden outbreak of typhoid fever!
article.articleSummary: Tamil Nadu is grappling with a dengue fever surge, with around 2,000 patients hospitalized across government and private facilities; Chennai accounts for over 900 cases this month. In the past week, about 200 new dengue cases daily, and a single day saw 228 confirmed cases statewide, including 79 from Chennai. Aedes aegypti breeding and delayed monsoon are cited as drivers; authorities have urged intensified vector control and removal of stagnant water, with dedicated dengue wards in state hospitals. Separately, scrub typhus cases are rising, with 29 confirmed yesterday, bringing Tamil Nadu’s year-to-date scrub typhus total to about 4,700. A controversy over an Anna University student’s death saw health authorities deny dengue as the cause, attributing it to scrub typhus; hostel residents are undergoing medical testing. Officials stress seeking hospital care for persistent fever and increasing public awareness. Published 2026-09-22.

triage.headline_ja: チェンナイでデング熱が急増！タミル・ナードゥ州全体で2000人が治療中！ツツガムシ病の突発的流行も
triage.triage_reason: タミル・ナードゥ州で季節性のデング熱・ツツガムシ病の症例数が増加しているが、例年発生する季節性疾患であり異常性は低い。ただし症例数の急増と死亡例の原因論争があり、続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: デング熱・ツツガムシ病はインドの当該地域で季節性に発生する疾患であり、モンスーン遅延と蚊媒介対策不足が要因とされる。大学生の死亡原因についてデング熱か否かの論争があり、地域的な公衆衛生対応（専用病棟設置、ベクター対策強化）が進行中。国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低いと判断される。

article.articleHeadline: 印尼木薯餅驗出違規甜味劑　法國乾酪檢出大腸桿菌遭攔截｜壹蘋新聞網
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Indonesian cassava cake found to contain prohibited sweeteners; French cheese detected with Escherichia coli and intercepted — Nextapple News Network
article.articleSummary: Three Indonesian cassava-based snack products—cassava cake, Millennium cake, and a fruit/vegetable cassava cake—were found non-compliant for prohibited sweeteners. The Taiwan FDA detected saccharin at 0.02–0.06 g/kg and cyclamate at 0.04–0.38 g/kg, additives not permitted in these foods, prompting intensified inspections and 100% batch testing for some items. Separately, two batches of French-imported cheese exceeded microbial limits, with Escherichia coli counts per gram of 23–1100 CFU/g and >1100 CFU/g; dairy standards require no sample above 100 CFU/g, so these products were returned or destroyed. In the past six months, 1,539 batches of other French cheeses were tested, with 7 non-conforming (≈0.5%) due to E. coli and pathogenic E. coli. To reinforce border controls, the TFDA raised sampling to 20–50% for Indonesian cassava products and other French cheeses, continuing surveillance.

triage.headline_ja: インドネシア産キャッサバケーキから違反甘味料検出、フランス産チーズから大腸菌検出で輸入差し止め｜壹蘋新聞網
triage.triage_reason: 台湾の輸入食品検査における規制違反事例であり、公衆衛生上の緊急性や人への感染拡大リスクは認められず、通常の食品安全管理の範囲内である。
triage.notes: 本件は台湾の食品輸入検査における違反事例報道であり、対象国（インドネシア、フランス、台湾）のうちインドネシアは対象国リストに含まれるが、事象自体はキャッサバ製品の甘味料規制違反であり大腸菌とは無関係。フランスのチーズの大腸菌汚染は対象国リストに含まれない国での出来事であり、いずれも感染症アウトブレイクではなく食品安全上の輸入管理事案のため対象国イベントとしての該当なし。

article.articleHeadline: Tak Perlu Panik, Ini Cara Mencegah Penularan Influenza A Menurut Pakar
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: No Need to Panic: Here’s How to Prevent the Transmission of Influenza A According to Experts
article.articleSummary: Influenza A infections have surged in hospitals across several regions, with surveillance data from Indonesia’s Ministry of Health (Kemenkes) showing the majority of detected cases occur in children aged 0–4 years, accounting for about 33%. Jakarta-based Kemenkes spokesperson Aji Muhawarman cautioned against overreaction, while noting the rise in August 2026. UGM microbiology expert Tri Wibawa said the circulating influenza A(H1N1) strain is a descendant of the 2009 pandemic H1N1 that has undergone genetic changes. Typical influenza symptoms include fever (often with chills), sore throat, cough, runny nose, muscle aches, headache, and fatigue. High-risk groups include children under 5, the elderly over 65, people with chronic diseases, and those with weakened immune systems. Tri outlined six preventive steps to minimize transmission, urging adherence to these measures in the community.

triage.headline_ja: パニックにならないで、専門家が語るインフルエンザA感染予防法
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアでインフルエンザA(H1N1)の症例増加が報告されているが、専門家は「パニックにならないよう」呼びかけており、深刻な公衆衛生上の緊急性を示す情報は限定的。続報を注視する。
triage.notes: 季節性インフルエンザA(H1N1)の症例増加であり、パンデミック株の変異体だが専門家は過度な懸念を否定。重症度や死亡者数など具体的な数値情報が記事内に不足しており、WATCHとして継続監視が妥当。

article.articleHeadline: Kasus Influenza A Sedang Meningkat: Kenali Gejala dan Penanganannya
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Influenza A Cases on the Rise: Recognize the Symptoms and Their Management
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-09-22, Influenza A cases are rising in Central Java, Indonesia, with a 10% month-over-month increase. Of specimens showing influenza-like symptoms, 44% were confirmed as Influenza A. National surveillance by the Ministry of Health reports the situation is controlled with no dangerous surge. Influenza A is a dynamic virus that mutates and reassorts, circulating seasonally as subtypes A(H1N1) and A(H3N2). Key symptoms include sudden high fever, dry cough, sore throat, muscle and joint pains, severe headache, fatigue, and nasal congestion. Most cases are self-limiting with supportive care: rest, hydration, and symptomatic treatment (antipyretics/anti-inflammatories as advised). Early recognition by health professionals is encouraged to reduce transmission, and facilities are prepared to care for patients as needed.

triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザAの通常範囲内の増加であり、当局も「コントロールされている」と報告しており、異常性・重篤性・国際的拡大の懸念は認められない。

article.articleHeadline: Kasus Influenza A Naik, BBLKM Surabaya Minta Waspadai Tanda Bahaya
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Influenza A cases rise, BBLKM Surabaya urges vigilance for warning signs.
article.articleSummary: Influenza A cases rose across East Java, Bali, West Nusa Tenggara (NTB), and East Nusa Tenggara (NTT) through week 37 of 2026, per BBLKM Surabaya, the sentinel ILI-SARI laboratory for four provinces. By week 37, 632 specimens had been received; 51 ILI-SARI specimens were tested that week, with an overall influenza positivity of 21%. Influenza A positives were 16 for H1N1pdm09 and 4 for H3N2 (up from 9 and 3 the prior week). Among positive influenza, H1N1pdm09 and H3N2 each accounted for 42%, while influenza B Victoria lineage accounted for 16%. About 42% of specimens came from babies and toddlers; the overall male-to-female distribution among tested samples was 60% to 40%. Symptoms resemble COVID-19, with droplet transmission; public health guidance calls for hand hygiene, masking when ill, distancing, proper cough etiquette, and prompt medical care for warning signs.

triage.headline_ja: インフルエンザA型症例増加、スラバヤBBLKMが危険な兆候への警戒を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: 東ジャワ・バリ・ヌサトゥンガラ地域における季節性インフルエンザ（H1N1pdm09・H3N2）の定点サーベイランス報告であり、重症例や異常な流行拡大の記載はなく、通常の季節変動の範囲内と判断される。
triage.notes: 季節性インフルエンザの定点サーベイランス（ILI-SARI）データに基づく通常の週次報告。死亡や重症例、異常な感染拡大の記述なし。乳幼児の検体割合が高い点は注視事項だが、緊急性を示す情報は見られない。

article.articleHeadline: Apa itu influenza A dan bagaimana bahayanya?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: What is Influenza A and how dangerous is it?
article.articleSummary: Influenza A is under watch in Indonesia as detections rise across regions, with IDAI urging mapping of spread since many cases involve children. Ministry of Health data through 19 September 2026 show 46% positivity in week 36 from 185 specimens, with 86 positives: 76 A(H1N1)pdm09, 8 A(H3N2), and 2 Influenza B Victoria. Forty-two percent of cases are in children aged 0–4. Overall influenza activity remains low and controlled, but A(H1N1)pdm09 is part of seasonal circulation, not a new pandemic. Transmission is by respiratory droplets; Indonesia experiences year-round activity with possible increases during rainy season. Symptoms include fever, cough, sore throat, congestion, headache, myalgia, and fatigue; cough may persist two weeks or more. High-risk groups include under-5s, elders, pregnant women, and those with chronic diseases. A(H3N2) subclade K, first detected Sept 2025, reached 74 cases in 13 provinces by Jan 2026 and remains in 13 provinces as of 19 Sept 2026.

triage.headline_ja: インフルエンザAとは何か、その危険性は?
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアで季節性インフルエンザA(H1N1)pdm09やH3N2の検出数増加が報告されているが、記事自体が『流行は低く制御下にあり、新規パンデミックではない』と明言しており、重症度や国際的拡大の情報は不足しているため、経過観察が妥当と判断した。
triage.notes: IDAI（インドネシア小児科学会）が小児例の多さを踏まえ拡散状況のマッピングを呼びかけているが、保健省データでは全体的な流行状況は低水準かつ制御下にあると報告されている。重症度・入院率・死亡数などの詳細情報は記事に記載がなく、今後の推移を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: 3 ca tử vong do bệnh tay chân miệng và sốt xuất huyết tại Lâm Đồng
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Three deaths due to hand, foot and mouth disease and dengue fever in Lâm Đồng Province.
article.articleSummary: Lam Dong Province, Vietnam, reports concurrent outbreaks of hand, foot and mouth disease (HFMD) and dengue fever as of mid-September 2026. HFMD cases exceed 4,200 with 2 deaths in Duc Trong district; dengue cases exceed 4,500 with 1 death. In the past week, five new HFMD clusters were identified, lifting total outbreaks to 75 since January, across communities and schools. Year-to-year comparisons show HFMD up by 2,040 cases and dengue up by 240. Authorities attribute surges to heavy rainfall and high humidity that promote mosquito breeding, with September's school return accelerating transmission among preschool and primary students. The provincial Department of Health is deploying measures to curb spread: source control, a campaign for environmental sanitation and larval control, strengthened triage and treatment in facilities, and early detection of severe HFMD and dengue signs. Lam Dong CDC will rapidly determine virus strains to assess risk and guide response.

triage.headline_ja: ラムドン省で手足口病とデング熱により3人死亡
triage.triage_reason: ベトナム・ラムドン省で手足口病とデング熱の同時流行が発生し、死者が出ているほか症例数が前年比で大幅増加しており、季節的流行拡大の兆候があるためフルリスク評価が望ましい。
triage.notes: 手足口病・デング熱ともにベトナムで季節性に流行する感染症だが、今回は前年比で症例数が大幅増（HFMD+2,040例、デング+240例）、死亡例も報告されており、地方保健当局が対策を強化中。国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは現時点で低いが、続報の注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: 食藥署揪3公噸印尼木薯餅、千禧餅甜味劑超標 法國乾酪大腸桿菌不合格
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: TFDA raids 3 metric tons of Indonesian cassava cakes; Millennium Cake sweetener exceeds limits; Escherichia coli not compliant in French cheese
article.articleSummary: Taiwan’s FDA (TFDA) reports border rejections of Indonesian snacks and French cheese in 2026. Over 3,000 kg of Indonesian grain- and fruit/vegetable-based foods, exported by Xiba Enterprises Co., Ltd., were found non-compliant for sweeteners: two batches of cassava cakes totaling 2,100 kg and one batch Millennium Cake 1,325 kg contained saccharin (0.02–0.06 g/kg) and cyclamate (0.04–0.06 g/kg); a third batch had saccharin 0.02 g/kg and cyclamate 0.38 g/kg. These items must be returned or destroyed; Indonesian grain-based foods are sampled 100% per batch, fruit/vegetable-based foods 20–50% ( intensified from 2026-06-02 to 2026-10-21; Indonesian checks 20–50% from 2026-09-22 to 2026-10-21). Two French cheeses imported by Lianfu Foods Co., Ltd. contained Escherichia coli counts per g ranging 23–1,100 and >1,100 CFU/g; among five samples, limits allow at most two samples between 10–100 CFU/g, with none exceeding 100 CFU/g. They must be returned or destroyed. From 2026-03-14 to 2026-09-14, 1,539 French-cheese batches were inspected with 7 failures (0.5%). Border checks for French cheese continue at 20–50% (2026-09-22 to 2026-10-21).

triage.headline_ja: 食薬署が3トンのインドネシア産キャッサバケーキを摘発、千禧餅の甘味料が基準超過、フランス産チーズの大腸菌検査も不合格
triage.triage_reason: 国境検疫による食品規制違反（添加物超過・大腸菌検出）の事例であり、公衆衛生上の広範な影響やヒト-ヒト感染のリスクは認められない。輸入食品の水際措置であり、シグナルとしての基準に該当しない。
triage.notes: これは台湾の食品安全当局による定型的な輸入食品検査報告であり、感染症アウトブレイクの兆候ではない。フランス・台湾は対象国リストに含まれないため除外。インドネシア産食品が対象となっているためIndonesiaのみ記載。

article.articleHeadline: Woman tests positive for Mpox at Pims
article.articleSummary: In Islamabad, Pakistan, a 41-year-old woman admitted to the Pakistan Institute of Medical Sciences (Pims) tested positive for Mpox, with samples confirmed by the National Institute of Health (NIH). The patient, presenting with facial skin lesions, was placed in the Infectious Control Ward and is reported to be out of danger and improving. Mpox is a viral zoonosis that WHO declared a global health emergency in July 2022 and renamed from monkeypox in November 2022 due to stigma concerns. The disease spreads via close contact and causes flu-like symptoms and pus-filled lesions; a rash often starts on the face after fever and then spreads. Two clades exist: Clade I (Congo Basin) more severe (up to 10% mortality) and Clade II (West African) less severe with high survival. Transmission occurs through contact with infected animals, humans, or contaminated materials; isolation remains a key component of case management.

triage.headline_ja: パキスタンの女性がPIMSでMpox陽性反応
triage.triage_reason: パキスタンで発生した単発のMpox症例であり、患者は回復中で重症度・国際的拡大リスクは低い。また発生国は本評価の対象国リストに含まれない。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はパキスタン（Islamabad）での単発Mpox症例。DRCやナイジェリア、アンゴラは疾患説明の背景情報として言及されているのみで、実際の発生地ではない。対象国リストにパキスタンは含まれないためverified_locationsは空配列とした。

article.articleHeadline: Chennai hospitals struggle with surge in flu, respiratory infections and dengue
article.articleSummary: Chennai private hospitals report a sharp surge in respiratory infections, influenza (including H1N1), and dengue ahead of the monsoon, fueling crowded outpatient departments, full wards, and emergency bed waits up to 12 hours. ICU-to-ward transfers are also delayed due to high demand. Most infections are mild and resolve with medication, rest, and hydration, but elderly patients and those with comorbidities are at risk for severe illness; fatalities are uncommon but possible. Common symptoms include high fever, sore throat, cold, persistent cough, severe body and leg pain, chest discomfort, fatigue, and loss of appetite; children may have prolonged fever and extreme exhaustion, with rare delirium. Some patients need nebulisation or IV fluids, adding to admissions. RSV, adenovirus, rhinovirus, and parainfluenza drive much of the caseload, alongside influenza/H1N1 and dengue. Early medical care, hand hygiene, masks in crowded places, and intensified mosquito-control measures are urged as monsoon approaches to curb transmission.

triage.headline_ja: チェンナイの病院、インフルエンザ・呼吸器感染症・デング熱の急増に苦慮
triage.triage_reason: 季節性の感染症（インフルエンザ、RSV、デング熱等）の増加であり、通常の季節的傾向の範囲内と考えられるが、医療体制逼迫の情報があるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: モンスーン期を前にした季節性感染症の増加であり、複数病原体（インフルエンザ/H1N1、RSV、アデノウイルス、デング熱等）が混在。重症例は稀とされ、致死率も低いとの記述あり。医療機関の逼迫（病床待ち12時間等）は注視すべきだが、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低い。

article.articleHeadline: Casos de dengue caem 62,5% em MT, mas chuvas reforçam alerta
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue cases fall 62.5% in Mato Grosso, but rains reinforce the alert.
article.articleSummary: Dengue cases in Mato Grosso fall 62.6% in 2026 through Sept 12, totaling 12,107 with 14 deaths (2025: 30). Chikungunya: 1,245 notifications, two confirmed deaths (one under investigation); Zika: 328 notifications, no deaths. Brazil-wide dengue cases drop about 70.25%. In Cuiabá, autochthonous dengue reaches 878 with 3 deaths; chikungunya 133 cases (no deaths); Zika 3 cases. The 36th epidemiological week shows dengue average 51.2 cases/week (6% below 2025); chikungunya average 4 (down 98.7%). Endemic-control teams in Cuiabá conducted 805,397 property inspections in 2026; 87,158 properties treated; 97,270 deposits treated; 23,268 deposits eliminated. About 80% of mosquito breeding sites are inside homes. Qdenga dengue vaccine is available for ages 10–14 in a two-dose schedule. If symptoms arise, seek health care and continue prevention, especially with upcoming rains.

triage.headline_ja: マット・グロッソ州のデング熱症例が62.5%減少、しかし降雨により警戒強化
triage.triage_reason: デング熱症例数は前年比で大幅減少しており、異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められない定例の公衆衛生報告である。
triage.notes: 季節性のデング熱・チクングニア熱・ジカ熱に関する定期的な地域保健当局の報告。症例数は前年より減少しており、雨季到来に伴う一般的な注意喚起の内容。

article.articleHeadline: டெங்குவை விட கொடூரம்.. சென்னை மாணவர் உயிரை பறித்த உண்ணிக் காய்ச்சல்! இந்த அறிகுறிகளை கவனிங்க!
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Worse than dengue.. Enteric fever that claimed the life of a Chennai student! Watch out for these symptoms.
article.articleSummary: Scrub Typhus (Orientia tsutsugamushi) caused a fatal outcome in Chennai, where a 20-year-old Anna University student, Harish, died after fever and suspected scrub typhus. This year Chennai reports its first scrub typhus death, with 173 lab-confirmed cases, per the corporation. The infection is not mosquito-borne; it is transmitted by larval mites (chiggers) that bite humans in dense vegetation, farms, and around homes, with rats as natural hosts. Incubation is about 1-3 weeks after bite. Symptoms include fever, chills, headache, body pains, fatigue, and abdominal discomfort; some develop an eschar at the bite site. Severe complications can include pneumonia, meningitis, kidney injury, respiratory distress, and multi-organ failure if not treated early. There is no vaccine; prevention relies on avoiding mite exposure, wearing protective clothing, trimming vegetation, and rodent control. Seek urgent medical care if symptoms appear after field exposure and inform clinicians.

triage.headline_ja: デングより危険…チェンナイの学生の命を奪ったツツガムシ病！これらの症状に注意
triage.triage_reason: チェンナイでツツガムシ病による死亡例が報告されたが、インドでは同疾患は地域的に流行しており、ヒト-ヒト感染もなく国際的拡大リスクは低い。ただし重症化・死亡例があり継続的な症例動向の確認が必要。
triage.notes: ツツガムシ病はインドで地域的に流行しており、ダニ媒介性でヒト-ヒト感染なし。今年チェンナイで173例の確定診断例と初の死亡例が報告されているが、国際的な公衆衛生上の脅威とは言えない。地域の症例数の推移を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Wamendagri Wiyagus Dorong Kolaborasi Lintas Sektor Wujudkan Kota Banjar Bebas TB
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Deputy Minister of Home Affairs Wiyagus Encourages Cross-Sector Collaboration to Make Banjar City TB-Free
article.articleSummary: Deputy Minister of Home Affairs Akhmad Wiyagus urged Banjar City, West Java, to strengthen cross-sector collaboration to achieve a TB-free status, aiming for declaration within 3–6 months. TB cases have been identified in Banjar, and addressing the outbreak requires multi-sector involvement beyond the health department. TB affects productivity and socio-economic conditions, with lengthy treatment; when the patient is the head of a family, it can disrupt earnings and strain relatives during therapy. TB is included in local planning and the APBD. Wiyagus called for expanding interventions to the village level through Desa Siaga TB, involving village heads, Babinsa, puskesmas chiefs, Posyandu, and PKK, noting West Java has only a few such villages. He also emphasized ongoing contact tracing and TB preventive therapy (TPT) to curb transmission and prevent new cases, at a cross-sector meeting and free health checks in Banjar on 2026-09-21 (reported 2026-09-22).

triage.headline_ja: 内務副大臣ウィヤグス、バンジャール市のTBフリー実現へ多分野協働を促進
triage.triage_reason: 既知の風土病である結核に関する行政・地域啓発活動の記事であり、異常事態や国際的拡大リスク、社会的関心の急激な高まりは見られない。
triage.notes: 結核は既知の風土病であり、本記事は行政主導の地域啓発・多分野協働キャンペーンに関する通常の公衆衛生活動報告。新規異常事態ではないためDISMISS。

article.articleHeadline: Cara Penularan HIV yang Paling Umum, Lewat Seks hingga Jarum Suntik
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Most Common Ways HIV Is Transmitted, From Sex to Needles.
article.articleSummary: HIV transmission occurs through specific body fluids—blood, semen, vaginal fluid, and breast milk—when they contact mucous membranes, damaged tissue, or enter the bloodstream. In Indonesia, the Health Ministry cites these routes alongside guidance from WHO and CDC. The main transmission pathways are: (1) sexual contact (vaginal or anal) without protection; oral sex rarely, but possible; (2) sharing needles or contaminated injection or surgical instruments; (3) non-sterile tattoo tools; (4) transfusion of infected blood (risks now low due to donor screening); (5) mother-to-child transmission during pregnancy, birth, or breastfeeding, with risk influenced by maternal health and treatment. HIV is not transmitted by casual contact, such as handshakes, hugging, sharing meals, or saliva, nor by ordinary kisses unless deep bleeding occurs. Understanding transmission helps prevention and reduces stigma; early detection and treatment are key.

triage.headline_ja: HIV感染の最も一般的な経路——性交渉から注射針まで
triage.triage_reason: HIV感染経路に関する一般的な啓発記事であり、特定の発生事例やアウトブレイクに関する報告ではないため、シグナルに該当しない。
triage.notes: 本記事はHIV感染経路に関する一般的な教育・啓発コンテンツであり、具体的な感染事例やアウトブレイクの報告ではない。

article.articleHeadline: நல்லவேளை கொரோனா டைமில் விஜய் ஆட்சி இல்லை.. டெங்கு பரவல்.. கடுமையாக சொதப்பும் தவெக அரசு
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: For a change, there is no Vijay rule in the COVID era.. Dengue spread.. The Tavek government is dragging its feet badly.
article.articleSummary: Rapid dengue fever outbreak in Tamil Nadu, with Chennai and districts Chengalpattu, Thiruvallur, Coimbatore, Salem, Krishnagiri, and Tiruvannamalai reporting a surge. Daily admissions 200-250; total cases exceed 16,500 this year, with nine deaths. The piece criticizes the state government’s pre-monsoon preventive slackness and inadequate vector control (larviciding and fogging) despite claims of over 25,000 sanitation workers deployed; many areas reportedly not sprayed. It contrasts current administration’s handling with DMK’s COVID-era measures, which included aggressive field operations, surveillance, containment zones, and vaccination drives that brought outbreaks under control. Public calls for urgent on-ground action: eliminate standing water and clogged drains, intensify fumigation, and ensure sufficient diagnostic testing and medicines at primary health centers. The narrative underscores political blame and the need for immediate operational response rather than promotional statements.

triage.headline_ja: COVID時代にはヴィジャイ政権はなかったのが幸い…デング熱が拡大…TVK政権が大きく失態
triage.triage_reason: タミルナードゥ州でデング熱症例が16,500件を超え死者9名に達し、ベクター対策の不備に対する社会的・政治的批判が高まっているため、WPRO基準複数該当かつ社会的関心も高い。
triage.notes: COVID-19は過去の対応との比較文脈で言及されているのみで、実際の感染症イベントはデング熱の季節的アウトブレイク。インドでは毎年発生する疾患だが、今年は症例数・死者数が多く、州政府のベクター対策不備への政治的批判が強い。

article.articleHeadline: Ini Perbedaan Gejala Influenza A dan Selesma Menurut IDAI
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Differences in Symptoms Between Influenza A and the Common Cold, According to IDAI
article.articleSummary: Influenza A and the common cold differ in cause, symptoms, and severity, according to IDAI in Jakarta, Indonesia. Influenza is caused by influenza A (subtypes H1N1 and H3N2) along with B, C, and D, with A mutating rapidly and crossing species, notably pigs. The common cold is usually rhinovirus-driven. Clinically, colds are milder and centered on the head and nose; influenza progresses quickly and can affect the whole body, with higher risk of complications. Amid rising Influenza A cases, IDAI warns groups at risk—children, the elderly, pregnant women, and those with comorbidities. Prevention emphasizes vaccination and PHBS: handwashing, good nutrition and hydration, ventilation, morning sun exposure, and masking in closed crowds. For treatment, paracetamol may relieve symptoms; antibiotics are not advised since influenza is viral. The virus can persist on surfaces, underscoring environmental hygiene.

triage.headline_ja: インフルエンザAと風邪の症状の違い、IDAI（インドネシア小児科医会）による解説
triage.triage_reason: 一般向けの症状解説記事であり、アウトブレイクの規模・重症度・異常性に関する具体的情報がなく、公衆衛生上の緊急性を示す内容ではない。
triage.notes: 記事は季節性インフルエンザAと風邪の鑑別に関する啓発記事であり、具体的な症例数・アウトブレイク情報は含まれていない。インドネシアでの「増加傾向」との記述はあるが定量的根拠がないため対象国としては計上しない。

article.articleHeadline: 聯馥食品又出包！2批「法國乾酪」大腸桿菌數超標全退運
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Lianfu Foods Hits Another Snag! Two Batches of 'French Cheese' Exceed E. coli Limits, All Shipments Recalled.
article.articleSummary: Two batches of French cheese imported by Lianfu Foods Co., Ltd. from France exceeded E. coli limits at Taiwan border, totaling about 4.56 kg; all lots were recalled or destroyed. E. coli counts ranged from 23 to over 1,100 MPN/g across five samples, exceeding the regulatory maximum of 100 MPN/g. The Taiwan FDA noted 100% batch checking for Lianfu, with 1,539 French cheese shipments inspected in the past six months and 7 nonconforming (0.5%). From Sep 22 to Oct 21, border checks on French cheeses were intensified (20–50% sampling). Separately, three Indonesian-grain/fruit-vegetable foods from Xi Ba Enterprises failed due to noncompliant sweeteners (saccharin and cyclamate), totaling over 3 metric tons to be returned or destroyed (2100 kg tapioca cakes, 1325 kg Millennium cakes, and a third batch). A total of 12 border items were noncompliant, including Chinese paper spoon containers, fresh white radish, and Thai cabbage dried with test/pesticide/sweetener issues.

triage.headline_ja: 聯馥食品またもや問題発生！フランス産チーズ2バッチが大腸菌基準超過で全量返送
triage.triage_reason: 国境検査で発見された食品輸入時の規制違反事案であり、ヒト感染症のアウトブレイクや公衆衛生上の緊急事態を示すものではない。
triage.notes: 本記事は台湾の食品輸入検査における大腸菌基準超過及び甘味料規制違反による返送・廃棄処分の報告であり、感染症アウトブレイク事例ではない。フランス産チーズの話であり、対象国リストのいずれの国も実際の発生地域として該当しない（Taiwan、Franceは対象国リスト外）。

article.articleHeadline: விழுப்புரத்தில் டெங்கு அலர்ட்! 43 பேர் பாதிப்பு... அரசு மருத்துவமனையில் தனி வார்டு
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue alert in Villupuram! 43 people affected... a separate ward in the government hospital.
article.articleSummary: As of 22 September 2026, Villupuram district, Tamil Nadu, reports 43 dengue fever cases under treatment, indicating an ongoing dengue outbreak. A dedicated 40-bed dengue ward has been established at Mundiyampakkam Government Hospital to manage patients. District Collector Sheikh Abdul Rahman announced the figures and the facility arrangement. In a separate public health effort, the district launched an expanded Kamarajar Breakfast Scheme at Govt Model Girls Higher Secondary School, with the program now active in 504 schools and benefitting 44,709 students. Officials said meal quality and safety are checked daily to ensure nutrition. The report notes no laboratory confirmation details in the article beyond government statements, and highlights local government actions to protect student nutrition while addressing the dengue situation in Villupuram.

triage.headline_ja: ヴィルップラムでデング熱警報！43人感染... 政府病院に専用病棟を設置
triage.triage_reason: インド・タミルナドゥ州の一地域でのデング熱流行だが、季節性のローカルな流行であり国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低い。今後の症例数推移を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: デング熱はインドで季節性・地方流行性の感染症であり、43例という規模は地域レベルでは管理可能とみられる。ラボ確認情報がなく、重症度の詳細も不明。

article.articleHeadline: Leptospirosis cases breach epidemic threshold, DOH says
article.articleSummary: Leptospirosis outbreaks in the Philippines exceed the epidemic threshold with 46 provinces, highly urbanized cities and independent component cities across 10 regions affected. As of 16 September, 10,936 suspected cases were reported, 38% higher than 7,931 in the same period in 2025, and a 3–4 week period was 116% higher than the previous 5–6 weeks. The cumulative case fatality rate stands at 5.1%, down from 10.55% last year. The surge is linked to persistent rains and flooding; exposed individuals are urged to seek medical advice, and treatment should start on clinical suspicion even before lab confirmation to prevent complications. By 21 September, DOH distributed 1,677,300 doxycycline capsules to regional offices, with 3,727,359 remaining as buffer stock. Forty-five leptospirosis fast lanes operate in DOH hospital EDs across NCR, Cordillera, Ilocos, Cagayan Valley, Central Luzon, Calabarzon, Mimaropa and Bicol. No information on imported/exported cases.

triage.headline_ja: レプトスピラ症の症例数が流行閾値を超過、DOHが発表
triage.triage_reason: フィリピン全土46州で流行閾値を超え、前年比38%増・致死率5.1%と公衆衛生への影響が深刻であり、IHR基準の2項目（深刻性・異常性）に該当するためフルRRAへの移行が妥当。
triage.notes: レプトスピラ症は人獣共通感染症でヒト-ヒト感染は基本的にないため国際的拡大リスクは低いが、洪水・豪雨による曝露継続と症例急増により国内公衆衛生上の懸念は大きい。DOHは抗生物質配布やfast lane設置など対応中で、外部支援の必要性については記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: Kasus Gangguan Pernapasan di Jabar Meningkat, Dinkes Soroti Influenza Tipe A
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Increase in cases of respiratory disorders in West Java, Health Office highlights Influenza Type A.
article.articleSummary: As of 22 September 2026, West Java’s health authorities report rising respiratory disorders in Depok and Bogor Regency, with influenza type A detected in several hospitals. Surveillance through influenza-like illness (ILI) and severe acute respiratory infection (SARI) shows an uptick linked to the volcanic ash dust event, though total cases remain below the monitored threshold. Influenza A infections are characterized by high fever (often above 40°C), fatigue, cough, runny nose, and body aches. Authorities urge reinforced hygiene, continued adherence to health protocols, and masking for the sick to limit transmission, while promoting immune health via nutritious meals, rest, and handwashing after outdoor activities. Vulnerable groups—children, the elderly, and those with comorbidities—require extra attention; hospital care is advised if pneumonia signs appear. District-level data are incomplete due to costly testing, and swab uptake has waned since Covid.

triage.headline_ja: 西ジャワ州で呼吸器疾患の症例が増加、保健局はA型インフルエンザに注目
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザA型の症例増加であり、監視閾値を下回っている。火山灰との関連が疑われる一時的な事象で、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 症例数は監視閾値未満であり、火山灰による一時的な呼吸器症状増加との関連が示唆されている。既知の季節性インフルエンザA型であり、新規病原体や異常な重症度は報告されていない。

article.articleHeadline: தமிழ்நாட்டில் அதிகரிக்கும் டெங்கு! இதுவரை 17,348 பேர் பாதிப்பு!
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue on the rise in Tamil Nadu! So far, 17,348 people affected.
article.articleSummary: As of 22 September 2026, Tamil Nadu reports dengue fever affecting 17,348 people, with 71 new cases confirmed yesterday, including 11 in Chennai. The total rose from 17,277. Scrub typhus accounts for 4,653 cases statewide. With dengue transmission described as intense, authorities are intensifying vector-control measures in Chennai and other urban municipalities, running medical camps and prevention drives in affected areas. The report notes ongoing efforts to curb spread through mosquito elimination and fever-management services, reflecting a persistent outbreak scenario in the state.

triage.headline_ja: タミル・ナードゥ州でデング熱が増加！これまでに17,348人が感染
triage.triage_reason: 毎年季節的に発生するデング熱・つつが虫病の増加であり、公的な対策も実施中だが、感染者数の増加傾向が続いているため経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: デング熱・つつが虫病ともにインド・タミル・ナードゥ州で毎年報告される季節性感染症であり、地元当局が媒介動物対策を強化している。重症度や死亡者数の情報はなし。

article.articleHeadline: Influenza Berat Melanda Malang, Warga Keluhkan Nyeri Tubuh
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Severe influenza hits Malang, residents complain of body aches.
article.articleSummary: Severe influenza detected in Kota Malang, East Java, with 12 cases of influenza A subtype H3N2 (superflu) among 20 influenza cases detected from January–August 2026. The remainder include seven influenza A H1N1 and one influenza B Victoria. Confirmatory testing was conducted on patient mucus samples at BBLabkesmas Surabaya and the Health Research and Development Agency (Litbangkes). Symptoms reported include cough, runny nose, sore throat, fever, and body aches; H3N2 is highlighted as potentially more severe, causing hoarse voice, fever, and systemic pains. Infections fall under influenza-like illness (ILI) and can progress to severe acute respiratory infection (SARI), for which treatment occurs in hospitals such as RSUD Saiful Anwar Malang; however, no SARI reports have been received yet. Transmission may be influenced by dust, vehicle exhaust, and smoke exposure. Dinkes Kota Malang urges masks, especially when outside or in crowds.

triage.headline_ja: 重度のインフルエンザがマラン市を襲う、住民は体の痛みを訴える
triage.triage_reason: 2026年1〜8月の8か月間で20例（H3N2 12例、H1N1 7例、B型1例）と少数であり、季節性インフルエンザの一般的な株で構成され、SARI（重症急性呼吸器感染症）の報告もないため、公衆衛生上の重大な懸念は認められない。
triage.notes: 報道されているH3N2は「スーパーフル」と俗称されているが、実際は季節性インフルエンザの既知株であり、症例数も8か月間で20例と少ない。地元保健局（Dinkes Kota Malang）はマスク着用を呼びかける程度の対応にとどまり、外部支援の必要性は示唆されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Influenza A Mulai Jadi Sorotan, Dinkes DKI: Belum Ada Lonjakan Signifikan di Jakarta
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Influenza A Begins to Draw Attention, DKI Jakarta Health Office: No Significant Surge Yet in Jakarta.
article.articleSummary: Influenza A draws attention in Indonesia as Jakarta reports no significant surge. DKI Jakarta Health Office notes acute respiratory infection (ISPA) cases in the capital rose about 15.7%—consistent with seasonal patterns—yet this increase does not yet indicate a rise in Influenza A infections, according to Dinkes DKI Jakarta Director Ani Ruspitawati. Data from Puskesmas and patient visits via SIRS Online show ISPA upticks but not a clear influenza spike. Health authorities urge the public to stay calm and follow proper hygiene: clean hands with soap, mask when ill or in crowded places, cough etiquette, adequate nutrition, fluids, and rest. Separately, WHO Western Pacific Region data as of 10 September 2026 show Southeast Asian countries with higher influenza positivity: Singapore 24–37%, Brunei 28%, Malaysia 19–20%, Vietnam 7–20%, while Indonesia has not observed a worrying surge, per MoH.

triage.headline_ja: インフルエンザAが注目され始める、DKIジャカルタ保健局:ジャカルタではまだ顕著な急増なし
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアでは現時点で顕著な感染急増は確認されていないが、近隣東南アジア諸国でインフルエンザ陽性率上昇が報告されており、季節性動向として経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はインドネシア(ジャカルタ)における季節性ISPA増加とインフルエンザA非急増を主題としており、ベトナムはWHO西太平洋地域データの一部として言及されている程度。ブルネイ、マレーシア、シンガポールは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Dengue cases down 33% from 2025, DOH says
article.articleSummary: Dengue cases in the country show a year-to-date drop of 33% from 2025, even as recent weeks trend upward. From 20 August to 2 September, 19,792 dengue cases were reported, a 14% increase from 17,342 cases recorded 6–19 August. The Department of Health (DOH) cautioned against complacency despite lower year-to-date figures and urged households and communities to eliminate or cover containers with stagnant water, a key mosquito breeding site. Dengue is a viral infection transmitted to humans by bites from infected Aedes mosquitoes. The report provides no details on symptoms, laboratory confirmation, or imported/exported cases. These figures underscore ongoing transmission risk and the need for sustained vector control to prevent further spikes.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱症例、2025年比33%減も直近では増加傾向-フィリピン保健省
triage.triage_reason: フィリピンで例年発生しているデング熱の定期的な統計報告であり、年間としては減少傾向だが直近数週間で増加が見られるため、今後の推移を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: デング熱はフィリピンで毎年発生する風土病であり、本記事は定例の疫学統計報告。直近2週間で14%増加している点は継続監視が必要だが、重症度や死亡者数等の詳細情報はなし。

article.articleHeadline: चेन्नई में फ्लू, डेंगू और सांस की बीमारियों के कारण अस्पतालों में मरीजों की भारी भीड़
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Overcrowding of patients in Chennai hospitals due to flu, dengue, and respiratory illnesses.
article.articleSummary: As of 22 September 2026, Chennai's private hospitals report overcrowding due to rising flu, dengue, and other respiratory illnesses. Emergency departments face up to 12-hour waits for beds; ICU-to-general ward transfers are delayed due to bed shortages, and OPD queues are long. Most infections are mild, but elderly and patients with comorbidities remain at risk for severe disease. Predominant symptoms include high fever, sore throat, runny nose, persistent cough, body and leg pains, chest discomfort, fatigue, and loss of appetite; children may exhibit prolonged fever and fatigue, with occasional anxiety or confusion. Laboratory-identified viruses involve RSV, adenovirus, rhinovirus, and parainfluenza, with notable activity from influenza (including H1N1) and dengue. Health officials advise against self-medication, emphasize fever monitoring, hand hygiene, masking in crowded places, and reducing contact with infected individuals. Some patients require nebulization or IV fluids, contributing to admissions.

triage.headline_ja: チェンナイの病院、インフルエンザ・デング熱・呼吸器疾患の急増で患者が殺到
triage.triage_reason: 季節性のインフル・RSV・デング熱による医療逼迫だが、既知病原体で国際的拡大の証拠はなく、社会的関心の高まりも不明なため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 季節性の複合呼吸器感染症（インフルエンザ、RSV、デング熱等）による病院の混雑。病原体自体は既知で新規性は低いが、医療リソース逼迫の状況を継続的に注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: चेन्नई में फ्लू, डेंगू और सांस की बीमारियों के कारण अस्पतालों में मरीजों की भारी भीड़ - Punjab Kesari
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Chennai Experiences Heavy Influx of Patients at Hospitals Due to Influenza, Dengue, and Respiratory Illnesses.
article.articleSummary: Chennai private hospitals report a rapid rise in influenza, respiratory infections, and dengue, leading to long OPD queues, full wards, and emergency bed delays–some patients waiting up to 12 hours for a bed, with ICU-to-general ward transfers also slowed by space shortages. Though most infections are mild, elderly individuals and those with preexisting conditions face higher risk, and some patients require nebulization or IV fluids, boosting admissions. Common symptoms include high fever, sore throat, runny nose, persistent cough, body and leg pains, chest discomfort, fatigue, and loss of appetite; children may show prolonged fever and fatigue, with occasional confusion. Viruses such as RSV, adenovirus, rhinovirus, and parainfluenza are major contributors, alongside influenza (including H1N1) and dengue. Doctors urge not ignoring fever or self-medicating, and emphasize hand hygiene, distancing from the infected, and mask use in crowded places. (As of 22 September 2026, Chennai)

triage.headline_ja: チェンナイでインフルエンザ・デング熱・呼吸器感染症の患者急増により病院が混乱
triage.triage_reason: チェンナイの複数の病院でインフルエンザ、RSV、デング熱等の患者が急増し、病床・救急対応が逼迫しているとの報道があり、公衆衛生上の負荷とヒト-ヒト感染の可能性を示すWPRO基準に複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要と判断。
triage.notes: 季節性の呼吸器感染症・デング熱の同時流行によるものと考えられるが、病院の病床逼迫や待機時間の長期化が報告されており、地域の医療体制への負荷が懸念される。死亡者数・重症化率などの詳細情報は不足しており、続報の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Bakteri E coli Ditemukan pada MBG yang Bikin Siswa Kediri Keracunan
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: E. coli Bacteria Found on MBG That Sickened Kediri Students
article.articleSummary: Escherichia coli contamination linked to Kediri City's Free Nutritious Meals (MBG) program in East Java, Indonesia, following illness among students. Laboratory tests detected E. coli in MBG samples of rice (1 bacterium) and melon (7 bacteria); a chicken sample is still awaiting results. Investigations suggest contamination could arise during food processing—raw material quality, washing, storage, cooking, and the interval between cooking and distribution—along with packaging of hot foods. The Kediri Health Office will advise the Nutrition Service to rigorously enforce SOPs for food safety and sanitation in daily practice. Of 15 students treated at RSUD Gambiran Hospital, 13 have been discharged, with 2 still under observation. Symptoms ranged from mild to severe and appeared to vary with individual immune status. Report dated 22 September 2026.

triage.headline_ja: MBG給食からE.coli菌検出、ケディリの生徒が食中毒
triage.triage_reason: 学校給食プログラムにおける単発的な食中毒事例であり、感染者数も限定的（15名、うち13名退院）で国際的拡大の可能性は低い。
triage.notes: 地域の学校給食プログラムにおける食品衛生管理の問題であり、地元保健当局が既に対応中。ヒト-ヒト感染の可能性はなく、食品由来の限定的な事例。

article.articleHeadline: شیوع کرونا به مرحله خطرناک رسید/ نمونه‌های مثبت کووید-۱۹ برای پنجمین هفته متوالی افزایش داشته است
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The coronavirus outbreak has reached a dangerous stage / Positive COVID-19 samples have increased for the fifth consecutive week.
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 positives in Iran rose for the fifth consecutive week, per the Ministry of Health’s Center for Infectious Diseases. In week 26 of 1405 (ending 27 Shahrivar), outpatient influenza-like illness (ILI) was 6.5% and hospitalized severe acute respiratory infection (SARI) 7.4% (previous week 7.4% and 6.9%). Among 194 respiratory samples from ILI/SARI patients, influenza positives fell to 2% while COVID-19 positives rose to 17% for the fifth straight week (year-ago: 8.9%). Laboratory-based surveillance tested 4,907 respiratory samples (95.9% from inpatients); 108 influenza positives (2.2%), up 14.2% WoW, with influenza B dominating at ~75%. Children accounted for 32.4% of influenza positives (under 2: 9.3%; 2–5: 12%; 6–15: 11.1%). Bushehr led positivity (25.3%), with Hormozgan 8.6% and Khuzestan 5.6%. Tehran/Hormozgan samples for 21 pathogens showed rhinovirus 16.7% and COVID-19 11.7%. Globally, COVID-19 remains low but rising in East Asia/parts of Europe; influenza activity is increasing elsewhere; Iran’s RV.1 lineage noted.

triage.headline_ja: コロナウイルスの流行が危険な段階に達した／COVID-19陽性者数が5週連続で増加
triage.triage_reason: イランにおける季節性のCOVID-19・インフルエンザサーベイランスの通常報告であり、対象国（中国等）が主題として扱われておらず、異常性や国際的拡大の兆候も乏しい。
triage.notes: 記事はイランの週次呼吸器感染症サーベイランス報告であり、中国（上海）は発生地域リストに含まれるがサマリー本文では主題として言及されていないため対象国から除外した。
